local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldBrandNewPizzaSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = AfterWorldBrandNewPizza @
		Comment = 첫 이벤트 시작 ~ 피자 건내주기까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'afterworld_1_2'

	-- ======== 필드 오브젝트 & 캐릭터 이름들 ========
	self.sales_female_name_prefix = 'pizza_female_'
	self.sales_male_name_prefix = 'pizza_male_'
	self.pizza_fo_name = 'brand_new_pizza'
	self.star_piece_name = 'pizza_star_piece'

	-- ======== 이벤트 존 이름 ========
	self.pizza_meeting_room = 'pizza_sales_meeting'

	-- ======== 아이템 스펙 아이디 ========
	self.pizza_box_id = 20503
	self.pizza_id = 20523

	-- ======== 아이템 스프라이트 이름 ========
	self.pizza_sprite_name = 'afterworld_hell_pie'

	-- ======== 캐싱 ========
	self.pizza_sprite = nil
	self.pizza_box_cache = {}
	self.wasted_pizza_box_cache = {}

	-- ======== 대사 스크립트 키 ========
	self.script_key = 'aw_pizza_s1_'

	-- ======== 이벤트의 섹션 관련 ========
	self.event_section = {
		none = 1,
		entered_meeting_room = 2,
		introduced_brand_new_pizza = 3
	}
	self.current_section = self.event_section.none

	-- ======== FIXME: Temporal ========
	self.game_ended = false

	self.is_eating_pizza = false

	-- ======== Getters ========
	---@param idx int
	---@return Character
	function self.get_sales_male_by_idx(idx)
		return get_character(self.sales_male_name_prefix .. idx)
	end

	---@param idx int
	---@return Character
	function self.get_sales_female_by_idx(idx)
		return get_character(self.sales_female_name_prefix .. idx)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:set_npcs()
	self:set_pizza_boxes()
	self:cache_wasted_pizza_boxes()

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debug_loop, self))
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	--message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	-- 피자 박스들 전부 해제
	for i = 1, #self.pizza_box_cache do
		self.pizza_box_cache[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		self.pizza_box_cache[i] = nil
	end
	self.pizza_box_cache = nil

	self.game_ended = true

	if self.pizza_sprite ~= nil then
		self.pizza_sprite:ConsumeComplete()
		self.pizza_sprite = nil
	end

	if self.pizza_box_sprite ~= nil then
		self.pizza_box_sprite:ConsumeComplete()
		self.pizza_box_sprite = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	return false
end

-- FIXME:
function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

			party_util.align_party(field:GetMarker('reset_gatekeeper').position, 'left', 0)
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

			-- 카메라 그리드 변경 기다림
			coroutine.yield()

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
			party_util.reset_controllers()
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.pizza_meeting_room then
		local leader_action_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		local is_holding_pizza = (leader_action_state ~= nil)
				and (lua_helper.type_compare(leader_action_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState))
				and self:is_fo_wasted_pizza_box(leader_action_state.HoldTarget)


		if self.current_section == self.event_section.none then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_pizza_sales_meeting, self)
		elseif self.current_section == self.event_section.entered_meeting_room then
			if is_holding_pizza then
				self.current_section = self.event_section.introduced_brand_new_pizza
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_brand_new_pizza_surprises_attendance, self)
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 저승내 파인애플 피자의 부정적 반응에 대해 회의 중인 사람들.
function local_class:play_pizza_sales_meeting()
	self.current_section = self.event_section.entered_meeting_room

	-- 카메라 회의 장소로 이동
	---@type Vector3
	local meeting_room_center = field:GetMarker('pizza_meeting_room_center').position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(meeting_room_center, 1)

	local senior = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(1)
	local female_1 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(1)
	local female_2 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(2)
	local female_3 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(3)
	local male_1 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(1)
	local male_2 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(2)

	character_util.set_anim(female_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_anim(female_2, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_anim(female_3, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_anim(male_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	character_util.set_anim(male_2, { name = 'cross_arm' })

	-- 부장(left, idle, seat) : …오늘 안건은 바로 우리 파인애플 피자의 매출 순위가 최하위라는 점에 대해서야.
	character_util.set_direction(senior, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(senior, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 부장(left, attack, release) : 믿겨져? 이렇게 맛있는 파인애플로 만든 피자를 기피한다는 게?
	character_util.set_emotion(senior, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(senior, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(senior, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(senior)

	-- 여자1(down, smile, seat) : 파인애플을 뜨겁게 녹여서 피자 도우로 사용하는 건 어때요?
	character_util.set_direction(female_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(female_1, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(female_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' } )
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female_1, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(female_1)

	-- 여자2 (right, smile, seat) : 피자 박스에 파인애플 첨가 농도 표시를 확대해서 인쇄해 봐요!
	character_util.set_direction(female_2, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(female_2, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(female_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'} )
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female_2, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(female_2)

	-- 부장(left, tired, seat) : 뭔가 신선한 판매 아이디어가 없을까…
	character_util.set_emotion(senior, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(senior, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(senior)

	-- 카메라 플레이어에게 돌아옴
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 새로운 피자를 보자 화들짝 놀라는 회의 멤버들.
function local_class:play_brand_new_pizza_surprises_attendance()
	-- 책상 근처로 가는 가디언
	local knight_move_pos = field:GetMarker('player_pizza_drop_wp_1').position

	local female_1 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(1)
	local female_2 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(2)
	local female_3 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(3)
	local male_1 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(1)
	local male_2 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(2)
	local male_3 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(3)

	local knight_wp = {
		vector(field:GetMarker('player_pizza_drop_wp_1').position.x, 0, user_party.Leader.Position.z),
		field:GetMarker('player_pizza_drop_wp_2').position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		field:GetMarker('player_pizza_drop_wp_2').position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party.Leader, knight_wp, 2.5, false, false,
			false, 'right')

	local leader_action_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	local pizza_dropped_pos = field:GetMarker('pizza_dropped_pos').position

	-- 가디언 책상위에 피자를 던져놓음.
	local pizza_box = leader_action_state.HoldTarget

	command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader, pizza_box, vector(1, 0, 0), pizza_box.Position,
			0, true)
	local custom_sine_move = function(target, data)
		local start_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'from')
		local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'to')
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration')
		local height = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'height', 1)
		local cb = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'cb', nil)
		local has_position_prop = target.Position ~= nil

		if start_pos == nil then
			start_pos = has_position_prop and target.Position or target.transform.position
		end

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
			local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y)

			if has_position_prop then
				target.Position = cur_pos
			else
				target.transform.position = cur_pos
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if cb ~= nil then
			cb()
		end

		if has_position_prop then
			target.Position = target_pos
		else
			target.transform.position = target_pos
		end
	end
	custom_sine_move(pizza_box,
			{ from = pizza_box.Position, to = pizza_dropped_pos, duration = 0.5, height = 0.6,
			  cb = function()
				  music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')
			  end})

	character_util.set_direction(female_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(female_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(female_3, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(male_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(male_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(male_3, 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(female_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(female_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(female_3)
	character_util.remove_anim(male_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(male_2)
	character_util.remove_anim(male_3)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.jump(female_1, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(female_2, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(female_3, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_1, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_2, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_3, 0.5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	-- 가디언, 남자 앞에 피자를 던진 후 smile, release
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' } )
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	local senior = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(1) ---@type Character

	-- 남자 피자쪽으로 웨이포인트 이동.
	local male_1_sp = {
		vector(senior.Position.x, 0, pizza_dropped_pos.z),
		vector(senior.Position.x - 1, 0, pizza_dropped_pos.z),
	}
	local distance_z = senior.Position.z - pizza_dropped_pos.z
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(senior, male_1_sp, 2.5, false, false,
			false, 'left')

	camera_util.move(senior.Position, 0.5)

	-- 남자1(left, idle, release) : 다들 모여봐! 새로운 피자야!
	character_util.set_direction(senior, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(senior, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(senior, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(senior)

	-- 여자1,2 남자1쪽으로 모인다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local sales_female_3 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(3)
			character_util.move_distance_async(sales_female_3, vector(0, 0, -1), nil,
					2.5, true, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local sales_female_1 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(1)
			local female_1_wp = {
				vector(sales_female_1.Position.x + 1, 0, sales_female_1.Position.z),
				vector(sales_female_1.Position.x + 1, 0, sales_female_1.Position.z - distance_z - 2.5),
				vector(sales_female_1.Position.x + 0.5, 0, sales_female_1.Position.z - distance_z - 2.5),
			}
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(sales_female_1, female_1_wp, 4, true, false,
					false, 'left')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local male_2 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(2)
			character_util.move_distance_async(male_2, vector(0, 0, -distance_z - 0.25), nil, 4,
					true, true)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local female_2 = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(2)
			character_util.move_distance_async(female_2, vector(0, 0, -distance_z), nil, 4,
					true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(female_2, 'right')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local male_3 = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(3)
			character_util.move_distance_async(male_3, vector(0, 0, -distance_z + 0.5), nil, 4,
					true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(male_3, 'right')
		end)
	})

	character_util.remove_emotion(female_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(female_2)

	-- 남자1 eat으로 피자 열어보는 연출.
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	character_util.set_anim(senior, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	eat_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(pizza_box.Position)
	self.pizza_sprite = self:create_drop_item(self.pizza_id, 'dontfindlooter', pizza_box.Position,
	0.6)
	self.pizza_sprite:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Default', -1, 'Under Effects', -2)
	pizza_box.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.remove_anim(senior)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 다른 직원들 표정 모두 scared로 변경
	character_util.set_emotion(female_1, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(female_2, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(female_3, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(male_1, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(male_2, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_emotion(male_3, { name = 'scared' })

	character_util.jump(female_1, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(female_2, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(female_3, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_1, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_2, 0.5, 0.3)
	character_util.jump(male_3, 0.5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	-- 여자1(left, scared, idle)  : 웁… 냄새…
	character_util.set_direction(female_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(female_1, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female_1, { key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 여자1(left, scared, release) : 이런 저질 식품을 어떻게 먹으라는 거예요?
	character_util.set_anim(female_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(female_1, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(female_1)

	-- 가디언 tired
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(0.35)

	-- 남자1(left, attack, idle) : 저승 식품위생법 제49조 제6항. 유령이 먹을 수 있는 음식이 아닌 저질 식품을 판매하는 자는…
	character_util.set_emotion(senior, { name = 'attack' })

-- 피자 펀치!!! 그는 신이야!!!
function local_class:pizza_punch()

	local hit_object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') ---@type UnityObjectPool
	local keep_punching = true

	---@type function
	---@param fo Character
	---@param wp table
	---@param last_dir string
	local move_to_pizza_stash= function(fo, wp, last_dir)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fo, wp, 4.5, true, false,
				false, last_dir, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	---@type function
	---@param pizza DropItem
	---@param duration float
	---@param end_pos Vector3
	---@param rotate_count int
	---@param height float
	local pizza_air_spin = function(pizza, duration, end_pos, rotate_count, height)
		local time_passed = 0
		local senior = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(2)
		local start_pos = pizza.Position

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_02', parent = senior })

		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
			pizza.Position = cur_pos + vector(0,cur_y,0)

			local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
			pizza.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', parent = senior, loop = false })
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(pizza.Position)
		pizza.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		pizza:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	---@type function
	---@param fo Character
	---@param anim string
	---@param pizzas_to_remove table<DropItem>
	---@param wait_sec float
	local pizza_punch_routine = function(fo, anim, wait_sec,
	                                     pizzas_to_remove)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = anim, loop = true })

		local cnt_original_pizza = #pizzas_to_remove
		local cnt_remove_pizza = 0
		local is_right= direction_util.to_str(fo.Direction) == 'right'

		---@type Vector3
		local x_pos_adj= lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_right == true, 0.5, -0.5)
		---@type float
		local x_deviate = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_right == true, 0.5, -0.5)
		---@type float
		local deviate_duration = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(#pizzas_to_remove == 3, 4.8, 6.5)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(fo, vector(x_deviate, 0, 0), deviate_duration, 0.3)

		-- 총 날려야하는 피자의 수와 현재까지 날린 피자의 수가 같을때까지 반복
		while(cnt_remove_pizza ~= cnt_original_pizza) do
			--character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = anim, loop = true })
			wait_for_sec(wait_sec)

			if (keep_punching) then
				cnt_remove_pizza = cnt_remove_pizza + 1

				---@type FieldObject
				local pizza_to_remove= pizzas_to_remove[cnt_remove_pizza]
				---@type Vector3
				local pizza_air_spin_x_adj = random_util.get_random_int(-1, 1)
				---@type Vector3
				local pizza_spin_end_pos = pizza_to_remove.Position + vector(pizza_air_spin_x_adj, 0, 3)

				hit_object_pool:Instantiate(pizza_to_remove.Position + vector(x_pos_adj, 0, 0))

				if cnt_remove_pizza == cnt_original_pizza then
					character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'success' })
					character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'smile' })
				end

				pizza_air_spin(pizzas_to_remove[cnt_remove_pizza], 0.8, pizza_spin_end_pos, 3, 3)

				--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				--		util.cs_generator(pizza_air_spin, pizzas_to_remove[cnt_remove_pizza], 0.8,
				--				pizza_spin_end_pos, 3, 3))
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.25)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local pizza_to_remove_by_each_fo = nil

	---@type function
	---@param loop_count int
	---@return table<int>
	local allocate_num_pizza_to_remove= function(loop_count)
		local ret = {}
		local remained = {}

		-- 21개중 18개 처리
		for i = 1, loop_count do
			ret[i], remained = random_util.get_values_in_array(self.pizza_box_cache, { overlap = false, count = 3 })
		end

		-- 나머지 3개 처리

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local random_table = ret[random_util.get_random_int(1, #ret)]
			random_table[#random_table + 1] = remained[i]
		end

		return ret
	end

	pizza_to_remove_by_each_fo = allocate_num_pizza_to_remove(6)
	local crowd_sfx = nil
	--region 피자쪽으로 달려가는 직원들
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(2)
			local waypoints = {
				npc.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 0),
				npc.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 0),
				npc.Position + vector(-1.25, 0, 4),
				npc.Position + vector(-0.75, 0, 4)
			}

			crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_01', parent = npc, loop = true })
			local pizza_list_to_remove = pizza_to_remove_by_each_fo[2]
			move_to_pizza_stash(npc, waypoints, 'right')
			pizza_punch_routine(npc, 'attack', 0.5, pizza_list_to_remove)

			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
			npc.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_pizza_post_4'
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(3)
			local waypoints = {
				npc.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
				npc.Position + vector(1, 0 , 3.75),
				npc.Position + vector(0, 0 , 3.75),
			}

			local pizza_list_to_remove = pizza_to_remove_by_each_fo[4]
			move_to_pizza_stash(npc, waypoints, 'left')
			pizza_punch_routine(npc, 'attack', 0.5, pizza_list_to_remove)

			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
			npc.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_pizza_post_3'
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(1)
			local waypoints = {
				npc.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				npc.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 4)
			}

			local pizza_list_to_remove = pizza_to_remove_by_each_fo[6]
			move_to_pizza_stash(npc, waypoints, 'left')
			pizza_punch_routine(npc, 'attack', 0.5, pizza_list_to_remove)

			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
			npc.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_pizza_post_2'
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(2)

				npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

			character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'success' })
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
			npc.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_pizza_post_5'
		end),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(3)

				npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
				npc.Position + vector(-1, 0, 4.5)

		end),

		util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(1)

function local_class:move_rotate_item(item, duration, end_pos, height, rotate_count)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = item.Position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0,cur_y,0)

		local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:set_npcs()
	local each_sales_count = 3
	local marker_name_post_fix = '_init'

	for i = 1, each_sales_count do
		local female_marker_name = self.sales_female_name_prefix .. i .. marker_name_post_fix
		local male_marker_name = self.sales_male_name_prefix .. i .. marker_name_post_fix

		local female_sales_marker = field:GetMarker(female_marker_name) ---@type MarkerInfo
		local male_sales_marker = field:GetMarker(male_marker_name) ---@type MarkerInfo

		local sales_female = self.get_sales_female_by_idx(i) ---@type Character
		local sales_male = self.get_sales_male_by_idx(i) ---@type Character

		character_util.set_position(sales_male, male_sales_marker.position)
		character_util.set_position(sales_female, female_sales_marker.position)

		character_util.set_direction(sales_male, male_sales_marker.direction)
		character_util.set_direction(sales_female, female_sales_marker.direction)

		character_util.set_anim(sales_female, { name = 'cross_arm' })
		character_util.set_anim(sales_male, { name = 'cross_arm' })

		character_util.set_active_state(sales_male, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(sales_female, 'enabled')
	end
end

function local_class:set_pizza_boxes()

	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('pizza_meeting_room_center').position ---@type Vector3
	local layer_count = 6
	local num_pizza_each_layer = 1

	for i = 1, layer_count do
		local pos_adj_formula = (0.25 * (i - 1))
		---@type Vector3
		local spawn_pivot = center_pos + vector(-(pos_adj_formula), 0, 1.25 - (pos_adj_formula))

		for j = 1, num_pizza_each_layer do
			---@type Vector3
			local spawn_pos = spawn_pivot + vector(0.5 * (j - 1), 0, 0)
			---@type DropItem
			local pizza_box = self:create_drop_item(self.pizza_box_id, 'dontfindlooter',
					spawn_pos, 1)
			table.insert(self.pizza_box_cache, pizza_box)
		end

		num_pizza_each_layer = num_pizza_each_layer + 1
	end

	-- 피자 박스 아래 스타피스 획득 못하게 막아주는 투명 벽 설치
	---@type FieldObject
	local star_piece_guardian = get_field_object('pizza_star_piece_hide')
	star_piece_guardian.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3.one * 2)
end

---@param id int
---@param loot_state string
---@param pos_to_spawn Vector3
---@param scale Vector3
---@return DropItem
function local_class:create_drop_item(id, loot_state, pos_to_spawn, scale)
	local drop_item_data = {
		itemid = id,
		pos = pos_to_spawn,
		lootstate = loot_state,
		notforinven = true,
		sprscale = scale,
		showoncharacter = true
	}

	return drop_item_util.create_item(drop_item_data)
end

function local_class:eat_pizza(fo)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 4.6
	local item_sprite_transform = self.pizza_sprite.SpriteTransform
	local item_shadow_transform = self.pizza_sprite.ShadowTransform
	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true, parent = fo,
	                                       type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })

	while time_passed < duration and self.is_eating_pizza do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local delta_scale = (0.4 - progress)

		if delta_scale < 0 then
			local updated_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * (0.6 + delta_scale)
			item_sprite_transform.localScale = updated_scale
			item_shadow_transform.localScale = updated_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	self.pizza_sprite:ConsumeComplete()
	self.pizza_sprite = nil
end

function local_class:cache_wasted_pizza_boxes()
	local target_zone = field:GetZone('wasted_box_zone') ---@type Zone
	---@type PooledSortedFieldObjectList
	local gimmick_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds,
			unity_class.vector3.zero)

	for i = 0, gimmick_list.Count - 1 do
		local gimmick = gimmick_list[i] ---@type FieldObject
		self.wasted_pizza_box_cache[#self.wasted_pizza_box_cache + 1] = gimmick
	end
end

---@param fo FieldObject
function local_class:is_fo_wasted_pizza_box(fo)

	for i = 1, #self.wasted_pizza_box_cache do
		local wasted_pizza_box = self.wasted_pizza_box_cache[i] ---@type FieldObject

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, wasted_pizza_box) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

			party_util.align_party(vector(50, 0, 63), 'left', 0)
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

			-- 카메라 그리드 변경 기다림
			coroutine.yield()

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
			party_util.reset_controllers()

		elseif CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.W) then

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'enable_head_control' }))

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'disable_head_control' }))

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_decapitated_soul()) then

			if self.cur_state == self.event_state.entered_maze_room then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.met_decapitated_soul, self))
			elseif self.cur_state == self.event_state.asked_to_help then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.pop_up_options, self))
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.maze_room_entrance and self.cur_state == self.event_state.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.entered_maze_room, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.maze_goal and self.cur_state == self.event_state.escaped_maze then
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.found_headless_body, self)
	end
end

function local_class:entered_maze_room()

	character_util.remove_emotion(head)

end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(head, { key = self.script_key .. '4_1', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(head, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(head, 'right')

	character_util.set_direction(head, 'left')

function local_class:pop_up_options()
	local head = self.get_decapitated_soul()
	quest_icon_util.remove(head)

	if (self.cur_state == self.event_state.asked_to_help) then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		self.evidence_controller:wait_until_popup_off()

		party_util.align_to_target(head, 'left', 1, 'arc')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(head, { key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true })
	end

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 수락한다.
		{ self.script_key .. 18, 'mercy'},
		-- 거절한다.
		{ self.script_key .. 19, 'brutal'},
	})

	if result == 1 then
		self:start_maze_escape()
	else
		self.cur_state = self.event_state.asked_to_help
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_accepted(head)

		camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

function local_class:start_maze_escape()
	self.cur_state = self.event_state.escaped_maze
	self.is_playing_maze_game = true

	-- 카메라 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot()

	-- 증거품 UI 꺼줌

	party_util.align_party(field:GetMarker('decapitated_head_init').position + vector(4, 0, 0),
			'left', 0, 'arc')

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })

	local maze_start_pos = field:GetMarker('maze_escape_start').position
	local manual_head = self.get_decapitated_soul()
	local gimmick_head = self.get_head_gimmick()

	character_util.set_active_state(gimmick_head, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(manual_head, maze_start_pos)
	gimmick_head.Position = maze_start_pos

	-- 메뉴얼 머리 기믹 설정
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'enable_head_control' }))

	-- 2프레임 정도 강제로 기다려서 확실하게 파티가 변경 되어있도록 보장.
	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.set_direction(manual_head, 'down')

	self.darkness_stencil_mask = self.get_fx_darkness_target()
	                   :Instantiate(manual_head.Position + vector(0, 4.7, -3), unity_class.quaternion.identity, manual_head.Transform)
	self.darkness_stencil_mask.transform.localScale = vector(0.8, 0, 0.8)
	self.darkness_background = self.get_fx_darkness_background()
						:Instantiate(stage_camera.transform.position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)
	self.darkness_background.transform.localScale = vector(6, 1, 3)

	local tint_color = 0.5
	field:Tint('maze_escape', unity_class.color(tint_color, tint_color, tint_color), 0)

	-- 카메라 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black)

	character_util.set_emotion(manual_head, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 머리 : 잘 부탁해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(manual_head, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(manual_head, { key = self.script_key .. 23, skip = true })

	character_util.normal_double_jump(manual_head, true)

	character_util.remove_emotion(manual_head)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 상단 UI 지워버림
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	quest_marker_util.show(self, 'maze_goal', get_character('headless_ghost'), true)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/afterworld/audio:bgm_afterworld_maze', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	self.evidence_controller:toggle_block_button(true)
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local manual_head = self.get_decapitated_soul()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, manual_head) and self.is_playing_maze_game then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			local leader = user_party.Leader

			-- 으아아아악!!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.original_leader, { key = self.script_key .. 22, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = leader.Position })

			--- 임지로 투명화를 해준다.
			leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			stage_camera:SetTarget(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			local damaged_dir = e.Info.direction
			damaged_dir = vector(damaged_dir.x * -2, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.air_spin(leader, { offset = damaged_dir })

			wait_for_sec(1.4)

			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				-- 재도전
				{ self.script_key .. 24, 'mercy' },
				-- 그만두기
				{ self.script_key .. 25, 'normal' }
			})

			if choose_result == 1 then
				self:reset_maze_game()
			else
				self:give_up_maze_game()
				self.evidence_controller:toggle_block_button(false)
				field_ui_manager:Show()
				party_util.reset_controllers()
			end
		end))

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:reset_maze_game()
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(leader, field:GetMarker('maze_escape_start').position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	-- 카메라 그리드 변경 기다림

	coroutine.yield()

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	for _, v in pairs(self.item_data) do
		if v.holder ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(v.holder)
			v.holder = nil
		end
	end

	if self.trashcan_twinkle ~= nil then
		self.trashcan_twinkle:Dispose()
		self.trashcan_twinkle = nil
	end

	local vending = self.get_vending()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(vending.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.PublishInteractable)) then
		vending.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	local video_obj = self.get_video_interact_obj()
	video_obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(diet_girl, self)

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.is_interacting then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diet_girl()) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
				self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.diet_girl_start_talking, self)
				return true
			elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.talked then
				self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.diet_girl_keep_talking, self)
				return true
			elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.accepted then
				if self.gave_item ~= self.found_item then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.give_item_to_diet_girl, self))
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_vending()) and
				not self:has_item(self.found_item, self.item_data.juice.num) then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.juice_found_routine, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_video_interact_obj()) and
				not self:has_item(self.found_item, self.item_data.video_tape.num) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.video_found_routine, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_ring_fit_hidden_obj()) and
				not self:has_item(self.found_item, self.item_data.ring_fit.num) then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.ring_fit_found_routine, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--region 아이템 전달 관련
function local_class:give_item_to_diet_girl()
	self.evidence_controller:wait_until_popup_off()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local diet_girl = self.get_diet_girl()
	local data = self.item_data

	self.is_interacting = true

	party_util.align_party(diet_girl.Position, 'left', 1)

	-- 전체 선택지
	local choose_table = {
		-- 해독 주스
		{ 'aw_diet_spirit_girl_19', 'intellect', data.juice.num },
		-- 낡은 고리
		{ 'aw_diet_spirit_girl_20', 'normal', data.ring_fit.num },
		-- 에어로빅 댄스 비디오
		{ 'aw_diet_spirit_girl_21', 'mercy', data.video_tape.num}
	}

	-- 보여줄 선택지
	local show_item_table = {}
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(choose_table) do
		local choice = choose_table[i]
		if self:find_not_given_item(choice[3]) then
			table.insert(show_item_table, choice)
		end
	end

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait = true
	local chose_item_num = -1

	for i, v in ipairs(show_item_table) do
		local branch = {}
		branch.Text = game_string:GetString(v[1])
		branch.Tendency = choose_util.get_tendency(v[2])
		branch.Callback = function()
			chose_item_num = v[3]
			wait = false
		end
		branches:Add(branch)
	end

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 전달한 아이템 정보 업데이트
	self:give_item(chose_item_num)

	if chose_item_num == data.video_tape.num then
		self:give_video_tape_routine()
	elseif chose_item_num == data.juice.num then
		self:give_juice_routine()
	elseif chose_item_num == data.ring_fit.num then
		self:give_ring_fit_routine()
	end

	self.is_interacting = false
end

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({

	})

	character_util.set_anim(diet_girl, { name = 'eat', loop = true })

	item.ConsumeTarget = diet_girl
	item:Fly()

	character_util.remove_anim(diet_girl)

	character_util.remove_anim(diet_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(diet_girl, { key = 'aw_diet_spirit_girl_28', skip = true })

			'aw_diet_spirit_girl_ringfit_subtitle', 'aw_diet_spirit_girl_ringfit_desc')

	self.is_interacting = false
end

--region 아이템 관련 유틸 함수
function local_class:give_item(item_num)
	self.gave_item = self.gave_item | item_num

	-- 얻은 아이템 값과 같으면 보유하고 있는 아이템 없는 것으로
	if self.found_item == self.gave_item then
		local diet_girl = self.get_diet_girl()
		character_util.remove_relate_event(diet_girl, self)
	end
end

function local_class:add_item(item_num)
	self.found_item = self.found_item | item_num

	if self.found_item ~= self.gave_item then
		local diet_girl = self.get_diet_girl()
		character_util.add_listener(diet_girl, self)
	end
end

---@param checking_item number self.found_item이나 self.gave_item을 인자로 사용
function local_class:has_item(checking_item, item_num)
	if checking_item & item_num == item_num then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:has_all_item(checking_item)
	for _, v in pairs(self.item_data) do
		if not self:has_item(checking_item, v.num) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

--- 아이템을 보유했지만 아직 여자 영혼에게 전달하지 않은 아이템인지 확인
--- 아이템 주기 선택지에 나와야 하면 return true
function local_class:find_not_given_item(item_num)
	if self:has_item(self.found_item, item_num) then
		if self.gave_item & item_num == 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

return local_class

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.is_interacting then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diet_girl()) then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.ring_fit_soul_appear, self)
		end

	if self.is_qte_start then

		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then

--region 기타 유틸 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(data)
	local type = data

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01');
	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.cur_swiped_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true

	local time_passed = 2.5
	local ring_fit_soul = self.get_ring_fit_soul()
	local speech_bubble_keys = {
		-- 조금만 더!
		'aw_diet_spirit_girl_63',
		-- 마지막 한 번!
		'aw_diet_spirit_girl_64'
	}
	local key_idx = 1

	while self.is_qte_start do
		if self.cur_swiped_type == type then
			break
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= 5 then
			time_passed = 0
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ring_fit_soul, { key = speech_bubble_keys[key_idx], bubble_direction = 'rb' })
			key_idx = key_idx + 1 > table_util.get_size(speech_bubble_keys) and 1 or key_idx + 1
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1.5)
end

function local_class:custom_party_align(align_pos, align_time, last_dir)
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		local dest_pos = align_pos + vector(0, 0, 1 * i)
		character_util.move_to(member, dest_pos, align_time, nil, true, true)
	end
	wait_for_sec(align_time)
	party_util.set_direction(last_dir)
end

function local_class:shake_item(item, magnitude, duration)
	local item_pos = item.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local shadow_pos = item.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local shake_range = magnitude / 2

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = item_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)
		item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
--endregion

return local_class

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_fairy = controller.get_fairy

	-- state
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		show_fairy = 1,
		meet_fairy = 2,
		meet_end = 3
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none

	-- 미니게임
	self.basket_mini_game = nil
	self.game_name = 'BasketCatchGame'

	-- 이나즈마킥
	self.item_list = nil

	-- 쓰레기 던지는 NPC 수
	self.thrower_count = 8

	-- 바구니용
	self.get_basket = function(num) return get_field_object('trash_basket_'..num) end

	-- 바구니 스프라이트
	self.basket_sprite = {}

	-- 쓰레기 스프라이트
	self.trash_sprite = {}
	self.trash_item_1 = nil
	self.trash_item_2 = nil
	self.trash_item_3 = nil

	-- 반복 실행방지용
	self.req_cnt = 0

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_knight = function()
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			return get_character('knight_male')
		end

		return get_character('knight_female')
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	local fairy_1 = self.get_fairy(1)
	local fairy_2 = self.get_fairy(2)

	--입구에서 선녀2, 왼쪽 구석에서 선녀1이 각각 쓰레기 줍고 있는 연출.
	--선녀2 머리 위해 빨간색 영혼에너지 1000000
	character_util.set_rolling_number(
			fairy_2.Transform, 1000000, nil, 0, unity_class.color.red)

	character_util.add_listener(fairy_2, self.controller)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fairy_1, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true },
			{ name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(fairy_2, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true },
			{ name = 'idle' })
	self.get_basket(1).Position = fairy_1.Position + vector(0,1.12,0)
	self.get_basket(2).Position = fairy_2.Position + vector(0,1.12,0)

	-- basket sprite
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local basket = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = self.get_basket(i).Position, itemid = 20179
				, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })
		basket.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		table.insert(self.basket_sprite, basket)
	end

	self.trash_item_1 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = fairy_2.Position + vector(0.5,0,0)
			, itemid = 20503, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	self.trash_item_2 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = fairy_1.Position - vector(0.5,0,0)
			, itemid = 20503, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	self.trash_item_3 = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = fairy_2.Position - vector(0.5,0,0)
			, itemid = 20503, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

	-- Subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_end

	if self.basket_sprite ~= nil then
		for _, basket in ipairs(self.basket_sprite) do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(basket)
		end
		self.basket_sprite = nil
	end

	if self.trash_sprite ~= nil then
		for _, trash in ipairs(self.trash_sprite) do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(trash)
		end
		self.trash_sprite = nil
	end
	self.trash_item_1 = nil
	self.trash_item_2 = nil
	self.trash_item_3 = nil

	self:mini_game_dispose()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_fairy(2), self.controller)

	if self.item_list ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.item_list) do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local fairy = self.get_fairy(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, fairy) and self.current_progress == self.progress.show_fairy then
			self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_fairy
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_fairy, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if e.Success then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.success_basket_catch_mini_game, self))
			return true
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fail_basket_catch_mini_game, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_basket(i)) then
			self.basket_sprite[i].Position = self.get_basket(i).Position

			if i == 1 then
				if self.trash_sprite[2] ~= nil then
					self.trash_sprite[2].Position = self.basket_sprite[i].Position + vector(-0.13, 0, 0.11)
					self.trash_sprite[2].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(4)
				end
			end

			if i == 2 then
				if self.trash_sprite[1] ~= nil then
					self.trash_sprite[1].Position = self.basket_sprite[i].Position + vector(-0.13, 0, 0.11)
					self.trash_sprite[1].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(3)
				end

				if self.trash_sprite[3] ~= nil then
					self.trash_sprite[3].Position = self.basket_sprite[i].Position + vector(-0.03, 0, 0.19)
					self.trash_sprite[3].SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(4)
				end
			end
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'meet_fairy_zone')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.show_fairy
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_fairy, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'fairy_grid')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress.show_fairy then
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_fairy, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'fairy_grid')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress.show_fairy then
		self.req_cnt = self.req_cnt + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	if self.basket_mini_game ~= nil then
		self.basket_mini_game.is_stage_ended = true
	end

	self:mini_game_dispose()

	return true
end

function local_class:move_fairy()
	local fairy_1 = self.get_fairy(1)
	local fairy_2 = self.get_fairy(2)
	local req_cnt = self.req_cnt

	fairy_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	fairy_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local fairy_1_pos = vector(-44,0,130)
	local fairy_2_pos = vector(-38,0,130)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local basket_1 = self.get_basket(1)
		local basket_2 = self.get_basket(2)

		while self.current_progress == self.progress.show_fairy and req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
			basket_1.Position = fairy_1.Position + vector(0, 1.12, 0)
			basket_2.Position = fairy_2.Position + vector(0, 1.12, 0)
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end))

	while self.current_progress == self.progress.show_fairy and req_cnt == self.req_cnt do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_1, fairy_1_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				2, false)

		if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.show_fairy or req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then break end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_2, fairy_2_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
				2, false)

		if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.show_fairy or req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then break end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_1, fairy_1_pos - vector(1, 0, 0),
				2, false)

		if self.current_progress ~= self.progress.show_fairy or req_cnt ~= self.req_cnt then break end
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_2, fairy_2_pos - vector(1, 0, 0),
				2, false)
	end

	fairy_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	fairy_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:interact_fairy()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	local fairy_1 = self.get_fairy(1)
	local fairy_2 = self.get_fairy(2)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.stop(fairy_1)
	character_util.stop(fairy_2)

	local npcs = {}
	for i = 1, self.thrower_count do
		table.insert(npcs, get_character('trash_thrower_'..i))
	end

	party_util.align_party(fairy_2.Position, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	--선녀1의 머리위에는 따로 영혼에너지가 보이지 않는다.

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local time = 0
		local start_pos = self.basket_sprite[2].Position
		local target_pos = self.basket_sprite[2].Position + vector(0,0.6,0)
		local sprite_1_start_pos = self.trash_sprite[1].Position
		local sprite_1_target_pos = self.trash_sprite[1].Position + vector(0,0.6,0)
		local sprite_2_start_pos = self.trash_sprite[3].Position
		local sprite_2_target_pos = self.trash_sprite[3].Position + vector(0,0.6,0)

		local duration = 0.15
		for i = 1, 2 do
			time = 0
			while time < duration do
				local progress = time / duration
				self.basket_sprite[2].Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				self.trash_sprite[1].Position = sprite_1_start_pos * (1 - progress) + sprite_1_target_pos * progress
				self.trash_sprite[3].Position = sprite_2_start_pos * (1 - progress) + sprite_2_target_pos * progress
				time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			time = 0
			while time < duration do
				local progress = time / duration
				self.basket_sprite[2].Position = target_pos * (1 - progress) + start_pos * progress
				self.trash_sprite[1].Position = sprite_1_target_pos * (1 - progress) + sprite_1_start_pos * progress
				self.trash_sprite[3].Position = sprite_2_target_pos * (1 - progress) + sprite_2_start_pos * progress
				time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end
	end))
	character_util.normal_double_jump(fairy_2, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fairy_2, { key = 'aw_fox_fairy_1', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(fairy_2, { name = 'throw', upper = true })
	self:basket_move(self.get_basket(2), fairy_2.Position + vector(0.2,0,0), true)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--선녀2 : 여기까진 어쩐 일로!

	character_util.set_direction(fairy_2, 'left')
	character_util.play_speech_action(fairy_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
	, 'smile', 'aw_fox_fairy_2')

	--선녀 1 머리위에 느낌표
	character_util.look_at(fairy_1, leader)
	character_util.remove_anim(fairy_1)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(fairy_1, nil, 'notice')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(fairy_1, { name = 'throw', upper = true })
	self:basket_move(self.get_basket(1), fairy_1.Position + vector(0.2,0,0), true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--가디언에게 다가온다.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_1, leader.Position - vector(2,0,0), 3)

	--선녀 1 : 막내야! 네가 왜 이곳에 있느냐!!
	character_util.look_at(leader, fairy_1)

function local_class:basket_mini_game_load()
	-- 미니게임 로드
	self.basket_mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, 'afterworld_basket', function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:basket_mini_game_start()
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.game_name)
end

	character_util.move_to(kicker, center + vector(-2, 5, 0), 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kicker, { key = 'aw_fox_fairy_41', bubble_type = "shout", screen_pos = vector(-250, -200) })
	character_util.shake(kicker, 0.2, 999)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_laser_build_up_01')

	character_util.shake(leader, 0.2, 999)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 999)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kicker)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kicker2)

	-- 키이이이이이이이익!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({{'aw_fox_fairy_43', 'mercy'}})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_team_combination_start_01')

	effect:Dispose()

	effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_lightning_kick_ready'):Instantiate(
			kicker2.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, kicker2.transform)

	effect2:Dispose()

	effect2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_lightning_kick_ready'):Instantiate(
			kicker.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, kicker.transform)

	effect3:Dispose()
	effect3 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_lightning_kick_ready'):Instantiate(
			leader.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, leader.transform)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_light_laser_03')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_impact_lightning_02')

	character_util.spine_rotate(kicker2, -30, 0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(kicker2, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(kicker2, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

	character_util.spine_rotate(kicker, 30, 0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(kicker, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(kicker, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'hold_loop', loop = false })


	local boom_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss'):Instantiate(center)
	local boom_effect_pos = boom_effect.transform.localPosition
	boom_effect.transform.localPosition = vector(99, 0, 99)
	wait_for_sec(2.0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(center, 0)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_02')

	effect:Dispose()
	effect2:Dispose()
	effect3:Dispose()
	screen_effect:Dispose()
	screen_effect2:Dispose()

	if self.item_list ~= nil then
		for i, sprite in ipairs(self.item_list) do
			if sprite.Position.z < center.z then
				sprite:SetSortingLayer(true)
			end
			if sprite ~= nil then
				local item_sprite = sprite.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
				if item_sprite ~= nil then
					item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 0.2, 0.2, 1 })
					item_sprite:Rebuild()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	screen_effect2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_screen_fx_scene2'):Instantiate(
			stage_camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	local screen_effect3 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_screen_fx_scene3'):Instantiate(
			stage_camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.Transform)

	character_util.set_position(kicker, center + vector(-7, 7, 0))
	character_util.set_position(kicker2, center + vector(7, 7, 0))
	character_util.set_position(leader, center + vector(0, 7.2, 0))

	character_util.move_to(kicker, center + vector(-0.6, 0.5, 0), 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(kicker2, center + vector(0.6, 0.5, 0), 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(leader, center + vector(0, 0.5, 0), 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_stomp_fire_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_aw_lightning_kick_explosion'):Instantiate(center + vector(0, 0.01, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_magic_shield_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
	screen_util.fade_out(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.item_list ~= nil then
		for i, item in ipairs(self.item_list) do
			if item ~= nil then
				item:ConsumeComplete()
			end
			self.item_list = nil
		end
	end

	kicker.SpineController:AddColor(kicker.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1), 1, 0)
	kicker2.SpineController:AddColor(kicker2.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1), 1, 0)
	leader.SpineController:AddColor(leader.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1), 1, 0)

	character_util.move_to(kicker, center + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(kicker2, center + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.2)
	character_util.move_to(leader, center + vector(0, 0, 0), 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0)
	kicker.SpineController:AddColor(kicker.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1), 1, 0)
	kicker2.SpineController:AddColor(kicker2.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1), 1, 0)
	leader.SpineController:AddColor(leader.name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1), 1, 0)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	character_util.stop_shake(kicker)
	character_util.stop_shake(kicker2)
	character_util.stop_shake(leader)
	character_util.set_position(kicker, center + vector(3, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_position(kicker2, center + vector(5, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_position(leader, center + vector(4, 0, -1))
	camera_util.move_async(kicker.Position, 0, { end_target = kicker })
	character_util.set_emotion(kicker, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(kicker2, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_direction(kicker, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(kicker2, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(kicker)
	screen_effect2:Dispose()
	screen_effect3:Dispose()

	character_util.set_active_shadow(kicker, true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(kicker2, true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)
	character_util.spine_rotate(kicker, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(kicker2, 0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	boom_effect.transform.localPosition = boom_effect_pos

	screen_util.fade_in(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	character_util.set_anim(kicker, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(kicker2, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_02')
	local throw_list = {}
	for i = 1, 20 do
		local itemid = 20503

		local rand_pos = origin_pos + vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-2, 10), 0.5,
				CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-2, 10))

		local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = origin_pos, target = rand_pos, itemid = itemid, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
				, notforinven = true, skip_text = true })

		trash_item:SetSortingLayer(true)

		table.insert(throw_list, trash_item)
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1.5
	local custom_alpha = 1
	local shadow_alpha = 1

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1.2
		local alpha_progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - (time_passed / duration))
		for i, sprite in ipairs(throw_list) do

			local custom_sprite = sprite.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			local shadow_sprite = sprite.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

			custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ custom_alpha * alpha_progress
			, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress, custom_alpha * alpha_progress })
			shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_alpha * alpha_progress
			custom_sprite:Rebuild()
			shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	-- 하나가 된
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kicker, { key = "aw_fox_fairy_44", bubble_direction = 'lb' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--우리 자매를
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(kicker2, { key = "aw_fox_fairy_44_1", bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	field:Tint(nil, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 평범한 선녀 영혼이라고 생각하지 말아줘!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({{'aw_fox_fairy_45', 'mercy'}})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	yield_return_func(self.basket_mini_game_load, self)
	self:basket_mini_game_start()

-- 바구니 holdable 하지 않기 위해 던지고 줍는 로직 추가
function local_class:basket_move(basket, target_pos, is_throw)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = basket.Position
	local height = start_pos.y

	local duration = 0.15
	if is_throw then
		duration = 0.2
	end

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		if is_throw then
			local h = unity_class.mathf.Cos(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress * 0.5) * height
			local xz_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
			basket.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(xz_pos, h)
		else
			basket.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		end
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	basket.Position = target_pos
end

function local_class:mini_game_dispose()
	if self.basket_mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
		self.basket_mini_game = nil
	end
end

return local_class

	local grandma = self.get_grandma()
	local ticket_box = self.get_ticket_box()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,grandma) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_grandma_1, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.grandma_1 then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_grandma_2, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress.ending then
			self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.grandma_ending, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,ticket_box) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress.none or self.current_progress == self.progress.grandma_1 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(ticket_box, { key = 'aw_grandma_oneline_1'})

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')

    self:get_box_obj(self.cheese_box_zone_name,self.cheese_box_name, self.cheese_box_list, self.box_enum.cheese)

function local_class:on_event(e)
    if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        self:on_interact_event(e)
    end

    return false
end

end
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    local ghost = self.get_ghost_npc()
    local pizza_npc = self.get_pizza_npc()
    if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,ghost) then
        if self.hungry_event_check == false then
            sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_ghost, self)
        elseif self.hungry_event_check then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pizza_ghost, self))
        end
    elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,pizza_npc) then
        if self.hungry_event_check then
            self:pizza_check()
        elseif self.hungry_event_check and self.pizza_ghost_check then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pizza_end, self))
        else
            -- 원하시는 재료를 가져오시면 피자를 구워드립니다.
            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pizza_npc, { key = self.aw_ghost_script..57 })
        end
    end

    return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
    if zone_name == self.ghost_pizza_zone_name then
            if  self.ham_box_list[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
                self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] = self.box_enum.ham
            elseif self.cheese_box_list[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
                self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] = self.box_enum.cheese
            elseif self.flour_box_list[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
                self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] = self.box_enum.flour
            elseif self.chicken_box_list[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
                self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] = self.box_enum.chicken
            end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
    if e.FullLeave then
        if zone_name == self.ghost_pizza_zone_name then
            if self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] ~= nil then
                self.pizza_check_list[e.FieldObject] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

-- 오븐 앞에 재료 놓을 초록색 존 생성
function local_class:show_range()
    if is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
        local zone = field:GetZone(self.ghost_pizza_zone_name)
        local decimal_num = zone.Bounds.center.y - math.floor(zone.Bounds.center.y)
        local sub_y_val = decimal_num > 0 and decimal_num * 0.75 or 0
        self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
                vector(zone.Bounds.center.x, zone.Bounds.center.y - sub_y_val, zone.Bounds.center.z+0.1 ),
                unity_class.vector2(zone.Bounds.size.x, zone.Bounds.size.z+0.2),
                self.range_light_color,
                self.range_dark_color
        )
    end
    self.attack_range:Show()
end

-- 필드에 박스 오브젝트를 불러오기 위해 존을 설정해서 오브젝트를 불러옴
function local_class:get_box_obj(zone_name, box_name, box_list, box_enum)
    local target_zone = field:GetZone(zone_name)
    local tile_name = box_name
    local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

    for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
        local v = list[i]
        if string.find(v.Name, tile_name) then
            box_list[v] = box_enum
        end
    end
    list:Dispose()
end

-- 재료를 판별하여 어떤 피자 조합이 되는지 판단하는 함수
function local_class:pizza_check()
    local pizza_npc = self.get_pizza_npc()

    -- 체크 할 때마다 초기화 후 체크
    self.pizza_check_enum= {
        ham = 0,
        cheese = 0,
        flour = 0,
        chicken = 0
    }
    -- 피자 존 안에 있는 재료 판별
    for fo,enum in pairs(self.pizza_check_list) do
        if enum == self.box_enum.ham then
            self.pizza_check_enum.ham = self.pizza_check_enum.ham + 1
        elseif enum == self.box_enum.cheese then
            self.pizza_check_enum.cheese = self.pizza_check_enum.cheese + 1
        elseif enum == self.box_enum.flour then
            self.pizza_check_enum.flour = self.pizza_check_enum.flour + 1
        elseif enum == self.box_enum.chicken then
            self.pizza_check_enum.chicken = self.pizza_check_enum.chicken + 1
        end
    end

    if self.already_got_pizza == false then
        -- 피자 재료를 이벤트 존 안에 올려 놓지 않으면
        if self.pizza_check_enum.cheese > 0 or self.pizza_check_enum.flour > 0
                or self.pizza_check_enum.ham > 0 or self.pizza_check_enum.chicken > 0 then
            -- 밀가루가 없으면
            if self.pizza_check_enum.flour < 1 then
                -- 밀가루는 피자의 필수 재료입니다, 반드시 넣어 주셔야 해요.

        -- 이미 만들어진 피자를 먹고 나면 다시 찾아와주세요.

-- 오븐 기믹 연출 작동
function local_class:oven_start(pizza_id)
    local oven = self.get_oven()
    local gate_animator = oven:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
    gate_animator:Play('aw_oven_open')
    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    for fo,enum in pairs(self.pizza_check_list) do
        character_util.move_to(fo,field:GetMarker('pizza_oven_in').position,0.3,4 )
        wait_for_sec(0.1)
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_bakery_01')
        wait_for_sec(0.2)
    end

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
    gate_animator:Play('aw_oven_close')

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_imperial_drone_01',duration = 3})
    oven:Shake(0.04, 3)
    wait_for_sec(1.5)

    music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_elevator_03',duration = 1.9})

    wait_for_sec(1.5)

    gate_animator:Play('aw_oven_open')
    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    self:drop_pizza_util(pizza_id)

    wait_for_sec(0.6)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_food_01')

    gate_animator:Play('aw_oven_close')
    wait_for_sec(1.2)

end

-- 피자 오븐에서 피자가 튀어나오는 연출을 피자 종류별로 하기 위한 함수

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
    drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = field:GetMarker('pizza_oven_in').position,
                                 target = field:GetMarker('pizza_oven_in').position + vector(0,0,-2),
                                 itemid = pizza_id, notforinven = true, skip_text = true})

end

return local_class

	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.guide_event_zone_name and self.guide_event_check then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.guide_event, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.steal_spirit_zone_name and 	self.steal_spirit_event_check then

-- 쥐구멍으로 점프해서 들어가는 연출
function local_class:jump_into_hole(fo, hole_pos, parent)
	local jump_dir = self:vector_to_side_dir(hole_pos - fo.Position)
	local move_dur = 0.7
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fall_down_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' , parent = parent})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_die_mouse_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' , parent = parent})

	fo.Direction = jump_dir
	character_util.jump(fo, 1, move_dur)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, move_dur)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, move_dur)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'get'})
	character_util.move_to_async(fo, hole_pos, move_dur)

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_position(fo,vector(999,0,999) )

end

function local_class:jump_out_hole(fo, hole_pos, target_pos, parent)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, 0)

	fo.Position = hole_pos
	fo.Direction = self:vector_to_side_dir(target_pos - hole_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' , parent = parent})

	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'get'})
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_scale(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, 0.5)
	character_util.jump(fo,1, 0.5)

	character_util.move_to_async(fo, target_pos, 0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

end
function local_class:vector_to_side_dir(v)
	return v.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
end
return local_class
