		return get_character('choco')
	end

	---@return ICharacter
	function self.get_laura()
		return get_character('laura')
	end

	---@return Vector3
	function self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(idx)
		return field:GetMarker('laura_mouse_pos_' .. idx).position
	end

	---@return IFieldObject
	function self.get_lucy_lever()
		return get_field_object('laura_lucy_lever_1')
	end

	---@return IFieldObject
	function self.get_choco_lever()
		return get_field_object('laura_choco_lever_1')
	end

	---@return ICharacter
	function self.get_security_by_idx(idx)
		return get_character(self.security_name .. idx)
	end

	---@return Vector3
	function self.get_security_pos_by_idx(idx)
		return field:GetMarker(self.security_marker .. idx).position
	end

	---@return table<IFieldObject>
	function self.get_all_braziers()
		local left_brazier_zone = field:GetZone(self.brazier_zone_name .. 1)
		local right_brazier_zone = field:GetZone(self.brazier_zone_name .. 2)

		local get_field_objects_collided_by = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy
		local left_braziers = get_field_objects_collided_by(left_brazier_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local right_braziers = get_field_objects_collided_by(right_brazier_zone.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		local ret = {}

		local num_braziers_each_side = 3

		for i = 0, num_braziers_each_side - 1 do
			ret[#ret + 1] = left_braziers[i]
			ret[#ret + 1] = right_braziers[i]
		end
		left_braziers:Dispose()
		right_braziers:Dispose()

		return ret
	end

	---@return IFieldObject
	function self.get_lucy_switch_by_idx(idx)
		return get_field_object('laura_lucy_switch_' .. idx)
	end

	---@return IFieldObject
	function self.get_lever_by_idx(idx)
		return get_field_object(self.lever_name .. idx)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.controller:init_mouse_holes()

	if not self:is_section_available() then return end

	self.is_section_activated = true

	self:set_mouse_scale()
	self:set_prisoner_lounge()

	--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.debug_loop, self))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.keep_detecting = false

	local num_attack_ranges = #self.attack_ranges
	if num_attack_ranges > 0 then
		for i = 1, num_attack_ranges do
			local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]
			attack_range:Dispose()
			attack_range = nil
		end
	end
	self.attack_ranges = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_choco()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.change_leader_to_choco, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:debug_loop()
	while not self.game_ended do
		if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKeyDown(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.Q) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

			party_util.align_party(vector(43.17621, 0, 0.2531), 'left', 0)
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

			-- 카메라 그리드 변경 기다림
			coroutine.yield()

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')
			party_util.reset_controllers()
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

---@param e ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.section_availbility_check_zone then
		if self:is_section_available() and self.is_section_activated == false then
			self.is_section_activated = true
			self:set_mouse_scale()
			self:set_prisoner_lounge()
		end
	end

	if zone_name == self.prisoner_lounge then
		if self.current_section == self.section_state.none and self.is_section_activated then
			self:progress_section()
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mouse_calls_player, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.laura_prison_name .. self.mouse_flee_count then
		if self.current_section >= self.section_state.found_choco
				and self.current_section < self.section_state.entered_isle_zone_3 then
			self.mouse_flee_count = self.mouse_flee_count + 1
			self:progress_section()
			self:mouse_runs_away()
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.lucy_event then
		if not self.seen_lucy_event then
			self.seen_lucy_event = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lucy_move_to_lever, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.choco_end then
		if not self.seen_choco_event then
			self.seen_choco_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bomb_exploded, self)
		end
	end
end

---@param e SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if e.Stepper ~= user_party.Leader then return end

	local switch = e.SwitchObject

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(switch, self.get_lucy_switch_by_idx(2))
			and not self.has_seen_guards_got_scared then
		self.has_seen_guards_got_scared = true
		self.keep_lucy_jumping = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local lucy_lever = self.get_lucy_lever()
			local lucy = self.get_lucy()

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_anim(lucy, { name = 'cast2' })

			self:pulled_lever(lucy_lever, 1, self.lever_activation_flag.left_side_lever_activated)
		end)
	end
end

---region 연출 함수
function local_class:mouse_calls_player()
	local choco = self.get_choco()

	character_util.normal_double_jump(choco, true)
	character_util.move_distance_async(choco, vector(0, 0, -10), nil, 7,
			true, true)

	self:set_laura_prison()
end

function local_class:mouse_runs_away()
	local choco = self.get_choco()
	local lucy = self.get_lucy()

	-- 쥐가 도망가는 루틴
	local routine_to_play = nil

	local run_speed = 9

	-- 첫 번째 구역 도달
	if self.current_section == self.section_state.entered_isle_zone_1 then
		local choco_waypoint = {
			self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(2) + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
			self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(3) + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		}

		local lucy_waypoint = {
			self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(2) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
			self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(3) + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
		}

		routine_to_play = function()
			local sb = speech_bubble_util.generate_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader,
					{ key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = false, screen_pos = vector(100, 300) })
			sb.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.None
			speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubble(sb)

			for _ = 1, 2 do
				character_util.normal_jump(choco, true)
				character_util.normal_jump(lucy, false)
				coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint(choco, choco_waypoint, run_speed, true, nil, nil,
					'down')
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(lucy, lucy_waypoint, run_speed, true, nil, nil,
			'down')
		end

	-- 두 번째 구역 도달
	elseif self.current_section == self.section_state.entered_isle_zone_2 then
		local dest = self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(4)
		routine_to_play = function()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)

			local sb = speech_bubble_util.generate_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader,
					{ key = self.script_key .. 7, skip = false, screen_pos = vector(-50, 300) })
			sb.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.None
			speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubble(sb)

			for _ = 1, 2 do
				character_util.normal_jump(choco, true)
				character_util.normal_jump(lucy, false)
				coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
			end

			character_util.move_to(choco, dest + vector(0.5, 0, 0), nil,
					run_speed,true, true, nil)
			character_util.move_to_async(lucy, dest + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil,
					run_speed,true, true, nil)
			character_util.set_position(choco, dest + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
			character_util.set_direction(choco, 'down')
			character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'down')
		end

	-- 세번째 구역 도달
	elseif self.current_section == self.section_state.entered_isle_zone_3 then
		local x_distance = 4
		local y_distance = 2

		local lucy_waypoint = {
			lucy.Position + vector(-x_distance, 0, 0),
			lucy.Position + vector(-x_distance, 0, y_distance),
			self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(5)
		}

		local choco_waypoint = {
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance, 0, 0),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance, 0, y_distance),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance + 6.5, 0, y_distance),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance + 6.5, 0, -y_distance),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance + 6.5, 0, -y_distance - 1),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance + 8, 0, -y_distance - 1),
			choco.Position + vector(x_distance + 8, 0, -y_distance - 1.5)
		}

		routine_to_play = function()
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)

			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.move_waypoint_async(choco, choco_waypoint, run_speed, true, nil,
							nil, 'down')
					--character_util.set_position(choco, self.get_mouse_isle_pos_by_idx(6))
					character_util.set_direction(choco, 'left')
					character_util.add_listener(choco, self.controller)
					self.keep_choco_jumping = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_choco_jumping, self))
				end),
				util.cs_generator(function()
					character_util.move_waypoint_async(lucy, lucy_waypoint, run_speed, true, nil,
							nil, 'down')
					character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'right')
				end),
			})
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(routine_to_play))
end

function local_class:lucy_move_to_lever()
	local lucy = self.get_lucy()
	local move_speed = 8

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_distance_async(lucy, vector(0, 0, 1), nil, move_speed,
			true, true)
	character_util.move_distance_async(lucy, vector(-3, 0, 0), nil, move_speed,
	true, true)

	local switch = get_field_object('laura_lucy_switch_1')
	message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(lucy))

	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	self.keep_lucy_jumping = true
	local jump_sfx = nil

	while self.keep_lucy_jumping do
		for _ = 1, 2 do
			jump_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', parent = lucy,
			                                        type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 8 })
			character_util.normal_jump(lucy, false)
			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
			jump_sfx:Stop()
		end

		if self.keep_lucy_jumping then
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
	end

	jump_sfx:Stop()
	jump_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:pulled_lever(lever, flag)
	local animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('pull')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.lever_activation_state = self.lever_activation_state | flag
	local cam_fade_duration = 0.35

	-- 레버 두 개를 당겨졌다면 모두 당겨졌을 때 연출 실행 후 탈출
	if self.lever_activation_state == self.lever_activation_flag.all_levers_activated then
		self:pulled_all_levers()

		screen_util.fade_out_async(cam_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		local right_security = self.get_security_by_idx(4)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(right_security)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(cam_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		return
	end

	self:pulled_first_lever()

	local cam_fade_duration = 0.35
	screen_util.fade_out_async(cam_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	local left_security = self.get_security_by_idx(3)
	local right_security = self.get_security_by_idx(4)

	self:show_all_attack_ranges()

	character_util.set_direction(left_security, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(right_security, 'down')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(left_security)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(right_security)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(cam_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		local right_security = self.get_security_by_idx(4)

		character_util.set_direction(right_security, 'down')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(left_security)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(right_security)

		self:show_all_attack_ranges()

					{ name = 'ondemand/afterworld/preload:bgm_afterworld_main', state = 'field' })
		end

		screen_util.fade_in_async(cam_fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	end

	-- 레버 두 개를 당겨졌다면 모두 당겨졌을 때 연출 실행 후 탈출
	if self.lever_activation_state == self.lever_activation_flag.all_levers_activated then
		self:pulled_all_levers()
		end_routine()

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
		return
	end

	self:pulled_first_lever()

	end_routine()

--- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target, distance, angle)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local full_diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center
	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)) > angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	if field:IsAnythingBlockingWithoutBounds(CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, vector(0.05, 0.05, 0.05)),
			CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, vector_util.get_x0z(full_diff)) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:hide_all_attack_ranges()
	for i = 1, #self.attack_ranges do
		local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]
		attack_range.AttackRange.gameObject:SetActive(false);
	end
end

function local_class:show_all_attack_ranges()
	for i = 1, #self.attack_ranges do
		local attack_range = self.attack_ranges[i]
		attack_range.AttackRange.gameObject:SetActive(true);
	end
end

function local_class:security_detect_routine()
	local securtiy_list = {
		self.get_security_by_idx(3),
		self.get_security_by_idx(4)
	}

	while self.current_section < self.section_state.activated_all_levers and self.keep_detecting == true do
		for i = 1, #securtiy_list do
			local security = securtiy_list[i]

			local is_in_sight = self:is_in_sight(security, user_party.Leader, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
			if is_in_sight then
				-- 누구냐!
				self:on_detected_by_security(security)
				break
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_detected_by_security(security)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_animation('embarrassed', true)

	character_util.set_anim(security, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_police_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(security, { key = 'aw_laura_8_1', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = false})

	local fade_duration = 0.5
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.black,'linear')
	party_util.align_party(vector(37.5, 0, 68), 'down', 0, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(security)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(security)
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	screen_util.fade_in_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.black,'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

	local gate_animator = laura_gate:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	laura_gate.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	gate_animator.speed = 10
	gate_animator:Play('factory_door_open')
	laura_gate.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:mouse_rush()
	local choco = self.get_choco()
	local lucy = self.get_lucy()
	local distance_vec = vector(0, 0, 9)
	local align_distance = vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local move_speed = 10
	local laura_init_pos = field:GetMarker('laura_chained').position

	self.cur_state = self.section_state.mouse_rushed

	character_util.set_position(choco, field:GetMarker('laura_choco_dash_start').position)
	character_util.set_position(lucy, field:GetMarker('laura_lucy_dash_start').position)

	character_util.set_direction(choco, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mouse_01')

	-- 쥐시키들 로라에게 달려간 다음 양 옆으로 정렬
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			lucy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			local dest = laura_init_pos - align_distance
			character_util.move_to_async(lucy, vector(dest.x, 0, lucy.Position.z), nil, move_speed,
					true, true)
			character_util.move_to_async(lucy, dest, nil, move_speed, true,
				true)
			character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(lucy, { name = 'push' })
			character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'tired' })
			lucy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local dest = laura_init_pos + align_distance

			choco.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.move_to_async(choco, vector(dest.x, 0, choco.Position.z), nil, move_speed,
					true, true)
			-- character_util.move_distance_async(lucy, distance_vec, nil, move_speed, true,
			-- 		true)
			character_util.move_to_async(choco, dest, nil, move_speed, true,
					true)
			character_util.set_direction(choco, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim(choco, { name = 'push' })
			character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'tired' })
			choco.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end),
	})
end

function local_class:floating_bubble_async(fo, string_idx, skippable)
	skippable = lua_helper.get_or_default(skippable, true)
	local bubble_offset = vector(2.2, 0, 1.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, { key = self.script_key .. string_idx,
	                                                  skip = skippable, offset = bubble_offset })
end

function local_class:released_laura()
	self.cur_state = self.section_state.released_laura

	party_util.align_party(vector(37.5, 0, 84), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_occult', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	self.magic_circle_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_magic_circle_active_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	camera_util.move_async(vector(37.5, 0, 84.73), 1)

	local laura = self.get_laura()
	local choco = self.get_choco()
	local lucy = self.get_lucy()

	-- 로라 : 루시, 초코…!
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(laura, { name = 'surprised' })
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 13)

	-- 로라 : 너희 대체 여긴 어떻게…
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'right')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 14)

	-- 로라 : 경비병들은…?
	character_util.set_emotion(laura, { name = 'tired' })
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 15)

	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(choco, 'down')

	character_util.remove_anim(lucy)
	character_util.remove_anim(choco)

	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'smile' })

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		character_util.normal_jump(lucy, true)
		character_util.normal_jump(choco, false)
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))
	end

	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(laura, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.remove_emotion(lucy)
	character_util.remove_emotion(choco)

	-- 로라 : 당신은… 그때 그 마법학교 때의…
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 16)

	-- 로라 : …
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 17)

	-- 로라(left, idle, idle) : 루시.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'left')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 18)

	-- 로라(right,idle,idle) : 초코.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(choco, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'right')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 19)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 너희에겐 제대로 말해준 적 없지만…
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'down')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 20)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 과거의 난 절대 씻지 못할 중죄를 저질렀어.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 21)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 결코 용서받을 수 없는… 생명을 제물로 쓰는 무거운 죄를 말이야.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 22)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 너희들이 죽었을 때… 어떤 기분이었는지 알았는데도...
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 23)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) :  결계를 풀어준 건 고마워.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 24)

	-- 로라(down, idle, ide) : 하지만… 나는 나갈 수 없어.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 25)

	-- 루시, 초코 동시에 nodx2, tired 하더니 이내 tired, eat으로 영혼 에너지를 건네준다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'tired' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'damaged' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mouse_01')
	character_util.set_anim(lucy, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_anim(choco, { name = 'eat' })

	-- 루시, 초코 계속 eat하면서 에너지 천천히 줄어들고 로라 에너지는 올라가는 걸 보여주도록 해야함
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local count_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_number_01', loop = true})
		character_util.rolling_number(choco.Transform, 100,
				nil, 8, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

		character_util.rolling_number(lucy.Transform, 100,
				nil, 8, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

		character_util.rolling_number(laura.Transform, 999973998,
				nil, 8, unity_class.color.red)

		wait_for_sec(8)
		count_sfx:Stop()
		count_sfx = nil
	end))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 로라(left, idle, idle) : 그만해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 26, false)

	-- 로라(right, idle, idle) : 뭐 하는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'right')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 27, false)

	-- 로라(left, idle, idle) : 그만하라니까…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'left')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 28,false)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 루시, 초코 에너지 100정도 남고 에너지 건네주는거 멈춘 후. idle, releasex2
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(lucy, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(choco, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		end),
	})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lucy)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(choco)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 로라(left, idle, idle) : …
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 29)

	-- 로라 아래쪽 보고 한 번 떰
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'down')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(laura, 0.04, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 로라(left, idle, idle) : 나한테… 왜 이렇게까지…
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 30)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 내 죄를 씻어내려면… 아주 오랜 시간이 걸리게 될 거야.
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'down')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 31)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 그게 몇 달이 될지, 몇 년이 될지, 몇 십 년이 될지는… 아무도 몰라.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 32)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 그래도… 내 곁에 있어줄 거야?
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 33)

	local mouse_move_close_to_laura = vector(0.125, 0, 0)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_distance_async(lucy, mouse_move_close_to_laura, 0.5, nil,
					true, true)
			character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(lucy, nil, 'heart')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_distance_async(choco, -mouse_move_close_to_laura,
					0.5, nil, true, true)
			character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(choco, nil, 'heart')
		end),
	})

	-- 루시, 초코 side, smile, idle
	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_emotion(choco, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : ...
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 29)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 루시, 초코…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'left')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 34)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 고마워…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'right')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 35)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 이런 나라도 다시 받아들여줘서.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 36)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 죗값을 다 치르고 나면…
	character_util.set_direction(laura, 'down')
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 38)

	-- 로라(down, idle, idle) : 정말로 셋이 행복했던 그때로 돌아가자.
	self:floating_bubble_async(laura, 39)

	-- 루시 right, idle, smile 로라 down, idle, smile 초코 left, idle, smile로 서 있음.
	character_util.set_emotion(laura, { name = 'smile' })

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 돌아옴.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	self.magic_circle_sfx:Stop()
	self.magic_circle_sfx = nil
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/afterworld/preload:bgm_afterworld_main', state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:lucy_gives_star_piece()
	local lucy = self.get_lucy()
	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'down')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mouse_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party.Leader,
			{ key = self.script_key .. 8, skip = true, scale = 1.2,
			  screen_pos = vector(-50, 400), bubble_type = 'shout' })

	local room_center = field:GetMarker('laura_gate_room_center').position
	party_util.align_party(room_center, 'down', 1,'arc')

	character_util.set_position(lucy, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 6))
	character_util.move_to_async(lucy, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			nil, 4, true,true)


	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(lucy, true)

	-- 루시가 스타피스 던져줌
	star_piece_util.appear(get_field_object('laura_star_piece'), lucy.Position,
			user_party.Leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0))
	-- 루시 다시 로라 방으로 올라감.

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lucy, nil, 'heart')
	character_util.move_to_async(lucy, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 6),
			nil, 4, true,true)

	local laura_init_pos = field:GetMarker('laura_chained').position
	local room_pos_adjust = vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(lucy, laura_init_pos - room_pos_adjust)
	character_util.set_direction(lucy, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(lucy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lucy)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldLightManagerSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = AfterWorldLightManager @
		Comment = 상인에게 파인애플 피자 구매 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 존 이름
	self.dancer_event_zone_name = 'island_dance'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

--region Event Listener
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if not self.controller.is_in_dance_zone and e.Zone.Name == self.dancer_event_zone_name then
			self.controller.is_in_dance_zone = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dance_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.light_manager) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_light_manager, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.island_booth) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_island_booth, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.island_radio) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_island_radio, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.island_item_holder) then
		local has_item = false

		for i = 1, #self.controller.buy_item_flags do
			if self.controller.buy_item_flags[i] then
				has_item = true

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.take_on_item_holder, self)

				break
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.controller.island_sell_item_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.island_sell_item_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_seller, self, i)

			break
		end
	end

	return true
end
--endregion

-- 댄스 이벤트
function local_class:dance_event()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:dance_event())
end

-- 가로등지기와 대화 이벤트
function local_class:talk_with_light_manager()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:talk_with_light_manager())
end

-- 섬 상인과 상호작용 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_island_booth()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:interact_with_island_booth())
end

-- 라디오와 상호작용 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_island_radio()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:interact_with_island_radio())
end

-- 댄스장 아이템 홀더와 상호작용 이벤트
function local_class:take_on_item_holder()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:take_on_item_holder())
end

-- 섬 가판대와 상호작용 이벤트
function local_class:interact_with_seller(index)
	coroutine.yield(self.controller:interact_with_seller(index))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end -- 방어코드

	self.maiden = get_character(self.maiden_name)
	self.princess = get_character(self.princess_name)

	self.main_character = get_character(self.main_character_name)
	self.firefly = get_character(self.firefly_name)

	self.corridor_reaper_spine_controller_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.SpineController)
	for i = 1, self.invader_reaper_num do
		self.corridor_reaper_spine_controller_list:Add(self:get_spine_controller(self.invader_reaper_name..i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.angry_guide_num do
		self.corridor_reaper_spine_controller_list:Add(self:get_spine_controller(self.angry_guide_name..i))
	end

	for i = 1, self.worry_branch_reaper_num do
		self.corridor_reaper_spine_controller_list:Add(self:get_spine_controller(self.worry_branch_reaper_name..i))
	end

	self.corridor_reaper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.oneline_reaper_num do
		self.corridor_reaper_list:Add(get_character(self.oneline_reaper_name..i))
	end

	self.reaper_leader = get_character(self.reaper_leader_name)

	self.co_worker_reaper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.co_worker_reaper_num do
		self.co_worker_reaper_list:Add(get_character(self.co_worker_reaper_name..i))
	end

	return true
end

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))
end

	self.maiden = nil

	self.main_character = nil
	self.firefly = nil

	self.corridor_reaper_spine_controller_list = nil
	self.corridor_reaper_list = nil

	self.co_worker_reaper_list = nil
	self.reaper_leader = nil
	self.corridor_reaper_list = nil

end

-- 스파인 컨트롤러 이름으로 찾아서 리턴

	return CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageTransform:Find(name):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
end

function local_class:intro_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 플레이어의 현재 부유성 정보 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, "theatres/heavenhold_theatre", "heavenhold_theatre", function(prefab)
				self.heavenhold_obj = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
			end)

	self.heavenhold_theatre = self.heavenhold_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.HeavenholdTheatre))

	coroutine.yield(self.heavenhold_theatre:LoadHeavenHoldTheatre(nil))

	local stage_camera_rotation = stage.StageCamera.Transform.parent.localRotation
	stage.StageCamera.Transform.parent.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	camera_util.move_async(unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_zoom_in, self))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_tavern', state = 'event' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bird_enter_01')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(self.heavenhold_theatre:UnloadHeavenHoldTheatre())

	if self.heavenhold_obj ~= nil then
		self.heavenhold_theatre = nil

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.heavenhold_obj)
	end

	if self.heavenhold_christmas ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.heavenhold_christmas)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- Tavern Background 로드
	local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local tavern_root

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			resholder, "ui/backgrounds/tavern", "tavern", function(prefab)
				tavern_root = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				tavern_root.transform.localPosition = self.tavern_2d_create_position
				tavern_root.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

				CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(tavern_root.transform, "Default")

				local tavern_camera = tavern_root.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
				tavern_camera.cullingMask = 1
				tavern_camera.clearFlags = CS.UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.SolidColor
				tavern_camera.backgroundColor = unity_class.color.black
				tavern_camera.orthographicSize = 2.5;

-- 카메라 줌 인
function local_class:camera_zoom_in()
	local start_size = 6
	local end_size = 2
	local duration = 4

	local heavenhold_camera = self.heavenhold_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = 6

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration

		if heavenhold_camera ~= nil then
			heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = start_size + (end_size - start_size) * normalized
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 아이템 흔들리는 연출
function local_class:shake_item(item)
	self.is_shake_item = true

	local item_pos = item.SpriteTransform.localPosition
	local shadow_pos = item.ShadowTransform.localPosition
	local shake_range = 0.02

	while self.is_shake_item do
		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = item_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)
		item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = shadow_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_to_room_out(npc, waypoint_list, speed)
	local dist = 0
	for i = 0, waypoint_list.Count - 1 do
		if i == 0 then
			dist = dist + (npc.Position - waypoint_list[i]).magnitude
		else
			dist = dist + (waypoint_list[i - 1] - waypoint_list[i]).magnitude
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(npc, waypoint_list, speed,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	if dist / speed > 1 then
		wait_for_sec(dist / speed - 1)
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end -- 방어코드

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomSendValueEvent), 'on_event')

	self.event_reaper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.event_reaper_num do
		self.event_reaper_list:Add(get_character(self.event_reaper_name..i))
	end

	self.event_prisoner_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.event_prisoner_num do
		self.event_prisoner_list:Add(get_character(self.event_prisoner_name..i))
	end

	self.party_prisoner_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	self.party_prisoner_list:Add(get_character(self.marty_name))
	self.party_prisoner_list:Add(get_character(self.tao_name))
	self.party_prisoner_list:Add(get_character(self.aggro_girl_name))

	self.main_character = get_character(self.main_character_name)

	self.gatekeeper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.gatekeeper_num do
		local cur_gatekeeper = get_character(self.gatekeeper_name..i)

		cur_gatekeeper.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
				cur_gatekeeper, self.gatekeeper_detected_custom_event, 4, 60)

		self.gatekeeper_list:Add(cur_gatekeeper)
	end

	self.hide_box_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.hide_box_num do
		local cur_box = get_field_object(self.hide_box_name..i)
		cur_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		self.hide_box_list:Add(cur_box)
	end

	self.pizza_holdable_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.pizza_holdable_num do
		self.pizza_holdable_list:Add(get_field_object(self.pizza_holdable_name..i))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	-- 문 닫음
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.box_bypass_door_name))

	-- 컨베이어 벨트 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			nil, { self.pause_animation_custom_event, self.belt_animation_zone_name }))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.pause_hammer_custom_event }))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			nil, { 'deactivate_sound_zone', 'conveyor_belt_sound_4' }))

	-- 박스 방 컨베이어 벨트 내리는 기믹 비활성화
	for i = 1, self.box_room_jump_down_num do
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.box_room_jump_down_name..i, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 설정
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-53.5, 0, 57.5))

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 9 then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.is_siren_tint = false

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomSendValueEvent))

	self.main_character = nil

	self.event_reaper_list = nil
	self.event_prisoner_list = nil
	self.party_prisoner_list = nil
	self.gatekeeper_list = nil

	self.hide_box_list = nil
	self.pizza_holdable_list = nil

	self.dough_list = nil

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		self:on_throw_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomSendValueEvent) then
		self:on_custom_send_value_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.box_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_box_zone then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_box_zone

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self)
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.conveyor_belt_finished_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.conveyor_belt_finished then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.conveyor_belt_finished

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(15.5, 0, 173))

				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_4))

				-- 우회로 문 염
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.box_bypass_door_name))

				-- 플레이어가 컨베이어 벨트에서 내릴 때까지 대기하는 루틴
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.wait_for_get_out_conveyor_belt, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.gatekeeper_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.conveyor_belt_finished and
					not self.is_play_gatekeeper_event then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gatekeeper_event, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.first_floor_zone_name then
			if not self.is_in_first_floor then
				self.is_in_first_floor = true

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-53.5, 0, 57.5))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.second_floor_zone_name then
			if self.is_in_first_floor then
				self.is_in_first_floor = false

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.idle then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
							self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-10.5, 0, 76.5))
				elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.conveyor_belt_finished then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
							self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(15.5, 0, 173))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.hide_box_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hide_box_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_box_event, self, e.Target)

			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.pizza_holdable_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pizza_holdable_list[i]) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.box_throw_check, self, e.Target))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.gatekeeper_detected_custom_event and not self.is_detected and not self.is_throw_box then
			self.is_detected = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.gatekeeper_detect_event, self, e.Sender)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_send_value_event(e)
	if self.dough_list ~= nil and self.is_move_dough and e.Key == self.hit_hammer_custom_event then
		for i = 0, self.dough_list.Count - 1 do
			if not self.dough_hitted_flags[i + 1] and (self.dough_list[i].Position - e.VectorParam).magnitude < 0.7 then
				self.dough_hitted_flags[i + 1] = true

				local past_item = self.dough_list[i]

				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset):Instantiate(
						past_item.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

				self.dough_list[i] = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = past_item.Position, itemid = self.flat_dough_item_id,
					notforinven = true, sprscale = 1.3, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
				self.dough_list[i].Position = past_item.Position

				past_item:ConsumeComplete()
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 스테이지 입장 이벤트
function local_class:intro_event()
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_rolling_number(
			get_party_leader().Transform, self.soul_point, nil, 0, unity_class.color.red)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	for i = 0, self.party_prisoner_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.party_prisoner_list[i],
				get_party_leader().Position + vector(0.7 * (i + 1), 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.party_prisoner_list[i], 'left')

		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.party_prisoner_list[i], user_party, true)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.main_character,
			get_party_leader().Position + vector(2.8, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.main_character, 'left')
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.main_character, user_party, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 스테이지 시작 연출
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry,
			get_party_leader().Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))
end

-- 들켜서 박스 지역에 갇히는 이벤트
function local_class:detected_event()
	party_util.align_party(
			vector(-10.5, 0, get_party_leader().Position.z + 2), 'down', 1, 'arc')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	self.is_siren_tint = true

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.siren_tint_event, self))

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.main_character,
			{
				key = self.main_script..1,
				screen_pos = vector(-100, 200),
				bubble_type = 'shout',
				skip = true
			})

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party[i], self.party_prisoner_list[1]) then
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		end
	end

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-10.5, 0, 70), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.hide_box_gate_name, false))

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.move_async(get_party_leader().Position, 1, { end_target = get_party_leader() })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	character_util.jump(self.party_prisoner_list[2], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.party_prisoner_list[2], { name = 'attack' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.party_prisoner_list[2], { key = self.main_script..2, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	character_util.set_anim(self.party_prisoner_list[0], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party[i], self.party_prisoner_list[0]) then
			character_util.look_at(user_party[i], self.party_prisoner_list[0])
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(
			self.party_prisoner_list[0], { key = self.main_script..3, skip = true })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.time_limit, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })
end

-- 사이렌 틴트 연출
function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_oneshot_04", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_siren_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

-- 타이머 종료 시 호출되는 함수

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.timer_finished_event, self)
end

-- 타이머 종료 연출
function local_class:timer_finished_event()
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-10.5, 0, 72), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.hide_box_gate_name, false))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 0, 5 do
		local val = math.floor(i / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		character_util.set_anim(self.event_prisoner_list[i], { name = 'run' })
		character_util.set_position(self.event_prisoner_list[i], vector(-11 + mod, 0, 64 - val))
		character_util.move_to(self.event_prisoner_list[i],
				self.event_prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 8),
				1.5, nil, true, false, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	for i = 0, 5 do
		character_util.look_at(self.event_prisoner_list[i], get_party_leader())
		character_util.jump(self.event_prisoner_list[i], 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(self.event_prisoner_list[i], { name = 'throw', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	end

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.look_at(user_party[i], self.event_prisoner_list[0])
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })

-- 박스로 이동해서 들어가는 파티원들
function local_class:move_to_box(npc, box)
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local last_dir

	if npc.Position.x < box.Position.x then
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x - 1, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x - 1, 0, box.Position.z))

		last_dir = 'right'
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x + 1, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x + 1, 0, box.Position.z))

		last_dir = 'left'
	end

	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, waypoint_list,
			6, true, 'stop', 'floor', last_dir, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk4legs' })
	character_util.move_to_async(npc, npc.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(npc.Direction),
			1, nil, true, false)

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
end

-- 박스로 이동해서 들어올리는 일꾼들
function local_class:move_to_box_and_holdup(npc, box)
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	local last_dir

	if npc.Position.x < box.Position.x then
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x - 1, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x - 1, 0, box.Position.z))

		last_dir = 'right'
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x + 1, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(box.Position.x + 1, 0, box.Position.z))

		last_dir = 'left'
	end

	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, waypoint_list,
			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', last_dir)

	box.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
	box.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	command_util.execute_holdup(npc, box, npc.Position)
end

-- 박스를 특정 지점에 내려놓는 일꾼들 + 박스가 이동하다가 특정 위치에서 멈춤
function local_class:move_and_throw_box(npc, party_member, box, stop_pos_z)
	box.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	if npc.Position.x < -10.5 then
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(-10.85, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(-10.85, 0, 83.3))
	else
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(-10.15, 0, npc.Position.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(-10.15, 0, 83.3))
	end

	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, waypoint_list,
			3, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim(npc)

	command_util.execute_throw(
			npc, box, vector(0, 1, 1), npc.Position, 9, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_box_02')

	character_util.move_to(npc, npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -12),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	while box.Position.z < stop_pos_z do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.box_move_finished_num = self.box_move_finished_num + 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset):Instantiate(
			box.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(party_member, vector(box.Position.x, 1, box.Position.z))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(party_member, 1, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_anim(party_member, { name = 'run' })

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			nil, { 'add_ignore_conveyor_belt_moving', party_member.Name }))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(party_member, get_party_leader()) then
		stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())
	end

	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(box.Name, 'disabled')

	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
end

-- 피자 도우 이동하다가 망치에 찍히면 변형
function local_class:move_dough()
	local move_speed = 2.45

	while self.is_move_dough do
		for i = 0, self.dough_list.Count - 1 do
			self.dough_list[i].Position = self.dough_list[i].Position +
					vector(-1, 0, 0) * unity_class.time.deltaTime * move_speed
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 0, self.dough_list.Count - 1 do
		self.dough_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.dough_list = nil
end

-- 플레이어 HP 체크해서 리셋시키는 이벤트
function local_class:check_player_hp()
	while self.is_on_conveyor_belt do
		if get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.HP <
				get_party_leader().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.1 then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()

			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
						nil, { 'add_ignore_conveyor_belt_moving', user_party[i].Name }))

				character_util.set_direction(user_party[i],
						CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(user_party[i].Direction))
				character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'dead', loop = false })
				character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'damaged' })
			end

			wait_for_sec(2.5)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				-- 힐로 HP 초기화
				local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
				heal_info.sender = nil
				heal_info.target = user_party[i]
				heal_info.heal = user_party[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

				command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

				character_util.set_position(user_party[i], vector(-10.5, 1, 94 - 0.7 * i))
				character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'up')
				character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
				character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
			end

			wait_for_sec(1)

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
						nil, { 'remove_ignore_conveyor_belt_moving', user_party[i].Name }))
			end

			field_ui_manager:Show()

			party_util.reset_controllers()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 컨베이어 벨트에서 내릴 때까지 대기
function local_class:wait_for_get_out_conveyor_belt()
	while get_party_leader().Position.y > 0 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	self.is_on_conveyor_belt = false

	character_util.set_immortal(get_party_leader(), false)

	for i = 1, self.block_shortcut_reaper_num do
		character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.block_shortcut_reaper_name..i), 'disabled')
	end

	-- 박스 방 컨베이어 벨트 내리는 기믹 활성화
	for i = 1, self.box_room_jump_down_num do
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.box_room_jump_down_name..i, 'enabled')
	end
end

function local_class:box_throw_check(target)
	self.is_throw_box = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 던져지는 물체 움직임이 멈출 때까지 대기
	local past_pos = target.Position
	local cur_pos = past_pos

	local is_play_sound = false

	while true do
		if not is_play_sound and target.Position.y < 0.1 then
			is_play_sound = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_food_01')
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		past_pos = cur_pos
		cur_pos = target.Position

		if (past_pos - cur_pos):IsAlmostZero() then
			break
		end
	end

	-- 던지기 완전히 끝날 때까지 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local target_pos = (self.gatekeeper_list[0].Position + self.gatekeeper_list[1].Position) / 2

	if (target.Position - target_pos).magnitude < self.gatekeeper_distance_limit then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.pizza_thrown

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
		quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.gatekeeper_runaway_event, self, target)
	else
		self.is_throw_box = false
	end
end

function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_oneshot_04", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_siren_tint  do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
	end

function local_class:guard_tutorial_scene()
	--군중 잠입 튜토리얼. 대로변에서 사람들 사이를 누비며 저승사자의 감시를 피한다.
	--영혼들이 대로변을 이동하며 돌아다니고 있고 중간 중간 저승 사자들이 감시하며 로밍하고 있다.
	--영혼들 뒤에 숨어서 저승 사자들의 감시망을 피해 돌아다닌다.
	local zone_bounds = field:GetZone('s12_guard_tutorial').Bounds
	local align_center = vector(zone_bounds.center.x, 0, zone_bounds.min.z + 1)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local is_left = leader.Position.x < align_center.x

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
				leader.Position, 3, false)
	end

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(leader, {waypoints = align_center
			+ (is_left and vector(-0.6, 0, 0) or vector(0.6, 0, 0)),
									 speed = 2, callback = move_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = align_center
			+ (is_left and vector(0.6, 0, 0) or vector(-0.6, 0, 0)),
								   speed = 2, callback = move_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--하나 up으로 한번 점프 후 (left, scared, release) : 회, 회사의 경비병들이에요!
	character_util.normal_jump(main)
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s12_14')

	--하나(left, scared, cast) : 그냥 지나가다간 영혼 에너지 수치 때문에 잡히게 되실 텐데…

function local_class:enter_square_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local staff_1 = self.get_staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.get_staff(2)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
				leader.Position, 3, false)
	end

	--광장에 도착하면 중앙 우측에서 팜플렛을 나눠주는 직원 강제 이벤트 발생.
	local align_pos = self:get_marker_pos('square_align')
	wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
			{waypoints = align_pos, speed = (leader.Position - align_pos).magnitude / 2,
			 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right})
	wp_util.move_way_points(main,
			{waypoints = align_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			 speed = (main.Position - align_pos - vector(1, 0, 0)).magnitude / 2,
			 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right})

	--직원1,2 팜플렛(paper_piece) 나눠주고 있다.
	camera_util.move_async((staff_1.Position + staff_2.Position) / 2, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {'sneak', 'disable_area_1'}))

	--직원1(left, smile, idle) : ‘카론의 고급 관광 패키지’! 마감 임박입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_17', skip = true})

	--직원2(left, smile, idle) : 저렴한 영혼 에너지로 최고의 관광 혜택을 누릴 기회!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_2, {key = 'aw_main_s12_18', skip = true})

	--직원1, 팜플렛 나눠주다 가디언에게 다가가

	self:detach_paper(staff_1)
	self:detach_paper(staff_2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	staff_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	character_util.normal_jump(staff_1, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(staff_2)

	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	local staff_1_wp = leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5)
	local staff_2_wp = leader.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(leader.Position, 1, {end_target = leader})
	local staff_move_done_count = 0
	local staff_move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			staff_move_done_count = staff_move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(staff_1,
			{waypoints = staff_1_wp, callback = staff_move_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			 speed = (staff_1_wp - staff_1.Position).magnitude, run = true, play_sfx = true})
	--(직원2도 같이 걸어와 직원1위에 left로 위치해 선다.)
	wp_util.move_way_points(staff_2,
			{waypoints = staff_2_wp, callback = staff_move_done_cb,  last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left,
			 speed = (staff_2_wp - staff_2.Position).magnitude, run = true, play_sfx = true})

	-- 가디언을 발견하고 옆에 있던 하나를 밀치며 둘러 싼다.
	local main_fly_check_dist = 0.6 * 0.6
	-- 혹시나 무한 루프 돌 상황 대비해서 그냥 조건문을 미리 세팅해놓음
	while staff_move_done_count < 2 do
		local dist_to_staff_1 = (staff_1.Position - main.Position).sqrMagnitude
		local dist_to_staff_2 = (staff_2.Position - main.Position).sqrMagnitude

		if dist_to_staff_1 < main_fly_check_dist or dist_to_staff_2 < main_fly_check_dist then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local target_pos = leader.Position + vector(-0.6, 0, -2 + -1)
		local duration = 0.5

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0.3, 0))
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0.3, 0))

		camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.3)

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(main)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(main)
		character_util.spine_rotate(main, -720, duration)
		character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'damaged'})
		character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = duration})

		character_util.jump(main, 1.5, duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(main, target_pos, duration)
		character_util.spine_rotate(main, 0, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
		character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'confused'})
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(main)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(main)
	end))

	while staff_move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--최저가 이용권 뽑기에 도전해볼 생각이 있냐고 묻는다.
	--직원1(left, smile, sing) : 거기, 헤실한 영혼님!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(staff_1, {name = 'sing'})
	character_util.set_anim(staff_2, {name = 'sing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_19', skip = true})

	--직원1(left, smile, sing) : ‘최저가 이용권 뽑기’에 도전해볼 생각 없으신가요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_20', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(staff_2)

	--가디언 right, tired, releasex2 다음
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, {name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2})

	--right, tired, bomb_idle
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	wait_for_sec(1.3)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--직원1(left, surprise, idle) : 네에? 영혼 에너지가 없으시다구요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.normal_jump(staff_1)
	character_util.normal_jump(staff_2)
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_2, {name = 'surprise'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_21', skip = true})

	--직원1(left, tired, idle) : 그런…
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_2, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_22', skip = true})

	--직원1(left, smile, cast2) : …분들을 위해 준비했습니다! ‘고급 노역소 패키지!’ (대사와 동시에 가디언 surprise)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_2, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, 'cast2', nil, 'aw_main_s12_23')

	--직원2(left, smile, sing) : 함께 구매해서 막노동으로 갚으면 걱정 끝! 참 쉽죠?
	character_util.play_speech_action(staff_2, 'sing', nil, 'aw_main_s12_24')

	--가디언 surprise 표정 유지하며 살짝 몸을 떤다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(leader, 0.025, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1.6)

	--가디언 scared표정으로 left, right 한번씩보다가
	--left쪽으로 뒷걸음치지만 직원들이 다가온다.

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	wp_util.move_way_points(staff_1, {waypoints = staff_1.Position + backstep_diff, speed = 0.5})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(staff_2,
			{waypoints = staff_2.Position + backstep_diff, speed = 0.5})

	leader.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--직원2(left, smile, cast) : 아이, 그러지 마시고 한 번만!

			 speed = 1.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})

			{waypoints = {
				vector(leader_x + backstep_diff.x - 1.5, 0, staff_2.Position.z),
				vector(leader_x + backstep_diff.x - 1.5, 0, leader.Position.z),
			}, speed = 4, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, play_sfx = true})

	leader.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--가디언, 자신을 둘러싼 직원들 한 번씩 쳐다본다.

	leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언, 표정이 scared로 변한다.

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--선택지
	--붉은색 뽑기
	--보라색 뽑기
	--노란색 뽑기
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'aw_main_s12_27', 'brutal'},
		{'aw_main_s12_28', 'forced'},
		{'aw_main_s12_29', 'intellect'},
	})

	local leader_origin_pos = leader.Position
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'katana_walk', scale = 0.7})
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, staff_1.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'katana_idle'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'paper_piece')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'katana_walk', scale = 0.7})
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader_origin_pos, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'katana_idle'})

	--어떤 걸 뽑던 직원은 80%할인에 당첨되었다면서 가디언을 당장 끌고 가려고 한다.
	--직원1(left, surprise, idle) : 세상에나…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	self:detach_paper(staff_1)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_2, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(staff_1, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(staff_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_30', skip = true})

	--직원1(left, awesome, sing) : 고.객.님! 운이 너~무 좋으시네요!

	character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'awesome'})
	character_util.set_emotion(staff_2, {name = 'awesome'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, 'sing', nil, 'aw_main_s12_31')

	--직원2 left,, aswesome, clap, 가디언 surprise 표정으로 한 번 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(staff_2, {name = 'clap'})
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_1, {key = 'aw_main_s12_33', skip = true})

function local_class:play_qte(direction)
	self.qte_success = false
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(direction)

	while not self.qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:guard_hit_routine(guards, ghost)
	local attacker_index = 1
	local effect_pos_list = {}

	for _, guard in pairs(guards) do
		table.insert(effect_pos_list, ghost.Position
				+ (guard.Position - ghost.Position).normalized * 0.3 + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	end

	while self.event_state ~= nil and self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.exit_square do
		local attacker = guards[attacker_index]
		character_util.set_anim(attacker, { name = 'attack', loop = false})
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		if self.event_state == nil or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.exit_square then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = ghost, max_distance = 3, min_distance = 2,
			type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
		})
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos_list[attacker_index])
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(ghost)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(ghost)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		if self.event_state == nil or self.current_event_state == self.event_state.exit_square then
			return
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(attacker)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		attacker_index = attacker_index + 1

		if attacker_index > #guards then
			attacker_index = 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:try_exit_wrong(zone)
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	--광장의 다른 출구들로 나가려 하면 노역소는 그쪽이 아니라며 하나가 막는다.
	--하나 : 노역소는 이쪽이 아니에요…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast', 'tired', 'aw_main_s12_110')

	local zone_bounds = zone.Bounds

	local main_target_pos
	local leader_target_pos

	if zone_bounds.min.x > leader.Position.x then
		leader_target_pos = vector(zone_bounds.min.x + 1, 0, leader.Position.z)
		main_target_pos = main.Position + (leader_target_pos - leader.Position)
	elseif zone_bounds.max.x < leader.Position.x then
		leader_target_pos = vector(zone_bounds.max.x - 1, 0, leader.Position.z)
		main_target_pos = main.Position + (leader_target_pos - leader.Position)
	elseif zone_bounds.max.z < leader.Position.z then
		leader_target_pos = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, zone_bounds.max.z - 1)
		main_target_pos = main.Position + (leader_target_pos - leader.Position)
	end

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(leader, {waypoints = leader_target_pos, speed = 2, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = main_target_pos, speed = 2, callback = move_done_cb})

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_trying_exit_wrong = false
end

	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},

	--하나 : 아고라에 이기기 위해선… 카론의 악행에 대한 증거를 철저히 준비해야 해요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s12_101', skip = true})
