	--하나 : 하지만… 귀인님은 노역소에 돌아갈 정도로 악한 영혼이 아닌 건 알아요!
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s12_102')

	--하나 : …이런 저라도 괜찮다면 함께 해주시겠어요?
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'sing',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s12_103')

	--하나 : 함께 카론의 악행에 대한 증거를 찾고, 귀인님의 결백도 증명하는 거예요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast2', nil, 'aw_main_s12_104')

	--가디언 smile, nodx2
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	--하나 : 그럼 출발할까요?
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'smile', 'aw_main_s12_105')

	--가디언 question
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--가디언 idle, release
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--하나 : 네? 펴, 편하게 불러달라고요…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.normal_jump(main)
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, nil,
			'surprise', 'aw_main_s12_106')

	--하나 : 그건… 아직 조금 부끄러운데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'blush'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s12_107', skip = true})

	--가디언 idle, release
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--하나 : 대, 대신! 귀인님이란 호칭 대신 {0}님이라고 부를게요!
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast', nil, 'aw_main_s12_108')

	--하나 : {0}님, 함께 가요!
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s12_109', skip = true})

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	local charon = self.get_charon()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(charon)
	charon.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	charon.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.get_staff(1).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	self.get_staff(2).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

function local_class:start_reminisce_scene(scene, after_setting_callback)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local tint_key = 'reminisce'
	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 0)

	scene(self)

	field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0)

	if after_setting_callback then
		after_setting_callback()
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', volume = 1})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:optimize_npcs(spec_names, key)
	local npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(spec_names)
	self.optimized_npcs[key] = npcs

	return npcs
end

--회상씬  : 주인공의 주변에서 안 좋은 일들이 계속해서 일어나고 마을 사람들 여론이 안좋아지는 회상씬.
function local_class:reminisce_scene_1()
	local npc_tint_color = unity_color({0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1})
	local corpse_tint_color = unity_color({0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1})

	-- 가족들 동적 로딩
	local family = self:optimize_npcs({
		-- 할머니
		grandma = 'aw_reminisce_oldwoman',
		-- 아빠
		father = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		-- 엄마
		mother = 'aw_reminisce_female',
		-- 꼬마
		kid = 'aw_reminisce_kid_a',
	}, 'reminisce_1_family')

	-- 시체들 동적 로딩
	local corpse = self:optimize_npcs({
		corpse1 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		corpse2 = 'aw_reminisce_male',

		corpse3 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		corpse4 = 'aw_reminisce_female',

		corpse5 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		corpse6 = 'aw_reminisce_kid_a',
		corpse7 = 'aw_reminisce_female',

		corpse8 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		corpse9 = 'aw_reminisce_female',

		corpse10 = 'aw_reminisce_female'
	}, 'reminisce_1_corpse')

	-- 하나 동적 로딩
	local other = self:optimize_npcs({
		-- 하나
		main = 'aw_main_character_kid',
		-- 투명 캐릭터 (end_target 용)
		cam_target_fo = 'aw_main_character_kid'
	}, 'reminisce_1_main')

	local group_shake = function(fos, magnitude, duration, wait)
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fos) do
			character_util.shake(fos[i], magnitude, duration)
		end

		if wait then
			wait_for_sec(duration)
		end
	end

	local release_speak = function(fo, speech_bubble_key)
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, fo, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
			util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, fo, { key = speech_bubble_key, skip = true })
		})
	end

	local grandma = family.grandma
	local father = family.father
	local mother = family.mother
	local kid = family.kid
	local main = other.main
	local cam_target_fo = other.cam_target_fo

	-- 기본 가족 테이블
	local family_table = { grandma, father, mother, kid }

	--- 가족 따라다니는 투명 캐릭터 까지 포함
	local family_table_for_move = { grandma, father, mother, kid, cam_target_fo }

	-- 가족 시작 설정
	local family_start_emotion = { grandma = 'smile', kid = 'smile', father = 'idle', mother = 'idle' }
	for k, v in pairs(family) do
		local marker_name = ('reminisce_1_' .. k .. '_1')
		character_util.set_position(v, self:get_marker_pos(marker_name) + vector(3, 0, 0))character_util.set_group_direction(family_table, 'down')

		character_util.set_direction(v, direction_util.to_str(self:get_marker_dir(marker_name)))
		character_util.set_emotion(v, { name = family_start_emotion[k] })
		v.SpineController:AddColor(k, npc_tint_color, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 시체 시작 설정
	for k, v in pairs(corpse) do
		local marker_name = ('reminisce_1_' .. k)
		character_util.set_position(v, self:get_marker_pos(marker_name))
		character_util.set_direction(v, direction_util.to_str(self:get_marker_dir(marker_name)))
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(v, { name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		v.SpineController:AddColor(k, corpse_tint_color, 1, 0)
	end

	-- 하나 시작 위치 설정
	character_util.set_position(main, self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_1_main_1'))
	character_util.set_direction(main, 'left')
	main.SpineController:AddColor('reminisce_1_main_1', npc_tint_color, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_position(cam_target_fo, father.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cam_target_fo, 0, 0)

	camera_util.move(cam_target_fo.Position, 0, { end_target = cam_target_fo })

	-- 가족들 걷는 속도
	local walk_speed = 1.5

	-- 화면 크기에 상관없이 두 번째 시체가 보일 때 까지 걷게 하기
	-- 2번 시체 위치에서 카메라 타겟 하는 캐릭터 위치를 뺀 거리에서 현재 화면의 사이즈 반 만큼 빼고 1 만큼 여유를 준 거리 ㄷㄷ
	local screen_extents = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() / 2
	local corpse_witness_distance = vector(corpse.corpse2.Position.x - cam_target_fo.Position.x - screen_extents.x + 1, 0, 0)

	-- 화면 페이드 인 시작과 동시에 걷기 시작
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_group_distance_async, family_table_for_move, corpse_witness_distance, nil, walk_speed, true, true),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 0.5 초 뒤에 말하기 시작
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 이제 이번 마을만 지나면 금방이야.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_0_1', skip = true })

			-- 빨리 가요! 빨리!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_0_2', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })
		end)
	})

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'event', name = 'bgm_cave_main', volume = 0.5})

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(family_table) do
		local member = family_table[i]
		-- 만약에 해당 지점에 도착 했는데 아직 말하고 있으면 스피치 버블 지움
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(member)
		character_util.set_emotion(member, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.normal_jump(member, '01_jump_01')
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이, 이게 대체 무슨 상황이야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	release_speak(father, 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_0_3')

	-- 할머니… 사람들이 다들 안 움직여…
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'up')
	release_speak(kid, 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_1')

	-- 저런 거 보는 거 아냐.
	character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(kid, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, { name = 'tired' })
	release_speak(mother, 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_2_1')

	-- 얼른 여길 벗어나요!
	character_util.set_direction(father, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(father, { name = 'attack' })
	release_speak(father, 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_2_2')

	-- 다시 걷기 시작함
	character_util.set_group_emotion(family_table, { name = 'scared' })
	local target_corpse_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_1_1_corpse_watch_pos_1')
	local next_target_dis = vector(target_corpse_pos.x - cam_target_fo.Position.x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_group_distance_async(family_table_for_move, next_target_dis, nil, walk_speed, true, true)

	-- …마을 전체에 역병이 돌았었나봐.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_3', skip = true })

	-- 불쌍하게도…
	character_util.set_group_emotion(family_table, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_4', skip = true })

	-- 우리한테까지 전염되기 전에 서둘러 떠나야겠어.
	character_util.set_direction(father, 'left' )
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(father, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_5', skip = true })

	-- 아들, 엄마 옆에 꼭 붙어서 걸어!
	character_util.set_direction(mother, 'left' )
	character_util.set_emotion(mother, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_6', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	character_util.move_to_async(kid, mother.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0.01), 0.75, nil, true, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(kid, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_group_emotion(family_table, { name = 'tired' })

	target_corpse_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_1_1_corpse_watch_pos_2')
	next_target_dis = vector(target_corpse_pos.x - cam_target_fo.Position.x, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_group_distance_async(family_table_for_move, next_target_dis, nil, walk_speed, true, true)

	-- 으아아앙~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_female_cry_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(father, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_7', skip = true,
														  screen_pos = vector(-50, 450), bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(grandma, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.set_group_direction(family_table, 'up')

	-- …이 소리는?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_8', skip = true })

	-- 위로 달려가는 할머니를 잡는 남자
	local grandma_run_speed = 2
	local grandma_move_dis = 2
	local grandma_move_dur = grandma_move_dis / grandma_run_speed
	local father_move_to_pos = vector(father.Position.x, 0, grandma.Position.z + grandma_move_dis)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_group_direction(family_table, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(grandma, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.normal_jump(father, true)
	character_util.move_distance(grandma, vector(0, 0, grandma_move_dis), nil, grandma_run_speed, true, false)
	wait_for_sec(grandma_move_dur / 2)

	character_util.set_anim(father, { name = 'run', loop = true })
	character_util.move_to_async(father, father_move_to_pos, grandma_move_dur / 2, nil,
			true, false, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(grandma)
	character_util.remove_anim(father)

	character_util.set_direction(grandma, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(father, 'left')

	-- 어머니. 지금 뭐 하시는 거에요?
	character_util.set_emotion(father, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, father, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, father, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_9', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rt' })
	})

	-- 우리 빨리 떠나요! 여긴 너무 위험해요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_10', skip = true })

	-- …분명 어린아이의 울음소리였어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_11', skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint(grandma, grandma.Position + vector(0, 0, 10), grandma_run_speed, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 어머니!
	character_util.set_direction(father, 'up')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, father, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_12', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(grandma.Position, { bonus_distance = 0.5 }) do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)
	})
	character_util.stop(grandma)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.move(main.Position, 0)

	local grandma_pos = vector(grandma.Position.x, 0, main.Position.z - (screen_util.get_world_screen_size().y / 2) - 1)
	character_util.set_position(grandma, grandma_pos)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, { name = 'cry' })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 어, 엄마…아빠…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_13', skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(grandma, vector(grandma.Position.x, 0, main.Position.z - 1),
			grandma_run_speed, true, 'stop','floor', 'right')

	-- 아가!  여기 있으면 안 돼!
	character_util.set_emotion(grandma, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_emotion(main, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, grandma, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_14', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })
	})

	-- 여긴 지금 전염병 때문에 위험해.
	character_util.set_emotion(grandma, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_15', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	-- 엄마가… 아빠가...
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_16', skip = true })

	-- …
	character_util.set_emotion(grandma, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_17', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	-- 가엾게도 혼자 살아남았나 보구나.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_18', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	-- 불쌍한 것… 할미라도 따라오련?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(grandma, { key = 'aw_main_s12_reminisce_1_19', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	character_util.move_distance_async(main, vector(0, 0, -1), nil, 1.5, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(main, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_distance_async(grandma, vector(0.3, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(grandma, { name = 'push' })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_anim(grandma)
	character_util.set_emotion(grandma, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.move_waypoint(grandma, grandma.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), 1.5, false)
	character_util.move_waypoint(main, main.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), 1.5, false)

	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(grandma.Position, { bonus_distance = 2 }) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.stop(grandma)
	character_util.stop(main)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadItemGetEvent()

	self.get_square_balances().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self:clue_setting()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.evidence_controller = get_or_create_global_table('Theatres/AfterWorldEvidence')
	self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(self)

end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	-- 여기서 비활성화해주면 다음 섹션에서 같은프레임에 enter해서 구독 요청이 씹힐 수가 있음
	self.evidence_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	if self.office_parole_item ~= nil then
		self.office_parole_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
	self.office_parole_item = nil
	self.office_door_exit_interactable = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_office_door_guard(), self.controller)
	self.get_office_door_guard().ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	if self.office_clue_item ~= nil then
		self.office_clue_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
	self.office_clue_item = nil

	if self.marina_clue_item ~= nil then
		self.marina_clue_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end
	self.marina_clue_item = nil

	if self.marina_twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.marina_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.marina_twinkle_effect = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_marina_guest(), self.controller)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_anteroom_photographer(), self.controller)

function local_class:dispose()

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		self:on_office_interact_event(e)
		self:on_garbage_interact_event(e)
		self:on_anteroom_interact_event(e)
		self:on_marina_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_square_balances()) and self.interacting_agora == false then
		self.interacting_agora = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.try_play_agora, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--region 증거 수집

function local_class:clue_setting()
	local sector_binary = self:get_sector_data()

	for key, _ in pairs(self.sector_infos) do
		local info = self.sector_infos[key]

		info.event_done = (sector_binary & (2 ^ info.binary_exponent)) ~= 0

		for _, index in pairs(info.clues) do
			self.clue_infos[index].sector_key = key
		end
	end

	local clue_binary = self:get_clue_data()

	for index, _ in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		local info = self.clue_infos[index]

		-- 증거 수집 여부 저장
		info.have = (clue_binary & (2 ^ info.binary_exponent)) ~= 0

		if info.have then
			self.clue_gather_count = self.clue_gather_count + 1
		end

		if info.have and info.sector_key ~= nil then
			local sector_info = self.sector_infos[info.sector_key]

			-- 각 구역에서 증거를 하나라도 먹은 경우
			if sector_info.gather_count == 0 then
				self.sector_gather_count = self.sector_gather_count + 1
			end

			sector_info.gather_count = sector_info.gather_count + 1
		end
	end

	--region 사무실
	if self.sector_infos.office.event_done == false then
		local guards = {
			self.get_office_guard(1),
			self.get_office_guard(2),
			self.get_office_guard(3),
			self.get_office_guard(4),
		}
		local guards_offsets = {
			vector(0, 0, 1),
			vector(1, 0, 0),
			vector(0, 0, -1),
			vector(-1, 0, 0),
		}
		local parole_interact = self.get_office_parole_interact()

		parole_interact.Position = self:get_marker_pos('office_parole_interact')

		for index, guard in pairs(guards) do
			guard.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			guard.Position = parole_interact.Position + guards_offsets[index]
			character_util.look_at(guard, parole_interact)
		end

		self.office_parole_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.office_parole_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			pos = parole_interact.Position
		})

		local bomb = self.get_office_bomb()
		bomb.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local door_guard = self.get_office_door_guard()
		door_guard.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		character_util.add_listener(door_guard, self.controller)

		local office_door = self.get_office_door()
		self.office_door_exit_interactable = office_door.Interactable
		office_door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_office_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_office_field_object_destroyed_event')

	else
		local parole_interact = self.get_office_parole_interact()
		parole_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	if self.clue_infos[self.office_clue_index].have == false then
		local clue_interact = self.get_office_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.Position = self:get_marker_pos('office_clue_interact') + vector(0, 0.7, 0)

		self:add_clue_emoticon(clue_interact, self.office_clue_index)

		self.office_clue_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.clue_infos[self.office_clue_index].item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			pos = clue_interact.Position
		})

		-- 위에서 세팅하지 않은 경우만
		if self.sector_infos.office.event_done then
			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_office_interact_event')
		end
	else
		local clue_interact = self.get_office_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	--endregion

	--region 오리배 선착장
	if self.sector_infos.marina.event_done == false then
		local staff = self.get_marina_staff()
		local guide = self.get_marina_guide()
		local guest = self.get_marina_guest()
		local boat = self.get_marina_boat()

		staff.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		staff.Position = self:get_marker_pos('marina_staff')
		staff.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

		guide.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		guide.Position = self:get_marker_pos('marina_guide')
		guide.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		boat.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		boat.Position = self:get_marker_pos('marina_boat')
		boat.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		guest.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		guest.Position = boat.Position + vector(-0.2, 1, 0)
		guest.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.set_anim(guest, {name = 'seat'})

		local clue_interact = self.get_marina_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.Position = self:get_marker_pos('marina_clue_interact')

		self:add_clue_emoticon(clue_interact, self.marina_clue_index)

		-- 증거 저장 시점이 이벤트 종료와 같기 때문에 아이템 조건 세팅 없음
		self.marina_clue_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.clue_infos[self.marina_clue_index].item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			pos = clue_interact.Position
		})

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marina_marker_key, guide, true)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_marina_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_marina_zone_enter_event')
	else
		local clue_interact = self.get_marina_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
	--endregion

	--region 안내원 대기실
	if self.sector_infos.anteroom.event_done == false then
		local photographer = self.get_anteroom_photographer()
		local clue_interact = self.get_anteroom_clue_interact()
		local blocker_1 = self.get_anteroom_blocker(1)
		local blocker_2 = self.get_anteroom_blocker(2)

		--스타피스 머리잘린 영혼 위쪽 그리드 뱃사공 근처 바깥쪽에 먼쪽을 바라보며 공허하게 있는 NPC 가 있다.
		character_util.set_anim(photographer, {name = 'cast'})
		photographer.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'camera')

		character_util.add_listener(photographer, self.controller)

		local blocker_center = (blocker_1.Position + blocker_2.Position) / 2
		blocker_1.Position = blocker_center + vector(0, 0, 4 / 6)
		blocker_2.Position = blocker_center + vector(0, 0, -4 / 6)
		blocker_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		blocker_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		blocker_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.2, 1, 1.6))
		blocker_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.2, 1, 1.6))

		self.anteroom_clue_nar_interactable = clue_interact.Interactable
		clue_interact.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		self:add_clue_emoticon(clue_interact, self.anteroom_clue_index)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_anteroom_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_anteroom_interact_event')
	end
	--endregion

	--region 쓰레기장
	if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done == false then
		local hide_interact = self.get_garbage_hide_interact()
		hide_interact.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local clue_interact = self.get_garbage_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_garbage_camera_grid_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_garbage_camera_grid_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_garbage_interact_event')
	end

	if self.clue_infos[self.garbage_clue_index].have == false then
		local clue_interact = self.get_garbage_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.Position = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_clue_interact')
		clue_interact.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 1))

		-- 위쪽에서 세팅 안해준 경우만 세팅해줌
		if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done then
			self:add_clue_emoticon(clue_interact, self.garbage_clue_index)
			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_garbage_interact_event')
		end
	else
		local clue_interact = self.get_garbage_clue_interact()
		clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	self:on_enter_main_field()

	--endregion
end

function local_class:add_clue_emoticon(fo, clue_index)
	self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(fo,
			nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_agora_evidence.png',
			{no_time_limit = true})
end

function local_class:remove_clue_emoticon(clue_index)
	if self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon ~= nil then
		self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon:Dispose()
	end
	self.clue_infos[clue_index].emoticon = nil
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then
		self:on_enter_main_field()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'main_field') then
		self:on_leave_main_field()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_enter_main_field()
	if self.sector_infos.office.event_done == false or self.clue_infos[self.office_clue_index].have == false then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.office_marker_key,
				self.get_office_door(), true)
	end

	if self.sector_infos.marina.event_done == false then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marina_marker_key,
				self.get_marina_guide(), true)
	end

	if self.sector_infos.anteroom.event_done == false then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.anteroom_marker_key,
				self.get_anteroom_clue_interact(), true)
	end

	if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done == false then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.garbage_marker_key,
				self.get_garbage_hide_interact(), true)
	elseif self.clue_infos[self.garbage_clue_index].have == false then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.garbage_marker_key,
				self.get_garbage_clue_interact(), true)
	end
end

function local_class:on_leave_main_field()
	if self.clue_infos[self.office_clue_index].have == false
			and field:GetZone('office_enter'):Contains(get_party_leader().Position) then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.office_marker_key,
				self.get_office_clue_interact(), true)
	end

	if self.sector_infos.marina.event_done == false then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.marina_marker_key)
	end

	if self.sector_infos.anteroom.event_done == false then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.anteroom_marker_key)
	end

	if self.clue_infos[self.garbage_clue_index].have == false then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.garbage_marker_key)
	end
end


--region 데이터 처리 유틸
-- 구역 별 이벤트가 끝났는지 저장하는 바이너리 정보 가져옴
function local_class:get_sector_data()
	local sector_binary = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.sector_custom_state_key)

	if sector_binary < 0 then
		return 0
	end

	return sector_binary
end

-- 구역 별 이벤트가 끝난 경우 저장
function local_class:set_sector_data_async(key)
	local info = self.sector_infos[key]
	local sector_binary = self:get_sector_data()
	info.event_done = true
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.sector_custom_state_key,
			sector_binary | (2 ^ info.binary_exponent))
end

function local_class:is_gathered_all_in_sector(key)
	for _, clue_index in pairs(self.sector_infos[key].clues) do
		if self.clue_infos[clue_index].have == false then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 증거 습득 세팅
function local_class:add_clue_data_async(index)
	local info = self.clue_infos[index]
	local clue_binary = self:get_clue_data()

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.clue_custom_state_key,
			clue_binary | (2 ^ info.binary_exponent))

	if info.have == false then
		info.have = true
		self.clue_gather_count = self.clue_gather_count + 1

		-- 구역 정보 갱신
		if info.sector_key then
			local sector_info = self.sector_infos[info.sector_key]

			-- 증거를 하나라도 먹은 경우
			if sector_info.gather_count == 0 then
				self.sector_gather_count = self.sector_gather_count + 1
			end

			sector_info.gather_count = sector_info.gather_count + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_clue_data()
	local clue_binary = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.clue_custom_state_key)

	if clue_binary < 0 then
		return 0
	end

	return clue_binary
end
--endregion

--region UI 유틸

function local_class:get_clue_ui_data()
	local data = {}

	for index, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		table.insert(data, {id = index, info_index = index, sprite = info.sprite_name,
							enabled = info.have, cur_count = self.clue_gather_count})
	end

	return data
end

--endregion

--region 공통 연출
function local_class:try_play_agora()
	party_util.align_to_target(field:GetMarker('s12_agora_center_pos').position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
			'down', 1, 'linear')
	local main = self.get_main_character()

	--아고라를 신청한다.
	--그만둔다.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'aw_main_s13_try_agora_1', 'intellect'},
		{'aw_main_s13_try_agora_2', 'normal'},
	})

	--승리에 필요한 증거를 다 수집하지 않은 상태일 경우
	if result == 1 then
		--하나(tired, question) :  $name님, 단서를 좀 더 찾아보는게 좋지 않을까요…?
		character_util.set_side_direction(main)
		character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'question', loop = false},
				'tired', 'aw_main_s13_try_agora_3')

		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	--대화 종료.
	self.interacting_agora = false
end

function local_class:after_gather_clue_scene(clue_index)
	self:add_clue_data_async(clue_index)

	--내레이션 박스 출력 : 새로운 증거품을 수집하였다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'aw_main_s13_clue_get_nar'})

	--새로 획득한 증거품 아이템의 정보가 표시 된 상태의 증거품 목록 팝업 UI 출력
	self.evidence_controller:show_clue_popup_async(clue_index - 1)

	if self.sector_gather_count == 1 then
		--첫 번째 증거를 찾고 나면(증거 순서 관계 없음) 이벤트 발생
		self:on_first_clue_scene()
	elseif self.sector_gather_count == 2 then
		--두 번째 증거를 찾고 나면(증거 순서 관계 없음) 이벤트 발생
		self:on_second_clue_scene()
	end

	--해당 구역에서 얻을 수 있는 모든 증거를 얻었을 때
	-- 전부 다 모은 경우
	if self.sector_gather_count == #self.clue_infos then
		self:on_all_clue_scene()
	else
		-- 해당 구역에서 얻을 수 있는 증거를 모두 획득하면 하나 대사
		local main = self.get_main_character()
		local leader = get_party_leader()

		character_util.look_at(main, leader)
		character_util.look_at(leader, main)

		--하나 : 여기서 필요한 증거들은 모두 찾은 것 같아요! 다른 곳으로 가 볼까요?
		character_util.play_speech_action(self.get_main_character(), 'cast2',
				'smile', 'aw_main_s13_clue_get_1')
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.3)
end

function local_class:on_first_clue_scene()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.look_at(leader, main)
	character_util.look_at(main, leader)

	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'smile'})

	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast', nil, 'aw_main_s13_1')

	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_3', skip = true})

	--가디언 bomb_idle)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--하나 : 전 언제나 실수투성이에 불행을 몰고 오는 저주받은 존재인걸요…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast', nil, 'aw_main_s13_4')

	--가디언 release
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--하나 : {0}님, 정말 고마워요…
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_5', skip = true})

	--하나 : 제게 그런 말을 해준 친구를 만난 건 정말 오랜만이네요….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_6', skip = true})

	--이후 두번째 회상씬
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	self:start_reminisce_scene(self.reminisce_scene_2, function()
		character_util.remove_emotion(main)

		camera_util.move_async((main.Position + leader.Position) / 2, 0)

	end)
end

		camera_util.move_async((main.Position + leader.Position) / 2, 0)
		coroutine.yield()
	end)

	--하나(idle, release) : {0}님과 함께라면 아고라에서도 승리도 가능할 거예요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_19')

	--하나(smile, victory_get),  :  자, 어서 가서 결판을 내러 가요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false},
			'smile', 'aw_main_s13_20')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

function local_class:start_reminisce_scene(scene, after_setting_callback)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local tint_key = 'reminisce'
	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 0)

	scene(self)

	field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0)

	if after_setting_callback then
		after_setting_callback()
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 2)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

function local_class:optimize_npcs(spec_names, key)
	local npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(spec_names)
	self.optimized_npcs[key] = npcs

	return npcs
end

function local_class:reminisce_scene_2()
	-- 사용할 NPC들 동적 로딩
	local npcs = self:optimize_npcs({
		main = 'aw_main_character_normal',
		male_1 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		male_2 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		male_3 = 'aw_reminisce_male',
		jennie = 'aw_reminisce_jennie',
	}, 'reminisce_2')

	for name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.SpineController:AddColor(name, self.reminisce_npc_tint_color, 1, 0)
	end

	local main = npcs.main
	local male_1 = npcs.male_1
	local male_2 = npcs.male_2
	local male_3 = npcs.male_3
	local jennie = npcs.jennie

	--주인공,  좌측 상단 벤치에 tired표정으로 앉아 있다.
	main.Position = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_2_bench') + vector(0, 0.35, 0)
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'meditation'})
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})

	camera_util.move_async(main.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0)
	coroutine.yield()

	local thrown_rocks = {}
	local next_index = 1
	local rock_count = 0
	local request_force_end = false
	local throw_rock = function(fo)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'throw', loop = false, remove_after = 0.5})
		local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{itemid = self.reminisce_rock_item_id, pos = fo.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0),
				 sprscale = 0.5, target = main.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.3), notforinven = true,
				 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true})
		thrown_rocks[next_index] = rock
		next_index = next_index + 1
		rock_count = rock_count + 1
	end
	local check_routine = function()
		local check_dist = 0.3

		while request_force_end == false or rock_count > 0 do
			local consume_indexes = {}
			for index, rock in pairs(thrown_rocks) do
				--저프레임 환경에서는 몇 개 덜 맞을 수도 있어서 무조건 끝나도록 세팅함
				local diff = main.Position.z - rock.Position.z
				if diff <= check_dist then
					table.insert(consume_indexes, index)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(main)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(main)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')
					self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(main.Position
							+ vector(0, 0.3, -0.2) + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
					if request_force_end == false then
						main:SetEmotion(CS.Oak.AnimationRequest('damaged', CS.Oak.AnimationPriorities.Custom, true, 1, 0.5))
					end
				end
			end

			for _, index in pairs(consume_indexes) do
				thrown_rocks[index]:ConsumeComplete()
				thrown_rocks[index] = nil
				rock_count = rock_count - 1
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	local right_center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_2_right_center')
	local left_center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_2_left_center')

	male_1.Position = left_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)
	male_2.Position = left_center_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	male_3.Position = left_center_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5)

	--하나가 벤치에 혼자 앉아 있고 좌측에서 꼬마 무리1,2,3이 하나에게 걸어온다.
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_1, { waypoints = vector(main.Position.x, 0, male_1.Position.z),
									  speed = 3, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_2, { waypoints = vector(main.Position.x + 0.5, 0, male_2.Position.z),
									  speed = 3, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_3, { waypoints = vector(main.Position.x - 0.5, 0, male_3.Position.z),
									  speed = 3, callback = move_done_cb})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--세 번째 회상씬 등장.
	--회상씬 : 돌팔매질 당하는 주인공. 주인공의 친구 첫 등장.

	--우측에서 꼬맹이 무리가 걸어온다. (꼬맹이 포함 3명)
	while move_done_count < 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	male_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	male_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	male_3.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	--꼬마1 : 야, 병균 덩어리!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(male_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_1', skip = true})

	--꼬마1 : 우리 마을에서 꺼져!
	--꼬마1이 하나에게 돌멩이를 던진다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(check_routine))
	throw_rock(male_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_2', skip = true})

	--꼬마2 : 병균 덩어리? 쟤 누군데?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_2, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_3', skip = true})

	--꼬마1 : 쟤가 우리 할머니한테 전염병을 퍼뜨려서 우리 할머니가…!
	male_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_emotion(male_1, { name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_4', skip = true})

	--꼬마1 : 쟤만 없었으면 할머니는 지금도 살아 계셨어!
	character_util.play_speech_action(male_1, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_5')

	--꼬마3 : 쟤가 혹시 그 소문의 저주받은 애야?
	character_util.play_speech_action(male_3, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_6')

	--꼬마3 : 우리 엄마가 절대로 가까이하지 말랬는데…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_3, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_7', skip = true})

	--꼬마2 : 내 친구 할머니 돌려 내!
	--꼬마2, 돌멩이를 던진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	male_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	throw_rock(male_2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_2, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_8', skip = true})

	--꼬마1, 돌멩이를 던진다.
	throw_rock(male_1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마3 : 이 살인마!
	--꼬마3, 돌멩이를 던진다.
	throw_rock(male_3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_3, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_9', skip = true})

	--꼬마2 : 죽어 버려! 전염병 귀신아!
	--꼬마1,2,3 계속해서 돌을 던진다.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local males = {
			male_1, male_2, male_3
		}

		while request_force_end == false do
			for _, fo in pairs(males) do
				throw_rock(fo)

				wait_for_sec(0.4)

				if request_force_end then
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_2, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_10', skip = true})

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--3초 정도 맞은 후 하나가 벌떡 일어나서 말한다.
	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	request_force_end = true
	character_util.normal_jump(male_1)
	character_util.normal_jump(male_2)
	character_util.normal_jump(male_3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

	character_util.move_to_async(main, vector(main.Position.x, 0, main.Position.z - 1), 0.4)

	--하나 : 나, 나는 전염병 걸린 게 아닌…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_11', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	--꼬마1,2,3 : 히이익!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(male_1, { name = 'embarrassed'})
	character_util.set_anim(male_2, { name = 'embarrassed'})
	character_util.set_anim(male_3, { name = 'embarrassed'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, {
		key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_12', skip = true, world_pos = male_3.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)})

	character_util.remove_anim(male_3)

	character_util.shake(male_1, 0.025, 999)

	--꼬마1 : 가, 가까이 오지 마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_1, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_13', skip = true})

	--꼬마2 : 우리도 죽을지 몰라!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(male_2, { key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_14', skip = true})

	--꼬마3 : 도망쳐!
	character_util.play_speech_action(male_3, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_15')

	character_util.stop_shake(male_1)
	character_util.stop_shake(male_2)
	character_util.stop_shake(male_3)

	character_util.set_emotion(male_1, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_emotion(male_2, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_emotion(male_3, {name = 'scared'})

	--꼬마1,2,3 좌측으로 빠르게 도망친다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	move_done_count = 0
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_1, { waypoints = vector(left_center_pos.x, 0, male_1.Position.z),
									  speed = 5, run = true, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_2, { waypoints = vector(left_center_pos.x, 0, male_2.Position.z),
									  speed = 5, run = true, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(male_3, { waypoints = vector(left_center_pos.x, 0, male_3.Position.z),
									  speed = 5, run = true, callback = move_done_cb})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--하나, left로 꼬마들이 떠나는 모습 지켜본다.
	camera_util.move(vector(main.Position.x, 0, left_center_pos.z), 1)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main, {waypoints = vector(main.Position.x, 0, left_center_pos.z),
										 speed = 3.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})

	while move_done_count < 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(male_1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(male_2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(male_3)

	--하나(down, tried, idle) : 나…정말 아닌데…
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_16', skip = true})

	--하나 : 왜 아무도 믿어주지 않는 거야…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_17', skip = true})

	move_done_count = 0
	jennie.Position = right_center_pos
	--제니가 우측에서 걸어와서 하나의 옆에 선다.
	wp_util.move_way_points(jennie, {waypoints = main.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0),
									 speed = 4, callback = move_done_cb})

	--하나 : …어쩌면 정말 나 저주받은 몸인 걸까…?
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_18')

	while move_done_count < 1 do
		coroutine.yield()

	camera_util.move_async(main.Position + vector(0.7, 0, 0), 0.4)

	--제니 : 얘!
	character_util.normal_jump(main, '01_small_jump_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'surprise'})

			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_2_19')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	wp_util.move_way_points(jennie, {waypoints = vector(right_center_pos.x, 0, jennie.Position.z), speed = 3})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')

	character_util.stop(jennie)

function local_class:reminisce_scene_3()
	local npcs = self:optimize_npcs({
		main = 'aw_main_character_normal',
		jennie = 'aw_reminisce_jennie',
		kid = 'aw_reminisce_kid_d',
		mom = 'aw_reminisce_kid_mom',
	}, 'reminisce_3')

	for name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.SpineController:AddColor(name, self.reminisce_npc_tint_color, 1, 0)
	end

	local main = npcs.main
	local jennie = npcs.jennie
	local kid = npcs.kid
	local mom = npcs.mom

	local hide_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_3_hide')
	local left_center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_3_left_center')
	local right_center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_3_right_center')
	local kid_cry_pos = self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_3_kid_cry')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(hide_pos.x, 0, left_center_pos.z), 0)
	coroutine.yield()

	--길거리 한복판에 꼬마 한명이 울고 있고
	kid.Position = kid_cry_pos
	kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'cry'})

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	--왼쪽에서 하나가 제니를 데려오고 있다.
	main.Position = left_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	jennie.Position = left_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5)

	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = vector(hide_pos.x - 2, 0, main.Position.z),
								   speed = 3.5, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(jennie, {waypoints = vector(hide_pos.x - 2.5 + 0.3, 0, jennie.Position.z),
								   speed = 3.5, callback = move_done_cb})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--둘은 벤치 뒤에 숨는다.

	while move_done_count < 1 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.normal_jump(main, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cast'})

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	move_done_count = 0
	camera_util.move(hide_pos, 0.7)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	main.LockedDirection = main.Direction
	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = hide_pos, speed = 4, run = true,
								   last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, play_sfx = true})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(jennie,
			{waypoints = hide_pos + vector(-1.4, 0, 0), speed = 4, run = true,
			 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, play_sfx = true})

	--제니 : 하나? 갑자기 왜 숨는 거야?
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jennie, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_1', skip = true})

	main.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	--하나가 제니에게 꼬마가 길을 잃은 것 같다며 도와줘야 된다고 말하고, 자신이 가면 싫어할테니 제니에게 대신 가 달라고 부탁한다
	--하나 : 저 꼬마가 길을 잃은 거 같아.
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_2')

	--하나 : 네가 가서 도와주면 안 될까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'sing',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_3')

	--제니 : 하나, 네가 직접 도와줘도 되잖아.
	character_util.play_speech_action(jennie, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_4')

	--하나 : …내가 가면 꼬마가 싫어하잖아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_5', skip = true})

	--하나 : 그렇다고 혼자 두기엔 걱정이 돼서…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_6')

	--하나 : 제니, 부탁해!
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'sing',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_7')

	--제니는 하나에게 직접 가서 꼬마를 도와주는 건 어떠냐고 제안하고, 하나는 처음엔 완강히 거절하지만 결국 꼬마에게로 다가간다.
	--제니 … 말풍선
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	character_util.set_anim(jennie, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(jennie, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(jennie, nil, 'silence')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jennie)

	--제니 : 하나, 모두가 너를 싫어한다고 생각하는 거야?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jennie, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_8', skip = true})

	--제니 : 저 꼬마는 도움이 필요한 상태잖아. 누구라도 손을 내밀어주면 고마워할 거야.
	character_util.play_speech_action(jennie, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'tired', 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_9')

	--하나 : 그치만…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_10')

	--제니 : 난 여기서 꼼짝도 안 할 거야. 얼른 네가 가서 도와줘!
	character_util.play_speech_action(jennie, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_11')

	--꼬마에게 다가가서
	camera_util.move(kid.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0), 2)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main, {waypoints = {
		vector(main.Position.x, 0, kid.Position.z),
		kid.Position + vector(-3.5, 0, 0)
	}, speed = 2.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	stage_camera:CancelMove()

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(jennie)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.move(kid.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0), (3.5 - 1.4) / 3.5)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main, {waypoints = kid.Position + vector(-1.4, 0, 0), speed = 3.5})
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	--처음엔 우물쭈물하지만 이내 사탕을 건네주고 꼬마와 대화를 하고 곧 화기애애해진다.

	--하나 : 저, 저기 꼬마야…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_12')

	--꼬마 : 저리 가아! 엄마!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'embarrassed'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_13', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)

	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'push', mix_duration = 0.3})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--하나 : 사탕…먹을래?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	local candy_offset = vector(0.3, 0.3, 0)
	local candy_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.reminisce_candy_item_id, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = main.Position + candy_offset, sprscale = 0.5
	})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_14', skip = true})

	character_util.remove_emotion(kid)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'tired'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--꼬마 : 사탕?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_15', skip = true})

	local duration = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	local target_pos = kid.Position + vector(-0.6, 0, 0)
	local start_pos = main.Position

	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'push', upper = true})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'walk'})

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		main.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		candy_item.Position = main.Position + candy_offset

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(main)

	main.Position = target_pos
	candy_item.Position = main.Position + candy_offset

	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'push', mix_duration = 0.5})
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim(main, true)

	character_util.move_to_async(main, start_pos, 1, nil, false, true)

	--꼬마는 울음을 그치고 사탕을 먹기 시작한다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_eat_02')
	candy_item.Position = kid.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'eat'})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--꼬마 : 누나는 머리가 재밌게 생겼어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_16', skip = true})

	--하나 : 내 머리?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_17')

	--꼬마 : 응! 무슨 푸들같이 생겼어! 그래서 완전 웃겨!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(kid)
	candy_item:ConsumeComplete()
	character_util.play_speech_action(kid, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_18')

	--하나 surprise
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(main, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--하나 : 푸, 푸들 같다고…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_19', skip = true})

	--이후 우측에서 꼬마의 엄마가 다가오고, 꼬마는 하나에게 고맙다고 말하며 엄마와 같이 퇴장한다.
	mom.Position = right_center_pos
	character_util.set_emotion(mom, {name = 'tired'})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(mom,
			{waypoints = kid.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0), speed = 5, run = true, play_sfx = true})

	--엄마 : 아들! 엄마가 한참 찾았잖아!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	camera_util.move(kid.Position, 0.5)
	kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.play_speech_action(mom, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_20')

	--꼬마 : 엄마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(kid, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_21')
	character_util.set_anim(kid, {name = 'push', upper = true})
	character_util.set_anim(mom, {name = 'push', upper = true})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(kid, {waypoints = mom.Position + vector(-0.4, 0, 0),
										speed = 3, run = true, play_sfx = true})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(kid, vector(0.06, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.15)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(mom, vector(0.06, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.15)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--엄마 : 저희 애를 돌봐주고 계셨던 건가요?
	character_util.set_emotion(mom, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_22', skip = true})

	--하나 : 아, 그게…
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_23', skip = true})

	--꼬마 : 저 누나가 사탕도 줬어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(mom, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(kid, true)
	kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.play_speech_action(kid, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_24')

	--엄마 : 아이고, 정말 고맙습니다…
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(mom, 'cast',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_25')

	--엄마 : 아들! 이제 그만 가자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
	character_util.move_to_async(mom, kid.Position + vector(1, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, false, true)
	kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_emotion(mom, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mom, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_26', skip = true})

	--꼬마 : 누나 안녕~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	kid.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.normal_jump(kid, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(kid, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_27')

	wp_util.move_way_points(kid, {waypoints = right_center_pos, speed = 3.5})
	wp_util.move_way_points(mom, {waypoints = right_center_pos, speed = 3.5})

	--혼자 서 있는 하나에게 제니가 다가오고 하나는 나를 피하지 않았다며 감격스러워한다.
	character_util.set_emotion(jennie, {name = 'smile'})
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(jennie, {waypoints = {
		vector(jennie.Position.x, 0, main.Position.z),
		main.Position + vector(-1.4, 0, 0)
	}, speed = 3.5})

	camera_util.move_async(main.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, 0), 0.7)

	--제니 : 거 봐. 고마워하잖아.
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.play_speech_action(jennie, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_28')

	--제니 : 잘했어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_02')
	character_util.play_speech_action(jennie, 'clap',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_29')

	--하나 : …나를 피하지 않았어…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_30')

	--하나 : 제니, 네가 용기를 준 덕분이야.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'blush'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_3_31', skip = true})

	--회상씬 종료
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	character_util.stop(kid)
	character_util.stop(mom)

	coroutine.yield()
	coroutine.yield()

	load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs.reminisce_3)
	self.optimized_npcs.reminisce_3 = nil
end

function local_class:reminisce_scene_4()
	local npcs = self:optimize_npcs({
		main = 'aw_main_character_normal',
		jennie = 'aw_reminisce_jennie',
	}, 'reminisce_4')

	for name, npc in pairs(npcs) do
		npc.SpineController:AddColor(name, self.reminisce_npc_tint_color, 1, 0)
	end

	local main = npcs.main
	local jennie = npcs.jennie
	local table = get_field_object('s13_reminisce_table')
	local cleaning_pos_list = {
		self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_4_cleaning_1'),
		self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_4_cleaning_2'),
		self:get_marker_pos('reminisce_4_cleaning_3'),
	}

	local garbage_1_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.reminisce_garbage_1_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = cleaning_pos_list[1] + vector(0.8, 0.56, 0), sprscale = 0.7,
	})
	local garbage_2_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.reminisce_garbage_2_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = cleaning_pos_list[2] + vector(-0.7, 0, 0.3), sprscale = 0.7,
	})
	local garbage_3_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.reminisce_garbage_3_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = cleaning_pos_list[3] + vector(-0.6, 0, -0.2), sprscale = 0.7,
	})
	local item_dead = function(item)
		local dead_effect = self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(item.Position)
		dead_effect.transform.localScale = 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.one
		item:ConsumeComplete()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	end

	--집 여기저기를 eat자세로 치우고 있는 하나.
	main.Position = cleaning_pos_list[1]
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'eat'})

	stage_camera:SetTarget(main)

	table.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local equip_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--하나 : 제니 오기 전에 깔끔하게 치워놔야지.
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, nil, nil, 'aw_main_s13_reminisce_4_1')
	item_dead(garbage_1_item)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	equip_loop_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main,
			{waypoints = cleaning_pos_list[2], speed = 4, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})

	--하나 : 오늘은 내 생일이니까 반드시 와준다고 했어.
	equip_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'eat'})

function local_class:on_office_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_clue_interact())
			and self.interacting_clue == false then
		self.interacting_clue = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.office_interact_clue, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.sector_infos.office.event_done then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_door_guard())
			and self.office_talking_with_guard == false then
		self.office_talking_with_guard = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.office_interact_guard, self)

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_bomb())
			and self.current_office_state == self.office_state.none and self.office_guard_warning == false then
		--폭탄을 들어올리려고 시도했을 때
		self.office_guard_warning = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_try_holdup_bomb, self))

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_office_parole_interact())
			and self.current_office_state == self.office_state.guards_gone then
		-- 아이템 습득 처리
		self.current_office_state = self.office_state.after_get_parole
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.office_interact_parole, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_office_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.office.event_done then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_office_bomb())
			and self.current_office_state == self.office_state.none then
		self.current_office_state = self.office_state.guards_gone
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.office_bomb_exploded, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:office_interact_guard()
	local guard = self.get_office_door_guard()

	party_util.align_to_target(guard, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--진짜 암구호 획득 전이면 빨간 선택지로 가짜 암구호만 뜬다.
	--경비병(down, idle, idle) : 카론님의 개인 사무실입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_1', skip = true})

	--경비병(down, idle, idle) : 카론님께서 아무도 들이지 말라 하셨습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_2', skip = true})

	--선택지
	--(빨간색) 삑↗️삑↗️삑↘️
	--(보라색) 카론 사촌입니다.
	--(노란색) 사고를 당해 기억이…
	--선택지에 상관없이 위의 잘못된 암구호 3개는 입장 불가능.
	local talk_branches = {
		{'aw_main_s13_office_3', 'forced'},
		{'aw_main_s13_office_4', 'mercy'},
		{'aw_main_s13_office_5', 'intellect'},
	}

	--(초록색) 49지부의 영원한 번영을 위하여.(추가)
	if self.current_office_state == self.office_state.after_get_parole then
		table.insert(talk_branches, {'aw_main_s13_office_6', 'brutal'})
	end

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(talk_branches)

	if result == 4 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		--경비병 : …카론님의 귀한 손님들이시군요.
		character_util.nod_twice(guard)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_8', skip = true})

		--경비병 : 49지부의 번영을 위하여.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(guard, {name = 'salute', loop = false},
				nil, 'aw_main_s13_office_9')

		--경비병 : 입장을 허가합니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_10', skip = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		guard.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		character_util.move_to_async(guard, guard.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
				nil, 1.5, false, true)

		character_util.remove_relate_event(guard, self.controller)
		self.get_office_door().Interactable = self.office_door_exit_interactable

		self:set_sector_data_async('office')
		self.current_office_state = self.office_state.done

		--암구호 완료하고 나서 앞에 지키고 있는 경비병 원라인 대사
		--경비병(down, idle, idle) : 너무 맹해 보이는데… 정말 카론님의 수족이 맞는 건가?
		guard.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_main_s13_office_10_1'
		guard.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'
	else
		--경비병 : 잘못된 암구호입니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_7', skip = true})
	end

	self.office_talking_with_guard = false
end

function local_class:office_try_holdup_bomb()
	local guard = self.get_office_guard(1)

	local guard_origin_dir = guard.Direction

	--폭탄을 들어올리려고 시도했을 때
	--경비병 : 어허! 위험한 물건이니 내려놓으시죠…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	self.get_office_bomb():CancelShake()
	self.get_office_bomb():Shake(0.03, 0.3)
	character_util.look_at(guard, get_party_leader())
	character_util.set_emotion(guard)
	character_util.set_anim(guard, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard, {key = 'aw_main_s13_office_11'})

	if self.current_office_state == self.office_state.none then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
		guard.Direction = guard_origin_dir
		self.office_guard_warning = false
	end
end

function local_class:office_bomb_exploded()
	local guards = {
		self.get_office_guard(1),
		self.get_office_guard(2),
		self.get_office_guard(3),
		self.get_office_guard(4),
	}
	local bomb = self.get_office_bomb()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(guards[1])

	--폭탄이 터지면 경비들이 모두 날아가 버려 가운데 암구호를 획득할 수 있다.
	--경비병들 : 으악!

	bomb.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	bomb.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_04', parent = guards[1], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_villain_scream_03', parent = guards[1], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	})

	for _, guard in pairs(guards) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guard)
		local air_spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(guard,
				(guard.Position - bomb.Position).normalized * 2, 1, 0.25, true)
		message_system:SendSync(guard.CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(air_spin_state))
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_office_field_object_destroyed_event')

	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guards[1])
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guards[1],
			{key = 'aw_main_s13_office_12', bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'cb'})
end

function local_class:office_interact_parole()

			and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')

	self.office_parole_item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FixLooter

	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
			{waypoints = vector_util.get_x0z(clue_interact.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, -1)),
			 speed = 1.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, callback = align_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(main,
			{waypoints = vector_util.get_x0z(clue_interact.Position + vector(0.7, 0, -1)),
			 speed = 1.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = align_done_cb})

	while align_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local equip_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'eat'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.office_clue_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.office_clue_item:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	self.office_clue_item = nil

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	equip_loop_sfx:FadeOut(0.3)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.office_marker_key)
	self:after_gather_clue_scene(self.office_clue_index)

	clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_office_interact_event')
	self.interacting_clue = false
end

--endregion

--region 오리배 선착장
function local_class:on_marina_interact_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.marina.event_done then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_marina_guest())
			and self.marina_got_guide_book then
		self.current_marina_state = self.marina_state.help_guest
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.marina_interact_guest, self)

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_marina_clue_interact())
			and self.marina_got_guide_book == false then
		self.marina_got_guide_book = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.marina_get_guide_book, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_marina_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.marina.event_done then return false end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_marina_enter')
			and self.current_marina_state == self.marina_state.none then
		self.current_marina_state = self.marina_state.marina_entered
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.marina_enter_marina, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:marina_enter_marina()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local guest = self.get_marina_guest()
	local boat = self.get_marina_boat()
	local guide = self.get_marina_guide()
	local staff = self.get_marina_staff()

	local align_center = self:get_marker_pos('marina_enter_align_center')

	if main.Position.x < leader.Position.x then
		wp_util.move_way_points(leader, {waypoints = align_center + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
										 speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
		wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = align_center + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
										 speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
	else
		wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = align_center + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
										 speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
		wp_util.move_way_points(leader, {waypoints = align_center + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
									   speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
	end

	local scene_center = self:get_marker_pos('marina_scene_center')
	local guest_move_done = false
	local guest_jump_done = false

	--오리배 선착장으로 가면 오리배를 이용한 영혼이 내리는 연출.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local duration = 3
		local time_passed = 0
		local start_pos = boat.Position
		local guest_offset = guest.Position - boat.Position
		local target_pos = self:get_marker_pos('marina_boat_anchor')

		local boat_loop_sfx = 	music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_water_loop_01', loop = true,  parent = boat,
			type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'
		})

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local move_progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(progress, 0, 1, 1)

			boat.Position = start_pos * (1 - move_progress) + target_pos * move_progress
			guest.Position = boat.Position + guest_offset

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		boat_loop_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)

		boat.Position = target_pos
		guest.Position = target_pos + guest_offset

		character_util.remove_anim(guest)
		character_util.set_anim(guest, {name = 'get'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_boat_01')
		character_util.jump(guest, 1.3, 0.6)
		character_util.move_to_async(guest, target_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.6)
		character_util.remove_anim(guest)

		guest_jump_done = true

		character_util.move_to_async(guest, scene_center + vector(-0.7, 0, 0),
				nil, 3, true, true)

		guest_move_done = true
	end))

	camera_util.move_async(scene_center, 1)

	--매표소 직원이 가이드 쪽 쳐다보며 idle, releasex2 한 뒤
	character_util.set_anim(staff, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(staff)

	--가이드 idle, nodx2.
	character_util.nod_twice(guide)

	while guest_jump_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--가이드, 투어 손님에게 다가가서
	character_util.move_to_async(guide, scene_center + vector(0.7, 0, 0),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	while guest_move_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--paper_piece 던진다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	character_util.set_anim(guide, {name = 'throw', loop = false})
	local paper_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.marina_paper_item_id, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = guide.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0), target = guest.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(guide)

	--가이드(idle, idle) : 손님, 오리배 투어 영수증입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, {key = 'aw_main_s13_marina_1', skip = true})

	--투어 손님, eat으로 가격표 보고 surprise 표정으로 한 번 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guest, {name = 'eat'})
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	character_util.set_emotion(guest, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.set_anim(guest, {name = 'eat', scale = 0, mix_duration = 999})
	character_util.normal_jump(guest, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	paper_item:ConsumeComplete()

	--손님(left, surprise, releasex2), : 가, 가격이 왜 이래?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.remove_anim(guest)
	character_util.play_speech_action(guest, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_marina_2')

	--가이드(right, idle, idle) : 부채질 서비스, 드링크 서비스, 성대모사 서비스 포함 가격입니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, {key = 'aw_main_s13_marina_3', skip = true})

	--손님(left, tired, release) : 서, 성대모사 서비스는 내가 신청한 것도 아닌데?
	character_util.set_emotion(guest, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(guest, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_marina_4')

	--가이드(right, smile, idle) : 손님이 즐거워하셨으니 책정 값에 포함됩니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(guide, nil, 'smile', 'aw_main_s13_marina_5')

	--손님(left, tired, cast)  : 이걸 다 지불하고 나면 난 빈털터리라고…!
	character_util.play_speech_action(guest, 'cast', nil, 'aw_main_s13_marina_6')

	--손님(left, tried, release) : 나, 난 동의 못 해…!
	character_util.set_emotion(guest, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(guest, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_marina_7')

	--가이드(right, idle, idle) : 그러면 강제로 수용소로 가실 수밖에 없겠군요.
	character_util.set_anim(guide, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, {key = 'aw_main_s13_marina_8', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(guide)

	--손님 : 아니! 이런 억지가 어디있어!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(guest, {name = 'cast2'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guest, {key = 'aw_main_s13_marina_9', skip = true})

	--이후 컨트롤 돌아오고 마지막 말들을 반복하며 다툼이 일어난 상황을 보여 준다
	guide.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_main_s13_marina_8'
	guest.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_main_s13_marina_9'
	guest.Interactable.TalkSfx = '03_dialogue_negative_02'

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marina_marker_key, guest, true)

	if self.marina_got_guide_book == false then
		local clue_interact = self.get_marina_clue_interact()
		self.marina_twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(clue_interact.Position)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:marina_get_guide_book()
	local clue_interact = self.get_marina_clue_interact()

	self:remove_clue_emoticon(self.marina_clue_index)

	if leader.Position.x < clue_interact.Position.x then
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	else
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	--매표소 안쪽에 책에 인터렉트 하면
	local equip_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'eat'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self.marina_twinkle_effect:Dispose()

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent, {ItemId = self.clue_infos[self.marina_clue_index].item_id},
			'aw_main_s13_marina_title', 'aw_main_s13_marina_subtitle', 'aw_main_s13_marina_desc')
