--region 쓰레기장

function local_class:on_garbage_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'garbage_area')
			and self.current_garbage_state == self.garbage_state.none then
		self.current_garbage_state = self.garbage_state.in_grid
		self:garbage_start_cooldown()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_garbage_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done then return false end

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'garbage_area')
			and self.current_garbage_state == self.garbage_state.in_grid then
		self:garbage_stop_cooldown()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_garbage_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_garbage_clue_interact()) and self.interacting_clue == false then
		self.interacting_clue = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.garbage_interact_garbage, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.sector_infos.garbage.event_done then return false end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_garbage_hide_interact())
			and self.current_garbage_state == self.garbage_state.in_grid then
		self.current_garbage_state = self.garbage_state.hide
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.garbage_interact_hide, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:garbage_start_cooldown()
	self.garbage_current_cooldown = self.garbage_cooltime

	if self.garbage_cooldown_on == false then
		self.garbage_cooldown_on = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.garbage_cooldown_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:garbage_stop_cooldown()
	self.current_garbage_state = self.garbage_state.none
end

function local_class:garbage_cooldown_routine()
	local leader_controller = get_party_leader().FieldObjectController

	while self.current_garbage_state == self.garbage_state.in_grid do

		if not lua_helper.type_compare(leader_controller.CurrentState,
				CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) and not self.evidence_controller.clue_ui_popup_on then
			if self.garbage_current_cooldown <= 0 then
				self.current_garbage_state = self.garbage_state.staff_appear
				self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.garbage_staff_appear, self)
			else
				-- 특정 연출중이지 않을 때는 쿨다운이 돌지 않도록 막아놓음
				-- 쿨다운이 돌지 않으면 staff_appear 이벤트도 발생하지 않음
				self.garbage_current_cooldown = self.garbage_current_cooldown - unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.garbage_cooldown_on = false
end

function local_class:garbage_interact_hide()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hide_interact = self.get_garbage_hide_interact()

	local move_done_count = 0
	local trashcan_opened = false

	local hide_routine = function(fo, jump_pos)
		character_util.move_to_async(fo, jump_pos, nil, 2, true, true)
		fo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

		while trashcan_opened == false do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'get'})
		character_util.jump(fo, 1.2, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(fo, 0, 0.8)
		character_util.move_to_async(fo, jump_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
		character_util.remove_rolling_number(leader.Transform)

		move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
	end

	local leader_jump_pos, main_jump_pos

	--if leader.Position.z < main.Position.z then
	--	leader_jump_pos = hide_interact.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5)
	--	main_jump_pos = hide_interact.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5)
	--else
	--	leader_jump_pos = hide_interact.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5)
	--	main_jump_pos = hide_interact.Position + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5)
	--end

	local hide_interact_center = vector_util.get_x0z(hide_interact.Bounds.center)

	if leader.Position.x < main.Position.x then
		leader_jump_pos = hide_interact_center + vector(-0.5, 0, -1)
		main_jump_pos = hide_interact_center + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
	else
		leader_jump_pos = hide_interact_center + vector(0.5, 0, -1)
		main_jump_pos = hide_interact_center + vector(-0.5, 0, -1)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(hide_routine, leader, leader_jump_pos))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(hide_routine, main, main_jump_pos))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
	animator_util.play_async(hide_interact, 'open', 1)
	trashcan_opened = true

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02', delayed_time = 14 / 60, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'
	})
	animator_util.play_async(hide_interact, 'close', 25 / 60)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:garbage_staff_appear()
end

function local_class:garbage_staff_appear()
	local staff_1 = self.get_garbage_staff(1)
	local staff_2 = self.get_garbage_staff(2)
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local appear_down = field:GetZone('s13_garbage_party_detect_left'):Contains(leader.Position)

	local staff_move_done_count = 0
	local staff_move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			staff_move_done_count = staff_move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	local staff_1_appear_pos, staff_2_appear_pos
	local staff_center

	staff_1.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	staff_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	if appear_down then
		local appear_center = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_appear_down_center')
		local target_center = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_target_down_center')
		staff_1.Position = appear_center + vector(-0.7, 0, 0)
		staff_2.Position = appear_center + vector(0.7, 0, 0)

		staff_1_appear_pos = staff_1.Position
		staff_2_appear_pos = staff_2.Position

		staff_center = target_center

		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_1,
				{waypoints = vector(staff_1.Position.x, 0, target_center.z),
				 speed = 4, callback = staff_move_done_cb})
		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_2,
				{waypoints = vector(staff_2.Position.x, 0, target_center.z),
				 speed = 4, callback = staff_move_done_cb})
		camera_util.move_async(target_center, 1)
	else
		local appear_center = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_appear_left_center')
		local target_center = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_target_left_center')
		staff_1.Position = appear_center
		staff_2.Position = appear_center + vector(-1.4, 0, 0)

		staff_1_appear_pos = staff_1.Position
		staff_2_appear_pos = staff_2.Position

		staff_center = target_center

		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_1,
				{waypoints = vector(target_center.x, 0, staff_1.Position.z),
				 speed = 4, callback = staff_move_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})
		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_2,
				{waypoints = vector(target_center.x - 1.4, 0, staff_2.Position.z),
				 speed = 4, callback = staff_move_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right})
		camera_util.move_async(target_center, 1)
	end

	while staff_move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.look_at(leader, staff_1)
	character_util.look_at(main, staff_1)

	if self.garbage_seen_staff_once == false then
		self.garbage_seen_staff_once = true

		character_util.look_at(staff_1, staff_2)
		character_util.look_at(staff_2, staff_1)

		character_util.set_emotion(staff_1, {name = 'tired'})

		--직원1(left, tired, idle) : 아, 아무리 카론님의 명령이라지만…
		character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, 'bomb_idle',
				nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_1')

		--직원1(left, tired, cast) : 우리 이래도 되는 걸까…?
		character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, 'cast',
				nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_2')

		--직원1(left, tired, releasex2) : 누가 지켜보고 있으면 어떡해…?
		character_util.play_speech_action(staff_1, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_3')
	end

	if self.current_garbage_state == self.garbage_state.hide then
		--쓰레기 더미에 숨었을 경우
		local hide_interact = self.get_garbage_hide_interact()
		local clue_interact = self.get_garbage_clue_interact()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(staff_1, staff_2)

		if appear_down then
			staff_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		else
			staff_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(staff_1, staff_2)
		character_util.look_at(staff_2, staff_1)

		--직원2(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 봤지? 아무도 없어.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_02')
		character_util.play_speech_action(staff_2, 'bomb_idle',
				nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_4')

		--직원2(right, attack, releasex2) : 누가 보기 전에 빨리 버려!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(staff_2, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				'attack', 'aw_main_s13_garbage_5')

		--직원1, left, right 한번씩 쳐다보고 throw로 쓰레기 더미 안에 paper_piece 던져 넣는다.

		local throw_pos = self:get_marker_pos('garbage_staff_1_throw')

		camera_util.move((throw_pos + clue_interact.Position) / 2, 1)

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(staff_1, {waypoints = {
			vector(throw_pos.x, 0, staff_1.Position.z),
			throw_pos
		}, speed = 6, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, play_sfx = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
		character_util.set_anim(staff_1, {name = 'throw'})

		local paper_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.clue_infos[self.garbage_clue_index].item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			pos = staff_1.Position + vector(0, 0.8, 0),
			--좀 더 쓰레기 안쪽에 던지고
			target = clue_interact.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
		})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.remove_anim(staff_1)
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		camera_util.move(staff_center, 1)

		if appear_down then
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(staff_1, {waypoints = {
				vector(throw_pos.x, 0, staff_2.Position.z),
				staff_2.Position + vector(-1.4, 0, 0)
			}, speed = 6, run = true, play_sfx = true})
		else
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(staff_1, {waypoints = {
				vector(throw_pos.x, 0, staff_2.Position.z),
				staff_2.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0)
			}, speed = 6, run = true, play_sfx = true})
		end

		--이후 직원1,2 사라진다.
		staff_move_done_count = 0
		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_1,
				{waypoints = staff_1_appear_pos, speed = 6, run = true,
				 callback = staff_move_done_cb, play_sfx = true})
		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_2,
				{waypoints = staff_2_appear_pos, speed = 6, run = true,
				 callback = staff_move_done_cb, play_sfx = true})

		while staff_move_done_count < 2 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		staff_1.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		staff_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

		self:add_clue_emoticon(clue_interact, self.garbage_clue_index)
		camera_util.move(leader.Position, 1, {end_target = leader})
		--fade되어 사라진다
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(paper_item, 0, 1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
		animator_util.play_async(hide_interact, 'open', 0.6)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
				{waypoints = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), speed = 2})
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(main,
				{waypoints = main.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), speed = 2})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim(main)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02', delayed_time = 14 / 60, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'
		})

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.garbage_marker_key, clue_interact, true)

	else

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		if appear_down then
			staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
			staff_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			staff_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			staff_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.8)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.look_at(staff_1, leader)
		character_util.look_at(staff_2, leader)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		--직원2 : 뭐야. 누군가가 있었잖아.

		character_util.normal_jump_async(staff_2)

		--직원1: 이따가 다시 와야겠어.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(staff_2, {key = 'aw_main_s13_garbage_7', skip = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points(staff_2,
				{waypoints = staff_2_appear_pos, speed = 4, callback = staff_move_done_cb})

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		staff_1.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		staff_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

		self.current_garbage_state = self.garbage_state.in_grid
		self:garbage_start_cooldown()
	end
end

function local_class:garbage_interact_garbage()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local clue_interact = self.get_garbage_clue_interact()

	self:remove_clue_emoticon(self.garbage_clue_index)

	--쓰레기 더미에 인터랙트하면 하나이 가디언에게 자기가 직접 쓰레기를 뒤지겠다고 말한다.
	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(leader, {waypoints = clue_interact.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
									 speed = 1.5, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, callback = move_done_cb})

	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = clue_interact.Position + vector(1, 0, -1),
								   speed = 2, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = move_done_cb})
	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--하나(right, idle, idle) : {0}님, 아무래도 쓰레기 속을 뒤져봐야 할 것 같은데요…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_8')

	--하나right, idle, idle) : 이런건 저에게 맡기세요!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_garbage_9')

	--하나(right, tired, idle) : 저… 회사에서 항상 쓰레기 뒤처리 담당이었거든요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s13_garbage_10')

	--쓰레기 사이로 들어가 뒤진다.﻿
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main,
			{waypoints = clue_interact.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.7), speed = 2})
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

	--하나 위쪽쓰레기더미로 가서 eat자세로 쓰레기 뒤지기 시작.
	local equip_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'eat'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	clue_interact.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	--쓰레기를 뒤지는 동안 사방으로 사과나 통조림 같은 쓰레기가 튀어나온다.(바로 알파 빠지며 사라진다.)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	local apple_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.garbage_apple_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = main.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), target = main.Position + vector(1.7, 0, 0.3),
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(apple_item, 0, 1)
		apple_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	local can_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.garbage_can_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = main.Position + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), target = main.Position + vector(2, 0, -0.2),
	})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(can_item, 0, 1)
		can_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	equip_loop_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	--하나가 찾았다! 하는 대사와 함께 종이를 찾아낸다.
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'cast2'})
	main:HideWeapon(true)
	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'paper_piece')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false},
			'smile', 'aw_main_s13_garbage_11')
	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	main:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(main, {waypoints = {
		vector(main.Position.x, 0, leader.Position.z),
		leader.Position + vector(1.4, 0, 0)
	}, speed = 3, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left})

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.garbage_marker_key)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_garbage_interact_event')

	--하나 : 버려진 가디언의 영수증 획득
	self:after_gather_clue_scene(self.garbage_clue_index)

	self.interacting_clue = false
end

function local_class:on_anteroom_interact_event(e)
	if self.sector_infos.anteroom.event_done then return false end

	if (lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_anteroom_blocker(1))
			or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_anteroom_blocker(2)))
			and self.anteroom_screenplaying == false then
		self.anteroom_screenplaying = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.anteroom_blocking, self)
		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_anteroom_photographer())
			and self.current_anteroom_state == self.anteroom_state.none then
		self.anteroom_screenplaying = true
		self.current_anteroom_state = self.anteroom_state.got_camera
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.anteroom_interact_photographer, self)
		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_anteroom_clue_interact())
			and self.anteroom_screenplaying == false then
		self.anteroom_screenplaying = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.anteroom_interact_clue, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_anteroom_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's13_anteroom_blocking')
			and self.anteroom_screenplaying == false then
		self.anteroom_screenplaying = true
		self.evidence_controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.anteroom_blocking, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:anteroom_blocking()
	local guard_1 = self.get_anteroom_blocker(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_anteroom_blocker(2)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local main = self.get_main_character()

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	local blocker
	local checker

	local guard_center = (guard_1.Position + guard_2.Position) / 2

	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction),
				leader.Position, 3, false)
	end

	camera_util.move(guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 0.8)

	if leader.Position.z > main.Position.z then
		wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
				{waypoints = guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5), speed = 2,
				 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = move_done_cb})
		wp_util.move_way_points(main,
				{waypoints = guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5), speed = 2,
				 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = move_done_cb})

		blocker = guard_1
		checker = guard_2
	else
		wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
				{waypoints = guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5), speed = 2,
				 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = move_done_cb})
		wp_util.move_way_points(main,
				{waypoints = guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5), speed = 2,
				 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left, callback = move_done_cb})

		blocker = guard_2
		checker = guard_1
	end

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_anteroom_zone_enter_event')

	--안내원 : 안내원 대기실은 회사 직원만 출입 가능합니다.
	character_util.play_speech_action(blocker, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_6')

	local main_origin_pos = main.Position

	--하나가 앞으로 나선다
	camera_util.move(guard_center + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(main, main.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	--하나 : 영혼 에너지 저장을 위해 출입 허가를 부탁드립니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7', skip = true})

	--경비병 : 저장할 영혼 에너지가 있긴 한가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(checker, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.set_emotion(blocker, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(checker, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_1')

	--경비병 : 얼마 안 되는 양으로 매번 귀찮게 하지 마시고 돌아가시죠.
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(blocker, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_2')

	--하나 : …그건…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_3', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(main)

	--하나 주저하며 물러선다.
	camera_util.move(guard_center + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(main, main_origin_pos, 0.5, nil, false, true)

	character_util.look_at(main, leader)
	character_util.look_at(leader, main)

	--선택지
	--넌 이미 훌륭한 저승사자야!
	--네 직급이 더 높잖아!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_4', 'mercy'},
		{'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_5', 'brutal'}
	})

	--가디언 idle, release
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--하나 nod
	character_util.nod_twice(main)

	--하나 경비병 앞에 다시 나서며
	camera_util.move(guard_center + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(main, main.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, true)

	--하나 : 방금 그 발언…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(blocker)
	character_util.remove_emotion(checker)
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_6', skip = true})

	--하나 : 저승사자에게 부여된 고유의 권한을 무시하신 거로 들리는데…
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, nil,
			'tired', 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_7')

	--하나 : 지부에 이 건에 대해 정식으로 문제를 제기하겠습니다.
	character_util.normal_jump(blocker, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(checker, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_8')

	--하나 : 사원 번호와 성명을 알려주시겠어요?
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_9')

	--경비병들 잠시 떨다가 길을 비켜준다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	character_util.look_at(blocker, checker)
	character_util.look_at(checker, blocker)
	character_util.set_anim(blocker, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_anim(checker, {name = 'cast'})
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--경비병 : …
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(checker, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_10', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(blocker)
	character_util.remove_anim(checker)

	blocker.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	checker.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- …49지부 사신 하나 신원 확인되셨습니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(checker)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(checker, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_11', skip = true})

	--안내원들 길을 열어준다.
	guard_1.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.2, 1, 1.1))
	guard_2.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.2, 1, 1.1))

	move_done_count = 0
	guard_1.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	guard_2.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_1,
			{waypoints = guard_center + vector(0, 0, 1.5), speed = 1})
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_2,
			{waypoints = guard_center + vector(0, 0, -1.5), speed = 1})

	camera_util.move(vector(guard_center.x + 0.5 - 4, 0, guard_center.z),
			0.5 + 4 / 3, {end_target = leader})
	--비켜준 길을 통해 경비병을 지나쳐 가다
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, main, vector(guard_center.x - 0.5, 0, guard_center.z),
				0.5, nil, false, true),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, leader, vector(guard_center.x + 0.5, 0, guard_center.z),
				0.5, nil, false, true),
	})

	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	wp_util.move_way_points(main, {waypoints = main.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), speed = 3,
								   last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
			{waypoints = leader.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), speed = 3, callback = move_done_cb})

	--멈춰서
	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--하나 : 휴우… 저 이런 건 처음이라 엄청나게 긴장했지 뭐예요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_12')

	--하나 : …헤헤.
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_13', skip = true})

	--하나 : {0}님과 함께라면 뭐든지 해낼 수 있을 거 같아요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_14')

	--하나 : 정말… 뭐든지 말이에요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_7_15', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	self.anteroom_screenplaying = false
end

	-- 저장고를 먼저 갔다 온 경우
	local clue_interact = self.get_anteroom_clue_interact()
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(clue_interact, typeof(CS.Oak.PublishInteractable)) then
		-- 나래이션 인터랙터블이 붙어있을 것임
		clue_interact.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	self.anteroom_screenplaying = false
end

function local_class:anteroom_interact_clue()
	local clue_interact = self.get_anteroom_clue_interact()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self:remove_clue_emoticon(self.anteroom_clue_index)

	--영혼 에너지 저장고들이 있는 방. 4개의 저장고에 각자 인터렉트할 수 있다.
	--일반 저장고들 인터렉트 시
	--영혼 에너지가 가득차 있다.
	--비어 있는 저장고에 인터렉트 시
	local align_done_count = 0
	local align_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			align_done_count = align_done_count + 1
		end
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points(leader,
			{waypoints = clue_interact.Position + vector(-0.7, 0, -1.2),
			 speed = 1.5, callback = align_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})
	wp_util.move_way_points(main,
			{waypoints = clue_interact.Position + vector(0.7, 0, -1.2),
			 speed = 1.5, callback = align_done_cb, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})

	while align_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.anteroom_seen_clue_once == false then
		self.anteroom_seen_clue_once = true

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		character_util.normal_jump_async(main)

		--하나 : 이건 카론님의 저장고 인데, 어째서 텅텅 비어 있는 걸까요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_18', skip = true})

		--하나 : 분명 이것이 단서가 될거에요!
		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
				'attack', 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_19')

		--하나 : 하지만 이곳은 저승사자들만의 비공개 구역이고, 저장고도 함부로 옮겨선 안되는데…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'question', loop = false})
		character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s13_anteroom_20', skip = true})
	end

	if self.current_anteroom_state == self.anteroom_state.got_camera then

		--카메라가 있을 경우) 사진을 찍는다.
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{'aw_main_s13_anteroom_21', 'intellect'}
		})

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)

		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up

		--사진찍는 연출
		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'cast'})
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_02')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		local picture_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = self.clue_infos[self.anteroom_clue_index].item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'FixLooter',
			pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0.2),
			target = leader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.3)
		})
		picture_item.ConsumeTarget = leader

		wait_for_sec(1.2)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		self.current_anteroom_state = self.anteroom_state.done

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.anteroom_marker_key)

		-- 구독 해제
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_anteroom_interact_event')

		clue_interact.Interactable = self.anteroom_clue_nar_interactable
		self.anteroom_clue_nar_interactable = nil

		--카론의 빈 영혼 에너지 창고 증거 획득
		self:set_sector_data_async('anteroom')
		self:after_gather_clue_scene(self.anteroom_clue_index)
	else
		--(카메라가 없을 경우) 방법을 찾아 보자.
		choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{'aw_main_s13_anteroom_22', 'normal'}
		})

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)

		main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
		wait_for_sec(1.2)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		--하나 끄덕끄덕
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(main)

function local_class:on_pre_load()

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('shortcut_door_1', true))
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('shortcut_door_2', true))
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_routine, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_agora_touch_event')

	self.get_agora_balances().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	if not is_unity_null(self.agora_ui_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.agora_ui_obj)
	end
	self.agora_ui_obj = nil
	self.agora_ui_controller = nil
	self.agora_ui_red_dot = nil
	self.agora_ui_left_arrow_sprite = nil
	self.agora_ui_right_arrow_sprite = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.res_holder = nil

	if self.evidence_controller ~= nil then
		self.evidence_controller:set_connected_class(nil)
		self.evidence_controller = nil
	end

	if self.agora_optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.agora_optimized_npcs)
	end
	self.agora_optimized_npcs = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	return false
end

	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'doyagao'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_5', skip = true})

									  speed = 6, run = true, callback = move_done_cb, play_sfx = true})

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--카론 : 저 범죄자를 연행하세요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_9')

	--경비병들 움직이려고 할 때
	move_done_count = 0
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_1, {waypoints = main.Position + vector(-1.2, 0, 0.7),
									  speed = 2.5, callback = move_done_cb})
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_2, {waypoints = main.Position + vector(-1.2, 0, -0.7),
									  speed = 2.5, callback = move_done_cb})

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--하나 샤우트로
	--하나 : 명계 규율 제 255조! 6항!
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.4, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(main.Position, 0.01)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	character_util.normal_jump(charon)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main,
			{key = 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_10', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	--하나 : 저승사자 간의 갈등이 있으면 아고라를 신청할 수 있다!
	main:HideWeapon(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_11')

	--하나 : 신청 받은 당사자는 반드시 이에 응해야 한다!
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_12')

	--하나 : 49지부 소속 저승사자 하나. 카론 님에게 정식으로 아고라를 요청합니다!
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'dualsword_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(main, {key = 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_13', skip = true})

	--경비병들 카론 처다봄
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async((main.Position + charon.Position) / 2, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	guard_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	guard_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_anim(guard_1, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	character_util.set_anim(guard_2, {name = 'bomb_idle'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(guard_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_2)

	--카론 : 조용하게 넘어가게 해드리려 했더니 어쩔 수 없군요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'cross_arm',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_14')

	--카론 : 어디 그 형편없는 논리를 들어보기라도 할까요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'dualsword_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_before_agora_15', skip = true})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	main:HideWeapon(false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(charon)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	charon.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	main.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	knight.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	guard_1.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	guard_2.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.agora_started

	self:agora_load_routine()
	self.current_agora_state = self.agora_state.loaded

	while self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.win do
		self:agora_start_routine()
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:agora_dispose()

	self:after_agora_scene()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 아고라 승리 이후
function local_class:after_agora_scene()
	local knight = get_party_leader()
	local main = self.get_main_character()
	local charon = self.get_charon()
	local tao = self.get_tao()
	local marty = self.get_marty()
	local aggro = self.get_aggro_girl()
	local ceo = self.get_ceo()

	main.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	knight.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	ceo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	tao.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	aggro.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	marty.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	charon.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	tao.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_tao')
	tao.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	marty.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_marty')
	marty.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	aggro.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_aggro')
	aggro.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	knight.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_knight')
	knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	main.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_main')

	charon.Position = self:get_marker_pos('after_agora_charon')

	--아고라에서 승리한 가디언과 하나.

	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'smile'})

	--마티 smile, cast2, 타오 smile,idle로 하나 근처에 적절하게 배치

	character_util.set_anim(marty, {name = 'cast2'})

	character_util.set_emotion(tao, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(aggro, {name = 'doyagao'})

	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'tired'})

	camera_util.move_async(vector(main.Position.x, 0, charon.Position.z), 0)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {'sneak', 'after_agora'}))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--하나(right, awesome, success) : {0}님! 저희가 해냈어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'success',
			'awesome', 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_1')

	--하나(right, smile, cast2) : 저희가 아고라를 이겼다구요!
	--가디언 left, smile, cast2로 마주보는 상태
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'cast2'})
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_2')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--카론은 모든 건 회사를 위해서였다고, 자신은 그저 성실히 일한 죄 밖에 없다고 적반하장격으로 발악한다.

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(marty)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tao)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(aggro)

	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	marty.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	tao.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	aggro.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--타오(left, attack, release) : 이제 그만 포기하시오. 당신의 죄목은 낱낱이 밝혀졌으니!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_china_master_shout_01')

	character_util.play_speech_action(aggro, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_3_1')

	camera_util.move_async(charon.Position + vector(1.2, 0, 0), 0.7)

	--카론(right, idle, idle) : … (카론 몸 떨고있도록)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(charon, 0.02, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_4', skip = true})

	--카론(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 죄? (카론 몸 떨고있도록)

			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_5')

	--카론(right, attack, release) : 난 그저 회사를 위해 성실히 일한 죄 밖에 없어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_6')

	--카론(right, attack, jingak) : 회사가 무너지면 너희도 끝장이라고!
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'jingak', loop = false, sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_02'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_7')

	local top_center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('square_top_entry')

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count, is_ceo)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
				if is_ceo then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
				end
				move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
			end
		end
	end

	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)

	local left_center_pos = field:GetMarker('s12_square_left_entry').position

	ceo.Position = vector(charon.Position.x - 2, 0, top_center_pos.z)
	ceo.Position = left_center_pos

	guard_1.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	guard_2.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	guard_1.Position = vector(left_center_pos.x - 1, 0, ceo.Position.z + 0.7)
	guard_2.Position = vector(left_center_pos.x - 1, 0, ceo.Position.z - 0.7)

	local get_appear_wp = function(npc)
		local diff = npc.Position - ceo.Position

		return charon.Position + vector(-2, 0, 0) + diff
	end

	--지부장, 가드 4명 정도 거느리고 등장
	wp_util.move_way_points(ceo, {waypoints = get_appear_wp(ceo), speed = 4,
								  callback = move_done_cb_generator(1, true)})

	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_1,
			{waypoints = get_appear_wp(guard_1), speed = 4, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1)})

	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_2,
			{waypoints = get_appear_wp(guard_2), speed = 4, callback = move_done_cb_generator(1)})

	--카론(right, attack, idle) : 노역소 영혼들 주제에 내게 감히…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_8', skip = true})

	--이 때 지부장과 경비병들이 등장한다. 카론은 지부장에게 도움을 요청하지만 지부장은 카론에게 실망했다고 하곤 카론을 연행시킨다.
	--지부장, 카론과 하나 앞쪽 중간쯤에 배치

	while move_done_count < 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--카론이 지부장 왼쪽으로 달려나간다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(charon)
	charon.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(charon, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	camera_util.move(ceo.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.4)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(charon,
			{waypoints = ceo.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), speed = 4, run = true, play_sfx = true})

	--카론(right, tired, push)  : 지, 지부장님…!
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'sing',
			'tired', 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_9')

	--카론(down, attack, release) : 저놈들이 뻔뻔하게도 제게 아고라를 신청해서 말도 안 되는 증거들로 저를 능멸했습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	charon.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_10')

	--지부장(left, idle, idle) : …카론.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ceo, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_11', skip = true})

	--카론(right, surprise, 한 번 점프) : 네, 넷?!

	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(charon, '01_player_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_12', skip = true})

	--지부장(left, tired, idle) : 이야기는 모두 전해 들었습니다.

	--지부장(left, tired, release) : 정말 실망입니다. 소중한 귀인들의 에너지를 횡령하다니요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(ceo, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_13')

	--카론(right, surprise, cast) : 네? 그게 무슨…
	character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'cast'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(charon, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_14', skip = true})

	--지부장(left, tired, question) : 아무리 회사가 소중하다 한들 이런 짓을 벌이면 곤란하지 않겠습니까?
	character_util.play_speech_action(ceo, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_15')
	character_util.remove_emotion(ceo)

	--지부장(left, idle, bomb_idle) : 회사에 누가 될 짓을 하는 직원은 누구나 공평히 처벌받아야 합니다.
	character_util.play_speech_action(ceo, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_16')

	--지부장(left, idle, idle) : 카론, 당신도 예외는 아니고요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'scared'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ceo, {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_17', skip = true})

	--카론(left, scared, release) : 지부장님! 저 정말 억울합니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_17_1')

	--카론(left, scared, idle) : 저만큼 회사를 생각하던 직원이 어디 있다고 그러십니까!
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_17_2')

	--지부장(down, attack, release) : 당장 이 죄인을 끌고 가!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_sapa_shout_01')
	ceo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.play_speech_action(ceo, {name = 'release', loop = false},
			'attack', {key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_18', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	--경비병들 : 네!

	character_util.set_anim(guard_1, {name = 'salute', loop = false})
	character_util.set_anim(guard_2, {name = 'salute', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(guard_1, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(guard_2, {name = 'attack'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guard_1,
			{key = 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			 world_pos = guard_1.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1.5)})
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_2)

	ceo.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	move_done_count = 0
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_1,
			{waypoints = vector(charon.Position.x, 0, guard_1.Position.z),
			 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down, speed = 4, run = true,
			 callback = move_done_cb_generator(1)})
	wp_util.move_way_points(guard_2,
			{waypoints = vector(charon.Position.x, 0, guard_2.Position.z),
			 last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up, speed = 4, run = true,
			 callback = move_done_cb_generator(1)})

	while move_done_count < 2 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--경비병 붙잡히고 나서 한 번 더 반항하도록 변경
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(guard_1, {name = 'push'})
	character_util.set_anim(guard_2, {name = 'cast'})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--카론(left, attack, embarrassed) : 이 자식들아! 이거 안 놔?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'embarrassed',
			'damaged', 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19_1')

	character_util.remove_anim(guard_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(guard_2)

	--카론(left, attack, release)  : 지부장님! 저한테 이러시면 정말 안 되는 겁니다!
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19_2')

	--지부장에게 반걸음 다가간다.
	guard_1.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	guard_2.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.4)
	character_util.move_to_async(charon, charon.Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0),
			0.4, nil, true, true)

	--카론 : 제가 누구 때문에 여기까지 왔는지 아시잖습니까!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'shoot',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19_2_1')

	--카론 : 저 카론입니다! 카론이라고요!
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'cast',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19_2_2')

	--카론 : 지시하신 건 그게 어떤 것이든 단 한 번도 어긴 적이 없는 엘리트 사원!
	character_util.play_speech_action(charon, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_after_agora_19_2_3')

	--뒤돌아 가디언 쳐다 보며

function local_class:get_clue_ui_data()
	if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.agora_started then
		return self:agora_get_clue_ui_data()
	end

	local data = {}

	for index = 1, 4 do
		local info = self.evidence_infos[index]
		table.insert(data, {
			id = index,
			info_index = index,
			sprite = info.sprite_name,
			enabled = true,
			cur_count = 4
		})
	end

	return data
end

end

function local_class:agora_routine()
	self:agora_enter()
	self:agora_start_scene()

	self.current_agora_state = self.agora_state.in_game

	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')
	local balances = self.get_agora_balances()

	local success = true
	local round_text_index = 0
	for round = 1, self.agora_round_info.target - 1 do
		-- 라운드 시작
		self.agora_round_info.current = round

		-- 라운드 시작 시의 연출
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
		self['agora_r' .. round .. '_pre_scene'](self)

		--대화 상자 UI 비활성화.
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

		if round > 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_01')
			animator_util.play(balances, 'up_L1')
		end

		while self.agora_hp_info.player.current > 0 do
			round_text_index = round_text_index + 1
			local round_text = game_string:Format('agora_battle_round_text', round_text_index)
			self.agora_ui_controller:SetRoundLabel(round_text)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(round_text, 1.5)

			--카론, 하나 (attack, dualsword_idle)
			character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'dualsword_idle'})
			character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'attack'})
			character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'dualsword_idle'})
			character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})

			wait_for_sec(1.5)

			--논쟁 대화 모드 UI 활성화
			self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)

			self:agora_enter_choice_mode()

			while self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index == 0 do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			self:agora_exit_choice_mode()

			--논쟁 대화 모드 UI 비활성화
			self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

			-- 맞는 선택을 한 경우
			if self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index == self.agora_round_info.choice[round].evidence.answer
					and self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index == self.agora_round_info.choice[round].speech.answer then
				self['agora_r' .. round .. '_post_scene'](self)
				break
			else
				-- 잘못된 선택을 한 경우
				self:agora_round_wrong_choice()
				-- 다시 선택할 수 있도록 루프문 바깥을 빠져나가지 않음
			end
		end

		-- 체력이 다 깎이면 게임 실패 처리
		if self.agora_hp_info.player.current == 0 then
			success = false
			break
		end
	end

	if success then
		-- 마지막 라운드
		-- 무조건 이기는 경우이므로 이전까지 살아남은 경우에 발동함
		-- 구조가 일반적인 경우랑 다르기 때문에, 부득이하게 루틴에서 따로 뺌 (쓸모없는 조건문 돌지 않도록)
		local round = self.agora_round_info.target

		self.agora_round_info.current = round

		-- 라운드 시작 시의 연출
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
		self['agora_r' .. round .. '_pre_scene'](self)

		--대화 상자 UI 비활성화.
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_01')
		animator_util.play(balances, 'up_L1')

		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
		self['agora_r' .. round .. '_middle_scene'](self)
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

		round_text_index = round_text_index + 1
		local round_text = game_string:Format('agora_battle_round_text', round_text_index)
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetRoundLabel(round_text)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(round_text, 1.5)

		--하나(attack, dualsword_idle), 가디언(attack 이모션), 카론(scared, cast) 상태로 캐릭터 쉐이크
		character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'dualsword_idle'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		character_util.shake(charon, 0.02, 99999)
		character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'cast'})

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		--논쟁 대화 모드 UI 활성화
		self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)

		--대화문 선택 진행
		--증거품 확인 버튼에는 레드닷이 추가 되어 있는 상태.
		self:agora_toggle_button_red_dot(true)
		self:agora_enter_choice_mode()

		--이 때 어떤 것을 선택하더라도 증거품 제출 시 정답 이벤트로 넘어감
		while self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index == 0 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self:agora_exit_choice_mode()

		self['agora_r' .. round .. '_post_scene'](self)

		-- 성공
		-- 연출은 r5에서 할 것임
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.win
	else
		--실패 연출
		self:agora_lose()
	end

	self:agora_exit()
end

function local_class:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(on)

	if on then
		self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.idle
	else
		self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.disabled
	end
end

function local_class:agora_toggle_left_arrow(on)
	self.agora_ui_left_arrow_sprite.enabled = on
end

function local_class:agora_toggle_right_arrow(on)

function local_class:agora_speech(talker, text, duration)
	local fo_info = self.agora_speech_info.fo_infos[talker]

	if fo_info then
		local string_builder = CS.System.Text.StringBuilder()
		string_builder:Clear()
		string_builder:Append(game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(text))
		local str_len = string_builder.Length

		self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, '')

		if duration == nil then
			local life_time = self.agora_speech_info.life_time
			local print_duration = str_len * self.agora_speech_info.type_speed

			local time_passed = 0

			self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.printing

			local text_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
			})
			while self.agora_speech_info.state == self.agora_speech_state.printing and time_passed < print_duration do
				local progress = time_passed / print_duration
				local sub_index = math.ceil(str_len * progress)

				if sub_index < str_len then
					self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString(0, sub_index))
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			text_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

			self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString())

			self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.wait_skip

			while self.agora_speech_info.state == self.agora_speech_state.wait_skip and life_time > 0 do
				life_time = life_time - unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		else
			-- 대략 절반정도의 시간동안은 텍스트 출력만 함
			local print_duration = duration / 2

			self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.non_skip_printing

			local time_passed = 0

			local text_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '03_dialogue_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default',
			})
			while time_passed < print_duration do
				local progress = time_passed / print_duration
				local sub_index = math.ceil(str_len * progress)

				if sub_index < str_len then
					self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString(0, sub_index))
				end

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
			text_sfx:FadeOut(0.05)

			self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name, string_builder:ToString())

			wait_for_sec(duration - print_duration)
		end
	else
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(nil, nil, nil)
	end

	self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.idle
end

function local_class:on_agora_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.agora_speech_info.state == self.agora_speech_state.wait_skip then
			self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.skipped
			return true
		elseif self.agora_speech_info.state == self.agora_speech_state.printing then
			self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.wait_skip
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:agora_update_selectable_speech()
	local selectables = self.agora_round_info.choice[self.agora_round_info.current].speech.selectables
	local cur_text_key = selectables[self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index]
	local fo_info = self.agora_speech_info.fo_infos[self:agora_get_npc('charon')]

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomUI(fo_info.portrait, fo_info.name,
			game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(cur_text_key))

	self:agora_toggle_left_arrow(self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index > 1)
	self:agora_toggle_right_arrow(self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index < #selectables)
end

function local_class:agora_toggle_button_red_dot(on)

function local_class:agora_get_clue_ui_data()
	local choice_info = self.agora_round_info.choice[self.agora_round_info.current]
	local data = {}

	for id, index in pairs(choice_info.evidence.selectables) do
		local info = self.evidence_infos[index]
		table.insert(data, {
			id = id,
			info_index = index,
			sprite = info.sprite_name,
			enabled = true,
			cur_count = #choice_info.evidence.selectables
		})
	end

	return data
end

function local_class:agora_show_evidence_popup()
	self.evidence_controller:show_clue_popup(nil, function(id)
		self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index = self.agora_round_info.choice[self.agora_round_info.current]
				.evidence.selectables[id]
		self.agora_ui_controller.EvidenceButtonCb = nil
	end)
end

function local_class:agora_set_hp(is_player, diff, duration)
	if is_player then
		local info = self.agora_hp_info.player

		info.current = info.current - diff
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetPlayerHeart(info.current, info.max)
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetPlayerProgressBar(info.current / self.agora_hp_info.player.max)
	else
		local info = self.agora_hp_info.enemy

		info.current = info.current - diff
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetNpcHeart(info.current, info.max)
		self.agora_ui_controller:SetNpcProgressBar(info.current / self.agora_hp_info.enemy.max)
	end
end

function local_class:agora_get_npc(name)
	return self.agora_optimized_npcs[name]
end

function local_class:agora_enter_choice_mode()
	-- 증거 리스트 관련 처리
	self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index = 0

	self.agora_ui_controller.EvidenceButtonCb = function()
		self:agora_toggle_button_red_dot(false)
		self:agora_show_evidence_popup()
	end

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetEvidenceButton(true)

	-- 대화창 관련 처리
	self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.selecting

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.yellow)

	local speeches = self.agora_round_info.choice[self.agora_round_info.current].speech.selectables

	self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index = 1
	self:agora_update_selectable_speech()

	-- 왼쪽 화살표 버튼 콜백 추가
	self.agora_ui_controller.LeftButtonCb = function()
		if self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index > 1 then
			self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index = self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index - 1
			self:agora_update_selectable_speech()
		end
	end

	-- 오른쪽 화살표 버튼 콜백 추가
	self.agora_ui_controller.RightButtonCb = function()
		if self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index < #speeches then
			self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index = self.agora_round_info.selected_speech_index + 1
			self:agora_update_selectable_speech()
		end
	end

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetArrowContainer(true)
end

function local_class:agora_exit_choice_mode()
	-- 따로 뭔가가 다시 발동하지 않도록 콜백 리셋
	self.agora_ui_controller.LeftButtonCb = nil
	self.agora_ui_controller.RightButtonCb = nil
	self.agora_ui_controller.EvidenceButtonCb = nil

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetArrowContainer(false)
	self.agora_ui_controller:SetEvidenceButton(false)

	self.agora_ui_controller:SetBottomDescColor(unity_class.color.white)

	self.agora_speech_info.state = self.agora_speech_state.idle
end

function local_class:agora_play_speech_action(fo, anim_data, emotion_data, talk_key)
	if anim_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(anim_data) then
			anim_data = { name = anim_data }
		end

		character_util.set_anim(fo, anim_data)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		if type_util.is_string(emotion_data) then
			emotion_data = { name = emotion_data }
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(fo, emotion_data)
	end

	self:agora_speech(fo, talk_key)

	if anim_data ~= nil then
		local is_upper = lua_helper.get_value(anim_data, 'upper', nil)
		character_util.remove_anim(fo, is_upper)
	end

	if emotion_data ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_emotion(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:agora_set_attachment(fo, item)
	local bone_follower = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject,
			typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = fo.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon1_side')
	self:agora_set_item_layer(item, false)
end

function local_class:agora_dispose_attachment(fo, item)
	local bone_follower = item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.enabled = false
end

function local_class:agora_create_item(evidence_index, pos)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.evidence_infos[evidence_index].item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		pos = pos, sprscale = self.evidence_infos[evidence_index].scale
	})

	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	return item
end

function local_class:agora_dispose_item(item)
	local bone_follower = item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	if not is_unity_null(bone_follower) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	end

	item:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:agora_set_item_layer(item, showoncharacter)
	if showoncharacter then
		item:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects')
	else
		item:SetSortingLayer('Under Effects')
	end
end

function local_class:agora_item_move_async(start_pos, target_pos, evidence_index, duration, item)
	item = item or self:agora_create_item(evidence_index, start_pos)
	local transform = item.SpriteTransform
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				+ vector(0, math.sin(math.pi * progress), 0)
		transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
				* unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(720 * progress, unity_class.vector3.forward)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	item:ConsumeComplete()
end

--정답 시 진행
function local_class:agora_round_right_choice(on_hit_callback)
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--화면 쉐이크 되며, 하나(left, attack, cross_arm): 받아랏!
	--해당 대사는 speech_bubble [shout]로 표현
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cross_arm', nil,
			{key = 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	--하나 (left, attack, sword_attack) 상태로 [저승 주식회사 규정 가이드 북] (snowman_general_log)을 카론에게 던짐.
	local evidence_info = self.evidence_infos[self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index]

	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', evidence_info.sprite_name)
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3})
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	local charon_tf = charon.Transform

	self:agora_item_move_async(main.Transform.position + vector(-0.3, 0.4, 0),
			charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0),
			self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index, 0.4)

	if on_hit_callback then
		on_hit_callback()
	end

	self:agora_set_hp(false, 1, 0.5)

	--날아간 증거품이 카론과 충돌 시
	--잠시 강하게 카메라 쉐이크가 되며
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.4)
	--lasthit 이펙트 연출.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0))
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.5, 0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'cast2'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'smile'})

	--증거품에 맞은 카론은 제 자리에서 낮게 airspin 후
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(charon)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(charon)

	local spin_dur = 0.5

	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.4})
	character_util.spine_rotate(charon, -720, spin_dur)
	character_util.jump(charon, 1, spin_dur)

	wait_for_sec(spin_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bridge_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

	character_util.spine_rotate(charon, 0, 0)

	--confused, prostrate로 쓰러짐.
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'confused'})

	local balances = self.get_agora_balances()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_02')
	animator_util.play_async(balances, 'down_L1', 1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
end

	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(main, 'cross_arm', nil,
			{key = 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	local evidence_info = self.evidence_infos[self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index]

	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	self:agora_item_move_async(main.Transform.position + vector(-0.3, 0.4, 0),
			charon_tf.position + vector(0.3, 0.3, 0),
			self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index, 0.4)
	--카론, 날아온 아이템을 (attack, get) 상태로 잡음.

			'doyagao', 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_2')

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--카론, sword_attack 모션으로 증거품 아이템을 하나 쪽으로 던짐.
	character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3})
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'sword_attack', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	charon.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	local main_tf = main.Transform

	self:agora_item_move_async(charon_tf.position + vector(0.3, 0.4, 0),
			main_tf.position + vector(-0.2, 0.4, 0),
			self.agora_round_info.selected_evidence_index, 0.4)

	--돌아온 증거품에 맞은 하나,
	--증거품에 맞을 때 FX_lasthit 이펙트, 데미지 표시 (-1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.4)
	--lasthit 이펙트 연출.
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(main_tf.position + vector(-0.2, 0.4, 0))
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(main_tf.position + vector(-0.2, 0.4, 0))
	character_util.remove_anim(charon)

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(main)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(main)
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(nil, 1, unity_class.color.red, main_tf.position + vector(0, -0.2, 0))

	self:agora_set_hp(true, 1, 0.5)
	if self.agora_hp_info.player.current == 0 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
	end

	local spin_dur = 0.5

	--제 자리에서 낮게 airspin 이후 confused, prostrate로 쓰러짐.
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.4})
	character_util.spine_rotate(main, 720, spin_dur)
	character_util.jump(main, 1, spin_dur)

	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'tired'})

	wait_for_sec(spin_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bridge_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')

	character_util.spine_rotate(main, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'confused'})

	if self.agora_hp_info.player.current == 0 then
		return
	end

	-- 저울, 하나 쪽으로 살짝 기울어 짐.
	--쓰러지는 타이밍에 맞춰서 저울이 기울어짐
	local balances = self.get_agora_balances()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_02')
	animator_util.play(balances, 'down_R1')

	--(damage, prostrate) : 이… 이게 아닌가…
	character_util.shake(main, 0.02, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'damaged'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_3')
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--하나, (tired, idle) 상태로 마리오 점프 기상
	character_util.remove_anim(main)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(main, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

	--저울, 다시 기본 상태로 돌아옴.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_01')
	animator_util.play_async(balances, 'up_R1', 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
end

function local_class:agora_round_end()
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	--잠시 뒤 카론, tired, idle 상태로 일어남.
	character_util.remove_anim(charon)
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'tired'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(charon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.remove_emotion(charon)

	--다음 라운드로 넘어감.
end

function local_class:agora_lose()
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	--저울 오브젝트 쉐이크 되기 시작.
	local balances = self.get_agora_balances()
	balances:Shake(0.03, 1.5)

	--플레이어 파티, (scared, embarrassed)
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'embarrassed'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--저울 오브젝트 쉐이크 중지 되며 플레이어 쪽 저울 바닥이 완전히 아래로 떨어짐.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_iron_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bridge_04')
	animator_util.play(balances, 'down_R2')

	wait_for_sec(4 / 6)

	--이후 카메라 짧고 강하게 쉐이크. 저울이 떨어진 곳에는 연기 이펙트(FX_Common_SmokeScreen)가 나옴.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_fx_smokescreen():Instantiate(
			self:get_marker_pos('agora_balances_center') + vector(2, 0, 0))

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)

	--플레이어 파티 (confused, prostrate) 상태.
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.2})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'confused'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)

	--카론(doyagao, bomb_idle) : 준비하신 게 겨우 이 정도인가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_02')
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'bomb_idle',
			'doyagao', 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_4')

	--카론(doyagao, question) : 흠… 간만의 아고라 신청이라 기대했는데, 시시하군요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			'tired', 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_5')

	--카론(attack, release x2) : 조만간 회사를 통해 이번 일에 대한 책임을 엄중히 묻겠습니다.
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'attack', 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_6')

	--카론(sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 그럼, 이만…!
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'cross_arm',
			'sleep_deep', 'aw_main_s14_agora_common_7')

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--연기 이펙트가 걷힐 즈음, 화면 fade out
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--이후 광장 저울 오브젝트 아래 쪽에서 fade in 되며 파티 다시 스폰. 이 때 아고라 진행 상태는 초기화.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
end
--endregion

--region 라운드 1
function local_class:agora_r1_pre_scene()
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	--카론(right, doyagao, bomb_idle) : 도대체 저한테서 어떤 죄를 입증하겠다는 건인지는 모르겠지만 일단 들어나 보죠.
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'bomb_idle',
			'doyagao', 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_1')

	--카론(right, idle, release) : 단! 당신이 이번 아고라에서 패배한다면 회사를 통해 책임을 엄중히 묻겠습니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cast'})
	character_util.normal_jump(main, '01_player_jump_01')
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			'doyagao', 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_2')

	--하나(left, scared, idle) : 윽…
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_3')

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--하나, right로 가디언 한 번 쳐다본다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'tired'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--가디언 left, idle, release x2후 nod x2
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, {name = 'release', sfx = '01_swing_01', count = 2})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)
	character_util.remove_emotion(knight)

	--하나, 다시 left
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	--하나(left, idle, nodx2) : 괜찮아… {0}가 함께 있어… 할 수 있어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(main)
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_4')

	--하나(left, attack, upgrade x1) : 카론, 당신의 첫 번째 혐의는… 바로 무고한 영혼들에게 고액의 바가지요금을 씌운 것입니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, {name = 'upgrade', loop = false},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_5')

	--하나(left, attack) : 그뿐만 아니라 그들의 영혼 에너지를 전부 빼앗아 수용소로 보내고 있죠!
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, 'cast2',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_6')

	--카론(right, tired, idle) : 네? 그게 무슨… 바가지라니요?
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, nil,
			'tired', 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_7')

	--카론(down, idle, release) : 여기 있는 모두가 알다시피, 저는 객관적인 실력으로 입증된 49 지부 최고의 안내원입니다.
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_8')

	--카론(right, idle, bomb_idle) : 그런 안내원에게 받는 서비스의 품질이 최고급이란 것은 당연지사고요.
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_9')

	--카론(right, idle, release) : 그에 걸맞은 비용을 받는다는 것에 대한 지적은 모든 안내원들의 정당한 노력에 대한 모욕입니다!
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_10')

	--카론(right, idle, cross_arm) : 49 지부에서 받을 수 있는 최고급 대접을 해드린 후 정당한 비용을 받았을 뿐인데 문제가 있는 겁니까?
	self:agora_play_speech_action(charon, 'bomb_idle',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_11')

	--하나 (sleep_deep, question) : …….
	local move_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local cam_move_dur = 1.5

	--카메라, 하나 쪽으로 포커싱, 줌 인(시야에서 카론이 잘 보이지 않을 정도로).
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	camera_util.move(main.Transform.position + vector(0, 0.3, 0), cam_move_dur)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(1.5, cam_move_dur)

	--서서히 까맣게 필드 틴트 적용
	local tint_key = 's14_agora_r1'
	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1}), cam_move_dur)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(charon, 0, cam_move_dur)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, cam_move_dur)

	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_12')

	while unity_class.time.time - move_start_time < cam_move_dur do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--하나 (sleep_deep, question) : 카론의 말 중에는 분명 허점이 있을 거야…
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_13')
	character_util.remove_anim(main)

	--하나 (sleep_deep, nod x2) : 증거물을 잘 살펴보고 반박의 실마리를 찾아보자…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(main)
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_14')
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)

	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--카메라, 다시 줌 아웃 되며 저울 중앙 쪽 포커싱.
	cam_move_dur = 1
	camera_util.move(self:get_marker_pos('agora_camera_center'), cam_move_dur)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, cam_move_dur)

	--필드 틴트 서서히 해제 됨.
	field:RemoveTint(tint_key, cam_move_dur)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(charon, 1, cam_move_dur)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 1, cam_move_dur)

	wait_for_sec(cam_move_dur)
end

function local_class:agora_r1_post_scene()
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	-- 증거가 날아가서 카론 공격
	self:agora_round_right_choice()

	--일반 대화 진행
	--하나(left, attack, upgrade x1) : 저승 주식회사 규정 제 3조!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, {name = 'upgrade', loop = false},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_15')

	--하나(left, attack, shoot) : 모든 가이드들은 손님의 허가 하에 요금을 제시해서 받아야 한다.
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, 'shoot',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_16')

	--하나(left, attack, upgrade x1) : 카론, 당신은 손님에게 제대로 된 확인 절차도 없이 요금을 받은 것이 문제입니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'nod', remove_after = 0.866})
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, {name = 'upgrade', loop = false},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r1_17')

	self:agora_round_end()
end

	--카론(right, tired, walk4legs) : …그건 아닙니다.

		'ghost_7',
		'ghost_8',
		'ghost_9',

	--마티, emoticon_bubble_angry
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(marty, nil, 'angry')

	--마티(어그로 걸 방향, attack, idle) : 넌 그냥 가만히 좀 있지?!
	character_util.play_speech_action(marty, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},

			 bubble_direction = 'rt', world_pos = talker_2.Position, scale = 1.5})

	--카메라 더 강하게 쉐이크 되며, 관중들 [shout] : 물러나라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_07')
	camera_util.shake(0.35, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker_2,
			{key = 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_14', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			 bubble_direction = 'lt', world_pos = talker_2.Position, scale = 1.5})

	charon.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	main.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})

	character_util.nod_twice(main)
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_14_1')

	character_util.normal_jump(charon, '01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
