function local_class:agora_r5_post_scene()
	local main = self:agora_get_npc('main')
	local charon = self:agora_get_npc('charon')
	local knight = self:agora_get_npc('knight')

	local center_pos = self:get_marker_pos('agora_camera_center')

	character_util.stop_shake(charon)
	--하나(left) : 카론님, 여기 피해자들 앞에서 다시 한번 말해보시죠…!
	character_util.remove_emotion(main)
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, 'cross_arm',
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_14_3')

	--하나(doyagao, cross_arm) : 방금 ‘그 말을 대체 누가 믿어주고 증명해준다는 거야’ 라고 하시지 않았나요?
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'doyagao'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_14_4')
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--카론, 간격 두고 캐릭터 쉐이크 2회 : 그… 그게….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(charon, 0.02,0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(charon, 0.02,0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	self:agora_speech(charon, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_14_5')

	--하나(left, attack, upgrade) : 이 아고라를 통해서, 49 지부 안내원 카론의 자격 박탈과 죄를 엄중히 처벌받기를 원하는 바입니다!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(main)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'cast2'})
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, {name = 'upgrade', loop = false},
			nil, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_15')
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	local charon_speech_done = false

	--하나, sword_attack 모션으로 1~4 라운드에서 사용 된 증거품 아이템을 카론 쪽으로 연달아서 던짐.
	--카론, 첫 번째 증거품 아이템에 맞고 (confused, prostrate) 상태로 쓰러짐. 이후 날아오는 아이템도 쓰러진 상태에서 연달아 맞음.
	--아이템에 맞을 때 마다 FX_lasthit 이펙트, 카메라 쉐이크
	local charon_tf = charon.Transform

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local evidence_info = self.evidence_infos[i]

		character_util.remove_anim(main)

		main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', evidence_info.sprite_name)
		character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3})
		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
		character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', mix_duration = 0, loop = false})
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

		self:agora_item_move_async(main.Transform.position + vector(-0.2, 0.4, 0),
				charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.3, 0), i, 0.4)

		--날아간 증거품이 카론과 충돌 시
		--잠시 강하게 카메라 쉐이크가 되며
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.35)
		--lasthit 이펙트 연출.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.3, 0))
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(charon)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(charon)

		if i == 1 then
			character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'damaged'})
			character_util.set_anim(charon, {name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = 0.4})
		elseif i == 2 then
			--카론, 2번 간격 두고 부들부들 떨며 (hurt, prostrate) : 제… 제발 그만…!
			character_util.shake(charon, 0.03, 99999)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
				self:agora_speech(charon, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_16')
				self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)
				charon_speech_done = true
			end))
		end
	end

	while charon_speech_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(main)

	--하나 쪽으로 카메라 이동되며 살짝 줌 인.
	local cam_move_dur = 1.5

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	camera_util.move(main.Transform.position + vector(0, 0.3, 0), cam_move_dur)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, cam_move_dur)

	--필드, 서서히 까맣게 틴트 처리.
	local tint_key = 's14_agora_r5'
	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 1}), cam_move_dur)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 0, cam_move_dur)

	wait_for_sec(cam_move_dur)

	--하나 (sleep_deep, cross_arm) : 이게 마지막이다…!
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(true)
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	self:agora_speech(main, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_17')

	character_util.stop_shake(charon)

	--하나 (eyelight, cross_arm) : 받아랏!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	self:agora_play_speech_action(main, nil,
			{name = 'eyelight', loop = false}, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_18')

	local evidence_info = self.evidence_infos[5]

	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', evidence_info.sprite_name)
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', scale = 0, mix_duration = 0.3})
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--게임 배속, 0.5로 변경
	local time_key = 's14_agora_r5'
	time_util.mod(time_key, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'sword_attack', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	main.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	--카메라, 날아가는 아이템을 따라서 패닝.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_02')
	camera_util.move(charon.Transform.position + vector(0, 0.3, 0), 1.5)
	--하나, (attack, sword_attack) 모션으로 ‘모두의 증언’ 아이템을 카론에게 던짐.
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.agora_item_move_async, self,
			main.Transform.position + vector(-0.3, 0.4, 0),
			charon_tf.position + vector(0.2, 0.3, 0), 5, 1.7))

	--카론, surprise 이모션.
	--카론(right, surprise, prostrate) : 나, 나는 정말로 49 지부를 위해…
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'scared'})
	self:agora_speech(charon, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_19', 0.7)

	--카론(right, surprise, prostrate) : 아… 안돼…!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	self:agora_speech(charon, 'aw_main_s14_agora_r5_20', 0.7)

	--날아간 아이템이 카론과 충돌하며 화면 화이트 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_villain_explosion_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({1, 1, 1, 0}))
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(knight, 1, 0)

	--카론 HP -1
	self:agora_set_hp(false, 1)

	--다시 화면 페이드 인 되면,
	--카메라는 저울 중앙 쪽으로 다시 포커싱 되어 있는 상태(사이즈 2.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 0)
	stage_camera:CancelMove()
	camera_util.move_async(self:get_marker_pos('agora_camera_center'), 0)

	--맵 검은 틴트 해제 돼 있음. 대화 상자 UI는 비활성화 된 상태.
	time_util.unmod(time_key)
	field:RemoveTint(tint_key)
	self:agora_toggle_bottom_ui(false)

	--카론 쪽 저울 바닥은 플로어와 맞닿아 있음.
	animator_util.play_async(self.get_agora_balances(), 'down_L2', 1.5)

	--카론은 저울 바닥에 hurt, prostrate 상태로 쓰러져 있음.
	character_util.set_emotion(charon, {name = 'damaged'})

	--하나, 가디언 smile, success 상태
	character_util.set_emotion(main, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(main, {name = 'success'})
	character_util.set_emotion(knight, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_anim(knight, {name = 'success'})

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--스테이지 타이틀 - K.O
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pvp_start_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('agora_battle_ko_text'), 1.5)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--화면 페이드 아웃 되고 미니 게임 종료.
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldMainSection16')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = AfterWorldMain @
		Comment = 회사 지하에서 깨어나는 주인공, 기사를 구하기 위해 지상으로 올라감 @
		Index = 15 @
		NextSections = 16 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'afterworld_1_4'
	self.talk_string_key = 'afterworld_main_s16_'

	self.fade_color = unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 })

	-- 촉수 동작 진행중인지
	self.tentacle_routine = false
	self.bone_follower = nil

	-- qte 시작 변수
	self.is_qte_start = false

	-- 탭 카운트
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0

	-- qte sfx name
	self.tap_sfx_name = nil

	self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.tap_sfx_name = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('under_floor_grid')

	if self.bone_follower ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bone_follower)
		self.bone_follower = nil
	end

	self:all_stop_tentacle_loop_sfx()
	self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list = nil
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.tap_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
		end
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'section_16_tentacle_2') then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tentacle_qte, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 터치 연타함수
--- @param is_wait boolean key: 성공 시에도 duration 시간만큼 기다려줄지
--- @param pre_delay number key: qte 연타 시작 시 일정 시간동안 입력을 받지 않고 싶을 때 사용
--- @param count number key: qte 연타 성공을 위한 횟수
--- @param animation_time_scale number key: qte 스파인 손가락 애니메이션 빠르기
--- @param tap_sfx nil key: qte 터치 시 마다 재생할 sfx
function local_class:turbo_tap(data)
	local delay = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'pre_delay', nil)
	local count = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'count', 1)
	local animation_time_scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'animation_time_scale', 1)
	self.tap_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tap_sfx', nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(animation_time_scale)

	if delay then wait_for_sec(delay) end

	local shake_scale = 1
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count do

		if self.turbo_tap_count >= shake_scale then
			character_util.shake(get_party_leader(), shake_scale * 0.02 , 999)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
end

function local_class:tentacle_appear(tentacle, attach_target, is_fade_out)
	local duration = 0.5
	local attach_timing = 0.2
	local is_attach = false
	local is_camera_up = false

	if attach_target then
		self.bone_follower = nil
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position)
	else
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position)
	end

	if is_fade_out ~= nil and not is_fade_out then
		local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'in')
		local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_01', parent = tentacle, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'in', scale = animation_scale })
		tentacle.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(tentacle, { name = 'idle' })
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if attach_target then
			if not is_attach and time_passed >= attach_timing then
				is_attach = true
				attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

				if is_fade_out ~= nil and not is_fade_out then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = attach_target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(attach_target,
							{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
				end

				self.bone_follower = attach_target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				self.bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
				self.bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
				self.bone_follower:SetBone('bone15')
			end

			if not is_camera_up and is_attach then
				is_camera_up = true

				camera_util.move(
						vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position) + vector(0, 3, 0), 3 / 11)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if not is_fade_out then
		self:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, '01_effect_beth_01')
	end
end

function local_class:tentacle_hidden(tentacle, attach_target)
	local duration = 0.5
	local target_y = 0

	local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'out')
	local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

	self:stop_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'out', scale = animation_scale })

	if attach_target then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bone_follower)
		self.bone_follower = nil

		target_y = attach_target.Position.y
		attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
		character_util.spine_rotate(attach_target, 0, duration)
		character_util.stop_shake(attach_target)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(attach_target, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		if attach_target then
			progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, target_y, duration)
			local cur_target_y = target_y - progress
			local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position, cur_target_y)
			attach_target.Position = cur_pos
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	tentacle.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	----임시 코드
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		coroutine.yield()
		coroutine.yield()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)
	end))
end

function local_class:exit()
	--Unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.current_grid_name)

	-- 동적할당 npc 제거
	if self.optimized_npc_list ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
		self.optimized_npc_list = nil
	end

	if self.optimized_sub_npc_list ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list)
		self.optimized_sub_npc_list = nil
	end

	-- 저승사자를 안도와주고 갔을 경우
	if self.current_reaper_progress == self.reaper_help_progress.appear then
		self.tentacle_appear_list[6].tentacle.Position = vector(999,0,999)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.tentacle_appear_list do
		if self.tentacle_appear_list[i] then
			CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.tentacle_appear_list[i].bone_follower)
			self.tentacle_appear_list[i].bone_follower = nil
		end
	end

	self.tentacle_appear_list = nil

	-- sprite
	if self.weapon_sprite then
		self.weapon_sprite:ConsumeComplete()
		self.weapon_sprite = nil
	end

	--npc
	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_civilian(i), self.controller)
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('reaper_1'), self.controller)

	self:all_stop_tentacle_loop_sfx()
	self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list = nil

	if self.tentacle_loop_sfx then
		self.tentacle_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.tentacle_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return false end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.tentacle_appear_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_civilian(i)) then
			local current_battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(user_party.Leader)
			local is_in_battle = current_battle ~= nil
			if not is_in_battle then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_civilian, self, i)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('reaper_1')) then
		if self.current_reaper_progress == self.reaper_help_progress.none then
			self.current_reaper_progress = self.reaper_help_progress.appear
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reaper_help_interact, self))
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reaper_talk, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('s17_weapon_item')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_weapon, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'section_17_first_talk') and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.first_talk
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.first_leader_talk, self))

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'section_17_meet_civilian') and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.first_talk then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.meet_civilian
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.meet_civilian, self))

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'BATTLE_2') and not
		self.second_floor_npc_event.speech_check then
		self.second_floor_npc_event.speech_check = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_floor_npc_talk, self))

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'tentacle_civilian_zone') and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.meet_civilian then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.qte_zone
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_floor_qte_zone, self))

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'yuna_meet_zone') and
			self.current_progress <= self.progress.qte_zone then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.talk_yuna
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.yuna_talk, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'yuna_tentacle_zone') and
		self.current_progress <= self.progress.talk_yuna then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.tentacle_zone
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tentacle_attack, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'yuna_end_zone') and
			self.current_progress == self.progress.tentacle_zone then
		self.current_progress = self.progress.tentacle_zone_end
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.section_end, self)
		return true
	elseif e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 1, 23) == 'section_16_tentacle_qte' then
				local num = tonumber(string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 25, string.len(e.Zone.Name)))

				if not self.is_activate_tentacle_qte_list[num] then
					self.is_activate_tentacle_qte_list[num] = true
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.tentacle_qte, self, num)
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('wall_tentacle_2_1'), e.FieldObject) then
		self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_1_dead = true
		if self.second_floor_npc_event.battle_end and self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_1_dead and
				self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_2_dead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_floor_npc_routine, self))
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('wall_tentacle_2_2'), e.FieldObject) then
		self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_2_dead = true
		if self.second_floor_npc_event.battle_end and self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_1_dead and
				self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_2_dead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_floor_npc_routine, self))
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(get_character('event_reaper_tentacle_1'), e.FieldObject) and
			self.current_reaper_progress == self.reaper_help_progress.appear then
		self.current_reaper_progress = self.reaper_help_progress.help
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.destroy_reaper_tentacle, self))

		return true
	end

	-- 저승사자를 붙잡는 촉수 처리 이후에 나머지 처리 위해 아래서 검사
	for i = 1, #self.tentacle_appear_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.tentacle_appear_list[i].tentacle, e.FieldObject) then
			self.tentacle_appear_list[i].tentacle_dead = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.tentacle_hidden, self, self.tentacle_appear_list[i].tentacle, i))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle2' then
		self.second_floor_npc_event.battle_end = true
		if self.second_floor_npc_event.battle_end and self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_1_dead and
				self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_2_dead then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_floor_npc_routine, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if self.tap_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.tap_sfx_name)
		end
		self.swipe_type = 'tap'
		self.turbo_tap_count = self.turbo_tap_count + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'under_floor_grid') then
		if self.current_grid_name ~= 'under_floor_grid' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.current_grid_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('floor_1_grid', 60049, true, get_field_object('exit_1'))
		end
		self.current_grid_name = 'under_floor_grid'
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'floor_1_grid') then
		if self.current_grid_name ~= 'floor_1_grid' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.current_grid_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('floor_1_grid', 60049, true, get_field_object('exit_2'))
		end
		self.current_grid_name = 'floor_1_grid'
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'floor_2_grid') then
		if self.current_grid_name ~= 'floor_2_grid' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.current_grid_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('floor_2_grid', 60049, true, get_field_object('exit_3'))
		end
		self.current_grid_name = 'floor_2_grid'
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'floor_3_grid') then
		if self.current_grid_name ~= 'floor_3_grid' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.current_grid_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('floor_3_grid', 60049, true, get_field_object('exit_4'))
		end
		self.current_grid_name = 'floor_3_grid'
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 무기 습득
function local_class:get_weapon()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local item_box = get_field_object('s17_weapon_item')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, item_box.Position - vector(1,0,0),
			2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'eat', count = 3 })
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	self.weapon_sprite.ConsumeTarget = leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.weapon_sprite = nil

	screen_util.item_get_event('aw_scythe_epic', 'afterworld_main_s17_4', 'afterworld_main_s17_5', 'afterworld_main_s17_6')

	item_box.Position = vector(999,0,999)
	self.has_weapon = true

	local weapon_leader = get_character('main_character')
	weapon_leader.Position = leader.Position
	weapon_leader.Direction = leader.Direction

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(weapon_leader, param, true)

	local character_spec_id = 437

	get_party_leader().CharacterInfo = CS.Oak.CharacterInfo.CreateDummyCharacterInfo(
		user_party_leader.CharacterInfo.User, character_spec_id)
end

-- 1층으로 올라온 후 하나 대사
function local_class:first_leader_talk()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader,
			field:GetMarker('first_floor_talk_point').position,
			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	--하나 : 이건…아까 봤던 촉수보다는 모양이 작네.
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = self.talk_string_key..7, skip = true })

	--하나 : 덤벼들지도 않는 것 같고…
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = self.talk_string_key..8, skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })

	--하나 : 날카로운 것만 있다면 벨 수 있을 거 같은데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader,
			{ key = self.talk_string_key..9, skip = true })

	-- 이 촉수는 날카로운 것으로 제거할 수 있을 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async( { key = self.talk_string_key..3 })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 1층 촉수에 붇잡히는 시민과 도망가는 시민들
function local_class:meet_civilian()
	local civilian_2 = self.get_civilian(2)

	--일반 영혼 2 (attack, eat) : 잠깐만 기다려! 금방 갈게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01', parent = civilian_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian_2, { key = self.talk_string_key..10, skip = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.civilian_damage_routine, self))

	--일반 영혼 1이 있는 바닥에서 거대한 촉수가 솟아 나와 일반 영혼 1을 낚아챔.
	self:tentacle_npc_attack_routine(1)
end

-- 1층 촉수에 붙잡힌 시민들 루틴
function local_class:civilian_damage_routine()
	local civilian_2 = self.get_civilian(2)
	local civilian_3 = self.get_civilian(3)

	civilian_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	civilian_3.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civilian_2, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civilian_3, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(civilian_2)
	character_util.normal_jump(civilian_3)

	--일반 영혼 2, 우측으로 도망치며 [shout] : 으악!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_02', parent = civilian_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian_2, { key = self.talk_string_key..11, skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint(civilian_2, self.get_civilian_pos(4),
			7, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(civilian_3, self.get_civilian_pos(5),
			7, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	character_util.move_waypoint(civilian_2, civilian_2.Position + vector(0,0,1),
			7, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(civilian_3, civilian_3.Position - vector(0,0,1),
			7, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	civilian_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	civilian_3.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tentacle_npc_attack_routine, self, 2, true))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.tentacle_npc_attack_routine, self, 3))
end

-- 구해준 시민 interact 시
function local_class:help_civilian(i)
	-- 이미 죽었다면
	if self.tentacle_appear_list[i].dead then
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'afterworld_main_s17_15' })
		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local civilian = self.get_civilian(i)

	if i == 4 then
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, civilian.Position + vector(1,0,0), 3,
				false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	else
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, civilian.Position - vector(1,0,0), 3,
				false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	end

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', parent = user_party.Leader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'eat', count = 3 })
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(civilian, civilian.Direction)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	if i == 4 then
		character_util.set_direction(civilian, 'right')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civilian, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
		-- 일반 영혼1(smile, sing) : 정말 감사합니다…!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian, { key = self.talk_string_key..15, skip = true })
	elseif i == 1 or i == 2 then
		character_util.set_direction(civilian, 'left')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civilian, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		-- 일반 영혼2(tired, idle) :  …구해주셔서 감사합니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian, { key = self.talk_string_key..13, skip = true })
	else
		character_util.set_direction(civilian, 'left')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(civilian, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'cry' })
		-- 일반 영혼3(cry, sing) : 휴… 살았다! 감사합니다…!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civilian, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 14, skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(civilian)
	if i == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(civilian, {
			civilian.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(4, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(4, 0, 10),
		}, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	elseif i == 4 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(civilian, {
			civilian.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(2, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(2, 0, 10),
		}, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(civilian, {
			civilian.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(-3, 0, 1),
			civilian.Position + vector(-3, 0, 10),
		}, 6, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	end
	character_util.remove_relate_event(civilian, self.controller)
	character_util.set_position(civilian, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

function local_class:second_floor_npc_talk()
	local civilian_4 = self.get_civilian(4)

	while not self.second_floor_npc_event.battle_end or
			not self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_1_dead or
			not self.second_floor_npc_event.tentacle_2_dead do
		local distance = vector_util.get_x0z(civilian_4.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude
		if not speech_check and distance < 4 then
			--영혼 1 : 제발 살려줘…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(civilian_4, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 16 })
			return
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

-- 2층에서 붙잡히는 npc들
function local_class:second_floor_npc_routine()
	local civilian_4 = self.get_civilian(4)
	local civilian_5 = self.get_civilian(5)

-- 정전 효과 함수
function local_class:field_blackout(npc_list, duration, fade_time, call_back)
	-- 잠시 검게 변함
	for _, npc in ipairs(npc_list) do
		npc.SpineController:AddColor(npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, fade_time)
	end
	field:Tint('tentacle_tint', unity_class.color.black, fade_time)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	if call_back then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(call_back, self))
	end

	for _, npc in ipairs(npc_list) do
		npc.SpineController:RemoveColor(npc.Name, fade_time)
	end
	field:RemoveTint('tentacle_tint', fade_time)
end

-- 촉수 등장 루틴
function local_class:tentacle_appear(tentacle, target_index, is_wall_tentacle, is_play_loop_sfx)
	local duration = 0.5
	local attach_timing = 0.2
	local is_attach = false
	local attach_target = nil

	is_play_loop_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_play_loop_sfx, true)

	if target_index then
		attach_target = self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].target
	end

	if attach_target then
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position)
	else
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position)
	end

	local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'in')
	local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_01', parent = tentacle, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'in', scale = animation_scale, mix_duration = 0, keep_anim = true, end_call_func = function()
		local animation_name = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.state.Tracks.Items[1].Animation.Name

		-- 현재 애니메이션이 out 애니메이션일 때만, idle로 되돌림.
		if animation_name == 'in_front' then
			character_util.remove_anim(tentacle)
		end
	end })
	tentacle.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if attach_target then
			if not is_attach and time_passed >= attach_timing then
				is_attach = true
				attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = attach_target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(attach_target,
						{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

				self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower =
				attach_target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
				self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer =
				tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
				self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower:SetBone('bone15')
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if is_play_loop_sfx then
		if is_wall_tentacle then
			self:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, '01_tentacle_03')
		else
			self:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, '01_effect_beth_01')
		end
	end
end

-- 촉수가 들어가는 루틴
function local_class:tentacle_hidden(tentacle, target_index)
	local duration = 0.5
	local attach_target

	local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'out')
	local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

	self:stop_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'out', scale = animation_scale })

	if target_index then
		attach_target = self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].target

		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower)
		self.tentacle_appear_list[target_index].bone_follower = nil

		attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
		character_util.move_to(attach_target, vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position), duration)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	character_util.set_position(tentacle, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 촉수에게 붙잡힌 후 데미지를 입는 NPC 루틴
-- soul point가 0이 되면 죽음
-- 중간에 촉수를 처치할 경우 풀려남
function local_class:tentacle_npc_attack_routine(index, speech)
	speech = lua_helper.get_or_default(speech, false)

	local target = self.tentacle_appear_list[index].target
	local tentacle = self.tentacle_appear_list[index].tentacle

	if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(target.Position) then
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	end

	self:tentacle_appear(tentacle, index, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local speech_check = false
	while self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point > 0 and not self.tentacle_appear_list[index].tentacle_dead do

		self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point = math.max(self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point - 30, 0)

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
		character_util.set_rolling_number(target.Transform, self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point, nil, 0, self.rolling_number_blue_color)
		damage_util.show_damage_number(target, 30, unity_class.color.red, target.Position)

		local distance = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).magnitude

		if speech and not speech_check and distance < 5 then
			speech_check = true
			--사, 살려주세요…!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(target, { key = self.talk_string_key..12, bubble_type = 'shout' })
		end

		-- wait_for_sec로 처리하면, 땅에 떨어진 이후에도 embarrassed 애니메이션이 나오다가, 2초가 다 지나야 prostrate 로 변경되어서
		-- 직접 구현해서, 조건에 따라서 중간에 바로 빠져나가게끔 처리
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 2
		while time_passed < duration and self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point > 0 and not self.tentacle_appear_list[index].tentacle_dead do
			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(target.Position) then
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
	end

	if self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point == 0 then
		self.tentacle_appear_list[index].dead = true
		target.SpineController:AddColor(nil, self.dead_tint_color, 1, 0)

		character_util.set_rolling_number(target.Transform,
				self.tentacle_appear_list[index].soul_point, nil, 0, unity_class.color.red)

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead', loop = false })

		self:tentacle_hidden(tentacle, index)
	else
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target,
				{ name = 'prostrate', loop = false }, { name = 'confused' })


		character_util.add_listener(target, self.controller)
	end
end

--- QTE 함수
--- @param type nil key: qte 타입
--- @param duration number key: qte 제한시간
--- @param time_mod number key: qte 시간동안 타임 스케일을 줄여줄 것인지
function local_class:qte_swipe(data)
	local type = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'type', 'tap')
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 9999)
	local time_mod = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'time_mod', nil)

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	if time_mod ~= nil then time_util.mod(self.time_mod_key, time_mod) end

	while self.is_qte_start and self.swipe_type ~= type and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	if time_mod ~= nil then
		time_util.unmod(self.time_mod_key)
	end

	if time_passed < duration then
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 터치 연타함수
--- @param duration number key: qte 연타 제한시간
--- @param is_wait boolean key: 성공 시에도 duration 시간만큼 기다려줄지
--- @param time_mod number key: qte 연타 시간동안 타임 스케일을 줄여줄 것인지
--- @param pre_delay number key: qte 연타 시작 시 일정 시간동안 입력을 받지 않고 싶을 때 사용
--- @param count number key: qte 연타 성공을 위한 횟수
--- @param animation_time_scale number key: qte 스파인 손가락 애니메이션 빠르기
--- @param tap_sfx nil key: qte 터치 시 마다 재생할 sfx
--- @return boolean key: duration 이후 연타 성공 시 true 실패 시 false
function local_class:turbo_tap(data)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'duration', 9999)
	local is_wait = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_wait', false)
	local time_mod = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'time_mod', nil)
	local delay = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'pre_delay', nil)
	local count = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'count', 1)
	local animation_time_scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'animation_time_scale', 1)
	self.tap_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tap_sfx', nil)
	local is_show_turbo_tap_spine = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_show_turbo_tap_spine', true)
	local is_close_turbo_tap_spine = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'is_close_turbo_tap_spine', true)

	if is_show_turbo_tap_spine then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(animation_time_scale)
	end

	if time_mod ~= nil then time_util.mod(self.time_mod_key, time_mod) end
	if delay then wait_for_sec(delay) end

	local time_passed = 0

	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count and time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if time_mod ~= nil then time_util.unmod(self.time_mod_key) end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	if is_close_turbo_tap_spine then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	-- 실패시
	if self.turbo_tap_count < count then return false end

	-- 기다리는 경우
	while is_wait and time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	return true
end

--region tentacle_qte
function local_class:tentacle_appear_qte(tentacle, attach_target, is_fade_out)
	local duration = 0.5
	local attach_timing = 0.2
	local is_attach = false
	local is_camera_up = false

	if attach_target then
		self.bone_follower = nil
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position)
	else
		tentacle.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(tentacle.Position)
	end

	if is_fade_out ~= nil and not is_fade_out then
		local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'in')
		local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_01', parent = tentacle, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'in', scale = animation_scale, mix_duration = 0 })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(tentacle, { name = 'idle' })
	end
	tentacle.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		if attach_target then
			if not is_attach and time_passed >= attach_timing then
				is_attach = true
				attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

				if is_fade_out ~= nil and not is_fade_out then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = attach_target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(attach_target,
						{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
				end

				self.bone_follower = attach_target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
				self.bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
				self.bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
				self.bone_follower:SetBone('bone15')
			end

			if not is_camera_up and is_attach then
				is_camera_up = true

				camera_util.move(
					vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position) + vector(0, 3, 0), 3 / 11)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, '01_effect_beth_01')
end

function local_class:tentacle_hidden_qte(tentacle, attach_target)
	local duration = 0.5
	local target_y = 0

	local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'out')
	local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

	self:stop_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_02', play_pos = tentacle.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, duration)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'out', scale = animation_scale })

	if attach_target then
		if self.bone_follower then
			CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bone_follower)
			self.bone_follower = nil
		end

		target_y = attach_target.Position.y
		attach_target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = true
		character_util.spine_rotate(attach_target, 0, duration)
		character_util.stop_shake(attach_target)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(attach_target, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

	end

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		if attach_target then
			progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, target_y, duration)
			local cur_target_y = target_y - progress
			local cur_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(attach_target.Position, cur_target_y)
			attach_target.Position = cur_pos
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	tentacle.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

--- 터치 연타함수
--- @param is_wait boolean key: 성공 시에도 duration 시간만큼 기다려줄지
--- @param pre_delay number key: qte 연타 시작 시 일정 시간동안 입력을 받지 않고 싶을 때 사용
--- @param count number key: qte 연타 성공을 위한 횟수
--- @param animation_time_scale number key: qte 스파인 손가락 애니메이션 빠르기
--- @param tap_sfx nil key: qte 터치 시 마다 재생할 sfx
function local_class:turbo_tap_tentacle_qte(data)
	local delay = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'pre_delay', nil)
	local count = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'count', 1)
	local animation_time_scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'animation_time_scale', 1)
	self.tap_sfx_name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'tap_sfx', nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(animation_time_scale)

	if delay then wait_for_sec(delay) end

	local shake_scale = 1
	self.turbo_tap_count = 0
	self.is_qte_start = true

	while self.is_qte_start and self.turbo_tap_count < count do

		if self.turbo_tap_count >= shake_scale then

--region tentacle_rf
-- 촉수 등장 루틴 연출용
function local_class:tentacle_appear_rf(tentacle, target_data, is_play_loop_sfx, is_play_start_sfx)
	local duration = 0.5
	local attach_timing = 0.2
	local is_attach = false
	is_play_start_sfx = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_play_start_sfx, true)

	local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(tentacle, 'in')
	local animation_scale = animation_duration / duration

	if is_play_start_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_tentacle_01', parent = tentacle, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(tentacle, { name = 'in', scale = animation_scale, mix_duration = 0 })
	tentacle.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if target_data.target then
			if not is_attach and time_passed >= attach_timing then
				is_attach = true
				target_data.target.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = target_data.target, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(target_data.target,
					{ name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

				-- 갑자기 본에 붙으면 캐릭터가 튀기 때문에, 서서히 붙게끔 연출 추가
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					local start_position = target_data.target.Position
					local time_passed = 0
					local duration = 0.1
					local bone = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation.skeleton:FindBone('bone15')

					while time_passed < duration and target_data.target do
						local progress = time_passed / duration
						local end_position = tentacle.Position + vector(bone.WorldX, bone.WorldY, 0)

						target_data.target.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)

						coroutine.yield()

						time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					end

					if target_data.target then
						if target_data.bone_follower then
							self:destroy_bone_follower(target_data.bone_follower)
							target_data.bone_follower = nil
						end
						target_data.bone_follower = target_data.target.UnityGameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
						target_data.bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
						target_data.bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = tentacle.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
						target_data.bone_follower:SetBone('bone15')
					end
				end))
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	if is_play_loop_sfx then
		self:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, '01_effect_beth_01')
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:destroy_bone_follower(bone_follower)
	if bone_follower then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	end
end

--region move_to
function local_class:move_to(fo, position, duration, speed, auto_direction, auto_animation, play_sfx)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_routine, self, fo, position, duration, speed, auto_direction, auto_animation, play_sfx))
end

function local_class:move_to_routine(fo, position, duration, speed, auto_direction, auto_animation, play_sfx)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	local final_duration = 1
	if duration ~= nil then
		final_duration = duration
	elseif speed ~= nil then
		final_duration = (position - start_pos).magnitude / speed
	end

	if auto_direction ~= nil and auto_direction then
		local dir = (position - fo.Position):ToDirection()
		if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			fo.Direction = dir
		end
	end

	if auto_animation ~= nil and auto_animation and lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'walk' })
	end

	local dash_sfx = nil

	if play_sfx ~= nil and play_sfx then
		dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = fo, loop = true, max_distance = 10, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
	end

	self:stop_move_to(fo)
	local req_id = self.move_to_req_id[fo]
	while req_id == self.move_to_req_id[fo] do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, position, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if req_id == self.move_to_req_id[fo] then
		fo.Position = position
	end

	if dash_sfx ~= nil then
		dash_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)
	end

	if auto_animation ~= nil and auto_animation and lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_move_to(fo)
	if self.move_to_req_id[fo] == nil then
		self.move_to_req_id[fo] = 0
	end

	self.move_to_req_id[fo] = self.move_to_req_id[fo] + 1
end
--endregion

--region tentacle_loop_sfx
function local_class:play_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle, sfx_name)
	self:stop_tentacle_loop_sfx()

	self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list[tentacle] = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, parent = tentacle, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc' })
end

function local_class:stop_tentacle_loop_sfx(tentacle)
	if self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list[tentacle] then
		self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list[tentacle]:Stop()
		self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list[tentacle] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:all_stop_tentacle_loop_sfx()
	for key, value in pairs(self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list) do
		value:Stop()
		self.tentacle_loop_sfx_list[key] = nil
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:item_fade(item, start_alpha, target_alpha, duration)
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, target_alpha, progress)
		item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ alpha, alpha, alpha, alpha })
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = unity_color({ alpha, alpha, alpha, alpha })
		item_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- easeInOut 이동
function local_class:move_ease_in_out(fo, start_pos, end_pos, duration, easeFunction)
	local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed > duration then
				time_passed = duration
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local progress_ease = easeFunction(time_passed, duration)

			local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			local cubic_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress_ease)

			fo.Position = vector(lerp_pos.x, 0, cubic_pos.z)
			coroutine.yield()
		end
end

-- 원 회전 + 커브 이동 / fo, 시작 각도, 종료 각도, 시작 반지름, 종료 반지름, 회전 중심, 회전시간, 커브 주기, 커브 세기
function local_class:move_curve_circle(fo, start_angle, end_angle, start_radius, end_radius, center, duration, curve_period, curve_weight)
	local time_passed = 0
	local sine_period = unity_class.mathf.PI * curve_period
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed > duration then
			time_passed = duration
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local angle = start_angle + ((end_angle-start_angle)*progress)
		local radius = start_radius - ((start_radius-end_radius)*progress)

		local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Cos(angle) * radius + center.x
		local cur_z = unity_class.mathf.Sin(angle) * radius + center.z
		fo.Position = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		local curve_angle = sine_period * progress
		local curve = (fo.Position - center).normalized * (unity_class.mathf.Sin(curve_angle) * curve_weight)

		fo.Position = fo.Position + curve
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 타원 + 커브 이동 / fo, 시작 각도, 종료 각도, 타원 x좌표 반지름, 타원 z좌표 반지름, 회전 중심, 회전시간, 커브 주기, 커브 세기
function local_class:move_curve_ellipse(fo, start_angle, end_angle, radius_x, radius_z, center, duration, curve_period, curve_weight)
	local time_passed = 0
	local sine_period = unity_class.mathf.PI * curve_period
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed > duration then
			time_passed = duration
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local angle = start_angle + ((end_angle-start_angle)*progress)

		fo.Position = vector(center.x + unity_class.mathf.Cos(angle) * radius_x, 0,
				center.z + unity_class.mathf.Sin(angle) * radius_z)


		local curve_angle = sine_period * progress
		local curve = (fo.Position - center).normalized * (unity_class.mathf.Sin(curve_angle) * curve_weight)

		fo.Position = fo.Position + curve
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end -- 방어코드

	screen_util.preload_item_get_event()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.main_character = get_character(self.main_character_name)
	self.firefly = get_character(self.firefly_name)

	self.rest_room_reaper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.rest_room_reaper_num do
		self.rest_room_reaper_list:Add(get_character(self.rest_room_reaper_name..i))
	end

	character_util.add_listener(self.rest_room_reaper_list[0], self.controller)

	self.book_guide = get_character(self.book_guide_name)
	self.book_guide.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 1), vector(2, 0.75, 1.1))
	character_util.add_listener(self.book_guide, self.controller)

	for i = 1, self.co_worker_reaper_num do
		local cur_co_worker = get_character(self.co_worker_reaper_name..i)
		character_util.set_active_state(cur_co_worker, 'disabled')
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.reaper_leader_name), 'disabled')

	self.roll_paper_interactable_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	for i = 1, self.roll_paper_interactable_num do
		local cur_interactable = get_field_object(self.roll_paper_interactable_name..i)
		cur_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		self.roll_paper_interactable_list:Add(cur_interactable)
	end

	self.kiosk = get_field_object(self.kiosk_name)
	self.kiosk.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	self.broken_roll_interactable = get_field_object(self.broken_roll_interactable_name)
	self.broken_roll_interactable.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.broken_roll_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(12, 0, -197))
	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))

	self.paper_piece_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

	for i = 0, self.roll_paper_interactable_list.Count - 1 do
		self.paper_piece_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ itemid = self.paper_item_id,
				  pos = self.roll_paper_interactable_list[i].Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' }))
	end

	self.broken_roll_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = self.torned_roll_book_item_id,
			  pos = self.broken_roll_interactable.Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 1 then
		character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), vector(-67, 0, -193.5))
		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.main_character = nil
	self.firefly = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.rest_room_reaper_list[0], self.controller)
	self.rest_room_reaper_list = nil

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.book_guide, self.controller)
	self.book_guide.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.75, 1.1))
	self.book_guide = nil

	self.kiosk.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.kiosk = nil

	self.roll_paper_interactable_list = nil

	self.broken_roll_interactable.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.broken_roll_interactable.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.broken_roll_interactable = nil

	self.paper_piece_list = nil
	self.broken_roll_item = nil

	if self.office_sfx ~= nil then
		self.office_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.office_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_roll_paper and
				e.Zone.Name == self.roll_paper_event_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_roll_paper

			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.rest_room_reaper_list[0])

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(11.5, 0, -211))
		elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_rest_room and
				e.Zone.Name == self.rest_room_zone_name then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_rest_room

			if self.office_sfx == nil then
				self.office_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{ sfx_name = "01_amb_office_01", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
			end

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.rest_room_reaper_list[0])

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_rest_room_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.get_broken_roll_paper and
				self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_leave_event and
				e.Zone.Name == self.rest_room_zone_name then
			if self.office_sfx ~= nil then
				self.office_sfx:FadeOut()
				self.office_sfx = nil
			end

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.book_guide.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))
			quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.rest_room_reaper_list[0]) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.talk_with_reaper then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.talk_with_reaper

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.broken_roll_interactable)

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_reaper_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_broken_roll_paper then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_reaper_event_2, self)
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
					self.rest_room_reaper_list[0], { key = self.main_script..11, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.broken_roll_interactable) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.get_broken_roll_paper then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.get_broken_roll_paper

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_broken_roll_paper_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.book_guide) then
		if self.current_progress > self.progress_state.get_broken_roll_paper and
				self.current_progress < self.progress_state.talk_with_guide then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.talk_with_guide

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_guide_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.talk_with_guide then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.book_guide, { key = self.main_script..48, skip = false })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.book_guide, { key = self.main_script..60, skip = false })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.kiosk) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.talk_with_guide then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.interact_with_kiosk

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_kiosk_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.interact_with_kiosk then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.kiosk, { key = self.main_script..52, skip = false })
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.roll_paper_interactable_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.roll_paper_interactable_list[i]) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_roll_paper_event, self, i)
		end
	end
end

-- 사이렌 틴트 연출
function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	local siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_loop_04", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_siren_tint  do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	siren_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.stage_name = nil
end

return local_class

	character_util.rolling_number(marty.Transform, 151800, nil, 1.5, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

		reaper_list[3].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		reaper_list[3].Position + vector(-1.1, 0, -0.5)

	reaper_list[3].OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	marty.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_s20_one_line_13'
	tao.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_s20_one_line_14'
