function local_class:aggro_girl_event()
	local aggro_girl = self.get_one_line_aggro_girl()

	local reaper_list = {}
	for i = 4, 6 do
		local reaper = self.get_one_line_reaper(i)
		table.insert(reaper_list, reaper)
	end

	local string_key = 'aw_s20_aggro_girl_'

	-- 저승 사자 5 (smile, idle) : 이번 사건 해결에 도움 주셔서 감사합니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_list[2], { key = string_key .. 1 })
	if self.is_exit then return end

	-- 저승 사자 5 (smile, release x2) : 귀인의 공로를 인정하여 저희 지부에서 포상을 주기로 결정했습니다.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(reaper_list[2], { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_list[2], { key = string_key .. 2 })
	if self.is_exit then return end

	-- 어그로 걸 (smile, victory_get) : 야호~! 어그로걸! 이제부터 새롭게 시작하는 거야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = aggro_girl, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(aggro_girl, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false },
			{ name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aggro_girl, { key = string_key .. 3 })
	if self.is_exit then return end
	character_util.remove_anim(aggro_girl)

	-- 저승 사자 5, 어그로 걸 앞 쪽으로 붙어서 attack, push 모션으로 영혼 에너지를 올려줌.
	reaper_list[2].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(reaper_list[2], reaper_list[2].Position - vector(1.1, 0, 0)
	, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'left', false)
	if self.is_exit then return end
	reaper_list[2].OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	-- 554000 → 454000 (붉은 색)
	-- 어그로 걸 영혼 에너지 숫자가 올라가는 연출 진행
	local count_number_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_number_01', loop = true, parent = marty, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', parent = reaper_list[2], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.remove_emotion(aggro_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(aggro_girl, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(reaper_list[2], { name = 'push' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.rolling_number(aggro_girl.Transform, 454000, nil, 1.5, unity_class.color.red)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	count_number_sfx:Stop()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if self.is_exit then return end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(reaper_list[2])

	-- 영혼 에너지 올리는 연출 끝나면, 저승 사자 5 뒤로 다시 물러남.
	reaper_list[2].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.move_to_async(reaper_list[2], reaper_list[2].Position + vector(1.1, 0, 0)
	, nil, 1.5, false, true)
	reaper_list[2].OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if self.is_exit then return end

	-- 저승 사자 4 (surprise, idle, jump x1) : 아직도 빚이 이만큼이나…! 대체 현생에서 무슨 짓을 했길래…
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', parent = reaper_list, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_group_emotion(reaper_list, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(reaper_list[2], true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_list[2], { key = string_key .. 4 })
	if self.is_exit then return end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(reaper_list[2])

	-- 저승 사자 5 (tired, idle) : ……
	character_util.remove_group_emotion(reaper_list)
	character_util.set_group_emotion(reaper_list, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_list[2], { key = string_key .. 5 })
	if self.is_exit then return end

	-- 어그로 걸 (scared, idle, jump x1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(aggro_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(aggro_girl, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.normal_jump(aggro_girl, true)

	-- 저승 사자 5 (tired, release x2) : 다시 노역소로 같이 가시죠.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(reaper_list[2], { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(reaper_list[2], { key = string_key .. 6 })
	if self.is_exit then return end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, reaper_list[1]
		, { vector(aggro_girl.Position.x, 0, reaper_list[1].Position.z)
				, aggro_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.75),
				}, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'down'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, reaper_list[3]
		, { vector(aggro_girl.Position.x, 0, reaper_list[3].Position.z)
				, aggro_girl.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.75),
				}, 1.5, false, nil, nil, 'up'),
	})
	if self.is_exit then return end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', parent = reaper_list[1], type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_list[1], { name = 'push' })
	character_util.set_anim(reaper_list[3], { name = 'push' })
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	if self.is_exit then return end

	-- 어그로 걸 (damaged, embarrassed) : 싫어 싫어! 나 다시 안 돌아갈 거야~!
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = aggro_girl, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(aggro_girl, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(aggro_girl, { key = 'aw_s20_one_line_18' })
	if self.is_exit then return end

	for i = 1, #reaper_list do
		local reaper = reaper_list[i]
		character_util.set_emotion(reaper, { name = 'tried' })
		reaper.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_s20_one_line_' .. (14 + i)
	end
	aggro_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_s20_one_line_18'
end

function local_class:start_scene()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'ondemand/afterworld/preload:bgm_afterworld_main'
	, state = 'field' })

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local leader_pos = field:GetMarker('s20_leader_start_pos').position
	local paper_pos = field:GetMarker('s20_room_paper_pos').position - vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 1프레임 HP바가 튀어서 보여서 강제로 꺼줌
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.HideCharacterHPBarEvent.Create(leader))

	character_util.reset_all_state(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(leader, leader_pos)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })

	local paper_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = 20519, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', pos = paper_pos, skip_text = true })

	paper_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = paper_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition + vector(0, paper_pos.y, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(vector(-999,0,0), 0)
	--region 동영상

	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.MediaPlayUtil.PlayMediaSimpleRoutine(
			CS.Oak.MediaLoadingType.CdnRawFile,
			'ondemand/afterworld/video/v2.29_afterworld_3_ending.$codec.mp4',
			nil,
			1,
			1,
			16,
			unity_class.color.black,
			unity_class.color.black,
			function()
				screen_util.fade_in_circular(0, 'linear')
				screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
			end
	))
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.move_async(leader_pos, 0)

	local sleep_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_sleep_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	sleep_sfx:Stop()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'right', 0.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.move_to(leader, leader_pos + vector(1.5, -0.5, 0), 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'right', 0.5, 1.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.75)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, { paper_item.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	}, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'eat', count = 3 })

	paper_item.ConsumeTarget = leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--일어나면 회사로 와주실 수 있나요? -하나로부터-
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.talk_string_key .. 1 })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('hotel_grid', 60049, true, get_field_object('exit_8'))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:ending_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hana = self.get_hana()
	local yuna = self.get_yuna()

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, hana.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(hana, nil, 'notice')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(hana, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(yuna, 'right')

	--하나 (smile, idle) : $name님, 오셨어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 2, skip = true })

	--하나 (smile, sing) : 명계의 위협을 막는 데에 $name님의 도움이 컸어요. 정말 감사합니다.
	character_util.set_anim(hana, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 3, skip = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(hana, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.remove_anim(hana)

	--가디언, 위 / 아래를 한번 씩 두리번 거림.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--가디언, left, idle, question, emoticon_bubble_silence 이모티콘 표시
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

	--가디언, idle, release x2
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	--하나 (tired, idle) : 지부장과 카론…
	character_util.set_emotion(hana, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	--하나 (tired, idle) : 그들은 너무 오랜 세월 동안 사자의 굴레에서 벗어나지 못했어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 10, skip = true })

	--하나 (tired, question) : 그래서 잘못된 길을 걸었던 것이 아닌가 싶어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(hana, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 11, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hana)

	-- 유나 (nodx2): 결국 자신들의 한을 풀지 못하고 되려 먹혀버린 결과지.
	character_util.nod_twice(yuna)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuna, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 유나 (cross_arm): 안타까운 사건이야.
	character_util.set_anim(yuna, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuna, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 7, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(yuna)

	--하나 (sleep_deep, cross_arm) : …
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hana, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 12, skip = true })

	--하나 (idle, cross_arm) : 이번에 깨닫게 되었어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(hana, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 13, skip = true })

	--하나 (idle, idle) : 저승사자의 굴레를 벗어나는 법은 실적 같은 것이 아니라…
	character_util.set_anim(hana, { name = 'idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 14, skip = true })

	--하나 (idle, release x2) : 자신의 미련을 이겨내야 한다는 것을요.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(hana, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 15, skip = true })

	--선택지 (normal)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--앞으로 어떻게 할 건지 묻는다.
		{ self.talk_string_key .. 16, 'normal' }
	})
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'idle' })

	--하나 (tired, question) : 물론 환생해서 새 삶을 살아볼 수도 있겠죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(hana, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 17, skip = true })

	--하나 (tired, question) : 하지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hana, { key = self.talk_string_key .. 18, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(hana)

	--유나 (blush 이모션)
	character_util.set_emotion(yuna, { name = 'smile' })

-- 카메라 줌 인
function local_class:camera_zoom_out()
	local start_size = 2
	local end_size = 6
	local duration = 4

	local heavenhold_camera = self.heavenhold_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = 6

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration

		if heavenhold_camera ~= nil then
			heavenhold_camera.orthographicSize = start_size + (end_size - start_size) * normalized
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:create_optimized_npc()

		reaper_5 = 'aw_reaper_male_b',
		reaper_6 = 'aw_reaper_female',
		reaper_8 = 'aw_reaper_male',
		reaper_7 = 'aw_reaper_female_b',
		princess = 'aw_princess',
		maiden = 'aw_maiden',
	})

	self.optimized_npc_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.reaper_count do
		local npc = optimized_npcs['reaper_' .. i]
		character_util.set_position(npc, field:GetMarker('s20_reaper_pos_' .. i).position)
		character_util.set_direction(npc, field:GetMarker('s20_reaper_pos_' .. i).direction)

			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'smile' })
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'idle' })
		end
		table.insert(self.optimized_npc_list, npc)
	end

	self.princess = optimized_npcs['princess']
	self.maiden = optimized_npcs['maiden']

function local_class:exit()
	--Unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

function local_class:on_event(e)

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent) then
		self:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.judgement_room_event_zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-97.5, 1, -191))
		elseif not self.see_tutorial and e.Zone.Name == self.judgement_tutorial_event_zone_name then
			self.see_tutorial = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.judgement_tutorial_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.judgement_room_event_zone_name then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

			if self.judgement_room_sfx ~= nil then
				self.judgement_room_sfx:FadeOut(2)
				self.judgement_room_sfx = nil
			end

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-13.5, 4, -173))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.judgement_gate) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_judgement_room_event, self)

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		quest_icon_util.remove(self.judgement_table)
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		if e.Success then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mini_game_clear_event, self))
		else
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.judgement_table)
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-97.5, 1, -191))
		end
	end
end

-- 심판의 방 입장 이벤트
function local_class:enter_judgement_room_event()
	local main_character_is_party_leader = false
	local main_character = get_character(self.main_character_name)
	local firefly = get_character(self.firefly_name)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_party_leader(), main_character) then
		main_character_is_party_leader = true
	end

	local center_pos = vector(-13.5, 0, -173)

	if not self.see_enter_judgement_gate_event then
		camera_util.move(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 2)

		party_util.align_party(center_pos, 'down', 1, 'arc')

		local animator = self.judgement_gate.Transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('judgegate_open')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_06')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gate_open_01')

		wait_for_sec(4)

		character_util.move_to(get_party_leader(),
				get_party_leader().Position + vector(0, 0, 2),
				2, nil, true, true)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(get_party_leader(), 0, 1)

		if main_character_is_party_leader then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(firefly, 0, 1)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	if self.judgement_room_sfx == nil then
		self.judgement_room_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = "01_amb_factory_01", loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = 'loop' })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if not self.see_enter_judgement_gate_event then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(get_party_leader(), 1, 0)

		if main_character_is_party_leader then
			character_util.set_active_state(firefly, 'enabled')
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(firefly, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	local enter_marker = field:GetMarker(self.entry_judgement_room_marker_name)

	party_util.align_party(
			enter_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 1), 'down', 0, 'arc')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.see_enter_judgement_gate_event = true
end

-- 튜토리얼 초록 버튼 누른 연출
function local_class:press_green_button(move_character, wait_list)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(
			self.tutorial_reaper, vector(0.3, 0, 0.5), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(self.tutorial_reaper, { name = 'spear_attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.show_o_event }))

	self:activate_button(true)

	-- 대기 위치 1칸씩 이동
	for i = 0, wait_list.Count - 1 do
		local waypoint_list_wait = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list_wait:Add(wait_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.7))

		character_util.move_waypoint(wait_list[i], waypoint_list_wait,
				4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')

	waypoint_list:Add(move_character.Position + vector(8, 0, 0))

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(move_character, waypoint_list,
			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', false)

	character_util.remove_emotion(move_character)
end

-- NPC들 추락하는 연출
function local_class:fall_down_npc(cur_npc)
	local timer = 0
	local fall_duration = 0.5

	local start_pos = cur_npc.Position

	local start_y = 0
	local end_y = -0.3

	local start_z = 0
	local end_z = -0.3

	local end_rotation = 720
	local end_scale = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')

	character_util.spine_rotate(cur_npc, end_rotation, fall_duration)
	character_util.spine_scale(cur_npc, unity_class.vector3.one * end_scale, fall_duration)

	while timer < fall_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(timer, start_y, end_y - start_y, fall_duration)
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(timer, start_z, end_z - start_z, fall_duration)

		character_util.set_position(cur_npc, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z + cur_z), true)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(cur_npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim(cur_npc)
	character_util.remove_emotion(cur_npc)
	character_util.spine_rotate(cur_npc, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(cur_npc, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
end

-- DropItem 강제 이동
function local_class:move_drop_item(drop_item, target_Pos, duration)
	timer = 0

	start_pos = drop_item.Position
	end_pos = target_Pos

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)
		local cur_y = (duration * timer - timer * timer) * 7

		drop_item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.3)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(drop_item.Position)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(drop_item.Position)

	drop_item.Position = end_pos
end

-- 사이렌 틴트 연출
function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	local siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_loop_04", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_siren_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	siren_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, 0)
	end
end

		self.knight_hot_spring = get_character(self.knight_male_hot_spring_name)
	else
		self.knight_hot_spring = get_character(self.knight_female_hot_spring_name)
	end

	-- Spot State 설정
	if ride_duck_boat then
		self.is_enter_river = self.spot_state.talk_with_charon
		self.soul_point = self.complete_river_soul_point
	end

	if enter_hot_spring then
		self.is_enter_hot_spring = self.spot_state.talk_with_charon
		self.current_onsen_progress = self.onsen_progress_state.game_end
		self.soul_point = self.complete_hot_spring_soul_point
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	-- 문 닫아 놓기
	if self.is_enter_hot_spring < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon then
		for i = 1, self.hot_spring_shortcut_door_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.hot_spring_shortcut_door_name..i))
		end

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.rainbow_hot_spring_door_name))
	end

	if self.is_enter_river < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.duck_boat_platform_door_name))
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name,
			vector(-0.5, 0, -33.5), true)
	self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = vector(-0.5, 0, -33.5) }

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.charon = nil
	self.knight_hot_spring = nil

	if self.hot_spring_ticket_seller ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.hot_spring_ticket_seller, self.controller)
		self.hot_spring_ticket_seller = nil
	end

	if self.river_ticket_seller ~= nil then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.river_ticket_seller, self.controller)
		self.river_ticket_seller = nil
	end

	self.hot_spring_customer_list = nil
	self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list = nil
	self.hot_spring_worker_list = nil

	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end

	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	self.npc_default_hitbox = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.door_open_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.door_opened then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.door_opened

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.door_open_event, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.main_square_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_main_square then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_main_square

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

				if self.is_enter_hot_spring < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
							self.quest_marker_name..1,
							vector(25.5, 0, -59.5), true)
					self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..1, marker_point = vector(25.5, 0, -59.5) }
				end

				if self.is_enter_river < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
							self.quest_marker_name..2,
							vector(-55, 0, -33.5), true)
					self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[2] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..2, marker_point = vector(-55, 0, -33.5) }
				end
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hot_spring_event_zone_name then
			if self.is_enter_hot_spring < self.spot_state.is_enter and not
					(self.is_enter_river >= self.spot_state.is_enter and
							self.is_enter_river < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon) then
				self.is_enter_hot_spring = self.spot_state.is_enter

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_hot_spring_event, self)
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.entrance_hot_spring_zone_name then
			if self.current_onsen_progress < self.onsen_progress_state.game_start then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_onsen_worker_event, self)
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.river_event_zone_name then
			if self.is_enter_river < self.spot_state.is_enter and not
					(self.is_enter_hot_spring >= self.spot_state.is_enter and
							self.is_enter_hot_spring < self.spot_state.talk_with_charon) then
				self.is_enter_river = self.spot_state.is_enter

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_river_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.charon) then
		if self.is_enter_hot_spring == self.spot_state.complete then
			self.is_enter_hot_spring = self.spot_state.talk_with_charon

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..1)

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hot_spring_talk_with_charon_event, self)
		elseif self.is_enter_river == self.spot_state.complete then
			self.is_enter_river = self.spot_state.talk_with_charon

			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..2)

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.river_talk_with_charon_event, self)
		elseif self.is_enter_river == self.spot_state.is_enter or self.is_enter_river == self.spot_state.get_ticket then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.charon, { key = self.main_script..37, skip = false })
		elseif self.is_enter_hot_spring == self.spot_state.is_enter or
				self.is_enter_hot_spring == self.spot_state.get_ticket then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.charon, { key = self.main_script..28, skip = false })
		end
	else
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hot_spring_ticket_seller) then
			if self.is_enter_hot_spring == self.spot_state.is_enter then
				self.is_enter_hot_spring = self.spot_state.get_ticket

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name..1,
						vector(33, 2, -78), true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..1, marker_point = vector(33, 2, -78) }
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[2] = nil

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(
						self.hot_spring_ticket_event, self, self.hot_spring_ticket_seller)
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.river_ticket_seller) then
			if self.is_enter_river == self.spot_state.is_enter then
				self.is_enter_river = self.spot_state.get_ticket

				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name..2,
						get_field_object(self.duck_boat_name), true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..2, marker_point = get_field_object(self.duck_boat_name) }
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[2] = nil

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(
						self.river_ticket_event, self, self.river_ticket_seller)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_start then
		for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i]) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.caught_evil_spirit_event, self, e.Target, i)

				break
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.hot_spring_customer_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hot_spring_customer_list[i]) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.caught_customer_event, self, e.Target, i)

				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.changing_clothes_custom_event then
		if self.current_onsen_progress < self.onsen_progress_state.change_clothes then
			self.current_onsen_progress = self.onsen_progress_state.change_clothes

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_name..1,
					vector(49, 2, -80.5), true)
			self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..1, marker_point = vector(49, 2, -80.5) }
			self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[2] = nil
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.ride_boat_custom_event then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..2)
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.get_off_boat_custom_event and
			self.controller.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.ride_duck_boat_custom_state) == -1 then
		self.is_enter_river = self.spot_state.complete

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.charon)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
				self.quest_marker_name..2,
				self.charon, true)
		self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name..2, marker_point = self.charon }
		self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[2] = nil
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.snowman_reset_fade_event then
		local time = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		if time ~= nil and time > 0 then
			self.snowman_reset_fade_event_time = time
		end
	end
end

-- 오리배 이동하는 연출
function local_class:move_duck_boat()
	local duck_boat_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.FieldObject)
	local start_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	for i = 1, self.duck_boat_deco_num do
		local cur_boat = get_field_object(self.duck_boat_deco_name..i)

		local animator_1 = cur_boat.Transform:Find('mesh/duck_wing'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))
		local animator_2 = cur_boat.Transform:Find('mesh/duck_part'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAnimator))

		animator_1.TimeScale = 1
		animator_2.TimeScale = 1

		cur_boat.Transform:Find('FX').gameObject:SetActive(true)

		duck_boat_list:Add(cur_boat)
		start_pos_list:Add(cur_boat.Position)
	end

	duck_boat_list[0].Position = vector(-38, 0, -104)

	local duck_boat_rider_1 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageTransform:Find(
			self.duck_boat_rider_name..1):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	duck_boat_rider_1.Transform.localPosition = duck_boat_list[0].Position + vector(0, 1, -0.2)
	duck_boat_rider_1:SetEmotion('smile', true)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.duck_boat_rotate_and_move, self,
					duck_boat_list[0], duck_boat_rider_1, 90, -4, start_pos_list[0], 0))

	duck_boat_list[1].Position = vector(-44, 0, -117)

	local duck_boat_rider_2 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageTransform:Find(
			self.duck_boat_rider_name..2):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	duck_boat_rider_2.Transform.localPosition = duck_boat_list[1].Position + vector(0, 1, -0.2)
	duck_boat_rider_2:SetEmotion('smile', true)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.duck_boat_rotate_and_move, self,
					duck_boat_list[1], duck_boat_rider_2, 90, 6, start_pos_list[1], 3))

	duck_boat_list[2].Position = vector(-72, 0, -127)

	local duck_boat_rider_3 = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.StageTransform:Find(
			self.duck_boat_rider_name..3):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	duck_boat_rider_3.Transform.localPosition = duck_boat_list[2].Position + vector(0, 1, -0.2)
	duck_boat_rider_3:SetEmotion('awesome', true)

-- 오리배 회전 + 이동 처리
function local_class:duck_boat_rotate_and_move(target, rider, start_angle, per_angle, end_pos, delay)
	local boat_speed = 1.5
	local cur_angle = start_angle

	target.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_angle, 0)

	wait_for_sec(delay)

	while self.is_move_duck_boat do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 각도 설정
		cur_angle = cur_angle + per_angle * dt
		target.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_angle, 0)

		-- 위치 설정
		local dir = vector(math.sin(math.rad(cur_angle)), 0, math.cos(math.rad(cur_angle)))
		target.Position = target.Position - dir * dt * boat_speed

		rider.Transform.localPosition = target.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.2)

		local angle = target.Transform.eulerAngles.y
		if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
			rider.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		elseif angle >= 135 and angle < 225  then
			rider.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		elseif angle >= 225 and angle < 315 then
			rider.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		else
			rider.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	target.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
	target.Position = end_pos
end

-- 일정 시간 지나면 힌트 주기
function local_class:hot_spring_game_hint()
	wait_for_sec(30)

	if self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list == nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_end then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.shake(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.02, 2)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(12)

	if self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list == nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_end then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.shake(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.04, 2)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(12)

	if self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list == nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_end then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.jump(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.jump(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(10)

	if self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list == nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_end then
		return
	end

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.jump(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
		if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
			character_util.jump(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.5, 0.3)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(10)

	if self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list == nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress == self.onsen_progress_state.game_end then
		return
	end

	local talk_delay_min = 1
	local talk_delay_max = 3

	while self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list ~= nil or
			self.current_onsen_progress ~= self.onsen_progress_state.game_end do
		for i = 0, self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list.Count - 1 do
			if not self.caught_evil_spirit_flags[i] then
				character_util.shake(self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], 0.04, 2)

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
						self.hot_spring_evil_spirit_list[i], { key = self.main_script..82 })

				wait_for_sec(unity_class.random.Range(talk_delay_min, talk_delay_max))
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(10)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.labor_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_labor_zone then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_labor_zone

				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(73.5, 0, -11))
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = vector(73.5, 0, -11) }

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.labor_event, self))
			end

			if self.loop_sfx == nil then
				self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{ sfx_name = "01_amb_toil_01", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hotel_event_zone_name then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_name,
					get_field_object(self.hotel_entrance_name_1), true)
			self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = get_field_object(self.hotel_entrance_name_1) }

			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_hotel_zone then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_hotel_zone

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hotel_event, self)
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hotel_zone_name_1 then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.enter_hotel_zone then
				local quest_marker_position = self.hotel_guide.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name,
						quest_marker_position, true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = quest_marker_position }
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_key then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name,
						get_field_object(self.hotel_entrance_name_2), true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = get_field_object(self.hotel_entrance_name_2) }
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hotel_zone_name_2 then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.enter_hotel_zone then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name,
						get_field_object(self.hotel_exit_name), true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = get_field_object(self.hotel_exit_name) }
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_state.get_key then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
						self.quest_marker_name,
						self.center_room_entrance, true)
				self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = self.center_room_entrance }
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hotel_room_center_zone_name then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_name,
					self.player_bed, true)
			self.controller.backup_quest_marker_point[1] = { marker_name = self.quest_marker_name, marker_point = self.player_bed }
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.labor_event_zone_name then
			if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
				self.loop_sfx:FadeOut()
				self.loop_sfx = nil
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.hotel_room_center_zone_name then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hotel_guide) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.get_key then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.get_key

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.get_key_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.center_room_entrance) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_center_room_door_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.player_bed) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_player_bed_event, self)
	end
end

-- 영혼 에너지 감소 연출
function local_class:decrease_soul_point(start_val, decrease_val, duration)
	self.is_soul_point_decrease = true

	local count_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_count_number_01", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })

	local cur_val = start_val - decrease_val

	if cur_val >= 0 then
		character_util.rolling_number(get_party_leader().Transform,
				cur_val, nil, duration, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))
	else
		character_util.rolling_number(get_party_leader().Transform,
				math.abs(cur_val), nil, duration, unity_class.color.red)
	end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.enter_row_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.intro_finished then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_row

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_row_event, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.middle_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_middle then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_middle

				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(30, 0, 26))

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
						self.event_reaper_list[3], { key = self.main_script..8, skip = false })
			end

			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_conveyor_belt then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_conveyor_belt

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_conveyor_belt_event, self))
			end
		end
	end

		if e.Zone.Name == self.conveyor_belt_player_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_conveyor_belt_player then

						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_conveyor_belt_player_event, self))
			end
		end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.minigame_name and e.Success and self.current_progress < self.progress_state.ending then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.ending

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(

	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
			stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.row_talk_event, self))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 이동 시작
	local walk_speed = 3

	for i = 0, self.event_prisoner_list.Count - 1 do
		if i ~= 6 and i ~= 7 and i ~= 10 and i ~= 11 then
			character_util.set_anim(self.event_prisoner_list[i], { name = 'walk' })
		end
	end

	for i = 0, 3 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.event_reaper_list[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(self.event_reaper_list[i], { name = 'walk' })
	end

	local collide_check_npc_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	collide_check_npc_list:Add(self.event_prisoner_list[14])
	collide_check_npc_list:Add(self.event_prisoner_list[15])

	local past_collided = false

	while self.event_reaper_list[1].Position.x < 34 do
		local cur_distance = walk_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 앞에 플레이어가 막고 있으면 이동하지 않는다
		-- 플레이어 앞의 NPC로 확인
		local is_collided = false

		for i = 0, collide_check_npc_list.Count - 1 do
			if (collide_check_npc_list[i].Position - get_party_leader().Position).magnitude < 1 or
					lua_helper.type_compare(
							get_party_leader().FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then
				is_collided = true

				break
			end
		end

		if not is_collided then
			for i = 0, self.event_prisoner_list.Count - 1 do
				if i ~= 6 and i ~= 7 and i ~= 10 and i ~= 11 then
					if past_collided then
						character_util.set_anim(self.event_prisoner_list[i], { name = 'walk' })
					end

					character_util.set_position(self.event_prisoner_list[i],
							self.event_prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(cur_distance, 0, 0))
				end
			end

			for i = 0, 3 do
				if past_collided then
					character_util.set_anim(self.event_reaper_list[i], { name = 'walk' })
				end

				character_util.set_position(self.event_reaper_list[i],
						self.event_reaper_list[i].Position + vector(cur_distance, 0, 0))
			end

			if past_collided then
				past_collided = false
			end
		else
			if not past_collided then

-- 죄수들 이동
function local_class:move_prisoner_list(prisoner_list, index)
	for i = 0, prisoner_list.Count - 1 do
		if prisoner_list[i] ~= nil then
			local center_dist

			if i < prisoner_list.Count / 2 then
				center_dist = i - 2
			else
				center_dist = i - 3
			end

			local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

			if center_dist ~= 0 then
				waypoint_list:Add(prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(center_dist, 0, 0))
			end

			waypoint_list:Add(prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(center_dist, 0, 15 + (index - 1)))

			if i < prisoner_list.Count / 2 then
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(39, 0, prisoner_list[i].Position.z + 15 + (index - 1)))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(39, 0, 41 - 5 * index))
			else
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(20, 0, prisoner_list[i].Position.z + 15 + (index - 1)))
				waypoint_list:Add(vector(20, 0, 41 - 5 * index))
			end

			waypoint_list:Add(vector(34 - 2 * i, 0, 41 - 5 * index))

			character_util.move_waypoint(prisoner_list[i], waypoint_list,
					3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
		end
	end
end

-- 파인애플 피자 이동
function local_class:move_pie(pie, end_pos, duration, remove_pie)
	self.is_move_pie = true

	local timer = 0

	local start_pos = pie.Position

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, 1 - (duration - timer) / duration)

		pie.Position = cur_pos

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_move_pie = false

	if not remove_pie then
		pie.Position = end_pos
	else
		pie:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

-- DropItem 강제 이동
function local_class:move_drop_item(drop_item, target_Pos, duration)
	timer = 0

	start_pos = drop_item.Position
	end_pos = target_Pos

	while timer < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, timer / duration)
		local cur_y = (duration * timer - timer * timer) * 7

		drop_item.Position = cur_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(drop_item.Position)

	drop_item.Position = end_pos
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end -- 방어코드

	-- 문 닫음
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.bully_door_name))

	-- DropItem 설정
	self.hell_pie_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.DropItem)

	for i = 0, 5 do
		self.hell_pie_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ itemid = self.hell_pie_item_id,
				  pos = self.event_prisoner_list[i].Position +
						  CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.event_prisoner_list[i].Direction) * 0.7,
				  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 }))
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커, 트래커 설정
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(51.5, 0, 23))

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name))

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.event_reaper_list = nil
	self.event_prisoner_list = nil
	self.party_prisoner_list = nil

	self.hell_pie_list = nil

	self.main_character = nil
	self.firefly = nil

	if self.crowd_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.crowd_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.cafeteria_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_cafeteria then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_cafeteria

				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(51.5, 0, 0.5))

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cafeteria_event, self))
			end

			if self.crowd_sfx == nil then
				self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
						{ sfx_name = "01_crowd_buzz_03", loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.bully_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_bully then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_bully

				ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, vector(8.5, 0, 5))

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bully_event, self)
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.start_room_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.enter_bully then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_start_room

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reaper_pizza_event, self))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.prison_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_prison then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_prison

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_prison_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.cafeteria_event_zone_name then
			if self.crowd_sfx ~= nil then
				self.crowd_sfx:FadeOut()
				self.crowd_sfx = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 스테이지 입장 이벤트
function local_class:intro_event()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 1, self.prison_door_num do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.prison_door_name..i))
		end

		character_util.set_rolling_number(
				get_party_leader().Transform, self.soul_point, nil, 0, unity_class.color.red)
	end

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	character_util.set_position(get_party_leader(), vector(30, 0, 26))
	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'right')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.prison_door_name..3))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(1, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		-- 스테이지 시작 연출
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.DirectionalStageEntry,
				get_party_leader().Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
				CS.Oak.Direction.Right, game_string:GetString(stage.Name))
	else
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end
end

function local_class:move_prisoner_to_eat(prisoner, waypoint_list, last_dir)

			3, false, 'stop', 'floor', last_dir)

	while prisoner.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.hell_pie_list:Add(drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = prisoner.Position,
	                                           target = prisoner.Position +
			                                           CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(prisoner.Direction) * 0.7,

	                                           lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'}))

	prisoner.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-19.5, 0, 0.5))

			nil, { self.pause_animation_custom_event, self.belt_animation_zone_name }))

			nil, { 'deactivate_sound_zone', 'conveyor_belt_sound_2' }))

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_event, self)

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))

	-- 물건 들고 있는 NPC 처리
	for i = 6, 10 do
		local holding_npc = self.event_prisoner_list[i]
		local holding_box = self.holded_box_list[i - 6]
		character_util.release_hold_object(holding_npc, self.holded_box_list[i - 6])

		character_util.stop(self.event_prisoner_list[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(holding_npc)
		holding_npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		holding_box.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	self.event_reaper_list = nil
	self.event_prisoner_list = nil
	self.party_prisoner_list = nil

	self.holded_box_list = nil
	self.complete_box_list = nil

	self.portable_brazier = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent)) then
		self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent)) then
		self:on_throw_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent)) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.conveyor_belt_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_conveyor_belt then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_conveyor_belt

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.cheese,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-18.5, 0, 26.5))
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.wheat,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-8.5, 0, -12.5))
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.tomato,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-29.5, 0, -14.5))

				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.conveyor_belt_event, self))
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress_state.move_box then
				if lua_helper.type_compare(
						get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
					local hold_target = get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget

					if hold_target.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
								util.cs_generator(self.block_holding_combustible_obj_event, self, hold_target, nil))
					end
				end
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.upper_conveyor_belt_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_upper_conveyor_belt then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_upper_conveyor_belt

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-53.5, 0, 48))
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.battle_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_battle_zone then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_battle_zone

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

				local battle_monster = get_character(self.battle_monster_name)

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
						battle_monster, { key = self.main_script..9, skip = false })
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.detected_event_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.enter_detected then
				self.current_progress = self.progress_state.enter_detected

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_event, self)
			end
		end
	elseif e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.portable_brazier) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.conveyor_belt_event_zone_name then
			if self.portable_brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
						util.cs_generator(self.block_holding_combustible_obj_event, self, nil, self.portable_brazier))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if e.Target.Name == self.wheat_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.wheat] then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.wheat)
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == self.tomato_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.tomato] then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.tomato)
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == self.cheese_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.cheese] then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.cheese)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if not self.enter_conveyor_belt_zone then
		return
	end

	if e.Target.Name == self.wheat_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.wheat] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.box_throw_check, self, e.Target, self.box_index.wheat))
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == self.tomato_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.tomato] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.box_throw_check, self, e.Target, self.box_index.tomato))
		end
	elseif e.Target.Name == self.cheese_box_name then
		if not self.box_flags[self.box_index.cheese] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.box_throw_check, self, e.Target, self.box_index.cheese))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.complete_box_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.complete_box_list[i]) then
			if e.FieldObject.Name == self.wheat_box_name then
				self.box_flags[self.box_index.wheat] = false

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.wheat)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.wheat,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-8.5, 0, -12.5))
			elseif e.FieldObject.Name == self.tomato_box_name then
				self.box_flags[self.box_index.tomato] = false

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.tomato)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.tomato,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-29.5, 0, -14.5))
			elseif e.FieldObject.Name == self.cheese_box_name then
				self.box_flags[self.box_index.cheese] = false

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.cheese)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name..self.box_index.cheese,
						self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-18.5, 0, 26.5))
			end

			e.FieldObject.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
			e.FieldObject.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_gatcha_box_02'

			self.complete_box_list:RemoveAt(i)

			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:block_holding_combustible_obj_event(hold_target, reset_obj)
	-- 박스 던지기 완료 연출과 겹치는 걸 막기 위한 처리
	while self.is_throwing_box do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.move_box then
		return
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.look_at(user_party[i], self.conveyor_belt_manager)
	end

	character_util.look_at(self.conveyor_belt_manager, get_party_leader())
	character_util.set_anim(self.conveyor_belt_manager, { name = 'cast2' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.conveyor_belt_manager, { name = 'mad' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.move_async(self.conveyor_belt_manager.Position, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	character_util.jump(self.conveyor_belt_manager, 1, 0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.conveyor_belt_manager, { key = self.main_script..37, skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	stage_camera:SetTarget(get_party_leader())

	-- 들고 있던 오브젝트를 내려놓음
	local cur_hold_target = get_party_leader().CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget

	if cur_hold_target ~= nil then
		command_util.execute_throw(get_party_leader(), cur_hold_target,
				vector(0, 0, 1), get_party_leader().Position, 0, false)
	end

	-- Block Object가 혹시 파괴되었다면 복구해줌
	for i = 1, self.block_jump_box_num do
		local block_box = get_field_object(self.block_jump_box_name..i)

		if block_box.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			-- 힐로 HP 초기화
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = nil
			heal_info.target = block_box
			heal_info.heal = block_box.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true

			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 들고 있거나 들어온 오브젝트가 Portable Brazier일 경우, 원래 위치로 이동
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hold_target, self.portable_brazier) then
		hold_target.Position = vector(-30, 0, -10)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(reset_obj, self.portable_brazier) then
		reset_obj.Position = vector(-30, 0, -10)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.conveyor_belt_manager, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.conveyor_belt_manager)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.conveyor_belt_manager, { name = 'attack' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

-- 박스 던지는 이벤트 받아서 박스의 던짐 상태가 종료되었을 때 위치가 목표 장소 내부인지 확인
function local_class:box_throw_check(target, index)
	self.is_throwing_box = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 던져지는 물체 움직임이 멈출 때까지 대기
	local past_pos = target.Position
	local cur_pos = past_pos

	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		past_pos = cur_pos
		cur_pos = target.Position

		-- 존 영역이 y좌표값 0이므로 해당 높이 기준으로 y 값 비교 추가
		if (past_pos - cur_pos):IsAlmostZero() and target.Position.y < 0.01 then
			break
		end
	end

	-- 던지기 완전히 끝날 때까지 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.box_target_bound, target.Bounds.center) then
		self.box_flags[index] = true

		self.complete_box_list:Add(target)
		target.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
		target.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance

		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name..index)
	--- ImpactMoving 중일 때 다시 들었는지 확인
	elseif not target.Holdable.IsHeld then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name..index,
				self.quest_spec.QuestId, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, target)
	end

	if not self.box_finished then
		local finished_num = 0

		for i = 1, #self.box_flags do
			if self.box_flags[i] then
				finished_num = finished_num + 1
			end
		end

		if finished_num == #self.box_flags then
			self.box_finished = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.box_finished_event, self)
		end
	end

	self.is_throwing_box = false
end

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldOniGirlPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = AfterWorldOniGirl @
		Comment = 오리배 레이싱 미니게임 이벤트 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.already_talk = false

	self.onigirl = function() return get_character('ancestor_onigirl') end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.controller:setting_onigirl_npc()
	self.controller.pre_section_starting = true
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.onigirl()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_onigirl, self))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:talk_onigirl()
	local onigirl = self.onigirl()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	party_util.align_party(onigirl.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	self.controller:stop_loop_sfx()
	character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

	if not self.already_talk then
		self.already_talk = true

		-- 뭐야...나에게 도전하려고 온 거야?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_1', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.set_anim(onigirl, { name = 'cast2' })
		-- 하하!! 이 번개처럼 빠른 키리님에게 덤비다니, 겁도 없구나!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_2', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)

		-- 우리 도깨비 종족의 명예를 걸고, 그 도전 받아주마!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_3', skip = true })

		local wait = true
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local choice = 1

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('aw_onigirl_4'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
			end })

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('aw_onigirl_5'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				wait = false
				choice = 2
			end })

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if choice == 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.remove_emotion(onigirl)
			-- 그게 무슨 소리야, 라이트닝 카운터?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_6', skip = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(onigirl, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
			-- 내 이름은 번개처럼 빠른 키리라고!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_7', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)
			-- 나와 대결할 생각에 겁에 잔뜩 질려서 머리 회전이 제대로 안 되는 모양인데…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_8', skip = true })

			character_util.normal_double_jump(onigirl, '01_small_jump_01')
			-- 정신 똑바로 차려!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_9', skip = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(onigirl, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			-- 자, 그러면 경주 시작이다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_11_1', skip = true })
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(onigirl, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
			-- 그럴 수 밖에! 이 키리님은 오리배 레이싱의 108년 연속 우승자니까 말야!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_10', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(onigirl)
			-- 저승에 소문이 쫙 퍼져서 몰라보는 사람이 없다구!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_11', skip = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(onigirl, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			-- 자, 그러면 경주 시작이다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_11_1', skip = true })
		end
	else
		-- 다시 도전할 준비가 됐어, 친구?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(onigirl, { key = 'aw_onigirl_11_2', skip = true })
	end

	local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId, false)

	if accepted == false then
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		return
	end

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:onigirl_boat_routine()
	local onigirl = self.onigirl()
	local onigirl_boat = self.onigirl_boat()
	local nod_count = 1
	local nod = self.onigirl_racing_nod(nod_count)
	local nod_dir_vec = (nod - onigirl_boat.Position).normalized
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(nod_dir_vec)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'onigirl', onigirl)

	while not self.anyone_enter_goal do
		-- 노드에 거의 도착했는지
		if self:onigirl_arrive_nod(onigirl_boat, nod, dir) then
			-- 더이상 노드가 없다면 원시 라나 승리
			if nod_count == self.onigirl_racing_nod_count then
				self.anyone_enter_goal = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.duck_boat_racing_lose, self))
				return
			else
				-- 아니면 다음 노드 세팅
				nod_count = nod_count + 1
				nod = self.onigirl_racing_nod(nod_count)
				nod_dir_vec = (nod - onigirl_boat.Position).normalized
				dir = vector_util.to_direction(nod_dir_vec)

				local start_rotation = onigirl_boat.transform.localRotation
				local end_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(-nod_dir_vec)
				local timer = 0

				-- 노드 방향으로 회전
				while timer < self.onigirl_rotate_time and not self.anyone_enter_goal do
					timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					onigirl_boat.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rotation,
							end_rotation, unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(timer / self.onigirl_rotate_time))

					self:onigirl_rotation()
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end
		else
			-- 움직이기
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(onigirl_boat, nod_dir_vec, self.onigirl_velocity * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			onigirl.Position = onigirl_boat.Position + self.boat_character_pos
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_rotation()
	local onigirl = self.onigirl()
	local onigirl_boat = self.onigirl_boat()

	local angle = onigirl_boat.transform.eulerAngles.y
	if angle > 45 and angle < 135 then
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'left')
	elseif angle >= 135 and angle < 225  then
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'up')
	elseif angle >= 225 and angle < 315 then
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(onigirl, 'down')
	end
end

function local_class:onigirl_arrive_nod(onigirl_boat, nod, dir)
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		if onigirl_boat.Position.x >= nod.x then
			return true
		end
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left  then
		if onigirl_boat.Position.x <= nod.x then
			return true
		end
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		if onigirl_boat.Position.z >= nod.z then
			return true
		end
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		if onigirl_boat.Position.z <= nod.z then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:set_marker(index)
	self.current_marker_index = index + 1
	if index > 1 then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	end
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_progress.QuestId,
			true, field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. self.current_marker_index).position)
end

function local_class:remove_marker()
	self.current_marker_index = 0
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldOnsenSnowmanSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	end

	-- 메인 섹션 4면 can_get_out_hot_spring_main_quest가 불리기 전 까지는 메인에서 문 관리
	-- 메인 섹션 4이상이고 can_get_out_hot_spring_main_quest가 true면 해당 서브이벤트에서 문 관리
	self.door_data = {

		hot_spring_exit_gate_2 = {},

	self.enter_hot_spring_custom_state = 'enter_hot_spring'

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
