	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(snowman)
	character_util.set_position(snowman, self.get_snowman_pos())
	snowman.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_reset_fx()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local target = e.Target

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.get_snowman()) then
		self:ask_snowman_star_piece()
	end
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_snowman()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.snowman_hold_up_reaction, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_snowman()) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.snowman_thrown_reaction, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.onsen_zone_name) then
		self.is_in_onsen_zone = true

		-- 설인 들고 zone에 진입 할 때
		local is_snowman_held_up = self.cur_hold_up_state == self.hold_up_state.held_up
		if is_snowman_held_up then
			self:activate_door_by_setting()
		end
		-- 메인 섹션 4이고 self.can_get_out_hot_spring_main_quest가 false이며 메인 퀘스트에서 온천 클리어하기 전에 진입하면
		-- 메인에서 연출을 진행하니까 방해 안되게 적당한 위치에 리셋
		if self:is_snowman_in_onsen_grid(self.onsen_grid.bounds) or is_snowman_held_up then
			if self:is_main_event_playing() then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_snowman_fade_out_in, self, self.get_drop_onsen_snowman_pos()))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.onsen_zone_name) then
		self.is_in_onsen_zone = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.onsen_grid == nil then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.onsen_grid_name) then
			self.onsen_grid = e.CameraGrid
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 메인 이벤트에서 문 여는 시점
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.main_quest_hot_spring_finished_custom_event then
		self.can_get_out_hot_spring_main_quest = true
	end

	-- 온천 나가는 선택 후 화면 검은색 되는 시점
	-- 설인이 온천에 던저지기 전에만 위치 리셋
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.exit_hot_spring_event and self.cur_progress < self.progress.in_onsen then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.reset_snowman, self, self.get_snowman_pos()))
	end
end
--endregion

-- 설인 들 때 리엑션
function local_class:is_snowman_in_onsen_grid(bounds)
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if snowman.Name == fo.Name then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:snowman_hold_up_reaction()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.held_up

	-- zone 안에서 설인 들 때
	self:activate_door_by_setting()

	character_util.remove_anim(snowman)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'surprise' })

	if self.is_snowman_talk_when_held_up then
		-- 으아아아…! 뭐 하는거야!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_13' })
	end
	self.is_snowman_talk_when_held_up = true

	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.cur_hold_up_state == self.hold_up_state.thrown then
			break
		end

		local dir = direction_util.to_str(leader.Direction)
		if dir == 'right' then
			character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'right')
		elseif dir == 'left' then
			character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'left')
		end
	end
end

-- 설인 덜질 때 리엑션
function local_class:snowman_thrown_reaction()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.thrown

	snowman.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, snowman)

	-- 던지는 위치에 온천이 있으면 온천으로 이동 시킴
	local leader_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(snowman.Bounds, leader_dir * 2.5)
	local target_pos = nil
	local start_pos = leader.Bounds.center
	local is_correct_onsen = false

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]

		local is_correct_onsen_detected = string.find(fo.Name, 'onsen_for_snowman')
		local is_wrong_onsen_detected = string.find(fo.Name, 'afterworld_spa')

		if is_wrong_onsen_detected or is_correct_onsen_detected then

			-- 찾은 온천이 플레이어 앞에 있는 것인지 체크
			local dest_pos = fo.Bounds.center
			if (leader_dir.x * (dest_pos.x - start_pos.x)) + (leader_dir.z * (dest_pos.z - start_pos.z)) > 0 then
				if leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
					target_pos = vector(start_pos.x, fo.Bounds.center.y, fo.Bounds.center.z)
				else
					target_pos = vector(fo.Bounds.center.x, fo.Bounds.center.y, start_pos.z)
				end

				-- 온천의 모퉁이 사이즈를 뺀 바운드
				local onsen_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fo.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3(fo.Bounds.size.x - 2.25, fo.Bounds.size.y, fo.Bounds.size.z - 2.25))
				-- 도착지점의 설인 바운드
				local new_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(target_pos, snowman.Bounds.size)

				-- 도착지점에서 설인과 온천의 (물) 바운드 안에 완전히 들어가는지 체크
				if not self:check_collision_bounds(new_bound, onsen_bound) then
					target_pos = nil
				else
					if is_correct_onsen_detected then
						is_correct_onsen = true
						target_pos = dest_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.25)
					end
				end
				break
			end
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true}, { name = 'damaged' })

	if target_pos ~= nil then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			while true do
				if snowman.Position.y <= 0 then
					character_util.set_active_shadow(snowman, false)
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_water_01')

					if not is_correct_onsen then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_explosion_gas_01')
					end
					break
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end))

		local pos = vector(target_pos.x, -0.5, target_pos.z)
		message_system:SendSync(snowman, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState.Instance))
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		snowman.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.jump_move(snowman, pos, 5, 1, true)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.none
		if is_correct_onsen then
			self:throw_into_correct_onsen()

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			return
		else
			self:throw_into_wrong_onsen()

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
		end
	else
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		while lua_helper.type_compare(snowman.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectThrownState) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'seat', loop = true })

		self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.none
	end

	snowman.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	snowman.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, snowman)
end

function local_class:throw_into_wrong_onsen()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 아… 안 돼!!!
	local speech_bubble_pos = snowman.Position
	if leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		speech_bubble_pos = speech_bubble_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_14', bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos =  speech_bubble_pos })
	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	character_util.move_distance_async(snowman, vector(0, -2, 0), 2, nil, false, false)

	self:reset_snowman_after_throwing()
end

function local_class:throw_into_correct_onsen()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.in_onsen

	camera_util.move_async(vector(snowman.Position.x, 0, snowman.Position.z), 0.5)

	-- 아… 안 돼!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_14', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	if leader.Position.x < snowman.Position.x then
		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'left')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'right')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'tired'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(snowman, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.shake(snowman, 0.03, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 이… 이 느낌은!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_15', skip = true })

	-- 온도가 나에게 너무 완벽해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'success', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_water_splash_01' }, { name = 'awesome' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_16', skip = true })

	-- 이 톡쏘는 탄산 느낌!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_17', skip = true })

	-- 정말 고마워! 네 덕에 평생의 꿈을 이룰 수 있게 됐네.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'sing', loop = true }, { name = 'love' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_19', skip = true })

	character_util.add_listener(snowman, self.controller)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'idle', loop = true }, { name = 'blush'})

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	self:reset_door_by_setting()
end

function local_class:ask_snowman_star_piece()
	if self.cnt_asked_star_piece > 2 then return end

	local snowman = self.get_snowman()

	character_util.look_at(snowman, user_party.Leader)

	local event_to_play = nil
	if self.cnt_asked_star_piece == 0 then
		event_to_play = function()
			-- 설인 : 왜 선행에서 보답을 바라지?
			character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'attack' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_21', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(snowman)
			character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'idle', loop = true }, { name = 'blush'})
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		end
	elseif self.cnt_asked_star_piece == 1 then
		event_to_play = function()
			-- 설인 : 어차피 다 나중에 포인트로 쌓이는 일인데 생색낼 샘?
			character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'doyagao' })
			character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'bomb_idle'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_22', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(snowman)
			character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'idle', loop = true }, { name = 'blush'})
			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
		end

	elseif self.cnt_asked_star_piece == 2 then
		event_to_play = function()
			-- 설인 : 아, 정말 알았어! 줄게, 준다고!
			character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'mad' })
			character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_23', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(snowman)

			self.controller.fx_twinkle:Dispose()
			self.controller.fx_twinkle = nil

			local drop_pos = self.get_star_piece_drop_pos()

			star_piece_util.appear(self.get_star_piece(), vector(snowman.Position.x, 0, snowman.Position.z), drop_pos)
			wait_for_sec(2)

			-- 설인 : 쳇, 쫌생이 같긴.
			character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'attack' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(snowman, { key = 'aw_onsen_snowman_24', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(snowman)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(snowman, { name = 'idle', loop = true }, { name = 'blush'})

			-- 온도가 나에게 너무 완벽해!
			snowman.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_onsen_snowman_16'

			camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

			character_util.remove_relate_event(snowman, self.controller)
			self.controller.is_twinkle_fx_following_snowman = false

			yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
		end
	end

	self.cnt_asked_star_piece = self.cnt_asked_star_piece + 1
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(event_to_play)

--region 설인 리셋 관련 함수들
-- 설인 기본 리셋
function local_class:reset_snowman(reset_pos)
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	if lua_helper.type_compare(snowman.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectHeldUpState) then
		message_system:SendSync(snowman, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
		message_system:SendSync(leader, CS.Oak.ReleaseHoldingObjectEvent.Create(leader))
		self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.thrown
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		snowman.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		snowman.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(snowman)
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'seat', loop = true })
	character_util.set_direction(snowman, 'right')

	character_util.set_position(snowman, reset_pos)
	self.cur_hold_up_state = self.hold_up_state.none

	self.is_snowman_in_reset_pos = true
end

-- 페이드 아웃 인 하면서 설인 리셋
function local_class:reset_snowman_fade_out_in(reset_pos)
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	if float_util.is_almost_zero((reset_pos - snowman.Position).magnitude) then
		return
	end

	local reset_time = self.snowman_reset_fade_event_time
	local fade_time = reset_time / 2
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {
		self.snowman_reset_fade_event,
		tostring((reset_time + 0.5))
	}))

	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_time, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	self:reset_snowman(reset_pos)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(fade_time, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

-- 설인을 잘못된 온천에 던진 후 리셋
function local_class:reset_snowman_after_throwing()
	local snowman = self.get_snowman()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(snowman)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(snowman, true)
	character_util.set_direction(snowman, direction_util.to_str(leader.Direction))
	character_util.set_emotion(snowman, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(snowman, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true })

	local reset_pos = leader.Position + vector(0, 1.1, 0)
	self.is_snowman_talk_when_held_up = false
	command_util.execute_holdup(leader, snowman, leader.Position)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
	self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(reset_pos)
	character_util.set_position(snowman, reset_pos)
end
--endregion

--region 문 관련
function local_class:activate_door_by_setting()
	if self:is_main_event_playing() then
		return
	end

	if self.is_in_onsen_zone then
		for name, door_data in pairs(self.door_data) do
			local gate = get_field_object(name)

			if name == 'rainbow_hot_spring_door' then
				self:activate_gate_by_condition(gate, door_data, gate.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsOpen)
			else
				local is_enabled = gate.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
				self:activate_gate_by_condition(gate, door_data, is_enabled)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:activate_gate_by_condition(gate, door_data, condition)
	if gate ~= nil then
		if door_data[2] == nil then
			-- 문이 원래 닫힌 경우
			if condition then
				door_data[1] = true
			else
				door_data[1] = false
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(gate.Name))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(gate.Name))
			end
			door_data[2] = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_door_by_setting()
	if self:is_main_event_playing() then
		return
	end

	for k, v in pairs(self.door_data) do
		local door = get_field_object(k)
		if door ~= nil then
			-- 원래부터 열린 문만 연다.
			if not v[1] then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(door.Name, false))
			end
			v[2] = nil
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:is_main_event_playing()
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(self.main_quest_id)
	if quest_progress.InnerProgress == 3 and not self.can_get_out_hot_spring_main_quest and
			quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.enter_hot_spring_custom_state) == -1 then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
	if bounds2.min.x < bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x > bounds1.min.x
			and bounds2.min.z < bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z > bounds1.min.z then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:is_bounds1_fully_in_bounds2(bounds1, bounds2)
	if bounds2.min.x < bounds1.min.x and bounds2.max.x > bounds1.max.x and
			bounds2.min.z < bounds1.min.z and bounds2.max.z > bounds1.max.z then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldOrpheusPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = AfterWorldOrpheus @

	end

	}

	self.lyre_id = 20510

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()

end

function local_class:start()

	orpheus.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'lira')
	character_util.set_anim(orpheus, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })
	character_util.add_listener(orpheus, self)

	-- 한 번 죽은 자는 절대 이승으로 돌아갈 수 없소.
	local voyeur = self.get_voyeur()
	voyeur.Interactable.Talk = 'aw_orpheus_oneline_4'
	voyeur.Interactable.TalkSfx = '02_die_ghost_01'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_orpheus(), self)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.orpheus_ask_favour, self)
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:orpheus_ask_favour()
	self.is_interacting = true

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local orpheus = self.get_orpheus()
	local ghosts = {
		self.get_ghost(1),
		self.get_ghost(2)
	}

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)
	party_util.align_party(orpheus.Position, 'left', 1)

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		-- 자, 잠시만요...! 말씀 좀 여쭤봐도 될까요?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_1', skip = true })

		-- 혹시… 제 아내 못 보셨나요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_2', skip = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'question')
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		-- 독사에 물려 죽은 아내를 찾아 저승까지 왔는데…
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(function()
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(orpheus, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
				character_util.set_anim(orpheus, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })
			end),
			util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_3', skip = true })
		})

		-- 이 구역 너머로 들여보내 주지를 않아 도저히 찾을 방도가 없습니다. 으흑…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_cry_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_4', skip = true })

		-- 그 악기는 뭔가요?
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'aw_orpheus_5', 'normal' } })

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		-- 이건…제가 즐겨 연주하던 악기인 리라입니다..
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3 })
		character_util.remove_emotion(orpheus)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_6', skip = true })

		-- 이 연주를 듣고 그녀가 찾아온다면 참으로 기쁠 텐데…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_7', skip = true })

		-- 연주 연출
		local lyre_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lira_loop_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_direction(orpheus, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(orpheus, { name = 'unique/playing_lira', loop = true }, { name = 'sing' })
		wait_for_sec(4)
		lyre_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		character_util.set_direction(orpheus, 'left')
		character_util.remove_emotion(orpheus)
		character_util.set_anim(orpheus, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })

		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'clap', loop = true })
		character_util.set_group_anim_and_emotion(ghosts, { name = 'clap', loop = true }, { name = 'cry' })

		-- 흑흑…너무 구슬픈 음악소리야…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ghosts[1], { key = 'aw_orpheus_8', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

		-- 리라의 음색이 심금을 울리네요!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(ghosts[2], { key = 'aw_orpheus_9', skip = true })

		-- 당신… 영혼 꼬리가 없는 걸 보면 여기 있는 유령들과는 다른 존재인 거죠?
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_10', skip = true })

		self.cur_progress = self.progress.talked
	end

	-- 이 리라는 아름다운 소리를 내는 힘이 있으니 이것을 이용해 제 아내를 찾아와주지 않겠습니까?
	character_util.remove_emotion(orpheus)
	character_util.set_anim(orpheus, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_11', skip = true })

	-- 그렇게만 해 주신다면 보답으로 아주 귀한 것을 드리겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_12', skip = true })

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 수락한다.
		{ 'aw_orpheus_12_1', 'mercy' },
		-- 거절한다.
		{ 'aw_orpheus_12_3', 'brutal' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.nod_twice(leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		-- 그럼 부탁드리겠습니다!
		character_util.set_emotion(orpheus, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_12_2', skip = true })

		orpheus.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(orpheus, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.067)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = orpheus.Position, target = leader.Position, itemid = self.lyre_id, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.75 })
		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.set_emotion(orpheus, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)

		coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
	else
		-- 어쩔 수 없군요… 알겠습니다.
		character_util.set_emotion(orpheus, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orpheus, { key = 'aw_orpheus_12_4', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
		self.is_interacting = false
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local voyeur = self.get_voyeur()
	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()

	character_util.add_listener(voyeur, self)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eurydice, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_position(eurydice, voyeur.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, eurydice)

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.battle_group_names) do
		local battle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleGroup(self.battle_group_names[i])
		table.insert(self.battle_groups, battle)
	end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	-- QTE 스파인 불러오기
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_voyeur(), self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_orpheus(), self)

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.is_interacting then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_voyeur()) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_to_voyeur, self)
			elseif self.cur_progress > self.progress.none and
					self.cur_progress < self.progress.eurydice_start_following then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.play_lyre, self, true)
			elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_faded_away then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.eurydice_start_following, self)
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_orpheus()) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_whining_end then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_event, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_qte_start then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.cur_swiped_type = 'left'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.cur_swiped_type = 'right'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.cur_swiped_type = 'up'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.cur_swiped_type = 'down'
			return true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_start_following then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.b6_grid_name) then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_fall_down
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.central_park_grid_name) then
			for i = 1, 2 do
				local ghost = self.get_ghost(i)
				if ghost ~= nil then
					character_util.remove_anim(ghost)
					character_util.set_emotion(ghost, { name = 'tired' })
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_start_whining then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.b6_grid_name) then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_whining_end

			local orpheus = self.get_orpheus()
			local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(eurydice)
			character_util.add_listener(orpheus, self)

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_following_again, self, 1))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then
		return
	end

	self.cur_zone = e.Zone.Name

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_fall_down then
		if self.zone_data.eurydice_fall_down[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_following_after_falling_down
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_following_again, self))
		end
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_following_after_falling_down then
		if self.zone_data.eurydice_following_after_falling_down[e.Zone.Name] ~= nil then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_start_whining
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		self.cur_zone = nil
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:talk_to_voyeur()
	self.is_interacting = true

	local voyeur = self.get_voyeur()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	party_util.align_party(voyeur.Position, 'right', 1)

	-- 무슨 용건이오?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_14', skip = true })

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 오르페우스의 아내를 찾으러 왔다.
		{ 'aw_orpheus_15', 'normal' },
		-- 나랑 뱃놀이하러 갈래요?
		{ 'aw_orpheus_19', 'mercy' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.talked
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'release', count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		-- …이미 한 번 강을 건너간 망령을 찾는다고?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_16', skip = true })

		-- 당신은 죽음을 참으로 가벼이 여기나 보군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_17', skip = true })

		-- 아무런 대가도 없이 이런 터무니없는 요구를 하는 것이오?
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_18', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

		self:play_lyre(false)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sing', loop = true }, { name = 'awesome' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		-- …이곳은 아무나 올 수 있는 곳이 아니오.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_20', skip = true })

		-- 산 자도, 죽은 자도 아닌 당신은 더더욱.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_21', skip = true })

		-- 당장 돌아가시오.
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_22', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	end

	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:play_lyre(align)
	local voyeur = self.get_voyeur()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self.is_interacting = true

	if align then
		party_util.align_party(voyeur.Position, 'right', 1)
	end

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 리라를 연주한다.
		{ 'aw_orpheus_23', 'mercy' },
		-- 그만둔다.
		{ 'aw_orpheus_24', 'normal' }
	})

	if result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })

		local reset_voyeur_room_npc = function()
			for k, v in pairs(self.npcs_data) do
				local character = get_character(k)
				if character ~= nil then
					character_util.set_direction(character, v.dir)
					character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(character, { name = v.anim, loop = true }, { name = v.emotion })
				end
			end
		end

		self.cur_progress = self.progress.played_lyre

		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)
		leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'lira')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'unique/playing_lira', loop = true }, { name = 'sing' })

		for k, _ in pairs(self.npcs_data) do
			local character = get_character(k)
			character_util.look_at(character, leader)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
		end

		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.qte_data) do
			yield_return_func(self.qte_swipe, self, self.qte_data[i])
		end

		local success_count = self.swipe_success_count
		self.swipe_success_count = 0

		-- 전부 성공
		if success_count == table_util.get_size(self.qte_data) then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
			for k, _ in pairs(self.npcs_data) do
				local character = get_character(k)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(character, { name = 'clap', loop = true }, { name = 'smile' })
			end

			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })

			-- 참으로 황홀한 리라의 음색이오만…
			character_util.set_anim(voyeur, { name = 'clap', loop = true })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_28', skip = true })

			-- 이미 이천 년도 더 전에 날 그런 식으로 꾀어내 죽은 자를 이승으로 데려가려 했던 놈이 있었소.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_29', skip = true })

			-- 더 이상은 속지 않으니 썩 물러나시오!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_ghost_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, voyeur, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
				util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_30', skip = true })
			})

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			reset_voyeur_room_npc()

			-- 부분 성공
		elseif success_count > 0 then
			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })

			-- …풋.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_emotion(voyeur, { name = 'doyagao' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_25', skip = true })

			-- 잠깐의 유흥거리조차 안 되는 그 연주 실력은 대체…
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_26', skip = true })

			-- 당장 꺼지시오!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_ghost_01')
			character_util.remove_emotion(voyeur)
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, voyeur, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
				util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_27', skip = true })
			})

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			reset_voyeur_room_npc()

			-- 전부 실패 (이벤트는 성공한 루트)
		elseif success_count == 0 then
			local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()

			local lyre_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lira_loop_02', loop = true, mix = 0 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			for k, _ in pairs(self.npcs_data) do
				local character = get_character(k)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(character, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'damaged' })
			end
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

			-- 으…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_ghost_01')
			character_util.shake(voyeur, 0.03, 9999)
			character_util.set_emotion(voyeur, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_31', skip = true })

			-- 이… 이 무슨 끔찍한…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_32', skip = true })
			character_util.stop_shake(voyeur)

			-- 당장 그 끔찍한 악기 연주를 멈추시오!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, voyeur, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
				util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_33', skip = true })
			})

			-- …
			character_util.set_emotion(voyeur, { name = 'scared' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_34', skip = true })

			-- …그,그만해 제발!
			lyre_sfx:Stop()
			lyre_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_lira_loop_03', loop = true, mix = 0 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'burning' })
			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, voyeur, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' }),
				util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_35', skip = true })
			})

			-- 그 아내인지 뭔지 데려와 주겠으니까 당장 그 고약한 연주 좀 멈춰달라고!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_anim(voyeur, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_36', skip = true })

			lyre_sfx:Stop()
			character_util.remove_emotion(voyeur)
			character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'basket_idle', loop = true })

			for k, _ in pairs(self.npcs_data) do
				local character = get_character(k)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
			end

			-- 망자 데려오는 연출
			character_util.set_direction(voyeur, 'down')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 3 })
			field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, eurydice)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eurydice, 1, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_direction(voyeur, 'right')
			character_util.remove_anim(voyeur)

			-- …여기 있소. 당장 데려가시오.
			character_util.set_emotion(voyeur, { name = 'tired' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_37', skip = true })

			-- 한 가지 첨언하자면, 죽은 자를 이승으로 데려갈 때의 규칙이 있소.
			character_util.remove_emotion(voyeur)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_38', skip = true })

			-- 도착할 때 까지 절대 죽은 자를 돌아봐서는 안 되오.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_39', skip = true })

			-- 이것은 몇십 만 년 동안 지켜져 온 불문율이니 반드시 명심하시오.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(voyeur, { key = 'aw_orpheus_40', skip = true })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.nod_twice(leader)
			character_util.move_distance_async(leader, vector(1.5, 0, 0), nil, 2.5, true, true)

			-- 잘 부탁드려요.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eurydice, { key = 'aw_orpheus_58', skip = true })

			reset_voyeur_room_npc()

			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(eurydice, user_party, false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone, 2)
			self.controller:close_gates()
			self:disable_battles()

			character_util.remove_relate_event(voyeur, self)
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_start_following

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_back_routine, self))
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'empty')
		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
	end

	self.is_interacting = false
end

function local_class:end_event()
	self.is_interacting = true

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.reach_to_orpheus

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local orpheus = self.get_orpheus()
	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(eurydice)

	local temp_party = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(temp_party, user_party[i])
	end
	table.insert(temp_party, eurydice)
	character_util.align_npc_group(temp_party, orpheus.Position, 'left', 1)
	temp_party = nil

	-- 아내분을 데리고 왔어요.
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })

-- qte swipe 연추 함수
function local_class:qte_swipe(data, delay)
	local type = data.type
	local duration = data.duration
	local success_sfx = data.success_sfx
	local fail_sfx = data.fail_sfx

	if type == 'tap' then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTap()
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(type)
	end

	self.cur_swiped_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0
	local is_success = false

	while self.is_qte_start do
		if self.cur_swiped_type == type then
			self.swipe_success_count = self.swipe_success_count + 1
			is_success = true
			break
		elseif time_passed > duration or (self.cur_swiped_type ~= '' and self.cur_swiped_type ~= type) then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_qte_start = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	if is_success then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1.5, success_sfx)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(fail_sfx)
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end
end

--region 에우레디케 따라가는 연출 관련
-- 에우레디케 바라봤는지
function local_class:is_watching_eurydice()
	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local leader_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
	local target_dir = eurydice.Position - leader.Position
	local angle = unity_class.vector3.Angle(target_dir, leader_dir)

	if angle < 70 and screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(eurydice.Position) then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

function local_class:watching_eurydice_routine(target_progress)
	while self.cur_progress == target_progress do
		if self:is_watching_eurydice() then
			self:eurydice_fade_away()
			return true
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 에우레디케 바라본 상태에 따른 연출
function local_class:turn_back_routine()
	-- 에루레디케 따라가기 시작
	self:watching_eurydice_routine(self.progress.eurydice_start_following)

	-- 에우레디케 넘어짐 (함정 연출)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_fall_down then
		self:eurydice_fall_down_routine()
		self:watching_eurydice_routine(self.progress.eurydice_fall_down)
	end

	-- 에우레디케 다시 일어나서 따라오는 중
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_following_after_falling_down then
		self:watching_eurydice_routine(self.progress.eurydice_following_after_falling_down)
	end

	-- 에우레디케 땡깡 부리기 시작 (함정 연출)
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_start_whining then
		self:eurydice_whining_routine()
		self:watching_eurydice_routine(self.progress.eurydice_start_whining)
	end

	-- 에우레디케 땡깡 부리기 끝나고 따라오는 중
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.eurydice_whining_end then
		self:remove_ghosts()
		self:watching_eurydice_routine(self.progress.eurydice_whining_end)
	end
end

-- 에우레디케 넘어지는 연출
function local_class:eurydice_fall_down_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.convert_to_npc(eurydice)

	local party_table = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(party_table, user_party[i])
	end
	character_util.move_group_distance_async(party_table, vector(1, 0, 0), nil, 4, true, true)

	local bubble_pos = leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	-- 아앗… 넘어졌어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eurydice, {
		key = 'aw_orpheus_41', skip = true, world_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 걸을 수가 없어요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eurydice, {
		key = 'aw_orpheus_42', skip = true, world_pos = bubble_pos, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 에우레디케 땡깡 부리는 연출
function local_class:eurydice_whining_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	character_util.convert_to_npc(eurydice)

	local target_pos = leader.Position + ((direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)) * -2)
	character_util.move_to_async(eurydice, target_pos, nil, 7, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(eurydice, 'right')

	-- 그쪽으로 가면 위험해요!
	character_util.set_emotion(eurydice, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eurydice, { key = 'aw_orpheus_43', skip = true })

	-- 제가 돌아가는 방향을 알아요. 절 따라오시겠어요?
	character_util.remove_emotion(eurydice)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eurydice, { key = 'aw_orpheus_44', skip = true })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:remove_ghosts()
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local ghost = self.get_ghost(i)
		if ghost ~= nil then
			character_util.set_position(ghost, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end
	end
end

-- 에우레디케 사라지는 연출
function local_class:eurydice_fade_away()
	local orpheus = self.get_orpheus()
	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
	local voyeur = self.get_voyeur()

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_fading_away

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = eurydice, loop = false })
	character_util.remove_relate_event(voyeur, self)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(orpheus, self)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(eurydice)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(eurydice, { name = 'embarrassed', loop = true }, { name = 'scared' })

	local fade_time = 0.75

	eurydice.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_ghost_disappear_03', parent = eurydice, loop = false })
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, eurydice)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eurydice, 0, fade_time)
	wait_for_sec(fade_time)

	self.controller:open_gates()
	self:enable_battles()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(eurydice)
	character_util.set_direction(eurydice, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(eurydice, voyeur.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fade_out_02', parent = eurydice, loop = false })
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, eurydice)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(eurydice, 1, fade_time)
	wait_for_sec(fade_time)

	character_util.add_listener(voyeur, self)
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.eurydice_faded_away
end

function local_class:start_following_again(follow_delay)
	local eurydice = self.get_eurydice()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local original_progress = self.cur_progress

	if follow_delay ~= nil and follow_delay > 0 then
		wait_for_sec(follow_delay)
	end

	-- 멀리 있으면 플레이어에게 빠르게 이동
	local distance = (eurydice.Position - leader.Position).magnitude
	if distance > 2 then
		character_util.set_anim(eurydice, { name = 'run', loop = true })
		local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = eurydice, loop = true })

		while true do
			distance = (eurydice.Position - leader.Position).magnitude
			if self:is_watching_eurydice() then
				dash_sfx:FadeOut(CS.Oak.SfxConstants.QuickFadeOutDuration)
				return
			end

			if distance <= 2 or original_progress ~= self.cur_progress then
				dash_sfx:FadeOut(CS.Oak.SfxConstants.QuickFadeOutDuration)
				break
			end

			local dir = (leader.Position - eurydice.Position).normalized
			local speed = 13 * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local new_pos = eurydice.Position + (dir * speed)
			character_util.set_position(eurydice, new_pos)
			character_util.look_at(eurydice, leader)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(eurydice)
	character_util.convert_to_following_npc(eurydice, user_party, false, CS.Oak.NpcFollowingStateInBattle.OutBattleZone, 2)
end
--endregion

function local_class:disable_battles()
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.battle_groups) do
		local battle = self.battle_groups[i]
		local monsters = battle:GetMonsters()

		for i = 0, monsters.Count - 1 do
			local monster = monsters[i]
			if monster ~= nil and
					lua_helper.type_compare(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController) and
					not monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
				monster.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end
		end
		battle.IgnoreZoneEvent = true
	end

end

function local_class:enable_battles()
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.battle_groups) do
		local battle = self.battle_groups[i]
		local monsters = battle:GetMonsters()

		for i = 0, monsters.Count - 1 do
			local monster = monsters[i]
			if monster ~= nil then
				if lua_helper.type_compare(monster.FieldObjectController, CS  .Oak.MonsterCharacterController) and
						not monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
					monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
					if monster.FieldObjectController.Zone == self.cur_zone then
						command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
					end
				end
			end
		end
		battle.IgnoreZoneEvent = false
	end
end


return local_class

	-- 사인보드 스트링 키
	self.sign_board_string_key = 'aw_secret_of_styx_board_'

	-- zone
	self.zone_name = 'secret_of_styx_'

	-- 표지판 갯수
	self.board_count = 3

	-- 표지판 interactable 캐싱용
	self.cached_interactable = nil

	-- 표지판 읽었는지 카운팅용
	self.read_board = { false, false, false }

	-- 보물 상자가 나올 조건이 완료 되었는지?
	self.is_success = false

	-- 온천 통로 방 자동 이벤트 보았는지?
	self.is_show_duck_boat_event = false

	-- 상자 등장 sfx
	self.earthquake_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	-- 만약 이미 상자가 열려 있다면 바로 퀘스트 클리어
	if stage_progress:GetNamedData(self.box_name, false, CS.Tilemaps.NameSection.Box) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_clear, self))
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_event')

	-- 온천 부분 원라인 npc 배치
	local pos = self.get_one_line_npc_marker().position

	local npc = self.get_one_line_npc(1)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(npc, pos)

	npc = self.get_one_line_npc(2)
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(npc, pos + unity_class.vector3.right)

	-- 표지판들 이벤트 진행을 위해  CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create() 로 변경
	self.cached_interactable = {}
	for i = 1, self.board_count do
		local sign_board = self.get_sign_board(i)
		local cur_interactable = sign_board.Interactable
		table.insert(self.cached_interactable, cur_interactable)
		sign_board.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		-- 표지판을 읽었는지 Custom State에서 가져온다.
		local is_read = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.read_board_custom_key .. i)
		self.read_board[i] = is_read > 0
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_box_open_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))

	self:dispose_earthquake_sfx()

	self.controller.is_floating_box = false

	-- 사인보드 원복
	if self.cached_interactable ~= nil then
		for i = 1, self.board_count do
			local sign_board = self.get_sign_board(i)
			sign_board.Interactable = self.cached_interactable[i]
		end
		self.cached_interactable = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent) then
		local treasure_box = self.get_treasure_box()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, treasure_box) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opened_box, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 1, self.board_count do
		local sign_board = self.get_sign_board(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sign_board) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_sign_board, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name .. 1 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			and self.is_success then
		-- 조건이 충족되면 보물 상자 얻는 연출
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_get_treasure_box, self))
		return true
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name .. 2 and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			and not self.is_show_duck_boat_event then
		-- 오리배 자동 이벤트
		self.is_show_duck_boat_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_duck_boat_event, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_sign_board(index)
	-- 읽지 않은 사인보드라면 읽은 사인보드라고 체크
	if self.board_count >= #self.read_board and self.read_board[index] == false then
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.read_board_custom_key .. index, 1)
		self.read_board[index] = true
	end

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = self.sign_board_string_key .. index })

	-- 조건이 충족되지 않았다면 조건 충족 확인하고 변경해준다.
	if self.is_success == false then
		self.is_success = self:is_success_read_sign_board()
	end
end

-- 보물상자 체크
function local_class:is_success_read_sign_board()
	local is_read_first = false
	local read_count = 0
	for i = 1, #self.read_board do
		if i == 1 and self.read_board[i] == true then
			is_read_first = true
			read_count = read_count + 1
		elseif i ~= 1 and self.read_board[i] == true then
			read_count = read_count + 1
		end
	end

	return is_read_first and read_count >= 2
end

function local_class:directing_get_treasure_box()
	-- 오리배 멈추고 조작 멈추기
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'stop_and_disable_boat_control' }))

	-- 박스를 좌표로 이동
	local treasure_box = self.get_treasure_box()
	local respawn_marker = self.controller.box_respawn_marker().position
	treasure_box.Transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	treasure_box.Position = respawn_marker

	-- 카메라가 상자쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.resize_to(3.75, 1.0)
	local camera_target_pos = treasure_box.Bounds.center
	camera_target_pos.y = camera_target_pos.y - treasure_box.Bounds.extents.y
	camera_util.move_async(camera_target_pos, 1)

	-- y축으로 올라오면서 스케일이 커진다.
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)

	local water_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_loop_04', loop = true })
	self.get_box_open_effect():Instantiate(treasure_box.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	self:showing_box(treasure_box, vector(-0.5, 0, -1), 2.5)
	water_sfx:Stop()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.floating_box,
			self.controller, treasure_box, 0.1, 0.5, 6))

	-- 보물 상자 획득
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, self.box_name,
			CS.Oak.TreasureOpenType.OnlyTreasureOpen))
end

function local_class:showing_box(box, position_offset, duration)
	self.earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_09', loop = true
	, type_priority = 'event' })

	local time_passed = 0
	local box_position = box.Position
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = box_position + unity_class.vector3.Lerp(position_offset
		, unity_class.vector3.zero, progress)

		local target_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(-0.75, 0, progress)
		local target_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(-0.375, 0, progress)
		box.Position = position + vector(0, target_y, target_z)
		box.Transform.localScale = vector(progress, progress, progress)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:dispose_earthquake_sfx()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_float_01')

	box.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	box.Position = box_position
end

-- 상자가 열린 후에 타는 함수
function local_class:opened_box()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.8)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.8)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 박스 Interactable 변경
	local treasure_box = self.get_treasure_box()
	treasure_box.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 보트 컨트롤 원복
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'reset_boat_controller' }))

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	self:quest_clear()
end

-- 오리배 부분 자동 이벤트
function local_class:play_duck_boat_event()
	local npc_1 = self.get_one_line_npc(1)
	local npc_2 = self.get_one_line_npc(2)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_1, { key = self.string_key .. 1 })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_2, { key = self.string_key .. 2 })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_2, { key = self.string_key .. 3 })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(npc_1, { key = self.string_key .. 4 })

	-- npc 상호작용 대사 세팅
	npc_2.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. 4
	npc_1.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. 3
end

function local_class:dispose_earthquake_sfx()
	if self.earthquake_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	self.earthquake_sfx:Stop()
	self.earthquake_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:quest_clear()
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldYoungBoySoulPostSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = AfterWorldYoungBoySoul @
		Comment = 라이브 이벤트 어린 아이의 영혼 포스트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- character
	self.get_boy_soul = function() return get_character('young_boy_soul') end
	self.get_woman_soul = function(index) return get_character('young_boy_soul_woman_' .. index) end
	self.get_inclement_woman_soul = function() return get_character('young_boy_soul_inclement_woman') end

	self.marker_name = 'young_boy_soul_marker_'

	-- 스트링 키
	self.string_key = 'afterworld_young_boy_soul_'

	self.string_key_sub = 'aw_young_boy_soul_interact_'

	-- 여자 영혼들 엔딩으로 끝났는지?
	self.is_womans_ending = false

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 움직임 루틴
	self.is_move_inclement_woman = false

	self.is_right = false

	self.left_pos = nil
	self.right_pos = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	self.is_womans_ending = self.quest_progress.Grade <= 0

	-- Grade에 따라 꼬마 세팅
	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. 3).position
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	local boy_soul_pos = pos + vector(-3.5, 0, 2.5)
	character_util.set_active_state(boy_soul, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(boy_soul, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(boy_soul, boy_soul_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = self.is_womans_ending and 'doyagao' or 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_rolling_number(boy_soul.Transform, 1, nil, 0
	, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

	--	(-2,0,1.5)
	if self.is_womans_ending then
		-- Grade에 따라 여자 영혼들 세팅
		local woman_pos_list = {
			pos + vector(-4.25, 0, 2),
			pos + vector(-4.25, 0, 3),
			pos + vector(-4.75, 0, 2.5)
		}

		local number_list = { 25764, 52437, 66542 }
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local woman_soul = self.get_woman_soul(i)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(woman_soul)
			character_util.set_active_state(woman_soul, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(woman_soul, woman_pos_list[i])
			character_util.set_direction(woman_soul, self.is_womans_ending and 'right' or 'left')
			character_util.set_rolling_number(woman_soul.Transform, number_list[i], nil, 0
			, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

			if self.is_womans_ending then
				character_util.set_emotion(woman_soul, { name = 'smile' })
				woman_soul.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. (54 + i)
			else
				woman_soul.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key_sub .. (2 + i)
			end
		end
		boy_soul.Interactable.Talk = self.string_key .. 58
		boy_soul.Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_bad_fairy_01'
	else
		-- 험악한 여자 영혼 배치
		local inclement_woman_soul = self.get_inclement_woman_soul()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(inclement_woman_soul)
		character_util.set_active_state(inclement_woman_soul, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(inclement_woman_soul, pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 2.5))
		character_util.set_direction(inclement_woman_soul, 'right')
		character_util.set_rolling_number(inclement_woman_soul.Transform, 42853, nil, 0
		, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

		-- 험악한 여자 영혼이 꼬마 영혼을 들어올린다.
		character_util.set_emotion(inclement_woman_soul, { name = 'smile' })
		command_util.execute_holdup(inclement_woman_soul, boy_soul, inclement_woman_soul.Position)
		character_util.set_anim(boy_soul, { name = 'prostrate' })

		inclement_woman_soul.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		boy_soul.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.left_pos = pos + vector(-5.5, 0, 2.5)
		self.right_pos = pos + vector(-2.5, 0, 2.5)
		self.is_right = true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.is_move_inclement_woman = false

	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.stop_shake(boy_soul)
	character_util.remove_rolling_number(boy_soul.Transform)

	if self.is_womans_ending then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local woman = self.get_woman_soul(i)
			character_util.remove_rolling_number(woman.Transform)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(woman, self.controller)
		end
	else
		character_util.remove_rolling_number(self.get_inclement_woman_soul().Transform)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.is_womans_ending then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'young_boy_soul_grid') then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.inclement_woman_move_routine, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_womans_ending then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'young_boy_soul_grid') then
		self.is_move_inclement_woman = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:inclement_woman_move_routine()
	self.is_move_inclement_woman = false
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.is_move_inclement_woman = true

	local cur_talk_count = 0
	local talk_count = 2

	local wait_for_sec_routine = function(time)
		local s = unity_class.time.time
		while unity_class.time.time - s < time do
			-- exit 호출 됐으면 break
			if not self.is_move_inclement_woman then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local inclement_woman_soul = self.get_inclement_woman_soul()
	while self.is_move_inclement_woman do
		if cur_talk_count >= talk_count then
			-- 자~ 비행기 날아간다!
			cur_talk_count = 0
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01'
			, loop = false, parent = inclement_woman_soul })

			talk_count = random_util.get_random_int(3, 4)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 67 })
		end

		-- 특정 좌표로 이동
		local pos = self.is_right and self.right_pos or self.left_pos
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_woman_soul, pos, 3.5, false, 'stop'
		, 'floor', self.is_right and 'right' or 'left')
		wait_for_sec_routine(0.75)

		if self.is_move_inclement_woman then
			self.is_right = self.is_right == false
			cur_talk_count = cur_talk_count + 1
		end
	end

end

return local_class

function local_class:dispose()

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 영혼들 배치

	return true
end

function local_class:set_soul_state()
	-- 남자 아이 영혼 배치
	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. 1).position
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.set_active_state(boy_soul, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(boy_soul, pos)
	character_util.set_direction(boy_soul, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'cry' })
	character_util.add_listener(boy_soul, self.controller)

	character_util.set_rolling_number(boy_soul.Transform, 1, nil, 0
	, unity_color({ 0, 0.7, 1, 1 }))

	-- 남자 아이 영혼에게 스타피스 이팩트

	for i = 1, 3 do
