end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_star_piece_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self:dispose_star_piece_effect()

	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.stop_shake(boy_soul)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(boy_soul, self.controller)
	character_util.set_active_state(boy_soul, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_rolling_number(boy_soul.Transform)

	local man_soul = self.get_man_soul()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(man_soul, self.controller)
	character_util.set_active_state(man_soul, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_rolling_number(man_soul.Transform)

	local inclement_woman_soul = self.get_inclement_woman_soul()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(inclement_woman_soul, self.controller)
	character_util.set_active_state(inclement_woman_soul, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_rolling_number(inclement_woman_soul.Transform)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local woman_soul = self.get_woman_soul(i)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(woman_soul, self.controller)
		character_util.set_active_state(woman_soul, 'disabled')
		character_util.remove_rolling_number(woman_soul.Transform)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local one_line_npc = self.get_one_line_npc(i)
		character_util.remove_rolling_number(one_line_npc.Transform)
		character_util.set_active_state(one_line_npc, 'disabled')
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	local man_soul = self.get_man_soul()
	local inclement_woman_soul = self.get_inclement_woman_soul()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, boy_soul) then
		if self.current_state <= self.quest_state.talk_young_boy then
			-- 어린 아이 영혼과의 대화 연출
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_interact_young_boy, self)
		else
			-- 누나들은 오리배 선착장 쪽에 많을 테니 그쪽으로 가봐. / 으아아아앙
			local index = self.is_send_man and 46 or 24
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. index })
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, man_soul) then
		if self.current_state == self.quest_state.request_young_boy and not self.is_send_man then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_man_soul, self, man_soul)
		else
			local string_key = self.is_send_man and self.string_key .. 41 or self.one_line_string_key .. 2
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(man_soul, { key = string_key })
		end
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, inclement_woman_soul) then
		if self.current_state == self.quest_state.request_young_boy then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_inclement_woman_soul, self, inclement_woman_soul)
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.one_line_string_key .. 1 })
		end
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local woman_soul = self.get_woman_soul(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, woman_soul) then
			if self.current_state == self.quest_state.request_young_boy then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_womans_soul, self, self.get_woman_soul(3))
			else
				local index = 2 + i
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(woman_soul, { key = self.one_line_string_key .. index })
			end
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'young_boy_soul_zone') then
		if self.current_state == self.quest_state.none then
			-- 후에에엥~
			self.current_state = self.quest_state.once_cry
			local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_cry_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 0, bubble_type = 'shout' })
			return true
		elseif self.current_state >= self.quest_state.send_man
				and self.current_state < self.quest_state.play_send_event then
			local cur_quest_state = self.current_state
			self.current_state = self.quest_state.play_send_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_young_boy_zone_after_send, self, cur_quest_state)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:first_interact_young_boy()
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	local knight = user_party.Leader

	-- 아이 왼쪽으로 정렬
	party_util.align_party(boy_soul.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'arc')

	local choose_result = nil
	if self.current_state <= self.quest_state.once_cry then
		-- 선택지) 꼬마야, 길을 잃었니? / 시끄러우니 그만 울래?
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(boy_soul)
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 1, 'mercy' }
		, { self.string_key .. 2, 'brutal' } })

		-- 선택지에 따라 횟수 및 표정 변경
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = choose_result == 1 and 'smile' or 'attack' })

		if choose_result == 1 then
			character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'sing' })
			wait_for_sec(1)
		else
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(knight, { name = 'release', count = 2
			, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		end

		-- 꼬마 영혼 silence
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(boy_soul, nil, 'silence')

		-- 기사 놀라며 surprise 꼬마는 두번 점프하며 화냄
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)
		character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'surprise' })
		if choose_result == 1 then
			character_util.normal_jump(knight, true)
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'mad' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump
		, boy_soul, true))

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : …에잇 진짜…저리 꺼져!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_kid_boy_shout_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 3, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(knight)
		character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : …야. 나 꼬맹이 아니야.
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(boy_soul, { name = 'release', count = 1, scale = 0.8, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 내가 이래 봬도 명계에도 몇십 년을 살았거든?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
		character_util.set_anim(boy_soul, { name = 'hold_loop' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 정신은 아주 성숙한 아저씨라고.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 6, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 선택지) 왜 꼬마 모습으로 있어?
		choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 8, 'normal' } })

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 저승 관광지를 이용하려면 영혼 에너지가 필요하잖아!
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 12, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 가진 에너지는 한정적인데, 에너지 쓰기는 싫고…
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'question', sfx_name = '01_rustle_01'
		, loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 13, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 :  여기서 이렇게 울고 있으면 마음씨 착한 누나들이 에너지를 대신 지불해주거든.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(boy_soul, { name = 'release', count = 1, scale = 0.8, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 14, skip = true })

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 오늘은 누나들이랑 오리배라도 타면서 놀까 했는데 네가 말을 걸어서 다 망쳐버렸잖아.
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(boy_soul, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 17, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 그래서 말인데…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 18, skip = true })
	end

	self.current_state = self.quest_state.talk_young_boy

	-- 다시 말을 걸 경우 여기부터 시작
	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 네가 영혼 에너지가 높은 누나들 좀 여기로 데려와 줄 수 있어?
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(boy_soul, { name = 'release', count = 2, scale = 0.8, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 19, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 사례는 확실히 할게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 20, skip = true })

	-- 선택지) 좋아! / 싫어.
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.string_key .. 21, 'mercy' }
	, { self.string_key .. 22, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 2 then
		character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : …그래?
		character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 25, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)

		-- 꼬마 영혼 : 어쩔 수 없지. 난 여기서 누나들이나 기다려야겠다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 26, skip = true })
		return
	end

	-- 기사 끄덕끄덕
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(knight)

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 거래 성립이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 23, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 누나들은 오리배 선착장 쪽에 많을 테니 그쪽으로 가봐.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(boy_soul, { name = 'release', count = 1, scale = 0.8, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 24, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)

	-- 남자 영혼 / 여자 영혼들 / 험악한 여자 영혼 리스너 구독
	self.current_state = self.quest_state.request_young_boy
end

--region 남자 영혼 이벤트

-- 남자 영혼에게 말을 걸었을 경우
function local_class:interact_man_soul(man_soul)
	party_util.align_party(man_soul.Position, 'left', 0.5, 'arc')

	local choose_result = self:show_default_choose()
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	-- 남자 영혼 : 길을 잃은 아이라…
	character_util.set_emotion(man_soul, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 29, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(man_soul)

	--남자 영혼 : 내가 한 번 가봐야겠군!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(man_soul, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 30, skip = true })

	--남자 영혼 : 알려줘서 고맙소.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 31, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(man_soul
	, man_soul.Position + vector(13, 0, 0)
	, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

	-- 남자를 꼬맹이 앞으로
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.set_position(man_soul, boy_soul.Position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_direction(man_soul, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(man_soul, { name = 'tired' })

	-- 꼬맹이 울고 있도록
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'cry' })

	self.current_state = self.quest_state.send_man
end

-- 남자 영혼을 보내고 어린 아이의 영혼쪽 존으로 이동시 재생되는 이벤트
function local_class:send_man(boy_soul)
	local man_soul = self.get_man_soul()

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 으아앙~ 꺼져! 꺼지라구!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_cry_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 39, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 너희랑 놀기 싫단 말이야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 40, skip = true })

	-- 남자 영혼1 :별 이상한 애를 다 보겠네…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 41, skip = true })

	-- 남자 영혼2 : 걱정 돼서 왔더니 뭐 이런 놈이 다 있어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(man_soul, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 42, skip = true })

	-- 남자 영혼 퇴장
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(man_soul
	, {
				man_soul.Position - vector(0, 0, 2.5),
				man_soul.Position - vector(13, 0, 2.5),
			}
	, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	local pos = field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. 2).position
	character_util.set_direction(man_soul, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(man_soul)
	character_util.set_position(man_soul, pos + vector(2.5, 0, 1))

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'attack' })

	party_util.align_party(boy_soul.Position, 'left', 1.5, 'arc')
	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party.Leader })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 야, 내가 언제 남자를 데려오랬어!
	character_util.set_anim(boy_soul, { name = 'cast' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 43, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 예쁜 누나들을 데려오란 말이야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_anim(boy_soul, { name = 'hold_loop' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 44, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 여기서 기다리고 있을 테니까 이번엔 꼭 제대로 데려와. 알았어?
	character_util.remove_anim(boy_soul)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 45, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 으아아앙~!!!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'cry' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 46, skip = true })

	self.current_state = self.quest_state.request_young_boy
	self.is_send_man = true
end

--region 여자 영혼들 이벤트

-- 여자 영혼들에게  말을 걸었을 경우
function local_class:interact_womans_soul(interact_womans_soul)
	party_util.align_party(interact_womans_soul.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	local choose_result = self:show_default_choose()
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	local woman_souls = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local woman_soul = self.get_woman_soul(i)
		character_util.set_direction(woman_soul, 'right')
		table.insert(woman_souls, woman_soul)
	end

	-- 여자 영혼1 : 어머나… 가엾기도 하지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[1], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[1], { key = self.string_key .. 32, skip = true })

	-- 여자 영혼2 : 엄마를 잃어버린 걸까?
	character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[2], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[2], { key = self.string_key .. 33, skip = true })

	-- 여자 영혼3 : 우리가 가서 돌봐주자!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[3], { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[3], { key = self.string_key .. 34, skip = true })

	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.remove_emotion(woman_souls[i])
	end
	character_util.set_direction(woman_souls[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(woman_souls[2], 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(woman_souls[3], 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(woman_souls[1], { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(woman_souls[2], { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(woman_souls[3], { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.set_direction(woman_souls[i], 'right')
	end

	-- 여자 영혼1 : 알려주셔서 고마워요. 우리가 아이에게 가볼게요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[1], { key = self.string_key .. 35, skip = true })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[1]
		, { woman_souls[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), woman_souls[1].Position + vector(12, 0, 2)
				}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[2]
		, { woman_souls[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), woman_souls[2].Position + vector(12, 0, 2)
				}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[3]
		, { woman_souls[3].Position + vector(0, 0, 2), woman_souls[3].Position + vector(12, 0, 2)
				}, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')
	})

	--어린 아이 영혼 앞에 여자 영혼들 세팅
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
	local pos_x = boy_soul.Position.x - 1
	local pos_z = boy_soul.Position.z + 1
	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.set_position(woman_souls[i], vector(i == 2 and pos_x or pos_x + 0.5, 0, pos_z - (0.5 * i)))
	end

	self.current_state = self.quest_state.send_womans
end

-- 여자 영혼들을 보내고 어린 아이의 영혼쪽 존으로 이동시 재생되는 이벤트
function local_class:send_womans(boy_soul)
	self.current_state = self.quest_state.ending

	local woman_souls = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local woman_soul = self.get_woman_soul(i)
		table.insert(woman_souls, woman_soul)
	end

	-- 여자 영혼들이 아이 영혼을 달래주고 있다. 아이 영혼은 비열하게 웃으며 계속 우는 척 연기한다.

	-- 여자 영혼1 : 어머, 어떡해…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[1], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[1], { key = self.string_key .. 47, skip = true })

	-- 여자 영혼2 : 길을 잃은 거야? 엄마는 어딨니?
	character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[2], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[2], { key = self.string_key .. 48, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 히이잉… 엄마아아아~!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_cry_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
	character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'cry' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 50, skip = true
	, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 여자 영혼3 : 누나들이 재밌는 오리배 태워줄게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.set_emotion(woman_souls[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end
	character_util.set_anim(woman_souls[3], { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[3], { key = self.string_key .. 49, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 지, 진짜요? 헤헤…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 여자 영혼2 : 누나들이랑 재밌는 오리배 타러 가자~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(woman_souls[2], { key = self.string_key .. 51, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(woman_souls[3])
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 꼬마아이 여자 영혼 퇴장
	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.remove_emotion(woman_souls[i])
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(boy_soul)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[1]
		, { woman_souls[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
				, woman_souls[1].Position + vector(-5, 0, -2.5) }
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[2]
		, { woman_souls[2].Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
				, woman_souls[2].Position + vector(-5, 0, -2.5) }
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[3]
		, { woman_souls[3].Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
				, woman_souls[3].Position + vector(-5, 0, -2.5) }
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, boy_soul
		, { boy_soul.Position + vector(0, 0, -2.5)
				, boy_soul.Position + vector(-5, 0, -2.5) }
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
	})

	party_util.set_direction('left')

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[1]
		, woman_souls[1].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0)
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[2]
		, woman_souls[2].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0)
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, woman_souls[3]
		, woman_souls[3].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0)
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, boy_soul
		, boy_soul.Position + vector(-8, 0, 0)
		, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
	})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #woman_souls do
		character_util.set_active_state(woman_souls[i], 'disabled')
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(boy_soul, vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, boy_soul.Position.z)
	, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	party_util.set_direction('down')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 이봐. 도와줘서 고마워.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 52, skip = true })

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 이건 약속한 보답.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 53, skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	self:dispose_star_piece_effect()
	self:appear_star_piece(boy_soul.Position, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back)

	-- 꼬마 영혼 : 천국아 기다려라~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')
	character_util.set_direction(boy_soul, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'hold_loop' }, { name = 'dayagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 54, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(boy_soul)

	-- 어린 아이 영혼 퇴장
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(boy_soul, boy_soul.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 12
	, 5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)
end

--endregion

--region 험악한 여자 영혼 이벤트

-- 험악한 여자 영혼에게  말을 걸었을 경우
function local_class:interact_inclement_woman_soul(inclement_womans_soul)
	party_util.align_party(inclement_womans_soul.Position, 'right', 0.5, 'arc')

	local choose_result = self:show_default_choose()
	if choose_result == 2 then
		return
	end

	-- 어머…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_womans_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 36, skip = true })

	-- 알겠어, 이 누나가 필요한 상황인거지?
	character_util.set_emotion(inclement_womans_soul, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_womans_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 37, skip = true })

	-- 지금 당장 누나가 갈께!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_womans_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 38, skip = true })

	self:shake_camera_walk_inclement_woman(12)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_womans_soul
	, {
				inclement_womans_soul.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
				inclement_womans_soul.Position + vector(15, 0, -1),
			}
	, 5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼을 어린 아이 앞으로 이동 및 어린아이 tired로 변경 및 shake
	local boy_soul = self.get_boy_soul()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.shake(boy_soul, 0.02, 9999)

	character_util.set_position(inclement_womans_soul, boy_soul.Position + unity_class.vector3.left)
	character_util.set_direction(inclement_womans_soul, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(inclement_womans_soul, { name = 'smile' })

	self.current_state = self.quest_state.send_inclement_woman
end

-- 험악한 여자 영혼을 보내고 어린 아이의 영혼쪽 존으로 이동시 재생되는 이벤트
function local_class:send_inclement_woman(boy_soul)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self.current_state = self.quest_state.ending
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local inclement_woman_soul = self.get_inclement_woman_soul()

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 어머! 귀엽기도 하지~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 59, skip = true })

	-- 아이 영혼 : 아…그…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 60, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 가엾어라… 엄마를 잃어버려서 떨고 있는 거니?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(inclement_woman_soul, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 61, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(inclement_woman_soul)

	-- 아이 영혼 : 아, 아니…괜찮….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 62, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 엄마를 찾기 전까진 누나가 같이 있어 줄게~
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 63, skip = true })

	-- 악한 여자 영혼 : 뭐 하고 놀아줘야 좋아하려나~?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 64, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 그래! 누나가 비행기 태워줄까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(inclement_woman_soul, { name = 'sing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 65, skip = true })

	-- 아이 영혼 : 비, 비행기요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, boy_soul, true))
	character_util.stop_shake(boy_soul)
	character_util.remove_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 66, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 nodx2
	character_util.remove_anim(inclement_woman_soul)
	character_util.nod_twice(inclement_woman_soul)

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 자~ 비행기 날아간다!
	character_util.set_emotion(inclement_woman_soul, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 67, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(inclement_woman_soul)

	-- 아이 영혼 들어 올린다.
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 1, 0.3, nil)
	camera_util.move(inclement_woman_soul.Position, 0.3)
	command_util.execute_holdup(inclement_woman_soul, boy_soul, inclement_woman_soul.Position)

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 슈웅!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(boy_soul, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 68, force_sfx = true })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(inclement_woman_soul)

	-- 아이 영혼 : 히이익! 도, 도와줘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boy_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 69, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 깜찍한 것. 누나랑 재밌게 놀자~ 우훗!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(inclement_woman_soul, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 70, skip = true })

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(boy_soul.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 0.5, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼, 방 끝에서 얼굴을 빼꼼 내밀곤 아이를 구할 수 있게 도와줘서 고맙다며 스타피스를 준다. 이벤트 종료.
	self:shake_camera_walk_inclement_woman(14)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_woman_soul
	, {
				inclement_woman_soul.Position - vector(0, 0, 2.5),
				inclement_woman_soul.Position - vector(5, 0, 2.5), }
	, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	party_util.set_direction('left')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_woman_soul,
			inclement_woman_soul.Position - vector(8, 0, 0)
	, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	-- 어린애 내려놓는다.
	character_util.release_hold_object(inclement_woman_soul, boy_soul)
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.set_active_state(boy_soul, 'disabled')

	self:shake_camera_walk_inclement_woman(9)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_woman_soul, vector(user_party.Leader.Position.x, 0, inclement_woman_soul.Position.z)
	, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	party_util.set_direction('down')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 참! 아이를 구할 수 있게 도와줘서 고마워요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 71, skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	self:appear_star_piece(inclement_woman_soul.Position, user_party.Leader.Position + unity_class.vector3.back)

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 : 여기 답례. 그럼 난 이만!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 72, skip = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼(좌측으로 달려가면서) : 꼬마야~ 기다리렴!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(inclement_woman_soul, { key = self.string_key .. 73, life_time = 1
	, force_sfx = true })

	-- 험악한 여자 영혼 달려서 퇴장
	self:shake_camera_walk_inclement_woman(10)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(inclement_woman_soul,
			inclement_woman_soul.Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 10
	, 5, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 1, false, false, false, false)
end

-- 험악한 여자 이동할 때 카메라 쉐이크 연출용 함수
function local_class:shake_camera_walk_inclement_woman(count)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		for _ = 1, count do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
			wait_for_sec(0.25)
		end
	end))
end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.stage_name = 'nightmare_titantavern_1'

	self.zone_1 = 'bug_chase_goal'
	self.zone_2 = 'bug_chase_zone'

	self.princess = nil
	self.herdboy = nil
	self.player_bug = nil

	self.ranch_bug_list = {}
	self.goal = {}

	self.cheerleading_pos = vector(83,0,-11.5)
	self.ranch_num = 22
	self.time_given = 30

	self.goal_count = 0
	self.move_count = 0

	self.reset = false

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		mission = 2,
		fail = 3,
		clear = 4,
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	self:setting()

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 0 then
		-- 수락한 직후
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beginning, self))
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.mission
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.herdboy ~= nil then
		if self.herdboy.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
			self.herdboy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
			self.herdboy.Interactable.Talk = 'herdboy_success_3'
		end
		self.herdboy = nil
	end
	self.princess = nil


	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) then
		self:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	end
	return false
end
------

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.herdboy) then
		if not self.seen_beginning then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beginning, self))
			--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_me, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.progress_enum.mission then
		return
	end


	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name
	for i=1, self.ranch_num do
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character('ranch_bug_'..i)) then
			if zone_name == self.zone_1 then
				self.goal_count = self.goal_count + 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.goal_land, self, i))
				if self.goal_count == self.ranch_num then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mission_success, self)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.mission then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject,self.player_bug) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_2 then
				-- 퀘스트 중도포기
				self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.fail
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.retire, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.IsComplete and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.mission then
		if self.goal_count < self.ranch_num then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.fail
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mission_fail, self))
		end
	end
end

------

function local_class:beginning()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	self.seen_beginning = true
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.herdboy.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		self.herdboy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	party_util.align_to_target(self.herdboy, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')
	--목동, smile, idle, right,  자세한 건 목장에서 얘기해줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_5', skip = true})
	--목동, smile, idle, right, 어서 가자!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_6', skip = true})
	--Fade in/Fade out
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_flight', state = 'event', mix = 2})
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	-- 이벤트 지역으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.player_bug, self.bombbug_ranch_pos-vector(0,2.5,0), false)
	character_util.set_position(self.herdboy, self.cheerleading_pos)

	-- 플레이어 탑승 전 UI 복구
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
	-- 탑승
	message_system:SendSync(self.player_bug, CS.Oak.InteractEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, self.player_bug))
	character_util.set_direction(self.player_bug, 'right')
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.resize_to(7, 0.3)
	camera_util.move(self.player_bug.Position,0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 이 시점에서 무언가가 transform.localPosition 에러 2개 띄움
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	--시작 지점에서 둘다 폭탄 벌레를 탑승 한 채로 시작

	camera_util.move_async(self.herdboy.Position,1)
	--목동, idle, idle, right 여기야!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.herdboy)
	character_util.set_direction(self.herdboy, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_9', skip = true, scale = 2})
	--목동, idle, idle, right 목장에서 키우는 폭탄 벌레들이라 목장을 벗어나지는 않을꺼야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_10', skip = true, scale = 2})
	--목동, idle, idle, right 우리를 보면 반대쪽으로 도망 갈테니…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_11', skip = true, scale = 2})
	--목동, idle, idle, right 사육장 쪽으로 잘 몰아보자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_12', skip = true, scale = 2})

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.mission
	self:bug_chase()


end

function local_class:cheer_line()
	-- 응원 대사
	character_util.set_direction(self.herdboy, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.herdboy, {name = 'cast2', loop = true}, {name = 'awesome'})
	while true do
		local num = random_util.get_random_int(1,3)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_cheer_'..num, scale = 2})
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end
end

function local_class:bug_chase()
	self.reset = false

	--목동, idle, idle, right 부모님이 오시기 전에 말이야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_13', skip = true, scale = 2})
	--목동, idle, idle, right 자! 출발!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.herdboy, {key = 'herdboy_14', skip = true, scale = 2})

	camera_util.move_async(self.player_bug.Position,0.5, {end_target = self.player_bug})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	for i = 1, self.ranch_num do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.run_away, self, self.ranch_bug_list[i],i))
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_timer, self))
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.herdboy.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable)) then
		self.herdboy.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack)
	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)
end

function local_class:goal_land(i)
	self.goal[i] = true
	local bug = self.ranch_bug_list[i]
	character_util.move_to_async(bug,self.goal_pos[i],nil,5,true,false,false)
	character_util.set_direction(bug, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(bug, bug.Position, false)
	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'idle' })
end

function local_class:run_away(bug, num)
	-- 여기서 bug 는 각 폭탄 벌레 이다
	local range = 6.5
	local dir_princess = vector (100,0,100)
	while true do
		local fos = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(bug.Position, range)
		for k, v in pairs(fos) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, self.player_bug) then
				dir_princess = bug.Position - self.player_bug.Position
			end
		end
		fos:Dispose()
		-- 대상이 보이면
		if dir_princess.magnitude <= range then
			if not self.goal[num] then
				-- 도망간다
				character_util.set_direction(bug, dir_princess:ToDirection())
				local scalar = 2 * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local dir = dir_princess.normalized
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(bug, vector(dir.x,0,0).normalized, math.abs(dir.x)*scalar)
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(bug, vector(0,0,dir.z).normalized, math.abs(dir.z)*scalar)
			end
		end
		if self.goal[num] or self.reset then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:retire()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	-- 중도 포기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	if self.goal_count == self.ranch_num then return end
	--실패 시
	self:end_timer()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self.reset = true
	self.seen_beginning = false
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.herdboy)
	self.herdboy.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	-- 탑승 방지를 위해 위치 변경
	local bug = get_character('hiding_bug')
	character_util.set_position(bug, vector(1, 0, -6.5))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.set_position(self.player_bug, self.herdboy_pos + vector(5,2.5,0), true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player_bug, 'left')

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.wanted_man)
	character_util.align_party(self.wanted_man, "left")
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:first_met_talk())

	local wait = true
	local ask_weather = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(string.format("%s%d", self.branch_name2, 3 + self.weather_count)),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			ask_weather = true
			wait = false
			self.weather_count = self.weather_count + 1
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.wanted_man, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if ask_weather then
		coroutine.yield(lua_helper.call_nullable(self.controller.scene, string.format("%s%d",
				"first_met_talk_", self.weather_count), self.controller.scene))

		if self.weather_count <= 2 then
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.wanted_man)
			user_party:ResetControllers()
		else
			coroutine.yield(self:found_wanted_man())
		end
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk2())
		coroutine.yield(self:found_wanted_man())
	end
end

end

	self.wanted_man.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.bounty_man = nil
	self.wanted_man = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bounty_man) then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.bounty_man, {key = self.talk_name1})

			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

			if self.is_revive_party then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.battle_init, self))
			else
				self.is_revive_party = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
						self.battle_init, self))
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.battle_finish, self))

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:battle_init()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.wanted_man)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local dir = (user_party_leader.Position - self.wanted_man.Position):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(self.wanted_man, dir)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk3())

	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.wanted_man, self.battle_group_name, self.zone_name)
	character_util.set_death_type(self.wanted_man, "prostrate")

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.wanted_man, user_party_leader, "battle")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:battle_finish()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.wanted_man)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk4())

	local wait = true
	local mercy = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			mercy = true
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.wanted_man, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if mercy then
		--coroutine.yield(coroutine_class:Coroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
		--		self.mercy_talk_branch, self)))
		coroutine.yield(self:mercy_talk_branch())

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

		coroutine.yield(quest_util.progress_section(self.controller))
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	else
		coroutine.yield(self:brutal_clear())
	end
end

function local_class:brutal_clear()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.bounty_man)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk5())

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(true))

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))
end

function local_class:show_effect()
	self.fx_hit:Instantiate(self.wanted_man.Position)
end

function local_class:mercy_talk_branch()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:after_mercy())

	local wait = true
	local second_mercy = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name3),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name4),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			second_mercy = true
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.wanted_man, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if second_mercy then
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:mercy_end())
	else
		coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:mercy_end2())
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

		return true
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

		, util.cs_generator(self.dead_brother, self))
		return true
	end
	return false

			or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

		return true

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_23' })

	local bicycle_boy = get_character('bicycle_boy')

	while true do
	-- 조, 이것봐 내가 자전거를 구해왔어!
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_17' })

	-- 너 이거 꼭 타고 싶다고 했잖아!
	character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_18' })

	-- 응?
	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_19' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)


		-- 조, 왜 아까부터 말이 없어?
		character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'push', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_20' })

		-- 장난 그만해.
		character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_21' })

		-- 대답 좀 해봐.
		character_util.remove_emotion(bicycle_boy)
		character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_22' })

		wait_for_sec(4)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

	local bicycle_boy = get_character('bicycle_boy')
	party_util.align_party(bicycle_boy.Position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_1', skip = true })

		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'release', count = 3, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })

	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_5', skip = true })

	-- 제가 돈 모아서 사주려구요!
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_6', skip = true })

	-- 마음이 행복해지면 분명 몸의 병도 나을 거에요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_7', skip = true })

	self.saw_talk = true

	local is_accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)

	if is_accepted then
		floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party.Leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
		yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	else
		self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.waypoint_moive_boy, self))
	end

	if self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine ~= nil then
		stop_coroutine(self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine)
		self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= 'steampunk_1_3' then
		return true
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bicycle_boy')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_bicycle_boy, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('bicycle_interact')) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.controller.pick_up_bicycle, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 소년과의 대화
function local_class:talk_bicycle_boy()
	stop_coroutine(self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine)
	self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine = nil

	local bicycle_boy = get_character('bicycle_boy')
	party_util.align_party(bicycle_boy.Position, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	character_util.remove_emotion(bicycle_boy)
	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)

	-- 자전거를 습득했는지
	if not stage_progress:GetCustomData(0) then
		character_util.look_at(bicycle_boy, user_party.Leader)
		-- ...동생이 이곳에 온 후 많이 아파요..
		character_util.remove_emotion(bicycle_boy)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_4', skip = true })

		-- 맨날 상점가에 자전거를 보며 타고 싶다고 했었는데..
		character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_5', skip = true })

		-- 제가 돈 모아서 사주려구요!
		character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_6', skip = true })

		-- 마음이 행복해지면 분명 몸의 병도 나을 거에요!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_7', skip = true })

		self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.waypoint_moive_boy, self))
		return
	else
		-- 아, 안녕하세요 선생님!
		character_util.look_at(bicycle_boy, user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_1', skip = true })
	end

	local wait_for_branch = true
	local next_check = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 자전거를 넘겨준다
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('boy_bicycle_talk_8'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			next_check = true
		end })

	-- 그만둔다
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('boy_bicycle_talk_9'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(bicycle_boy, branches)

	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 그만둔다를 선택한 경우
	if not next_check then
		self.waypoint_moive_boy_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.waypoint_moive_boy, self))
		return
	end

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	local bicycle = get_character('bicycle_1')
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_position(bicycle, user_party.Leader.Position)
	character_util.jump(bicycle, 1.0, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(bicycle, bicycle_boy.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(bicycle.Position)
	character_util.set_position(bicycle, vector(999, 0, 999))

	CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(bicycle_boy):JustPrintItemName(
			game_string:GetString('boy_bicycle_talk_0'), 0)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_get_drop_item_01')

	-- 이, 이건…!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(bicycle_boy)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_10', skip = true })

	-- 정말로 이걸 그냥 주시는거에요?!
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_11', skip = true })

	-- 리더 고개를 끄덕임
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	-- 저, 정말 고마워요 선생님…!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_12', skip = true })

	-- 이거 큰 보상은 되진 않겠지만..
	character_util.set_emotion(bicycle_boy, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_13', skip = true })

	-- 고철더미 안에서 주은 거에요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_14', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 등장
	local star_piece = get_field_object('bicycle_star_piece')
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(bicycle_boy.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 동생이 정말 좋아할거에요!
	character_util.set_anim(bicycle_boy, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_15', skip = true })

	-- 그 녀석 얼마나 기뻐할까..!!
	character_util.remove_emotion(bicycle_boy)
	character_util.remove_anim(bicycle_boy)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bicycle_boy, { key = 'boy_bicycle_talk_16', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(bicycle_boy, bicycle_boy.Position + vector(0, 0, 4), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bicycle_boy, 0, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(bicycle_boy, vector(-22.5, 0, 70), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_position(bicycle_boy, vector(94, 0, -36))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CafeFrozenThronePreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 얼어붙은 왕좌
	self.get_frozen = function() return get_field_object('frozen_throne') end

	-- 화로
	self.get_torch = function() return get_field_object('throne_torch') end

	-- 아서스, 우서, 제이나

	self.get_uther = function() return get_character('uther') end
	self.get_jaina = function() return get_character('jaina') end

	-- 이벤트 시작 zone 이름

	self.started = false
	self.moved_on = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PushStartEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PushStartEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name and not self.started then
			self.started = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.begin_quest, self))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.begin_quest_check, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end


-- 매 명령 마다 코루틴 종료 조건 확인. StopCoroutine() 안쓰고 좀더 단순한 방식 없는지 나중에 알아보기
function local_class:begin_quest()
	local jaina = self:get_jaina()
	local uther = self:get_uther()

	character_util.set_direction(uther, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'up')

	if self.moved_on then return end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(uther, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 제이너, 이 얼어붙은 의자…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(uther, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_1', skip = false})

	if self.moved_on then return end
	-- 이 사람, 옛날 어느 왕국의 왕자였다고 하더군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(uther, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_2', skip = false})

	if self.moved_on then return end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jaina, { name = 'nod' }, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 우더, 저도 그 얘기를 들은 적이 있어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jaina, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_3', skip = false})

	if self.moved_on then return end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jaina, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 악마를 멸하겠다는 명분으로 자신의 백성들을 직접 학살하고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jaina, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_4', skip = false})

	if self.moved_on then return end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jaina, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 결국엔 미쳐버려 자신의 아버지, 왕까지 죽여버렸다고 하더군요…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(jaina, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_5', skip = false})

	if self.moved_on then return end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(uther, { name = 'cast'}, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 지옥에 이 자를 위한 특별한 자리가 마련되어 있기를…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(uther, { key = 'cafe_1_4_frozen_throne_6', skip = false})
	if self.moved_on then return end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(uther)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jaina)
end

function local_class:begin_quest_check()
	local throne = self:get_frozen()
	local arthas = self:get_arthas()
	local uther = self:get_uther()
	local jaina = self:get_jaina()

	self.firstmove = true
	local arthas_prev_pos = arthas.Position

	while true do
		if arthas_prev_pos ~= throne.Position and self.firstmove and throne.Position ~= self.controller.original_position then
			self.firstmove = false
			self.moved_on = true

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(uther)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jaina)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(uther)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(jaina)

			character_util.set_direction(uther, 'down')
			character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'up')

			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' } )
			character_util.normal_jump(uther)
			character_util.normal_jump(jaina)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(uther, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jaina, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })

			character_util.move_to(uther, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.2, nil, nil, nil)
			character_util.move_to_async(jaina, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.2, nil, nil, nil)

			yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
			break
		end
		arthas_prev_pos = arthas.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	return
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CafeFrozenThroneSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 얼어붙은 왕좌
	self.get_frozen = function() return get_field_object('frozen_throne') end

	-- 화로
	self.get_torch = function() return get_field_object('throne_torch') end

	-- 아서스, 우서, 제이나
	self.get_arthas = function() return get_character('arthas') end
	self.get_uther = function() return get_character('uther') end
	self.get_jaina = function() return get_character('jaina') end

	-- 스타피스
	self.star_piece_name = 'frozen_throne_starpiece'

	self.melt_talk_flag = false
	self.uther_talk_flag = false
	self.jaina_talk_flag = false
	self.first = false
	self.second = false

	self.melt_zone_name = 'ice_melt_zone'
	self.uther_zone_name = 'uther_zone'
	self.jaina_zone_name = 'jaina_zone'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.controller.firstmove then self.first = true end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.follow_player, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		local throne = self:get_frozen()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, throne) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.jaina_zone_name and not self.jaina_talk_flag then
				--self.jaina_talk_flag = true
				--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.jaina_talk, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.uther_zone_name and not self.uther_talk_flag then
				--self.uther_talk_flag = true
				--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.uther_talk, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.melt_zone_name and not self.melt_talk_flag then
				self.melt_talk_flag = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.melt_ice, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	--[[
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushStartEvent) and not self.first then
		local throne = self:get_frozen()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, throne) then
			self.first = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_scene, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PushEndEvent) and not self.second then
		local throne = self:get_frozen()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, throne) then
			self.second = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.jaina_surprise, self))
			return true
		end
		--]]
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:follow_player()
	local uther = self:get_uther()
	local jaina = self:get_jaina()
	local arthas = self:get_arthas()
	local throne = self:get_frozen()
	local torch = self:get_torch()

	local arthas_prev_pos = arthas.Position
	local reset = false
	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if self.melt_talk_flag then
			break
		end
		if throne.Position == self.controller.original_position and reset then
			reset = false
			if not self.uther_talk_flag then
				character_util.move_to(uther, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.4, nil, true, false)
				character_util.set_direction(uther, 'down')
			end
			if not self.jaina_talk_flag then
				character_util.move_to(jaina, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.4, nil, true, false)
				character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'up')
			end
			if not self.uther_talk_flag or not self.jaina_talk_flag then wait_for_sec(0.405) end
		elseif self.first then
			if arthas_prev_pos ~= throne.Position and throne.Position ~= self.controller.original_position then
				reset = true
				if not self.uther_talk_flag then
					uther.Position = unity_class.vector3(arthas.Position.x, 0, uther.Position.z)
					jaina.Position = unity_class.vector3(arthas.Position.x, 0, jaina.Position.z)

					character_util.set_direction(uther, 'down')
					character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'up')

					if (arthas.Position - torch.Position).magnitude < 4.5 then
						self.uther_talk_flag = true
						yield_return_func(sp_util.play_normal_screenplay, self.uther_talk, self)
					end
				elseif self.uther_talk_flag and not self.jaina_talk_flag then
					jaina.Position = unity_class.vector3(arthas.Position.x, 0, jaina.Position.z)

					character_util.look_at(uther, user_party.Leader)
					character_util.set_direction(jaina, 'up')

					if (arthas.Position - torch.Position).magnitude < 2.5 then
						self.jaina_talk_flag = true
						yield_return_func(sp_util.play_normal_screenplay, self.jaina_talk, self)
					end
				elseif not self.melt_talk_flag then
					character_util.look_at(uther, user_party.Leader)
					character_util.look_at(jaina, user_party.Leader)
				end
			end
		elseif arthas_prev_pos ~= throne.Position and throne.Position ~= self.controller.original_position and not self.jaina_talk_flag then
			self.first = true
			reset = true

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(uther)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(jaina)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(uther)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(jaina)

			character_util.look_at(uther, user_party.Leader)
			character_util.look_at(jaina, user_party.Leader)

			music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' } )
			character_util.normal_jump(uther)
			character_util.normal_jump(jaina)

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if not self.uther_talk_flag then character_util.move_to(uther, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.forward, 0.2, nil, nil, nil) end
			if not self.jaina_talk_flag then character_util.move_to(jaina, arthas.Position + 1.2 * unity_class.vector3.back, 0.2, nil, nil, nil) end
			wait_for_sec(0.25)

			character_util.look_at(uther, user_party.Leader)
			character_util.look_at(jaina, user_party.Leader)
			if not self.jaina_talk_flag then music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '03_runaway_01' } )	end
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(uther, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(jaina, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		end
		arthas_prev_pos = arthas.Position
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

local local_class = newclass('CafeLoveDollPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 부품들
	self.get_parts = function()
		return self.controller:get_parts()
	end

	-- 남자
	self.get_man = function() return get_character('lovedoll_man') end
	self.started = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	local man = self:get_man()
	man.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	character_util.set_emotion(man, { name = 'tired' })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pre_event_speech_bubble, self))
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local man = self:get_man()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(man.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		man.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local man = self:get_man()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, man) then
			self.started = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_start, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:quest_start()
	local man = self:get_man()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.align_to_target(man, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	character_util.set_anim(man, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 저기, 나 좀 도와주지 않겠나?

	-- 부탁이야! 제발 우리 제시카를 구해줘!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_4', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'question' , loop = false})
	-- 납치? / 경찰에 신고해야죠!
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'cafe_lovedoll_5', 'brutal' }, { 'cafe_lovedoll_6', 'intellect' } }, 'release' )

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(man, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'tired' })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 어… 제시카는 사람이 아닌데.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_7', skip = true })
	else
		-- 그건 조금 그런게…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_8', skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(man, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'blush' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' } )
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' } )

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party[i], 'left')
		local tmp = user_party[i].Position
		character_util.move_to(user_party[i], tmp + 1 * unity_class.vector3.right, nil, 3, false, true )

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_10', skip = true })

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party[i], 'none')
	end
	party_util.align_to_target(man, 'right', 0.5, 'linear')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(man, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'love' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '01_gatcha_point_01' } )
	camera_util.resize_to(stage_camera:GetDefaultSize() - 0.4, 0.5, nil)
	-- 그녀의 쭉 뻗은 다리! 그 각선미에 난 사랑에 빠지고 말았어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_11', skip = true })

	-- 매끈한 피부에선 눈부시게 광채가 나서 쳐다보지도 못 할 정도야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(man, { key = 'cafe_lovedoll_13', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx( { sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01' } )
	-- 그녀와의 첫날 밤을 잊을 수 없군. 그땐 나도 참 서툴렀지.

function local_class:pre_event_speech_bubble()
	local man = self:get_man()
	repeat

	--]]
end

-- 아이언 티탄 걷는 함수. IronTeatans.March() 참조
function local_class:ironteatan_move(wps, speed, angular_speed, playerjump)
	local getcomponent_generic = xlua.get_generic_method(CS.UnityEngine.GameObject, 'GetComponent')
	local getcomponent_anim = getcomponent_generic(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)

	local animator = getcomponent_anim(self.controller.iron_teatans.gameObject)
	yield_return(animator, 'SetBool', 'walk', true)

	---[[
	local tmp = CS.Oak.SfxInfo()
	tmp.sfxName = '02_iron_teatan_walk_01'
	tmp.loop = true
	tmp.typePriority = CS.Oak.SfxTypePriority.Event
	tmp.playerPriority = CS.Oak.SfxPlayerPriority.Npc
	local audioSourceHolder = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance:PlaySfx(tmp)
	--]]

	local walker = 0;
	local currentPoint = self.controller.iron_teatans.Position
	local nextPoint = wps[walker]
	local radSpeed = math.rad(angular_speed)
	while true do
		local moveSfxOnce = false
		local currentDir = CS.UnityEngine.Quaternion.AngleAxis(self.controller.iron_teatans.YAngle, unity_class.vector3.up) * unity_class.vector3.forward

		local dir = (nextPoint - currentPoint)
		local distance = dir.magnitude
		dir:Normalize()
		if not moveSfxOnce then
			moveSfxOnce = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_iron_teatan_head_turn_01' })
		end
		---[[
		while not currentDir:AlmostCloseTo(dir) do
			currentDir = unity_class.vector3.RotateTowards(currentDir, dir, radSpeed * CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime, 0)
			local rad = math.acos(-currentDir.x * 0.9999)
			if currentDir.z < 0 then
				rad = rad * -1
			end
			if rad == nil then
				CS.Debug.LogError('Acos returned NaN: ' + currentDir.ToString('F3'))
			end

			self.controller.iron_teatans:SetYAngle(math.deg(rad) - 90)

			-- IronTeatans.UpdateRotation() 에서 스케일을 바꿔서 어쩔수가 없음
			local teatanman = self.controller.iron_teatans.MainSpine
			if teatanman.gameObject.transform.parent.localScale.x < 0 then
				local tmp =  unity_class.vector3(1,1,1)
				teatanman.gameObject.transform.parent.localScale = tmp
				teatanman.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
--]]

		local duration = distance / speed
		local timePassed = 0
		local wholesecs = 0.25

		local first = true

		while (timePassed < duration) do
			if timePassed > wholesecs then
				wholesecs = wholesecs + 1.05
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)
				party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

				local teatanman = self.controller.iron_teatans.MainSpine
				if teatanman.gameObject.transform.parent.localScale.x < 0 then
					local tmp =  unity_class.vector3(1,1,1)
					teatanman.gameObject.transform.parent.localScale = tmp
					teatanman.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
				end

				if playerjump then
					-- party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)
					if first then
						first = false
						party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
						camera_util.resize_to(CS.Oak.IronTeatans.MarchCameraSize, 3)
					end
				end
			end
			timePassed = timePassed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

			local progress = math.min(1, timePassed / duration)
			self.controller.iron_teatans.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(currentPoint, nextPoint, progress)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		walker = walker + 1
		if walker >= wps.Count then break end

		currentPoint = wps[walker - 1]
		nextPoint = wps[walker]
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	audioSourceHolder:FadeOut(0.1)
	yield_return(animator, 'SetBool', 'walk', false)
end

return local_class

		---
		color = nil,
		---
		gradient = nil
	}

	self.is_blizzard_active = false
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	self.is_in_lupina_zone = false

	self.is_idling = false

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	local lupina = get_character('lupina')

	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

		lupina = get_character('lupina')

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee

		damage_info.target = hit_info.target

		local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, vector(1, 0, 0), 8500, 0.1, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party.Leader, knockback_info);
