	self.preset.blizzard = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Blizzard")
	self.preset.blizzard_fade = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Screen_Blizzard_Cloud")

	-- particle system 조정에 쓰일 gradient 생성
	-- stage 진행 중 생성할 경우 끊기는 현상이 발생해, 미리 생성
	self.fade.gradient = CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient(unity_class.color.black)

	self:setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self:blizzard_dispose()
	self.blizzard = nil
	self.fade.gradient = nil
	self.fade = nil

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end

	for key in pairs(self.preset) do
		self.preset[key] = nil
	end
	self.preset = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.event_progress = nil
	self.recruit_progress = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_zone_enter_event, self, e))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_zone_leave_event, self, e))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_event, self, e))

	end

	return false
end


function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'lupina_recruit' then
				if self.recruit_progress < self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_open then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lupina_recruit_event_opening, self)
				end
			end
			if e.Zone.Name == 'blizzard_zone' then
				self.is_in_lupina_zone = true
				if self.recruit_progress == self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_on_blizzard, self, 0.4))
				end
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_field_object('school_brazier')) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'lupina_entrance' then
				if e.FieldObject.CombustibleBehaviour.IsBurning and self.recruit_progress == self.event_progress.none then
					self.recruit_progress = self.event_progress.entrance
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.entrance_melting, self))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'blizzard_zone' then
				self.is_in_lupina_zone = false
				if self.recruit_progress == self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.turn_ofF_blizzard, self, false))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end


function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local lupina = get_character('lupina')
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, lupina) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lupina_recruit_event_clear, self)
	end
end

function local_class:setting()
	self.is_idling = true
	for i = 1, 12 do
		local victim = get_character(self.lupina_victim_name .. i)
		character_util.set_direction(victim, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(victim, {name = 'cross_arm', upper =  true})
		character_util.set_emotion(victim, {name = 'blush'})

		if i > 6 and i ~= 7 and i ~= 11 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.idling, self, victim))
		end
		if i == 6 or i == 8 or i == 10 then
			-- coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mumbling, self, victim, i))
		end
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do

function local_class:entrance_melting()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_02')
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local blocker = get_character(self.lupina_blocker_name .. i)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			blocker.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(blocker, {name = 'unique/ice_end', count = 1})
			blocker.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(blocker, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
			if i == 2 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(blocker, {key = self.lupina_entrance_talk_name .. 1})
			end
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim(blocker)
			character_util.set_emotion(blocker, {name = 'scared'})
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(blocker, {
				vector(5, 0, -67),
				vector(13 + i, 0, -67)
			}, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
			character_util.set_anim(blocker, {name = 'hurt'})
			if i == 2 then character_util.set_direction(blocker, 'left') end
			character_util.shake(blocker, 0.03, 9999)
			blocker.Interactable.Talk = self.lupina_entrance_talk_name .. 2
			blocker.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
		end))
	end
end

function local_class:lupina_recruit_event_storm_setting()

	local lupina = get_character('lupina')

	if self.recruit_progress >= self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm then
		return
	end
	self.recruit_progress = self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm

	-- 오른쪽으로 프로젝타일 발사하기 시작.
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(user_party_leader, {key="lupina 리쿠르트 이벤트 프로젝타일 발사", skip = true})
	character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'right')

	while self.recruit_progress == self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm do

		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(lupina, {name = 'staff_attack', count = 1})
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(lupina.Bounds.center, vector(1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_anim(lupina, {name = 'staff_cast'})
		if self.recruit_progress ~= self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_storm then
			break
		end
		wait_for_sec(1.3)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 루피나에게 인터랙트하면 종료

	if self.recruit_progress == self.event_progress.lupina_recruit_clear then
		--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("lupina recruit_clear")
		return
	end

end

function local_class:turn_on_blizzard(value)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_blizzard_active and self.is_in_lupina_zone then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		--- blizzard start
		self:blizzard_start()

		stage.BuffManager:AddBuff(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
				user_party.Leader, self.blizzard_buff, 0, false, false)

		self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2, type_priority = "event", player_priority = "player"
		})
		local fade_time = 0.3
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

		local mult = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, 0.4)

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fade_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * mult

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

function local_class:turn_ofF_blizzard(force)
	while self.is_blizzard_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	local cond = not self.is_in_lupina_zone
	if force then
		cond = true
	end
	if self.is_blizzard_active and cond then
		self.is_blizzard_changing = true
		--- flag set
		self.is_blizzard_active = false

		music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'field', mix = 2})
		--- blizzard inner param refresh
		self:blizzard_color_refresh()

		stage.BuffManager:RemoveBuff(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, user_party_leader, self.blizzard_buff)

		local fade_time = 0.4
		if force then
			fade_time = 1
		end

		local wait_time = fade_time + 1.5
		--local remove_buff_time = 1.5
		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		--local remove_buff = false

		self.blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil

		--- blizzard update
		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_time do
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / fade_time, 0) * 0.4

			self:blizzard_update(progress)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if unity_class.time.time - cur_time > fade_time and self.is_in_lupina_zone and not force then
				break
			end
		end

		--- blizzard dispose
		self:blizzard_dispose()
		self.is_blizzard_changing = false
	end
end

--- blizzard 이펙트 셋업
function local_class:blizzard_start(args)
	if self.blizzard == nil or self.fade == nil then return end
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil or self.fade.obj ~= nil then return end

	local with_fade = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'with_fade', true)
	local alpha = lua_helper.get_value(args, 'alpha', -1)
	local custom_alpha = false

	if not float_util.almost_close_to(alpha, -1) then
		custom_alpha = true
	end

	local camera = stage_camera

	self.blizzard.obj = self.preset.blizzard:Instantiate(
			camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 5, 10), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
	self.blizzard.material = self.blizzard.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
			typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer)).material

	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	local target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.blizzard.color.a * 0.2

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, target_alpha }))

	if with_fade then
		self.fade.obj = self.preset.blizzard_fade:Instantiate(
				camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.fade.main_module = self.fade.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color

		target_alpha = custom_alpha and alpha or self.fade.color.a * 0.2

		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, target_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_lerp(from, to, duration)

	self.is_blizzard_changing = true
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local tint = from

	--- blizzard update
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Max((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration, 0)
		tint = from + (to - from) * progress

		self:blizzard_update(tint)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.is_blizzard_changing = false
end
function local_class:blizzard_update(alpha, fade_alpha)
	if fade_alpha == nil then
		fade_alpha = alpha
	end

	self.blizzard.material:SetColor(self.property_name, unity_color(
			{ self.blizzard.color.r, self.blizzard.color.g, self.blizzard.color.b, alpha }))

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, fade_alpha })

		self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:blizzard_fade_max()
	if self.fade.obj == nil then return end

	self.fade.gradient.color = unity_color({ self.fade.color.r, self.fade.color.g, self.fade.color.b, 1 })

	self.fade.main_module.startColor = self.fade.gradient
end

function local_class:blizzard_color_refresh()
	self.blizzard.color = self.blizzard.material:GetColor(self.property_name)

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.color = self.fade.main_module.startColor.color
	end
end

--- 눈보라 관련 이펙트 dispose
function local_class:blizzard_dispose()
	if self.blizzard.obj ~= nil then
		self.blizzard.material = nil
		self.blizzard.color = nil
		self.blizzard.obj:Dispose()
		self.blizzard.obj = nil
	end

	if self.fade.obj ~= nil then
		self.fade.main_module = nil
		self.fade.color = nil
		self.fade.obj:Dispose()
		self.fade.obj = nil
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)

		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, michael) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.we_are_magic_michael, self)
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local dancer = self.get_dancer(i)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dancer) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.we_are_magic_michael, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.swipe_type = 'left'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
		self.swipe_type = 'right'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.swipe_type = 'up'
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.swipe_type = 'down'
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_zone_enter_event, self, e))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) and e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_school_tint' then
			self.is_in_school = false
			field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.1)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.smoke_off, self, 0.5, false))
		end

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_event, self, e))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_field_object_destroyed_event, self, e))

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_damage_event, self, e))

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if e.FullEnter then

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			self:quest_marker(e.Zone.Name)
			if e.Zone.Name == 'escape_school' then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.students_escape_event, self))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_school_tint' then
				if not self.on_fire_first_enter then
					self.on_fire_first_enter = true
					music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = false, type_priority = 'event', fade_in_time = 1, fade_out_time = 1})
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_shout_02')
					get_field_object('defence_1').Position = get_field_object('defence_1').Position + vector(0, 0, -5)
					get_field_object('defence_2').Position = get_field_object('defence_2').Position + vector(0, 0, -5)
				end
				self.is_in_school = true
				field:Tint(nil, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), 0.1)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.smoke_on, self, 0.5))

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'g6' and self.g6_cnt == false then
				if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
					self.current_progress = self.event_progress.escape_student
					self.g6_cnt = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.g6, self))
				end


			end

		end


	end


end

	local yuze = get_character('yuze')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, yuze) then

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)

	if string.find(e.Info.target.Name, 'school_fire')
			and string.find(e.Info.sender.Name, 'water_pot') then
		if e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee or e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion then
			--CS.Debug.LogError(string.format("%s < %s", e.Info.target.Name, e.Info.sender.Name))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_extinguished, self, e.Info.target))
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:smoke_on(duration)
	while self.smoke_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_in_school then
		return
	end
	self.smoke_changing = true
	local timer = 0
	if self.school_smoke.obj == nil then
		local camera = stage_camera
		self.school_smoke.obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fire_smoke_right_view_weak_big'):Instantiate(
				stage_camera.transform.position + vector(-7, 0, 0), unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)
		self.school_smoke.main_module = self.school_smoke.obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
				typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main
		self.school_smoke.color = self.school_smoke.main_module.startColor.color

		self.school_smoke.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.school_smoke.color.r, self.school_smoke.color.g, self.school_smoke.color.b, 0.2 })

		self.school_smoke.main_module.startColor = self.school_smoke.gradient
		self.school_smoke.color = self.school_smoke.main_module.startColor.color
	end
	while timer < duration do
		self:smoke_update((timer / duration) * 0.2)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not self.is_in_school then
		self.smoke_changing = false
		return
	end
	if not self.is_in_school then
		self.smoke_changing = false
		return
	end
	self.smoke_changing = false
end

function local_class:smoke_off(duration, immediate)
	while self.smoke_changing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if self.is_in_school then
		return
	end
	self.smoke_changing = true

	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		self:smoke_update(unity_class.mathf.Max(1 - (timer / duration), 0) * 0.2)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	if not immediate then
		timer = 0
		while timer < 5 do
			if self.is_in_school then
				self.smoke_changing = false
				return
			end
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	if self.school_smoke.obj ~= nil then
		self.school_smoke.main_module = nil
		self.school_smoke.color = nil
		self.school_smoke.obj:Dispose()
		self.school_smoke.obj = nil
	end
	self.smoke_changing = false
end

function local_class:smoke_update(alpha)
	if self.school_smoke.obj ~= nil then
		self.school_smoke.gradient.color = unity_color(
				{ self.school_smoke.color.r, self.school_smoke.color.g, self.school_smoke.color.b, alpha })

		self.school_smoke.main_module.startColor = self.school_smoke.gradient
	end
end

function local_class:get_extinguished(fo)
	if self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.burning_school then return end
	self.fire_count = self.fire_count + 1
	if self.fire_count == 6 then
		user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	end
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 1
	local init_scale = fo.transform.localScale
	quest_marker_util.remove(fo.Name)
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		fo.transform.localScale = init_scale * (1 - (unity_class.time.time - cur_time))
		fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 0))
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	if self.fire_count == 6 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.burning_school_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_event, self, e))
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent) then

	end

        self:quest_marker(e.Zone.Name)

	end

function local_class:end_cafe_event()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	local yuze = get_character('yuze')
	local choice = 0

	character_util.align_party(yuze.Position, 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--어때, 이제 장사 시작할 준비 됐어?
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_14', skip = true })

	--선택지
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait_for_branch = true
	--네
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('cafe_s9_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 1
		end
	})
	--아니오
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('cafe_s9_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait_for_branch = false
			choice = 0
		end
	})
	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = yuze

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
	while wait_for_branch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)

	--선택지 준비 됐어?
	if choice == 1 then
		--좋아! 에밀리를 이기기 위해서는 매출이 {0}정기는 되어야 해.
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s13_1', self.target_score), skip = true })

		--영업 시작해 보자구!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s13_2', skip = true })

		--카페 운영 시작.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeStartEvent.Create(self.target_score))

	else
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, yuze)

		--인터랙트 종료.
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end


end

function local_class:quest_marker(nm)
    local yuze = get_character('yuze')
    if nm == 'cafe' then
        quest_marker_util.remove(yuze.Name)
        quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, yuze)
    else
        quest_marker_util.remove(yuze.Name)
        quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, vector(13.5, 0, -27))
    end
 end

function local_class:cafe_event_end(iscancelled, score)

	local yuze = get_character('yuze')

	if score >= self.target_score then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('yuze')

		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	elseif iscancelled then
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_20', skip = true })

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, yuze)

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()

	else
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/audio:bgm_world_map_06', state = 'event', mix = 1.5 })
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		--목표는 {0}정기였는데... {1}정기밖에 못 벌었어...
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s9_18', self.target_score, score), skip = true })

		--{0}정기가 부족했어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s9_19', (self.target_score - score)), skip = true })

		--괜찮아. 다시 한 번 해보는거야, 파트너!

		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_17', skip = true })

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, yuze)

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
 end



function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil


end

	vector(13, 0, -49.5), vector(14, 0, -49.5)}

	vector(-6, 0, -96.5), vector(-5, 0, -96.5)}

	self.stage_name = "cafe_1_4"

	self.succubus_reset = false

	self.sight_distance = 4.0
	-- 감시 각도
	self.sight_angle = 60

	self.direction_interview = 'right'

	self.clear_interview_time = 50

	self.camera_name = 'interview_camera'
	-- 성공 여부
	self.success_interview = false

	self.interview_req_cnt = 0

	self.rich_goblin_loop = true
	self.interview_2_loop = true

	self.saw_first_interview = false
	self.saw_second_interview = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local rich_goblin = get_character('interview_rich_goblin')
	rich_goblin.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	local customer = get_character('interview_customer')
	customer.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.has_battle_1_start then
			self.has_battle_1_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_start, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_2' and not self.has_battle_2_start then
			self.has_battle_2_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_2_start, self))
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'worrying_demo_zone' then

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(true)
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.has_battle_1_over then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/audio:bgm_cafe_main', state = 'field', mix = 1.5 })

			self.has_battle_1_over = true

			for i = 1, 6 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_1_door_'..i, true))
			end
			local rich_goblin = get_character('interview_rich_goblin')
			rich_goblin.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			rich_goblin.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'interview_1', rich_goblin)
		elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' and not self.has_battle_2_over then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/audio:bgm_cafe_main', state = 'field', mix = 1.5 })

			self.has_battle_2_over = true

			for i = 1, 3 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_2_door_'..i, true))
			end

			local customer = get_character('interview_customer')
			customer.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			customer.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'interview_2', customer)
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(false)
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.has_battle_1_over and not self.saw_first_interview and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('interview_rich_goblin')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_1_over, self))
			return true
		end

		if self.has_battle_2_over and not self.saw_second_interview and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('interview_customer')) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_2_over, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interview_camera_on()
	local interview_camera = get_field_object('interview_camera')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local scale = 0
	interview_camera.Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		scale = time_passed / duration

		interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:interview_camera_off()
	local interview_camera = get_field_object('interview_camera')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local scale = 0
	-- interview_camera.Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		scale = 1 - time_passed / duration
		interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

--- 인터뷰 진행 함수
--- taget : 인터뷰 할 대상 character
--- direction : 유저가 바라보는 방향
function local_class:interview_start(target, direction, start_target_pos)
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()

	screenplay_operations.stage_bgm_transition({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 대상 시작 위치, 방향 설정
	character_util.set_position(target, start_target_pos)

	if direction == 'right' then
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
		-- 플레이어 방향 설정
		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, target.Position + vector(-1.5,0,0))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	elseif direction == 'left' then
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'right')
		-- 플레이어 방향 설정
		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, target.Position + vector(1.5,0,0))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	end

	-- 플레이어 위치로 카메라 이동
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)
	local camera = get_field_object(self.camera_name)
	if direction == 'right' then
		camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -90, 0))
	elseif direction == 'left' then
		camera.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0))
	end
	-- camera.Position = user_party.Leader.Position

	-- 검사 및 그리기를 위해 각도 고정시켜야 함
	self.direction_interview = direction
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, self.direction_interview)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 최초 한번 유저가 카메라를 들게 함
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_TV_on_01')
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(
			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader,
				camera, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.1, false)
		self:interview_camera_on()
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 감시 범위 그리기
	-- 방향 전환 시 다시 그려지는걸 원하지 않으므로 반복 처리에서 attack_range_renderer의 업데이트를 진행하지 않음
	local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(user_party.Leader, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
	attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
	attack_range_renderer:Update(user_party.Leader)

	-- 각종 키 제거
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 미니게임 시작 위해 조작 on
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	local time_passed = 0
	self.clear_interview_time = 50
	self.interview_req_cnt = self.interview_req_cnt + 1

	-- 여기에 랜덤하게 움직이는 루틴 코루틴으로 넣기 가능
	self.interview_move_stop = false
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('interview_rich_goblin')) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_rich_goblin, self))
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('interview_customer')) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_customer, self))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event' })

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 정해진 시간 동안 인터뷰에 성공할 경우
		if time_passed >= self.clear_interview_time then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
			-- 감시 범위 해제
			attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			-- 움직이는 루틴 해제
			self.interview_move_stop = true

			-- anim, 대사 초기화
			character_util.remove_anim(target)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(target)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			-- 카메라 초기화
			command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader,
					camera, vector(1, 0, 0), user_party.Leader.Position, 1, false)
			-- self:interview_camera_off()
			wait_for_sec(1)
			camera.Position = vector(999,0,999)
			break
		end

		-- is_in_sight : 감시 범위 검사를 개별 함수로 처리
		-- 진행 중 대상을 놓칠 경우
		if not self:is_in_sight(user_party.Leader, target) then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
			-- 감시 범위 해제
			attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			-- 움직이는 루틴 해제
			self.interview_move_stop = true

			-- anim, 대사 초기화
			character_util.remove_anim(target)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(target)
			coroutine.yield()

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.look_at(target, user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

			-- target이 고블린이라면
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('interview_rich_goblin')) then
				-- 어이! 나 찍는다고 했잖아!! 어딜 찍는 거야?!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'cafe_interview_goblin_12', skip = true })
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_character('interview_customer')) then
				-- 어이! 인터뷰의 주인공은 나라고!!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(target, { key = 'cafe_interview_customer_13', skip = true })
			end
			character_util.remove_anim(target)

			-- 재시작 후 함수 탈출
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.interview_start, self, target, direction, start_target_pos))
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 플레이어 방향 고정 해제
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'none')

	-- 인터뷰 성공으로 체크
	self.success_interview = true

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized,
			direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_direction(self.direction_interview))) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:moving_rich_goblin()
	local req_cnt = self.interview_req_cnt
	local rich_goblin = get_character('interview_rich_goblin')

	local move_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	move_pos_list:Add(rich_goblin.Position + vector(4,0,0))
	move_pos_list:Add(rich_goblin.Position + vector(4,0,-3))
	move_pos_list:Add(rich_goblin.Position + vector(0,0,-3))
	move_pos_list:Add(rich_goblin.Position)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local time_passed = 1
	local pattern_count = 0
	local move_time = 2.5
	local start_x = rich_goblin.Position.x
	local start_z = rich_goblin.Position.z

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local talk_index = 5
		while not self.interview_move_stop and talk_index <= 11 and req_cnt == self.interview_req_cnt do
			-- 나는 엄청난 부자지만 말이야, 고블린이라고 이곳 저곳에서 차별을 당하곤 해.
			-- 어느 식당에서는 비싼 음식을 시켰다고, 누구 돈 훔친 거냐고 쫓겨나기도 했지.
			-- 하지만...
			-- 서큐버스 카페는 달랐어.
			-- 나를 차별없는 눈으로 바라봐준 유일한 곳이야...
			-- 상처받은 사나이의 마음을 달래주는 유일한 쉼터...
			-- 서큐버스 카페가 최고야!!
			if talk_index == 11 then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			end
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(rich_goblin, { key = 'cafe_interview_goblin_'..talk_index })
			talk_index = talk_index + 1
		end
		-- 클리어 타임 0으로 하면 이미 진행중인 시간이랑 비교해서 작아지므로 성공으로 끝남
		if talk_index > 11 and req_cnt == self.interview_req_cnt then
			self.clear_interview_time = 0
		end
	end))

	while not self.interview_move_stop and self.interview_req_cnt == req_cnt do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= 2.5 then
			time_passed = 0
			pattern_count = pattern_count + 1
			cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			start_x = rich_goblin.Position.x
			start_z = rich_goblin.Position.z
		end

		if time_passed == 0 then
			if pattern_count % 2 == 0 then
				character_util.remove_anim(rich_goblin)
			else
				character_util.set_anim(rich_goblin, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
			end
		end

		-- 움직임 처리
		if pattern_count % 8 == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(rich_goblin, 'right')
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_x,
					move_pos_list[0].x - start_x, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(rich_goblin, vector(cur_x, 0, rich_goblin.Position.z))
		elseif pattern_count % 8 == 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(rich_goblin, 'down')
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_z,
					move_pos_list[1].z - start_z, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(rich_goblin, vector(rich_goblin.Position.x, 0, cur_z))
		elseif pattern_count % 8 == 5 then
			character_util.set_direction(rich_goblin, 'left')
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_x,
					move_pos_list[2].x - start_x, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(rich_goblin, vector(cur_x, 0, rich_goblin.Position.z))
		elseif pattern_count % 8 == 7 then
			character_util.set_direction(rich_goblin, 'up')
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_z,
					move_pos_list[3].z - start_z, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(rich_goblin, vector(rich_goblin.Position.x, 0, cur_z))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end

function local_class:wake_up(character)
	character_util.shake(character, 0.04, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_emotion(character)

	character_util.mario_jump_async(character, character.Direction, 0.5, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

return local_class

	get_character('tinia').Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_3' then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('tinia_event')

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(true)

		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_3' and self.battle_3_over == false then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/audio:bgm_cafe_main', state = 'field', mix = 1.5 })
			
			self.battle_3_over = true
			local tinia = get_character('tinia')
			character_util.convert_to_npc(tinia)
			tinia.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'tinia', tinia)

			for i = 1, 5 do
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_3_door_'..i, true))
			end
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_fight, self))

		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_3' then
			if self.see_tinia_over == false then
				self.see_tinia_over = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.see_tinia_and_fight_against, self))
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(false)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:interview_camera_on()
	local interview_camera = get_field_object('interview_camera')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local scale = 0
	interview_camera.Position = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		scale = time_passed / duration

		interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:interview_camera_off()
	local interview_camera = get_field_object('interview_camera')
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local scale = 0

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		scale = 1 - time_passed / duration

		interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	interview_camera.Position = vector(999, 0, 770)
end

function local_class:interview_start(target, direction, start_target_pos, first_start)

	if not first_start then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		-- 대상 시작 위치, 방향 설정
		character_util.set_position(target, start_target_pos)

		character_util.set_direction(target, 'left')
		-- 플레이어 방향 설정
		character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, target.Position + vector(-1.5,0,0))
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	self.direction_interview = direction
	character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, self.direction_interview)

	-- 감시 범위 그리기
	-- 방향 전환 시 다시 그려지는걸 원하지 않으므로 반복 처리에서 attack_range_renderer의 업데이트를 진행하지 않음
	local attack_range_renderer = CS.Oak.GhostGuardAttackRangeRenderer(user_party.Leader, self.sight_distance, self.sight_angle)
	attack_range_renderer.AttackRange:Show(0)
	attack_range_renderer:Update(user_party.Leader)

	-- 각종 키 제거
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Throw)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 미니게임 시작 위해 조작 on
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	local time_passed = 0
	self.clear_interview_time = 50
	self.interview_req_cnt = self.interview_req_cnt + 1

	self.interview_move_stop = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_golem_rider, self))

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 정해진 시간 동안 인터뷰에 성공할 경우
		if time_passed >= self.clear_interview_time then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
			-- 감시 범위 해제
			attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			-- 움직이는 루틴 해제
			self.interview_move_stop = true

			-- anim, 대사 초기화
			character_util.remove_anim(target)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(target)
			break
		end

		-- is_in_sight : 감시 범위 검사를 개별 함수로 처리
		-- 진행 중 대상을 놓칠 경우
		if not self:is_in_sight(user_party.Leader, target) then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
			-- 감시 범위 해제
			attack_range_renderer:Dispose()
			-- 움직이는 루틴 해제
			self.interview_move_stop = true

			-- anim, 대사 초기화
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(target)
			coroutine.yield()

			-- 재시작 후 함수 탈출
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.interview_start, self, target, direction, start_target_pos, false))
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 인터뷰 성공으로 체크
	self.success_interview = true
end

-- 플레이어가 감시에 보이는지 체크용 함수
function local_class:is_in_sight(fo, target)
	if fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		return false
	end

	local diff = target.Bounds.center - fo.Bounds.center

	if diff.magnitude > self.sight_distance then
		return false
	end

	diff.y = 0

	if unity_class.vector3.Angle(diff.normalized,
			direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_direction(self.direction_interview))) > self.sight_angle / 2 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 인터뷰 할 때 움직이는 골렘라이더
function local_class:moving_golem_rider()
	local golem_rider = get_character('golem_rider')
	local req_cnt = self.interview_req_cnt

	local move_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(0,0,2.5))
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(-2,0,2.5))
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(-2,0,0))
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(-1,0,0))
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(-1,0,-2.5))
	move_pos_list:Add(golem_rider.Position + vector(-1,0,0))

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local time_passed = 2
	local pattern_count = 0
	local move_time = 2
	local start_x = golem_rider.Position.x
	local start_z = golem_rider.Position.z

	while not self.interview_move_stop and pattern_count <= 12 and req_cnt == self.interview_req_cnt do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= 2 then
			time_passed = 0
			pattern_count = pattern_count + 1
			cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			start_x = golem_rider.Position.x
			start_z = golem_rider.Position.z
		end

		if time_passed == 0 then
			if pattern_count % 2 == 0 then
				if pattern_count == 2 then
					-- 정열의 땅에서 온 레이디여, 이 서큐버스 레이디들은 악당이 아니야.
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_1' })
				elseif pattern_count == 4 then
					--이 레이디들은 하루하루 일상에 지쳐있는 우리들을 위로하고,
					character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'left')
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(golem_rider)
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
					character_util.set_emotion(golem_rider, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_2' })
				elseif pattern_count == 6 then
					--상처받은 내 마음을 고루 어루만져주는...
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_point_01')
					character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'right')
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(golem_rider)
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_3' })
				elseif pattern_count == 8 then
					--진정한 사랑의 힘! 그 자체!
					character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'right')
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(golem_rider)
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
					character_util.set_emotion(golem_rider, { name = 'love', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_4' })
				elseif pattern_count == 10 then
					--진정한 사랑의 힘! 그 자체!
					character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'left')
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(golem_rider)
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
					character_util.set_emotion(golem_rider, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_5' })
				elseif pattern_count == 12 then

					--진정한 사랑의 힘! 그 자체!
					character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'right')
					speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(golem_rider)
					character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
					character_util.set_emotion(golem_rider, { name = 'attack', loop = true })
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(golem_rider, { key = 'cafe_s17_19_6' })
				end
			else
				character_util.set_anim(golem_rider, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
			end
		end

		-- 움직임 처리
		if pattern_count == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'up')
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_z,
					move_pos_list[0].z - start_z, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(golem_rider, vector(golem_rider.Position.x, 0, cur_z))
		elseif pattern_count == 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'left')
			local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_x,
					move_pos_list[1].x - start_x, move_time)
			character_util.set_position(golem_rider, vector(cur_x, 0, golem_rider.Position.z))
		elseif pattern_count == 5 then
			character_util.set_direction(golem_rider, 'down')
			local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_z,

local local_class = newclass('CafeMainSection18')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CafeMain @
		Comment = 카페 운영(페이퍼마스크와의 배틀) @
		Index = 17 @
		NextSections = 18 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	self.target_score = 100000

	self.event_progress = {
		none = 0,
		interview_upload = 1,
		cafe_onetime_ask = 2,
		cafe_start = 3,
		cafe_retry = 4,
		cafe_end = 5
	}
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.none

	self.cafe_manage_over = false

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'cafe_1_4'

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()
	if user_party_leader.Position.z >= -1 then
		self:marker_manage(true)
	else
		self:marker_manage(false)
	end

	local succubus_1 = get_character('succubus_1_1')
	local succubus_2 = get_character('succubus_1_2')
	local succubus_3 = get_character('succubus_2_1')
	local succubus_4 = get_character('succubus_2_2')
	local succubus_5 = get_character('golem_succubus_1')
	local succubus_6 = get_character('golem_succubus_2')

	character_util.set_position(succubus_1, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(succubus_2, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(succubus_3, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(succubus_4, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(succubus_5, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(succubus_6, vector(999, 0, 999))

	local golem_rider = get_character('golem_rider')
	character_util.set_position(golem_rider, vector(999, 0, 778))

end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent))

	local yuze = get_character('yuze')
	character_util.set_position(yuze, vector(0.5, 0, 7.5))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')

	if yuze.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		yuze.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(true)

		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('yuze')) then
			-- CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("active state:" .. self.current_progress)

			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interview_upload, self, false))
				return true

			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cafe_manage_start, self, false))
				return true

			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe_zone' then
			self:marker_manage(false)
		end
		return true
	end


	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cafe_event_end, self, e.IsCancelled, e.Sales))

	end

	return false
end


function local_class:interview_upload()
	local yuze = get_character('yuze')
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	stage.FieldUIManager:Hide()
	self.current_progress = self.event_progress.interview_upload

	-- 카페 안 유즈에게 말을 걸면
	character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')
	character_util.align_party(yuze.Position, 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	-- 파트너! 인터뷰는 많이 모아왔어?
	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s18_1', skip = true })

	-- 고개 끄덕하고 카메라를 유즈에게 다시 돌려준다.
	character_util.remove_anim(yuze)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2, keep_anim = false })

	local interview_camera = get_field_object('interview_camera')
	interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	interview_camera.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 270, 0))

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 0.5
	local scale = 0

	local target_pos = yuze.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)
	local start_pos = user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
	interview_camera.Position = start_pos

	-- 카메라 꺼내는 주인공
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_fade_out_05')
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		scale = time_passed / duration

		interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	scale = 1
	interview_camera.Transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'throw', loop = false })

	-- 카메라 유즈에게 토스
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_holdup_01')
	time_passed = 0
	duration = 0.2
	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= duration then
			break
		end

		interview_camera.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:enter()

-- 돌 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_rock_to_target(thrower, target)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(thrower, target)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	local rock_item_id = 20019
	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ itemid = rock_item_id, notforinven = true, pos = thrower.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			  target = target.Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	if not self.throw_rock_stat then return end

	character_util.remove_anim(thrower)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	if not self.throw_rock_stat then return end

	-- 명중에 성공했을 경우 실행
	if (rock.Position - target.Position).magnitude < 0.5 then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_hit_big_01')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

		character_util.spine_pulse_color(target, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(target, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	if not self.throw_rock_stat then return end

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

function local_class:loop_rock_throw(fo, type)
	while self.throw_rock_stat do
		for i = 1, #fo do
			if type then
				if i~= 3 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.random_wait_throw, self, fo[i]))
				end

			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.random_wait_throw, self, fo[i]))

			end
		end
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

end

function local_class:random_wait_throw(fo)
	local paper_mask = get_character('paper_mask')
	local rand_num = random_util.get_random_value() * 0.8
	wait_for_sec(rand_num)
	if not self.throw_rock_stat then return end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_to_target, self, fo, paper_mask))
end



function local_class:change_playable_faker_mask()
	local playable = get_character('faker_mask')
	local user_leader = user_party_leader
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(playable, user_party.Leader) then
		return
	end

	party_util.set_active_state('disabled')
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(playable, param)
	character_util.set_active_state(user_leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(user_leader, vector(99, 0, 99))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.s2_succu_1 = nil
	self.s2_succu_2 = nil
	self.s2_succu_3 = nil
	self.s2_succu_4 = nil
	self.s2_succu_5 = nil
	self.s2_succu_6 = nil
	self.s2_yuze = nil

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'sec2' then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.enter
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = false, fade_in_time = 1, fade_out_time = 2, type_priority = "default"})
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s2_enter, self))
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s2_yuze) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.enter then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.talk
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s2_interact, self))
		end

	end


	return false
end

	if stage.Name == self.stage_name then
		quest_util.load_pool_resource(
				'FX_hit',

				'fx_event_speedline_radiation_camera_fx',

				'fx_event_speedline_stagebg_camera_fx_yellow',
				'fx_punch_proj_loop',
				'fx_event_punch_hit_loop'
	)

		coroutine.yield(self.breaking_news_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/cafe/ui', 'BreakingNews'), function(p)
			local news_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			self.breaking_news = news_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.CafeBreakingNews))
			self.breaking_news.transform:SetParent(stage.UIRoot.transform)
			self.breaking_news:Init('cafe_s21_48') -- 뉴스 속보
			self.breaking_news.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end))
	end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()

end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s21_opening, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self:dispose_breaking_news()

	self.breaking_news_holder = nil
	self.breaking_news = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_switch_on_off_event, self, e))

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_zone_enter_event, self, e))

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_4' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_ending, self, e))
		end

	end

	return false
end

function local_class:ora_bubble()
	local i = 1
	while self.ora_loop do
		local x, y
		if i % 4 == 0 then
			x = -460
			y = 350
		elseif i % 4 == 1 then
			x = 110
			y = -300
		elseif i % 4 == 2 then
			x = 110
			y = 350
		elseif i % 4 == 3 then
			x = -460
			y = -300
		end

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('employee_' .. i % 3 + 1), {
			key='cafe_s21_46', skip = false, scale = self.bubble_scale, screen_pos = vector(x, y)
		, auto_layout = true, bubble_type = 'shout', type_speed = 0 })

		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		i = i + 1
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end
	local switch_1 = get_field_object('prison_open_switch_1')
	local switch_2 = get_field_object('prison_open_switch_2')

	if e.IsTurningOn then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, user_party.Leader) then

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch_1) then
				if self.prison_1_stat then
					return
				else
					self:change_marker(self.event_code.switch_on_off)
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prinson_setting, self, 1)
				end

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch_2) then
				if self.prison_2_stat then
					return
				else
					self:change_marker(self.event_code.switch_on_off)
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.prinson_setting, self, 2)
				end

			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

			if e.Zone.Name == 'prison_zone_1' then
				self:change_marker(self.event_code.zone_enter)
				return true

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'prison_zone_2' then
				self:change_marker(self.event_code.zone_enter)
				return true

			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_4' and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.boss then
				self:change_marker(self.event_code.zone_enter)
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.boss_intro, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_marker(e_code)
	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		return
	end

	local marker_name = 'main_quest_marker'
	local quest_id = self.quest_spec.QuestId
	local is_story = self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest

	if e_code == self.event_code.none then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.prison_1_room then
			self.present_quest_marker_key = marker_name

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(marker_name, quest_id, is_story, vector(53, 0, 4))

		end

	elseif e_code == self.event_code.zone_enter then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.prison_1_room then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.prison_1_switch

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.present_quest_marker_key, vector(49, 0.5, 6))

		elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.prison_2_room then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.prison_2_switch

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.present_quest_marker_key, vector(51, 0.5, 28))

		end

	elseif e_code == self.event_code.switch_on_off then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.prison_1_switch then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.prison_2_room

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.present_quest_marker_key, vector(54.5, 0.5, 30.5))

		elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.prison_2_switch then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.boss

			ui_quest_marker:MoveQuestMarkerToPoint(self.present_quest_marker_key, vector(54.5, 0.5, 46.5))

		end
	end

	return
end

				local pos = self.prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
				character_util.move_waypoint(self.prisoner_list[i], pos, 5, true, nil, nil, 'right')

			else
				local pos = self.prisoner_list[i].Position + vector(-3, 0, 0)
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.prisoner_list[i], pos, 5, true, nil, nil, 'left')

			end
			self.prisoner_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		end
		run_sound:Stop()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_clap_03')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

		for i = 6, 9 do
			character_util.set_emotion(self.prisoner_list[i], {name = 'smile', loop = true})
			character_util.set_anim(self.prisoner_list[i], { name = 'sing', loop = true, scale = 1})

			-- 감사합니다!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.prisoner_list[i], {key='cafe_s21_7', skip = true})
			self.prisoner_list[i].Interactable.Talk = 'cafe_s21_7'
		end
		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		camera_util.move_async(golem_rider.Position, 1, {use_unscaledtime = false, ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = golem_rider})

	end


end

function local_class:move_boss_room_pot(type)
	local count = 18
	local pot_move_x = 120
	local pot_move_z = 100

	for i = 1, count do
		local temp = get_field_object('pot_' .. i)
		table.insert(self.pot_origin_pos, temp.Position)
		if type then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.teleport_fx_name):Instantiate(temp.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		end
		temp.Position = vector(pot_move_x+i, 0, pot_move_z)
	end

end

function local_class:recover_boss_room_pot()
	local count = 18

	for i = 1, count do
		local temp = get_field_object('pot_' .. i)
		temp.Position = self.pot_origin_pos[i]
	end

end

function local_class:random_damaged_anim(karmen)
	local dir = nil

	if rand_dir <= 3 then
		index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
		dir = 'down'
	elseif rand_dir <= 5 then
		index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		dir = 'left'
	elseif rand_dir <= 7 then
		index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
		dir = 'right'

function local_class:random_punch_fx(target_pos, custom_dir)
	local rand_pos_1 = random_util.get_random_value() * 0.3
	local rand_pos_2 = random_util.get_random_value() * 0.1

	local rand_dir = random_util.get_random_int(-30, 30)
	local fx_size = 1

	local dir = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	-- dir = 1

	local fx_pos = vector(0,0,0)

	local num1 = 0.7
	local num2 = 0.5
	local num3 = 0.2


	if custom_dir ~= nil then
		local golem_rider = get_character('golem_rider')

		dir = custom_dir

		rand_pos_1 = 0.25
		rand_pos_2 = 0

		rand_pos_1 = random_util.get_random_value() * 0.5
		-- rand_pos_2 = random_util.get_random_value() * 0.1

		num1 = 0.25
		num2 = 0.15
		num3 = 0.05
		local num4 = 0.05


		if dir == 1 then
			fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_1 - num1, 0.1, rand_pos_2 + num2 + 0.5)
			-- golem_rider.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 4)
			-- golem_rider.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, 0)

			local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
			temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
			temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -90, 0))

		elseif dir == 2 then
			fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_2 + num1, 0.1, rand_pos_1 + num1 - num3)

			local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
			temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
			temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

		elseif dir == 3 then
			fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_2 - num1, 0.1, rand_pos_1 + num1 - num3)

			local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
			temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
			temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -180, 0))

		elseif dir == 4 then
			fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_1 - num1, 0.1, rand_pos_2 + num2)

			local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
			temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
			temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0))
		end

		return

	end


	if dir == 1 then
		fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_1, 0.1, rand_pos_2 - num1)

		local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
		temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
		temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -90, 0))

	elseif dir == 2 then
		fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_2 - num1 - num3 , 0.1, rand_pos_1)

		local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
		temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
		temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))

	elseif dir == 3 then
		fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_2 + num1 + num3, 0.1, rand_pos_1)

		local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
		temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
		temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -180, 0))

	elseif dir == 4 then
		fx_pos = target_pos + vector(rand_pos_1, 0.1, rand_pos_2 + num1 + num2)

		local temp_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.punch_fx_name):Instantiate(fx_pos)
		temp_fx.transform.localScale = vector(fx_size, fx_size, fx_size)
		temp_fx.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0))
	end

end

function local_class:break_obj()
	local karmen = get_character('karmen')
	local count = 1
	while count <= 14 do
		local check = false
		if karmen.Position.z >= 57 and count < 2 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 61 and count < 4 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 65 and count < 6 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 70 and count < 8 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 75 and count < 10 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 77 and count < 12 then
			check = true
		elseif karmen.Position.z >= 81 and count < 14 then
			check = true
		end

		if check then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_mech_stomp_01')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_explosion_01")

			karmen.SpineController:DamageSquish(0.3)
			karmen.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
			get_field_object('obj_karmen_' .. count).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			get_field_object('obj_karmen_' .. count + 1).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.crash_fx_name):Instantiate(karmen.Position)
			count = count + 2
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.crash_fx_name):Instantiate(karmen.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return false
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		self:quest_marker(e.Zone.Name)
		if e.Zone.Name == 'cafe_old' then
			if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
				self.current_progress = self.event_progress.talk
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.merchant_3, self))
			end
		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s3_teacher) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cleaned then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.carry
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.s3_teacher.Name)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.carry, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s3_yuze) and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.carry then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.ready
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local chk = false
		for i = 1, 30 do
			if i ~= 17 then
				if get_field_object('cafe_break_'..i).ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
					chk = true
				end
			end
			if chk == true then
				break
			end
		end
		if chk == false and self.current_progress ~= self.event_progress.cleaned then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.cleaned
			self.yuze_is_moving = false
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.s3_yuze.Name)
			--quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.s3_teacher.Name, self.s3_teacher)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.s3_teacher.Name, vector(-12.5, 0, 99.5))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cleaned, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GamepadEvent) then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown then
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown then
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:quest_marker(nm)
	local yuze = get_character('yuze')
	local teacher = get_character('succu_teacher')

	if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		if nm == 'cafe' or nm == 'cafe_old' or nm == 'cafe_music' then
			quest_marker_util.remove(yuze.Name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, vector(-12.5, 0, 110))
		else
			quest_marker_util.remove(yuze.Name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, yuze.Name, vector(0.5, 0, 76))
		end
	elseif self.current_progress == self.event_progress.cleaned then
		if nm == 'cafe' or nm == 'cafe_old' or nm == 'cafe_music' then
			quest_marker_util.remove(teacher.Name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, teacher.Name, vector(-12.5, 0, 99.5))
		else
			quest_marker_util.remove(teacher.Name)
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, teacher.Name, teacher)
		end
	end
end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.s3_yuze)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.s3_yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s3_55', user.Name), skip = true })

	-- 어서 가구들을 카페로 옮기자!
	character_util.set_anim(self.s3_yuze, {name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.s3_yuze, { key = 'cafe_s3_56', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_yuze)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ready, self))


	--[[
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_2)

	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_1, vector(39, 0, 112))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_2, vector(39, 0, 111))

	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_4, vector(38, 0, 112))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_5, vector(38, 0, 111))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_6, vector(38, 0, 110))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_yuze, vector(41, 0, 111))
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(42, 0, 111))

	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_7, vector(999,0,999))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_8, vector(999,0,999))
