-- 가구 옮기기 미니게임
function local_class:mini_game()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 클리어 여부
	self.is_clear = false

	-- 마커 위치로 정렬
	local marker_pos = field:GetMarker('mini_game_pos').position

	-- 유저 왼쪽에서 전달 해줄 캐릭터
	local user_left_characer = self.s3_succu_4
	local user_right_character = self.s3_succu_5

	-- 현재까지 옮긴 가구 수
	local mission_count = 0

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_4)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_6)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_7)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.s3_succu_8)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	self.s3_succu_1.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.s3_succu_2.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.s3_succu_3.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.s3_succu_4.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.s3_succu_5.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.s3_succu_6.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local distance = 2
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_1, marker_pos + vector(distance * -4, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_2, marker_pos + vector(distance * -3, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_3, marker_pos + vector(distance * -2, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_4, marker_pos + vector(distance * -1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, marker_pos)
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_5, marker_pos + vector(distance * 1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_6, marker_pos + vector(distance * 1, 0, distance * 1))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_7, marker_pos + vector(distance * 1, 0, distance * 2))
	character_util.set_position(self.s3_succu_8, marker_pos + vector(distance * 1, 0, distance * 3))

	-- UI 버튼 셋업 -- 임시
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)
	local left_button = nil
	local right_button = nil

	local left_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + 149, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	local right_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - 149, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	local button_scale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	if game_string.IsRTL then
		left_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - 149, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		right_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + 149, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		button_scale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
	end

	-- 임시 설정
	local stage_item_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('cafe_mini_game_arrow'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(stage_item_obj.transform, "FieldUI")
	stage_item_obj.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos
	stage_item_obj.transform.localScale = button_scale
	stage_item_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
	left_button = stage_item_obj

	local stage_item_obj2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("cafe_mini_game_arrow"):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(stage_item_obj2.transform, "FieldUI")
	stage_item_obj2.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos
	stage_item_obj2.transform.localScale = button_scale
	right_button = stage_item_obj2

	-- play_game
	local left_button_pos = left_button.transform.localPosition
	local right_button_pos = right_button.transform.localPosition

	local left_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
	left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(200, 200)

	local right_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
	right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(200, 200)

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	local time_passed = 0
	local pattern_time = 0
	local pattern_time2 = 0

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크용
	local left_pressed = left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local right_pressed = right_button_touch_handler.Pressed

	-- 게임 시작 시 유저 방향(오른쪽) 으로 설정
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	self.is_left_dir = false

	-- 게임 오버 타임 체크
	local over_time = 2
	local current_time = 0
	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_ride', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		pattern_time = pattern_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		pattern_time2 = pattern_time2 + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 버튼 눌려 지는 Animation용
		local left_down = false
		local left_up = false
		local right_down = false
		local right_up = false

		-- 버튼이 눌러졌는지 체크 코드
		local current_left_pressed = left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

		local current_right_pressed = right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
				or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
		self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

		left_button_touch_handler:Update()
		right_button_touch_handler:Update()

		if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
			if current_left_pressed then
				left_down = true
			else
				left_up = true
			end
			left_pressed = current_left_pressed
		end

		if current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
			if current_right_pressed then
				right_down = true
			else
				right_up = true
			end
			right_pressed = current_right_pressed
		end

		-- 왼쪽 눌렸다면
		if left_down then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_snowball_throw_01')
			left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)
			--left_state:SetAnimation(0, "blue_touch_on", false)
			self:set_button_tint(left_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1,0.7921,0.3647, 1}),unity_color({0,0,0,0.5}))
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
			self.is_left_dir = true
		elseif left_up then
			left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos
			self:set_button_tint(left_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({1,1,1,0.2}),unity_color({0,0,0,0.5}))
		end

		-- 오른쪽 눌렸다면
		if right_down then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_snowball_throw_01')
			right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)
			self:set_button_tint(right_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1,0.7921,0.3647, 1}),unity_color({0,0,0,0.5}))
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
			self.is_left_dir = false
		elseif right_up then
			right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos
			self:set_button_tint(right_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
					unity_color({1,1,1,0.2}),unity_color({0,0,0,0.5}))
		end

		local left_current_state = user_left_characer.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		local user_current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(left_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			-- 유저 왼쪽 캐릭터가 물건을 들고 있을 경우
			if self.hold_up_req_count == self.cur_hold_up_req_count then
				self.cur_hold_up_req_count = self.cur_hold_up_req_count + 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)
					character_util.set_direction(user_left_characer, 'right')

					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(user_left_characer, over_time))
					while true do
						current_time = current_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
						local hold_target = left_current_state.HoldTarget
						local succu_dir = (user_party.Leader.Position - user_left_characer.Position):ToDirection()

						if self.is_left_dir and
								not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
								, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
							current_time = 0
							character_util.remove_emotion(user_left_characer)
							character_util.stop_shake(user_left_characer)
							message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_left_characer))

							command_util.execute_throw(user_left_characer,
									hold_target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(succu_dir),
									user_party.Leader.Position, 2, true)
							wait_for_sec(0.2)

							command_util.execute_holdup(user_party.Leader,
									hold_target, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.2, false)
							wait_for_sec(0.2)
							self.hold_up_req_count = self.hold_up_req_count + 1
							return
						end

						-- 실패 시
						if current_time >= over_time then
							current_time = 0
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_bomb_holdup_fail_01')
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
							character_util.shake(user_left_characer, 0.02, 2)
							character_util.set_emotion(user_left_characer, { name = 'scared' })
							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_left_characer, {
								key = 'cafe_s3_minigame_1' })
						end
						coroutine.yield()
					end
				end, self))
			end
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(user_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			-- 유저가 물건을 들고 있을 경우
			if self.throw_req_count == self.cur_throw_req_count then
				self.cur_throw_req_count = self.cur_throw_req_count + 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, over_time))
					character_util.set_direction(user_right_character, 'left')

					while true do
						current_time = current_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
						local hold_target = user_current_state.HoldTarget
						local succu_dir = (user_party.Leader.Position - user_right_character.Position):ToDirection()

						if not self.is_left_dir and
								not lua_helper.type_compare(user_right_character.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
								, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
							current_time = 0
							character_util.remove_emotion(user_right_character)
							character_util.remove_anim(user_right_character)
							message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))
							character_util.set_direction(user_right_character, succu_dir)


							command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader,
									hold_target, unity_class.vector3.right,
									user_right_character.Position, 2, true)
							wait_for_sec(0.2)

							command_util.execute_holdup(user_right_character,
									hold_target, user_right_character.Position, 0.2, false)
							wait_for_sec(0.2)
							self.throw_req_count = self.throw_req_count + 1
							return
						end

						-- 실패 시
						if current_time >= over_time then
							current_time = 0
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
							music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
							character_util.set_emotion(user_right_character, { name = 'attack' })
							character_util.set_anim(user_right_character, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
							speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_right_character, {
								key = 'cafe_s3_minigame_2' })
						end
						coroutine.yield()
					end
				end, self))
			end
		end

		-- 일정 시간 마다 첫 번째 npc에게 물건을 쥐어줌
		if not lua_helper.type_compare(self.s3_succu_1.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and time_passed >= 2 and self.furniture_count > mission_count then
			time_passed = 0
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				command_util.execute_holdup(self.s3_succu_1,
						self.furniture_list[mission_count], self.s3_succu_1.Position, 0.2, false)
				mission_count = mission_count + 1
				wait_for_sec(0.2)

				if mission_count == 3 then
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.s3_succu_3, {
						key = 'cafe_s3_minigame_3'})
				elseif mission_count == 6 then
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.s3_succu_6, {
						key = 'cafe_s3_minigame_4'})
				elseif mission_count == 9 then
					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.s3_succu_3, {
						key = 'cafe_s3_minigame_5'})
				end
			end, self))
		end

		if pattern_time2 > 0.4 then
			pattern_time2 = 0
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.move_furniture, self, 5, 7, user_left_characer))
		end

		if pattern_time >= 0.8 then
			pattern_time = 0
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
					self.move_furniture, self, 1, 3, user_left_characer))
		end

		-- 미션 성공 시점
		if self.clear_count == self.furniture_count then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 성공 여부에 따라 다르게
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local succu = get_character('succu_'..i)
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(succu, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(succu, 'left')
		end
		character_util.set_emotion(succu, { name = 'awesome' })
		character_util.set_anim(succu, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 관련 변수 및 상태 초기화
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local succu = get_character('succu_'..i)
		local cur_state = succu.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.type_compare(cur_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			local hold_target = cur_state.HoldTarget
			command_util.execute_throw(succu,
					hold_target, unity_class.vector3.right,
					succu.Position, 0, false)
		end
	end

	local cur_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(cur_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = cur_state.HoldTarget
		command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader,
				hold_target, unity_class.vector3.right,
				user_party.Leader.Position, 0, false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- UI 해제
	left_button:Dispose()
	right_button:Dispose()
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	for i = 0, self.furniture_count - 1 do
		self.furniture_list[i].Position = vector(999,0,999)
	end

	self.is_clear = true
end

-- 서큐버스가 가구 옮기는 루틴
function local_class:move_furniture(pre, next, user_left_characer)
	-- 서큐버스 카운트 임의 상수로 함
	for i = pre, next do
		local pre_succu = get_character('succu_' .. i)
		local next_succu = get_character('succu_' .. i + 1)

		-- 가구를 들고 있는 캐릭터가 유저의 왼쪽 캐릭터가 아닐 경우에는 자동으로 옮겨준다
		local pre_succu_current_state = pre_succu.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		local next_succu_current_state = next_succu.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState

		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(pre_succu, user_left_characer) and
				not lua_helper.type_compare(next_succu_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) and
				lua_helper.type_compare(pre_succu_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			local pre_succu_dir = (next_succu.Position - pre_succu.Position):ToDirection()
			local next_succu_dir = (pre_succu.Position - next_succu.Position):ToDirection()
			character_util.set_direction(pre_succu, pre_succu_dir)
			character_util.set_direction(next_succu, next_succu_dir)

			local hold_target = pre_succu_current_state.HoldTarget

			command_util.execute_throw(pre_succu,
					hold_target, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(pre_succu_dir),
					next_succu.Position, 2, false)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
			command_util.execute_holdup(next_succu, hold_target, next_succu.Position, 0.2, false)
			break
		end

		-- 마지막 서큐버스가 물건을 들었을 경우를 재검사
		next_succu_current_state = next_succu.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(next_succu, self.s3_succu_8) and
				lua_helper.type_compare(next_succu_current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			local hold_target = next_succu_current_state.HoldTarget

			self.clear_count = self.clear_count + 1
			command_util.execute_throw(next_succu,
					hold_target, vector(1,0,0),
					next_succu.Position + vector(0,0,2), 5, false)
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:move_item(item, start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		item.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / final_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:rotate_item(item, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local final_duration = duration

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed >= final_duration then
			break
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / final_duration)

		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 360 * 3 * progress))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:item_scale_up(drop_item, duration)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local start_scale = drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale.x

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local start_size = (1 - start_scale) * (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration + start_scale

		drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_size
		drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * start_size

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CafeMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CafeMain @
		Comment = 에밀리가 팬들끼리 싸움을 붙이고 정기를 빼앗음 @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.laugh_over = false

	self.battle_1_start = false
	self.battle_1_over = false
	self.after_battle_scene_start = false

	self.drained_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'cafe_1_2'

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()

end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'laughing_zone' and self.laugh_over == false then
			self.laugh_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.world_cloud_preset,
			self.controller, {'cafe_s6_0_0', 'cafe_s6_0_1', 'cafe_s6_0_0_1', 'cafe_s6_0_0_2', 'cafe_s6_0_2'}, 0.05, 0.2, 32, 64, false))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'BATTLE_1' and not self.battle_1_start then
			self.battle_1_start = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_start, self))

		end

		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_1' and self.battle_1_over == false then
			self.battle_1_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_battle_emily_drain_power, self))

		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

local local_class = newclass('CafeMainSection8')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @

		Comment = 비앙카를 직원으로 영입함. @

]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	self.drained_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)

	self.is_bianca_door_open = false

	self.battle_2_over = false

	self.is_quiz_start = false

	--비밀의 방 들어갔는지
	self.is_secret_room_enter = false

	self.photo_interact_count = 0
	self.photo_interact_list = {false, false, false, false}

	self.succubus_school_pos = {vector(9, 0, 47.5), vector(6, 0, 47.5), vector(7, 0, 47.277), vector(8, 0, 47.277),
	vector(9, 0, 46.5), vector(6, 0, 46.5), vector(7, 0, 46.277), vector(8, 0, 46.277), vector(9.7, 0, 48.2),
	vector(9.7, 0, 47.2), vector(5.3, 0, 48.2), vector(5.3, 0, 47.2), vector(4.5, 0, 47.7), vector(7.5, 0, 45.5), vector(10.5, 0, 47.7)}

	self.school_zone_over = false

	self.stage_name = 'cafe_1_2'

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	lua_helper.call_interface(self.yuze_photo, 'System.IDisposable', 'Dispose')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bianca')) then
			if not self.is_quiz_start then
				self.is_quiz_start = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quiz_start, self))
				return true
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_bianca, self))
				return true
			end
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bianca_guard_1')) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bianca_guard_2'))
		or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bianca_guard_1_1')) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('bianca_guard_1_2')) then
			if not self.is_bianca_door_open then
				self.is_bianca_door_open = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_door_event, self))
			end
		else
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local yuze_photo = get_field_object('yuze_photo_'..i)
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, yuze_photo) then
					yuze_photo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
					ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('yuze_photo_'..i)
					self.photo_interact_list[i] = true
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.photo_interact, self))
					break
				end
			end

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'secret_room' and not self.is_secret_room_enter then
			self.is_secret_room_enter = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.secret_room_enter, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'bianca_house' then
			self:marker_manage(true, e.Zone.Name)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe' then
			self:marker_manage(true, e.Zone.Name)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'yuze_photo_out_zone'
				and not self.yuze_photo_out_over and self.is_quiz_start then
			self.yuze_photo_out_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.yuze_photo_out, self))

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'school_zone' and not self.school_zone_over then
			self.school_zone_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.school_event, self))

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'bianca_house' then
			self:marker_manage(false, e.Zone.Name)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe' then
			self:marker_manage(false, e.Zone.Name)
		end
		return true
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'BATTLE_2' and self.battle_2_over == false then
			self.battle_2_over = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_battle_emily_drain_power, self))

		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:yuze_photo_out()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_paper_01')
	local x_integ_func = function(t)
	   return -3 * t ^ 3 + 4.5 * t ^ 2 + 1.5 * t
	end

	local y_integ_func = function(t)
	   return 0.75 * t ^ 2 - 1.5 * t + 1.5
	end

	local x_func = function(sec)
	   if sec < 1 then
		  return x_integ_func(sec)
	   elseif sec < 2 then
		  return x_integ_func(1) + x_integ_func(sec - 1)
	   else
		  return x_integ_func(1) * 2
	   end
	end

	local y_func = function(sec)
	   if sec < 1 then
		  return y_integ_func(sec)
	   elseif sec < 2 then
		  return y_integ_func(sec - 1) - 0.75
	   else
		  return 0
	   end
	end

	local start_pos = vector(71.5, 1.5, 101.5)
	self.first_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
	   {itemid = 20203, notforinven = true, pos = start_pos,
		  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true, sprscale = 0.4})

	local duration = 2
	local time_passed = 0

	while true do
	   time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	   if time_passed > duration then
		  break
	   end

	   self.first_item.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(
			 start_pos + vector(x_func(time_passed), 0, 0), y_func(time_passed))
	   coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.first_item.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(
		  start_pos + vector(x_func(duration), 0, 0), y_func(duration))
 end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = self.controller.cs_controller

	self.target_score = 10000

	self.talk_to_yuze_count = 0

	-- 현재 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name = 'cafe_1_2'

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then return end

	self:object_setting()

end

function local_class:exit()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent))

	local yuze = get_character('yuze')

	if yuze.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		yuze.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('yuze')) then
			self.talk_to_yuze_count = self.talk_to_yuze_count + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cafe_manage_start, self, false))
			return true
		end
	end


	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'bianca_house' then
			self:marker_manage(true, e.Zone.Name)

		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe' then
			self:marker_manage(true, e.Zone.Name)

		end
	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cafe_event_end, self, e.IsCancelled, e.Sales))

	end

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'bianca_house' then
			self:marker_manage(false, e.Zone.Name)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and e.Zone.Name == 'succubus_cafe' then
			self:marker_manage(false, e.Zone.Name)
		end
		return true
	end


	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

		--유즈!!!
		character_util.normal_jump(bianca, '01_small_jump_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(bianca, { name = 'smile', loop = true })

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(bianca, {bianca.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), yuze.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)}, 6, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'left')

		character_util.shake(bianca, 0.03, 0.3)

		character_util.normal_jump_async(bianca, '01_player_jump_01')

		character_util.set_direction(bianca, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(bianca, { name = 'blush', loop = true })

		--라이벌이 간곡히 부탁하길래 어쩔 수 없이 왔을 뿐이다!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_anim(bianca, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bianca, { key = 'cafe_s9_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		--절대 약점 잡혀서 그런거 아니니까!!
		character_util.set_anim(bianca, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bianca, { key = 'cafe_s9_6_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

		--고마워!! 비앙카!!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'nod', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_7', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(bianca)
		character_util.set_emotion(bianca, { name = 'smile', loop = true })

		character_util.set_direction(bianca, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(bianca, { name = 'idle', loop = true })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		--파트너! 역시 널 지배인으로 모셔오길 잘 했는 걸?
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'idle', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_8', skip = true })

		--정말 어려운 친구인데, 설득해내다니...
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'sing', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_9', skip = true })

		--정말 대단해!!
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_10', skip = true })

		--그럼 바로 장사를 시작해볼까?
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_11', skip = true })

		--선택지
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		local wait_for_branch = true
		--네
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('cafe_s9_12'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 1
			end
		})
		--아니오
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('cafe_s9_13'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				choice = 0
			end
		})
		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = yuze

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	else

		--어때, 이제 장사 시작할 준비 됐어?
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'bomb_idle', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_14', skip = true })

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false

			end

		--아니오

			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false

			end

		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = yuze

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)
		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(yuze)
	end

	--선택지 준비 됐어?
	if choice == 1 then

		--좋아! 에밀리를 이기기 위해서는 매출이 {0}정기는 되어야 해.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s9_15', self.target_score), skip = true })

		--영업 시작해 보자구!
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_16', skip = true })

		--카페 운영 시작.
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeStartEvent.Create(self.target_score))

	else
		--인터랙트 종료.
		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

 end

 function local_class:cafe_event_end(iscancelled, score)
	local yuze = get_character('yuze')

	if score >= self.target_score then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('yuze')

		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	elseif iscancelled then
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		--준비되면 언제든지 말해줘, 파트너!
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_20', skip = true })

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()

	else
		camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
		character_util.set_direction(yuze, 'down')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/audio:bgm_world_map_06', state = 'event', mix = 1.5 })
		screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

		--목표는 {0}정기였는데... {1}정기밖에 못 벌었어...
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'tired', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s9_18', self.target_score, score), skip = true })

		--{0}정기가 부족했어.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = game_string:Format('cafe_s9_19', (self.target_score - score)), skip = true })

		--괜찮아. 다시 한 번 해보는거야, 파트너!
		character_util.set_anim(yuze, { name = 'cast2', loop = true })
		character_util.set_emotion(yuze, { name = 'smile', loop = true })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(yuze, { key = 'cafe_s9_17', skip = true })

		stage.FieldUIManager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
 end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('CafePrincessSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = CafePrincess @
		Comment = 꼬마공주 스타피스 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then
		return
	end

	local princess = get_character('princess')
	character_util.add_listener(princess, self.controller)

	local succubus1 = get_character('princess_succubus_1')
	character_util.add_listener(succubus1, self.controller)

	local succubus2 = get_character('princess_succubus_2')
	character_util.add_listener(succubus2, self.controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local interacters = { get_character('princess'), get_character('princess_succubus_1'), get_character('princess_succubus_2') }
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, interacters) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_to_princess, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:interact_to_princess()
	local princess = get_character('princess')
	local succubus1 = get_character('princess_succubus_1')
	local succubus2 = get_character('princess_succubus_2')

	character_util.remove_relate_event(princess, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(succubus1, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(succubus2, self.controller)

	party_util.align_party(princess, 'right')

	-- 어머~ 손님! 정말 어른스러우시네요!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus1, {key = 'cafe_princess_1', skip = true})

	-- 음료는 어떤 걸로 드릴까요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus2, {key = 'cafe_princess_2', skip = true})

	 -- 차가운 우유? 아니면 따뜻한 우유?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(succubus1, {key = 'cafe_princess_2_1', skip = true})

	-- 어허! 누굴 어린애로 보나!
	princess:SetEmotion('attack', true)
	princess:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.normal_double_jump(princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_2_2', skip = true})

	-- 여기 탄산 보리차 한 잔!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	princess:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(princess, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_2_3', skip = true})
	princess:RemoveAnimation()

	-- 앗! {0}...
	character_util.look_at(princess, user_party.Leader)
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	princess:RemoveAnimation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = game_string:Format('cafe_princess_4', user.Name), skip = true})

	-- ...이 아니라. 반갑네! 자네도 드림 테라피를 즐기러 온 모양이지?
	princess:RemoveEmotion()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_5', skip = true})

	-- 에헴! 나같은 어른에게는 이런 정신적 힐링이 꼭 필요하지!
	princess:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_6', skip = true})

	-- 흠흠! 자네같은 젊은이도 힘든 일이 많나보군.
	princess:RemoveAnimation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_7', skip = true})

	-- 힘내라고 선물 하나 줌세.
	princess:SetAnimation('release', true)
	character_util.add_animation_sfx(princess, '01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_8', skip = true})
	princess:RemoveAnimation()

	local star_piece = get_field_object('princess_star_piece')
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(princess.Position + unity_class.vector3.up, false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 아, 사양할 필욘 없네. 난 어른이니까.
	princess:SetEmotion('doyagao', true)
	princess:SetAnimation('cross_arm', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_9', skip = true})

	-- 진짜 멋쟁이 어른들만이 이런 선물들도 척척 내 주는 법이지!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	princess:SetAnimation('get', true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_10', skip = true})


	-- 그럼, 자네도 즐거운 테라피 즐기시게!
	princess:RemoveAnimation()
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'cafe_princess_11', skip = true})

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	-- 여기 탄산 보리차 한 잔!
	princess.Direction = character_util.get_direction('left')
	princess:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	princess:SetAnimation('seat', true)
	princess.Interactable.Talk = 'cafe_princess_2_3'

	-- 어머~ 손님! 정말 어른스러우시네요!
	succubus1.Interactable.Talk = 'cafe_princess_1'
	succubus2.Interactable.Talk = 'cafe_princess_1'
end

return local_class
